Shri Krishna keh rahe hain ki jo log sirf apne liye jeete hain — sirf apna faida dekhte hain — unhe is duniya mein bhi chain nahi milta. Kyunki dena hi woh raasta hai jisse andar ki bhoook mit-ti hai, lena se nahi.

Aur jo log dete hain — apna kuch nishwarth dete hain — woh ek gehri shanti aur ek badi taaqat ko praapt karte hain. Wahi amrit hai. Wahi Brahm ka raasta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo sirf apne liye jeeta hai, use is duniya mein bhi sukh nahi milta — asli chain dene mein hai, lene mein nahi.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं बहुविधा यज्ञा वितता ब्रह्मणो मुखे ।
कर्मजान्विद्धि तान्सर्वानेवं ज्ञात्वा विमोक्ष्यसे ॥
verses.transliteration:
Evam Bahuvidhaa Yajnaa Vitataa Brahmano Mukhe,
Karmajaanviddhi Taansarvanevam Jnaatva Vimokshyase.
verses.englishMeaning: Thus, many kinds of yajnas (sacrifices) are described in the Vedas. Know all of them to be born of action — born of the body, mind and deeds. Knowing this truth fully, you shall attain liberation.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Iss tarah se Vedic shaastron mein anek prakar ke yajna bataye gaye hain — alag-alag tarike, alag-alag raaste.

Lekin Shri Krishna ek badi baat keh rahe hain: ye sab karm se paida hote hain — yaani har yajna ek karm hai. Aur jab tum yeh sach jaano — ki har karm ek yajna ban sakta hai — tab tum mukti ki taraf badhte ho.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna yahan ek bahut khoobsoorat sach kholte hain — seva ka koi ek hi roop nahi hota.

Koi puja karta hai, koi padhaata hai, koi apna maal daan karta hai, koi apna khoon-pasina deta hai. Har ek apni jagah ek yajna hai — agar bhaav sachcha ho.

Aur sabse zaroori baat — yeh sab karm se hota hai, sirf baithne se nahi. Kuch karna padta hai, kuch dena padta hai. Jab yeh samajh aa jaati hai, tab insaan ka har kaam ek pooja ban jaata hai. Aur isi samajh mein mukti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Seva ka koi ek roop nahi hota — jo bhi tum sachche bhaav se karo, woh yajna hai aur wahi tumhara raasta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रेयान्द्रव्यमयाद्यज्ञाज्ज्ञानयज्ञः परन्तप ।
सर्वं कर्माखिलं पार्थ ज्ञाने परिसमाप्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Shreyan Dravyamayaad Yajnaaj Jnana Yajnah Parantapa,
Sarvam Karmakhilam Partha Jnane Parisamapyate.
verses.englishMeaning: O scorcher of foes! The yajna of knowledge is superior to any yajna performed with material offerings. O Partha, all actions without exception culminate in knowledge — knowledge is the ultimate goal of all karm.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Hey Parantapa — dushmanon ko bhi ghabra dene wale Arjun! Cheez-vastuo se ki gayi pooja se kahin zyada shrestha hai gyaan ka yajna — yaani sachchi samajh aur andar ki jagriti.

Aur Hey Partha! Sabhi karmon ka — poora ka poora — ek hi ant hota hai: gyaan. Har karm tumhe andar ki roshan-i ki taraf le jaata hai, agar sahi bhaav se kiya jaaye.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna yahan ek gehri baat keh rahe hain — jo cheez bahar se di jaaye, woh seeemit hai. Paisa, sona, anaj — sab khatam ho jaate hain.

Lekin jo gyaan andar se mile — sachchi samajh — woh kabhi khatam nahi hoti. Woh tum par hamesha ke liye naqsh ho jaati hai.

Aur sabse sundar baat — har karm, chahe bada ho ya chhota, chahe saadharan ho ya khaas — agar sachche mann se kiya jaaye, toh woh ant mein gyaan ki taraf hi le jaata hai. Karm ka aakhri mukaam sirf gyaan hai — andar ki samajh.
verses.lifeLesson: Paisa ya cheezein dekar ki gayi seva bhi achhi hai, par sachcha gyaan dena ya paana — woh sabse bada daan hai jo koi de ya le sakta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्विद्धि प्रणिपातेन परिप्रश्नेन सेवया ।
उपदेक्ष्यन्ति ते ज्ञानं ज्ञानिनस्तत्त्वदर्शिनः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tad Viddhi Pranipaten Pariprashnena Sevaya,
Upadekshyanti Te Jnaanam Jnaaninas Tattvadarsinah.
verses.englishMeaning: Seek to know that knowledge by approaching a Self-realized teacher with deep reverence, sincere questioning, and selfless service. Such enlightened seers — those who have truly seen the Truth — will impart that knowledge to you.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Yeh gyaan — jo har karm se shreshtha hai — ise paane ka raasta bata rahe hain Krishna.

Pehle: Pranipat — sachchi vinamrata ke saath jaao. Apna ahankar peeche chhod ke.
Doosra: Pariprashn — sachche sawaal poocho. Dikhawa nahi, sachchi jigyasa ke saath.
Teesra: Seva — apni mehnat aur prem guru ko do.

Aur jo log sachchi realityको jaante hain — tattvadarshi gyaani — woh tumhe yeh gyaan denge.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok Gita ka ek sabse zaroori shlok hai — kyunki yeh batata hai ki gyaan kaise milta hai.

Teen cheezein chahiye: pehli — vinamrata. Ahankar ke saath koi bhi gyaan andar nahi jaata. Doosri — sachche sawaal. Aage badhne ke liye sachchi jigyasa chahiye, dikhawa nahi. Teesri — seva. Guru ki seva sirf kaam karna nahi — iska matlab hai apna prem aur samarpan dena.

Aur jab yeh teeno ek saath hoti hain, tab jo sachmuch jaanta hai woh khud tum tak pahunch jaata hai — aur gyaan deta hai jo hamesha ke liye tumhara ho jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Gyaan sirf padhne se nahi milta — sachchi vinamrata, sachche sawaal aur sachchi seva se milta hai. Ahankar ka darvaza band hota hai, vinamrata ka khula.

verses.sanskrit:
यज्ज्ञात्वा न पुनर्मोहमेवं यास्यसि पाण्डव ।
येन भूतान्यशेषाणि द्रक्ष्यस्यात्मन्यथो मयि ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yaj Jnaatvaa Na Punar Moham Evam Yaasyasi Paandava,
Yena Bhootaany Asheshaani Drakshyasy Aatmany Atho Mayi.
verses.englishMeaning: Having known this, O Pandava, you will not fall into delusion again like this. And through this knowledge, you shall see all beings — without exception — first within your own Self, and then within Me.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Hey Pandava! Yeh jo gyaan main de raha hoon — ise sachchi tarah jaankar tum dubara is tarah ke moha — is tarah ki bewajah bhatkan — mein nahi padoge.

Aur ek aur gehri baat: is gyaan ke zariye tum har jeev ko — har insaan ko, har prani ko — pehle apne andar dekhoge, aur phir mujh mein dekhoge.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok ek anokha wada hai jo Krishna Arjun se karte hain — ki ek din aayega jab tum dobara confuse nahi honge.

Lekin usse bhi badi baat jo Krishna keh rahe hain: yeh gyaan tumhari aankhon ko badal dega. Tum duniya ko alag nazar se dekhne lagoge. Har insaan mein — bhale bura, ameer garib, dost dushman — tum ek hi jyot dekhoge. Pehle apne andar, phir sab mein.

Yeh woh nazar hai jab insaan sachchi duniya dekhta hai — jab farq mitne lagte hain aur ek gehra prem poori duniya ke liye dil mein jaagna shuru hota hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sachcha gyaan sirf confusion door nahi karta — woh aankhein bhi badal deta hai. Phir har jagah apna hi dikhta hai, begaana koi nahi rehta.

verses.sanskrit:
अपि चेदसि पापेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यः पापकृत्तमः ।
सर्वं ज्ञानप्लवेनैव वृजिनं सन्तरिष्यसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
Api Ched Asi Paapebhyah Sarvebhyah Paapakrit Tamah,
Sarvam Jnaana Plavenaiva Vrujinam Santarishyasi.
verses.englishMeaning: Even if you are the most sinful of all sinners, you shall cross over all sin by the boat of knowledge alone — without doubt, without exception.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Hey Arjun! Agar tum sabse bade paapi bhi hote — sabse bura kaam karne wale — tab bhi gyaan ki naav tumhe poore paap ke samandar se paar kar deti.

Yeh ek unconditional wada hai. Koi bhi insaan — kuch bhi kiya ho — agar sachchi samajh aur sachchi badlaav ki taraf mud jaaye, toh gyaan uski naav ban jaata hai aur woh paar ho jaata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok unke liye hai jo sochte hain — maine itna bura kiya hai, ab mera koi future nahi.

Shri Krishna bahut seedhi baat keh rahe hain: koi insaan itna nahi gir sakta ki gyaan ki roshni usse nahi pahunch sake. Gyaan ek naav hai — aur woh naav sabke liye hai. Sirf sawaar hone ki zaroorat hai.

Yeh shlok ummeed ka shlok hai. Yeh kehta hai ki koi bhi insaan apni galtiyon ka bojh utha ke hamesha ke liye nahi dab sakta — ek baar sachchi samajh aaye, toh sab saaf ho sakta hai. Shuruaat karna hamesha mumkin hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Koi bhi insaan apni galtiyon se itna bada nahi hota ki sachche gyaan ki roshni usse nahi pahunch sake — badlaav hamesha mumkin hai, har waqt.

verses.sanskrit:
यथैधांसि समिद्धोऽग्निर्भस्मसात्कुरुतेऽर्जुन ।
ज्ञानाग्निः सर्वकर्माणि भस्मसात्कुरुते तथा ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yathaadhaansi Samiddho Agnir Bhasmasaat Kurute Arjuna,
Jnaana Agnih Sarva Karmaani Bhasmasaat Kurute Tatha.
verses.englishMeaning: Just as a blazing fire reduces all wood to ashes, O Arjuna, so too does the fire of knowledge reduce all karmas — all past actions and their accumulated impressions — to ashes, without leaving any residue.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Jis tarah ek tez jalti hui aag lakkad ko — chahe kitni bhi ho — poori tarah jalaa ke raakh kar deti hai, usi tarah gyaan ki aag — sachchi andar ki samajh — saare karmon ko — purane, naye, acha bura sab — poori tarah bhasm kar deti hai. Kuch nahi bachta.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok ek bahut powerful comparison deta hai — aag aur gyaan ki.

Aag ka kaam kya hai? Jo bhi uske saamne aaye, use jala dena. Koi fark nahi ki lakkad sookhi hai ya geeli, thodi hai ya zyaada — aag sab jala deti hai.

Usi tarah gyaan ki aag bhi kaam karti hai. Agar sachchi samajh aa gayi — ki main sirf yeh sharir nahi hoon, ki mera karm mujhe nahi bandh sakta — toh phir koi bhi purana bojh, koi bhi purana paap, koi bhi purana dard — sab jal jaata hai. Kuch nahi bachta.

Yeh sirf concept nahi — yeh anubhav ki baat hai. Jab andar roshan-i aati hai, toh sab chhoot jaata hai. Aage hi aage rehta hai — peechhe kuch nahi.
verses.lifeLesson: Sachcha gyaan andar se aisa badlaav laata hai ki purane dukh, purani galtiyan aur purane bojh — sab kuch jal jaate hain. Koi raakh bhi nahi bachti.

verses.sanskrit:
न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते ।
तत्स्वयं योगसंसिद्धः कालेनात्मनि विन्दति ॥
verses.transliteration:
Na Hi Jnaanena Sadrisham Pavitram Iha Vidyate,
Tat Svayam Yoga Samsiddhah Kaalena Aatmani Vindati.
verses.englishMeaning: Truly, in this world there is no purifier equal to knowledge. One who has been perfected in yoga — purified through sincere practice — finds this knowledge spontaneously within their own Self, in time.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Is poori duniya mein — koi cheez, koi dhan, koi teerthhsthal, koi ritual — gyaan jaisi pavitra nahi kar sakta.

Aur jo insaan yoga — yaani sachcha karm, sachchi sadhna — mein siddhi paa leta hai, woh ek din uchit waqt par khud apne andar hi yeh gyaan paata hai. Koi bahar se nahi deta — woh khud prakash hota hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna yahan ek bahut badi baat keh rahe hain — gyaan se pavitra koi cheez nahi hai is duniya mein. Paise se, dhone se, kisi teerth jaane se — baahri shuddhi ek seema tak hoti hai. Lekin andar ki shuddhi sirf gyaan se hoti hai.

Aur dusri baat — yeh gyaan kisi ko zordarsti se nahi milta. Jo insaan sachchi mehnat karta hai, sachcha karm karta hai, sachcha jeevan jeeta hai — ek din, sahi waqt par, yeh gyaan khud uske andar se uthta hai. Jaise beej mein se ped khud nikalata hai.

Deri ho sakti hai, par hoti zaroor hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Is duniya mein gyaan se badi koi shuddhi nahi — aur yeh gyaan bahar nahi milta, sachchi mehnat ke baad ek din khud andar se nikalta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रद्धावाँल्लभते ज्ञानं तत्परः संयतेन्द्रियः ।
ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा परां शान्तिमचिरेणाधिगच्छति ॥
verses.transliteration:
Shraddhavaan Labhate Jnaanam Tatparah Samyata Indriyah,
Jnaanam Labdhvaa Paraam Shaantim Achirena Adhigacchati.
verses.englishMeaning: One who has faith, who is fully devoted and sincere, and who has mastered the senses — that person attains knowledge. Having attained knowledge, they swiftly reach the highest peace.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Gyaan unhe milta hai jinmein teen cheezein hoti hain:
Pehli — Shraddha: sachcha vishwas, andar se. Na dikhawa, na dar — sachchi aastha.
Doosri — Tatparta: poora dhyan, poora dedication. Idhar-udhar ka mann nahi.
Teesri — Samyata Indriyah: indriyaan kaaboo mein. Aankhein, kaan, mann — sab ek taraf.

Aur jo yeh gyaan paa leta hai, woh jald hi — bahut jald — ek aisi shanti ko paata hai jo kisi bhi cheez se par hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna yahan gyaan paane ki teen zarooratein bata rahe hain — aur yeh teeno ek saath honi chahiye.

Pehli — Shraddha. Yeh blind faith nahi hai. Yeh woh yakeen hai jo anubhav se aata hai, jo dil se aata hai. Jo baar-baar toot ke bhi tikta hai.

Doosri — Tatparta. Idhar-udhar ka mann nahi. Ek cheez pe poori taakat lagaana. Jaise koi target dekhke baan chalaata hai — aankh nahi hatati.

Teesri — Indriyaan kaaboo mein. Agar aankhein aur kaan harr time duniya ki taraf bhaag rahe hain, toh gyaan andar nahi jaata. Khamoshi aur focus chahiye.

Aur jo yeh teen karta hai — usse gyaan milta hai. Aur gyaan milne ke baad? Ek aisi shanti jo koi cheez chheen nahi sakti.
verses.lifeLesson: Sachcha vishwas, poora dhyan aur kaaboo mein indriyaan — yeh teeno jab ek saath hon, tab gyaan khud chal ke aata hai. Aur phir jo shanti milti hai, woh hamesha ke liye rehti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अज्ञश्चाश्रद्दधानश्च संशयात्मा विनश्यति ।
नायं लोकोऽस्ति न परो न सुखं संशयात्मनः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Ajnash Cha Ashrad Dadhanas Cha Samshayaatma Vinashyati,
Nayam Loko Asti Na Paro Na Sukham Samshayaatmanah.
verses.englishMeaning: One who is ignorant, one who lacks faith, and one whose very nature is doubt — such a person perishes. For the doubt-filled soul there is happiness neither in this world nor in the next, nor anywhere.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Teen tarah ke log hain jo khud ko barbad karte hain:
Pehla — Agyan-i: jo jaanta hi nahi aur jaanna bhi nahi chahta.
Doosra — Ashraddhalu: jise vishwas hi nahi — na apne aap par, na kisi sach par.
Teesra — Samshay-atma: jiske andar sirf shak hai — har baat mein, har rishte mein, har faisle mein.

Aur Krishna keh rahe hain — aise insaan ke liye na is duniya mein sukh hai, na parlok mein. Kahin nahi.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok seedha aur katha baat karta hai — shak ek aisaa zeher hai jo insaan ko andar se khaata rehta hai.

Agyan-i insaan ko tak thik ho sakta hai — agar woh seekhna chahe. Ashraddh-alu bhi badal sakta hai — agar woh ek baar sachche anubhav ko andar aane de.

Lekin jo hamesha shak mein jeeta hai — jo koi faisla nahi kar paata, jo kisi cheez mein poora nahi jaata — woh na idhar ka rehta hai na udhar ka. Zindagi usi mein nikal jaati hai. Na is taraf kuch milta hai, na us taraf.

Shak bura nahi hota — sawaal poochho. Lekin shak ko apna sthayi ghar mat banao. Shak se guzro, sach dhundho, aur aage badho.
verses.lifeLesson: Shak ka zeher insaan ko do jagahon ke beech latka ke rakhta hai — na aage, na peeche. Faisla karo, aage badho — adhoori zindagi shak mein nahi, sachche kadam mein hai.

verses.sanskrit:
योगसंन्यस्तकर्माणं ज्ञानसञ्छिन्नसंशयम् ।
आत्मवन्तं न कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yoga Sannyasta Karmanam Jnana Sanchhinna Samshayam,
Atmavantam Na Karmani Nibadhnanti Dhananjaya.
verses.englishMeaning: One who has surrendered all actions through the practice of yoga, whose doubts have been completely cut away by true knowledge, and who is established in the self — such a person, O Arjun, is never bound by karma.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jisne yoga ke zariye apne saare karm ek bade maqsad ko arpan kar diye hain, jiske saare shak sachche gyaan ki talwaar se kaat diye gaye hain, aur jo apni aatma mein sthir hai — aisa insaan, hey Arjun, kisi bhi karm ke bandhan mein nahi padta.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna is poore adhyaay ka nicharod ek shlok mein de rahe hain.

Teen cheezein jo insaan ko azaad karti hain — pehla, apne kaam ko ek bade maqsad ke liye karna, na apne fayade ke liye. Doosra, jo bhi shak andar baitha hai — ki main kaun hoon, mujhe kya karna chahiye, kya sahi hai — use sachche gyaan ki talwaar se kaat dena. Teesra, apni aatma mein tika rehna — yaani khud ko jaanna.

Jab yeh teeno saath hoti hain, tab koi bhi kaam insaan ko baandhta nahi. Woh karta hai, par bandhan mein nahi aata.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab kaam maqsad se ho, shak kat jaayein, aur khud ki pehchaan ho — tab zindagi ka koi bhi bojh tujhe todh nahi sakta.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मादज्ञानसम्भूतं हृत्स्थं ज्ञानासिनात्मनः ।
छित्त्वैनं संशयं योगमातिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भारत ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tasmad Ajnana Sambhutam Hrit Stham Jnana Asina Atmanah,
Chittva Enam Samshayam Yogam Atishtha Uttishtha Bharata.
verses.englishMeaning: Therefore, with the sword of self-knowledge, cut away this doubt born of ignorance that has settled in your heart. Rise up, O Arjun, take refuge in yoga and stand firm.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Isliye apne dil mein baitha yeh shak — jo anjaane se paida hua hai — use gyaan ki talwaar se kaat do. Hey Arjun, ab uth khade ho, yoga ka sahara lo aur apna kaam karo.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh poore Chapter 4 ka aakhiri shlok hai — aur yeh ek aawaaz hai jo seedha dil ko chhooti hai.

Shri Krishna keh rahe hain ki teri pareshani baahri nahi, andar hai. Woh shak jo tere dil mein baitha hai — ki main theek hoon ya nahi, main kar sakta hoon ya nahi, yeh sahi hai ya galat — wahi tera sabse bada dushman hai.

Aur iska ilaaj sirf ek hai — sachcha gyaan. Gyaan ki talwaar se woh shak kaat do. Phir uth. Khade ho ja. Aur jo karna hai — karo.

Yeh shlok sirf Arjun ke liye nahi — yeh har us insaan ke liye hai jo andar se toot ke baitha hai aur uthna chahta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Teri sabse badi ladai bahar nahi, andar hai — woh shak jo tujhe uthne nahi deta. Use gyaan se kaat, uth khada ho aur chal — bas yahi sab kuch hai.

summary: The fifth chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Karma Sanyasa Yoga. In this chapter, Krishna compares the paths of renunciation in actions (Karma Sanyas) and actions with detachment (Karma Yoga) and explains that both are means to reach the same goal and we can choose either. A wise person should perform his/her worldly duties without attachment to the fruits of his/her actions and dedicate them to God. This way they remain unaffected by sin and eventually attain liberation.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
संन्यासं कर्मणां कृष्ण पुनर्योगं च शंससि ।
यच्छ्रेय एतयोरेकं तन्मे ब्रूहि सुनिश्चितम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Arjuna Uvacha:
Sannyasam Karmanam Krishna Punar Yogam Ca Shamsasi,
Yac Chreya Etayor Ekam Tan Me Bruhi Su Nishcitam.
verses.englishMeaning: Arjun said: O Krishna, you praise the renunciation of actions and then again the practice of yoga. Tell me with certainty which one of these two is truly better for me.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Arjun ne kaha:

Hey Krishna! Aap ek taraf karmon ka tyaag karne ki taarif karte hain, aur doosri taraf karm karte rehne ki. Inn dono mein se jo ek sachchi aur poori tarah behtar ho — woh mujhe nishchit roop se batayein.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ek bahut zaroori sawaal poochh rahe hain — aur yeh sawaal sirf unka nahi, har insaan ka hai.

Kya sab kuch chhhod do aur shaant baith jao — ya phir duniya mein rehkar kaam karte raho?

Arjun confuse hain kyunki Krishna ne dono ki taarif ki hai. Aur woh seedha jawab chahte hain — dono mein se ek chunna hai, dono saath nahi chal sakte.

Yeh shlok dikhata hai ki sachcha shishya woh hota hai jo seedha aur saaf sawaal poochhhta hai — ghoomata nahi, darta nahi.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab do raaston mein se ek chunna ho aur dil confuse ho — tab seedha poochhhna hi sabse badi samajhdaari hai. Sawaal karna kamzori nahi, sachchi talash ki nishaani hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
संन्यासः कर्मयोगश्च निःश्रेयसकरावुभौ ।
तयोस्तु कर्मसंन्यासात्कर्मयोगो विशिष्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Shri Bhagavan Uvacha:
Sannyasah Karma Yogas Ca Nihshreyasa Karav Ubhau,
Tayos Tu Karma Sannyasat Karma Yogo Vishishyate.
verses.englishMeaning: Shri Krishna said: Both renunciation of action and the yoga of action lead to the highest good. But between the two, the yoga of action is superior to the mere renunciation of action.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Shri Krishna ne kaha:

Dono raaste — karmon ka tyaag aur karm karte rehna — dono hi insaan ko oonchi jagah le jaate hain. Lekin inn dono mein, sirf karmon ko chhhod dene se behtar hai karm karte hue yoga mein rehna.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna Arjun ke sawaal ka jawab dete hain — aur woh bahut seedha hai.

Dono raaste theek hain. Lekin ek zyaada behtar hai — karm yoga. Kyun?

Kyunki sirf kaam chhhod dena aasaan nahi hota. Andar se lagav tab bhi rehta hai. Lekin jab koi kaam karte hue bhi natije se nahi chipakta — tab sachchi azaadi hoti hai.

Yeh ek bahut gehri baat hai — azaadi bhagne mein nahi, theek wahan rehne mein hai jahan tum ho. Bas bhaav badlna hai, jagah nahi.
verses.lifeLesson: Azaadi kaam chhhhodne mein nahi — kaam karte hue natije se azaad rehne mein hai. Jagah mat badlo, apna bhaav badlo.

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञेयः स नित्यसंन्यासी यो न द्वेष्टि न काङ्क्षति ।
निर्द्वन्द्वो हि महाबाहो सुखं बन्धात्प्रमुच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Jneyah Sa Nitya Sannyasi Yo Na Dveshti Na Kankshati,
Nir Dvandvo Hi Mahabaho Sukham Bandhat Pramucyate.
verses.englishMeaning: One who neither hates nor desires anything — that person should be understood as one who is always in renunciation. Free from all opposites, such a person is easily and joyfully liberated from all bondage.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Jo insaan na kisi se nafrat karta hai aur na kisi cheez ki chahat rakhta hai — woh hamesha ka sachcha sanyaasi hai.

Hey Arjun! Jo insaan sukh-dukh, laabh-haani jaise dono chhonon se upar uth jaata hai, woh aasani se aur sukh ke saath har bandhan se azaad ho jaata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna sanyaas ka sachcha matlab bata rahe hain — sanyaas matlab kapde badalna ya ghar chhhodni nahi hai.

Sachcha sanyaasi woh hai jiske mann mein na kisi ke liye nafrat hai, na kisi cheez ki lalak hai.

Jab koi insaan in dono se — nafrat aur chahat — mukt ho jaata hai, tab woh duniya mein rehte hue bhi bilkul azaad hota hai. Koi bhi cheez use nahi baandh sakti.

Yeh bahut badi baat hai — azaadi kahin jaane mein nahi, andar ki nafrat aur chahat khatam hone mein hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sachcha sanyaas ghar chhhodni nahi — andar ki nafrat aur chahat chhhodni hai. Jis din yeh dono gaye, usi din tu azaad hua.

verses.sanskrit:
साङ्ख्ययोगौ पृथग्बालाः प्रवदन्ति न पण्डिताः ।
एकमप्यास्थितः सम्यगुभयोर्विन्दते फलम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sankhya Yogau Prithag Balah Pravadanti Na Panditah,
Ekam Api Asthitah Samyag Ubhayor Vindate Phalam.
verses.englishMeaning: Only the immature say that the path of knowledge and the path of action are different and separate. The truly wise do not say this. One who is sincerely established in either path attains the fruits of both.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Jo log samajh mein abhi chhote hain, woh gyaan ke raaste aur karm ke raaste ko alag-alag maante hain. Lekin sachche gyaani aisa nahi kehte.

Jo koi bhi inn dono mein se kisi ek mein poori tarah se tik jaata hai, woh dono ke phal paa leta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna ek bahut badi galatfahmi door kar rahe hain.

Log sochte hain — gyaan ka raasta alag hai aur karm ka raasta alag. Lekin yeh soch abhaag ki nishani hai.

Sachchi baat yeh hai ki dono raaste ek hi jagah le jaate hain. Farq sirf shuruwaat ka hai — baad mein dono ek hi ho jaate hain.

Aur jo koi ek mein bhi sachche mann se tik jaata hai — woh dono ka fal paata hai. Isliye ek chunno aur poori tarah us par chal pado — baaki sab apne aap ho jaayega.
verses.lifeLesson: Raasta ek chunno aur poori tarah us par chal pado — sachche mann se liya gaya ek kadam do raaste bhaagne se kahin behtar hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यत्साङ्ख्यैः प्राप्यते स्थानं तद्योगैरपि गम्यते ।
एकं साङ्ख्यं च योगं च यः पश्यति स पश्यति ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yat Sankhyaih Prapyate Sthanam Tad Yogair Api Gamyate,
Ekam Sankhyam Ca Yogam Ca Yah Pashyati Sa Pashyati.
verses.englishMeaning: The destination reached by those on the path of knowledge is the same as that reached by those on the path of action. One who sees knowledge and action as one — truly sees.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Jo manzil gyaan ke raaste waale paate hain, wahi manzil karm ke raaste waale bhi paate hain.

Jo insaan gyaan aur karm ko ek hi cheez ke do roop dekhta hai — wahi sachchi nazar rakhta hai, wahi sachchi tarah se dekhta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna pichle shlok ki baat ko aur gehra karte hain.

Dono raaston ka anjaama ek hi hai — ek hi sachcaai tak pahunchna. Farq sirf yeh hai ki ek raaste par chalne waale gyaan se pahuunche, doosre karm se.

Lekin jo insaan dono ko ek hi sachcaai ke do darwaaze maanta hai — woh sachchi nazar waala hai. Woh raaste mein nahi uljha, manzil par nazar tiki hai.

Yeh shlok sikhata hai ki sachcha gyaan woh hai jo vibhaajan nahi, ekta dekhta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo dono raaston mein ek hi manzil dekhe — woh sachche mein samajhdaar hai. Raaste alag ho sakte hain, sachcaai hamesha ek hi hoti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
संन्यासस्तु महाबाहो दुःखमाप्तुमयोगतः ।
योगयुक्तो मुनिर्ब्रह्म नचिरेणाधिगच्छति ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sannyasas Tu Mahabaho Duhkham Aptum Ayogatah,
Yoga Yukto Munir Brahma Na Cirena Adhigacchati.
verses.englishMeaning: But renunciation without the practice of yoga is difficult and painful to achieve. The contemplative person who is united in yoga attains Brahman swiftly.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Lekin hey Arjun! Yoga ke bina sirf karm chhhod dena bahut mushkil aur dukhdayi hota hai.

Lekin jo muni yoga mein tika hua hai — yaani jo karm karte hue bhi andar se azaad rehta hai — woh bahut jaldi Brahman tak pahunch jaata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna ek bahut zaroori sach bata rahe hain — sirf kaam chhhod dena itna aasaan nahi hota jitna lagta hai.

Andar se lagav tab bhi rehta hai. Mann tab bhi baahri duniya ke baare mein sochta rehta hai. Isliye sirf baahri tyaag kafi nahi.

Lekin jo insaan kaam karte hue bhi andar se sthir rehta hai, jo natije se nahi chipakta, jo har kaam ek arpan ki tarah karta hai — woh bahut jaldi sachcaai tak pahunch jaata hai.

Raasta wahi theek hai jo andar se shuru ho — baahir se nahi.
verses.lifeLesson: Baahri duniya chhhodni mushkil hai — pehle andar ka lagav chhhodo. Jab andar se azaad ho gaye, tab baahri koi cheez baandh nahi sakti.

verses.sanskrit:
योगयुक्तो विशुद्धात्मा विजितात्मा जितेन्द्रियः ।
सर्वभूतात्मभूतात्मा कुर्वन्नपि न लिप्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yoga Yukto Vishuddha Atma Vijita Atma Jita Indriyah,
Sarva Bhuta Atma Bhuta Atma Kurvan Api Na Lipyate.
verses.englishMeaning: One who is united in yoga, whose inner self is purified, who has mastered the mind and senses, and who sees the self in all living beings — even while acting, such a person is never touched by sin.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo yoga mein tika hua hai, jiska andar ka mann saaf ho gaya hai, jisne apne aap ko aur apni indriyaan ko kaaboo kar liya hai, aur jo har jeev mein apni hi aatma dekhta hai — aisa insaan kaam karte hue bhi kisi karm se lipat nahi hota.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna ek sachche yogi ki poori tasweer khinch rahe hain.

Woh yoga mein tika hai — yaani andar se sthir hai. Uska mann saaf hai — koi purana daag, koi purani jalaan nahi. Woh apne aap ko kaaboo mein rakhta hai. Aur sabse badi baat — woh har jagah, har insaan, har jeev mein apni hi aatma dekhta hai.

Aur jab koi yeh sab jeeta hai — tab woh kaam karte hue bhi kisi karm ka bojh nahi uthata. Jaise kamal paani mein rehta hai lekin bheegta nahi.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab har insaan mein apni hi aatma dikhe — tab na nafrat bachti hai, na ahankar. Aur usi din koi bhi kaam bojh nahi lagta.

verses.sanskrit:
नैव किञ्चित्करोमीति युक्तो मन्येत तत्त्ववित् ।
पश्यञ्शृण्वन्स्पृशञ्जिघ्रन्नश्नन्गच्छन्स्वपञ्श्वसन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Naiva Kincit Karomi Iti Yukto Manyeta Tattva Vit,
Pashyan Shrinvan Sprishan Jighran Nashnan Gacchan Svapan Shvasan.
verses.englishMeaning: The one who knows the truth, established in yoga, thinks — I am truly doing nothing at all — even while seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, walking, sleeping and breathing.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo sachcaai ko jaanta hai aur yoga mein tika hua hai — woh yeh maanta hai ki main asal mein kuch nahi kar raha — chahe woh dekh raha ho, sun raha ho, chhhoo raha ho, soong raha ho, kha raha ho, chal raha ho, so raha ho ya saans le raha ho.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok sunne mein ajeeb lagta hai — main kuch nahi kar raha? Toh kar kya raha hai?

Shri Krishna ek gehra raaz khol rahe hain — jo insaan sachcaai ko jaanta hai, woh jaanta hai ki yeh sab kaam sharir kar raha hai, indriyaan kar rahi hain, prakriti kar rahi hai.

Meri aatma kuch nahi karti — woh toh sirf dekhne waali hai. Aankhein dekhti hain, kaan sunte hain, haath chhhooate hain — lekin andar jo baitha hai, woh sirf saakshi hai.

Jab yeh samajh aa jaati hai, tab koi bhi kaam ahankar nahi banta. Kaam hota hai, par kartapan nahi rehta.
verses.lifeLesson: Jis din samajh aa jaaye ki main karta nahi — sirf dekhta hoon — usi din koi bhi kaam ahankar nahi banta aur koi bhi natija dukh nahi deta.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रलपन्विसृजन्गृह्णन्नुन्मिषन्निमिषन्नपि ।
इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेषु वर्तन्त इति धारयन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Pralapan Visrijan Grihnan Unmishan Nimishan Api,
Indriyani Indriyartheshu Vartanta Iti Dharan.
verses.englishMeaning: Even while speaking, releasing, grasping, opening and closing the eyes — such a person firmly holds the understanding that it is only the senses moving among their objects, and not the self.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Bolta hua, chhhoodta hua, pakadta hua, aankhein kholte aur band karte hue — aisa insaan poori tarah se yeh jaanta aur maanta hai ki yeh sab indriyaan apne-apne kaam kar rahi hain — main nahi.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok pichle shlok ka hi aagla hissa hai — krishna aur gehraai se samjha rahe hain.

Har ek kaam — bolna, pakadna, chhhoodna, aankhein kholna — yeh sab indriyaan kar rahi hain.

Aur jo sachcha gyaani hai, woh har pal yeh yaad rakhta hai — main nahi kar raha, yeh sab prakriti kar rahi hai, indriyaan kar rahi hain.

Yeh sirf ek soch nahi — yeh ek gehri samajh hai jo hamesha uske saath rehti hai. Jaise ek jaagta hua insaan jaanta hai ki woh jaag raha hai — usi tarah woh hamesha jaanta hai ki karta woh nahi, prakriti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Har kaam ke waqt yeh yaad rakho — yeh kaam ho raha hai, main kar nahi raha. Jis din yeh samajh pakki ho gayi, usi din koi bhi kaam tujhe baandhega nahi.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः ।
लिप्यते न स पापेन पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा ॥
verses.transliteration:
Brahmany Adhaya Karmani Sangam Tyaktva Karoti Yah,
Lipyate Na Sa Papena Padma Patram Ivambhasa.
verses.englishMeaning: One who performs all actions as an offering to Brahman, giving up all attachment — that person is not touched by sin, just as a lotus leaf is untouched by water.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo insaan apne saare kaam Brahman ko arpan karke, bina kisi lagav ke karta hai — woh kisi bhi galti se lipat nahi hota. Bilkul aise jaise kamal ka patta paani mein rehta hai lekin paani usse chhhoo nahi paata.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna yahan ek bahut sundar aur aasaan misaal dete hain — kamal ka patta.

Kamal paani mein rehta hai — lekin paani usse bheegota nahi. Patta paani ke oopar hota hai, paani ke andar nahi.

Usi tarah jo insaan apna har kaam Brahman ko arpan karta hai aur natije se nahi chipakta — woh duniya mein rehta hai, duniya ka kaam karta hai, lekin duniya ki gandagi use andar tak nahi pahunchti.

Yeh duniya se bhaagna nahi — iske beech rehkar bhi saaf rehna hai. Aur yeh mumkin hai — bas bhaav badlna hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Kamal ki tarah jeeo — duniya mein raho, par duniya ko andar mat aane do. Kaam karo, par kaam ko apna sab kuch mat maano.

verses.sanskrit:
कायेन मनसा बुद्ध्या केवलैरिन्द्रियैरपि ।
योगिनः कर्म कुर्वन्ति सङ्गं त्यक्त्वात्मशुद्धये ॥
verses.transliteration:
Kayena Manasa Buddhya Kevalair Indriyair Api,
Yoginah Karma Kurvanti Sangam Tyaktva Atma Shuddhaye.
verses.englishMeaning: Yogis perform actions with the body, mind, intellect and even the senses alone — having given up all attachment — for the purification of the self.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Sachche yogi apne sharir se, mann se, buddhi se aur indriyaan se kaam karte hain — lekin kisi bhi cheez se lagav rakhe bina. Aur yeh sab woh sirf ek maqsad ke liye karte hain — apne aap ko andar se saaf aur shuddh karna.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna yahan yogi ki ek bahut khaas pehchaan bata rahe hain.

Yogi bhi uthta hai, khaata hai, kaam karta hai — bilkul aam insaan ki tarah. Fark sirf itna hai ki woh yeh sab bina kisi lagav ke karta hai. Na taareef ke liye, na nateeje ke liye, na apne fayade ke liye.

Woh karta hai kyunki yeh zaroori hai — aur iss karne se woh andar se shuddh hota jaata hai. Jaise paani mitti ko saaf karta hai, aise nishkaam karm mann ko saaf karta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Kaam karo — par apne andar ki shuddhi ke liye, na taareef ya natije ke liye. Isi mein sachchi taraqqui chhuppi hai.

verses.sanskrit:
युक्तः कर्मफलं त्यक्त्वा शान्तिमाप्नोति नैष्ठिकीम् ।
अयुक्तः कामकारेण फले सक्तो निबध्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yuktah Karma Phalam Tyaktva Shantim Apnoti Naishthakim,
Ayuktah Kama Karena Phale Sakto Nibadhyate.
verses.englishMeaning: The one who is united in yoga gives up the fruits of action and attains lasting peace. The one who is not united, driven by desire and attached to results, remains bound.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Jo insaan karm ke natije se apna lagav chhhod deta hai, use ek gehri aur tikaau shanti milti hai.

Lekin jo insaan apni khwaishon ke peeche bhaagta hai aur nateeje se chipka rehta hai — woh khud hi apne bandhan baan leta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna do tarah ke logon ki tasweer khinch rahe hain — ek jo andar se azaad hai, ek jo andar se jakda hua hai.

Pehla woh jo kaam karta hai lekin natije se nahi chipakta — use ek aisi shanti milti hai jo na koi cheez de sakti hai aur na koi chhin sakti hai.

Doosra woh jo har kaam nateeje ke liye karta hai — woh jab nateeja milta hai tab khush, jab nahi milta tab dukhi. Woh hamesha ek see-saw par baitha rehta hai — kabhi oopar, kabhi neeche. Aur isi mein poori zindagi nikal jaati hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Kaam ke baad sukoon chahiye toh natije se nahi, kaam ke bhaav se chipko — jo natije se mukt hai, wahi sachchi shanti mein jeeta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वकर्माणि मनसा संन्यस्यास्ते सुखं वशी ।
नवद्वारे पुरे देही नैव कुर्वन्न कारयन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sarva Karmani Manasa Sannyasya Aste Sukham Vashi,
Nava Dvare Pure Dehi Naiva Kurvan Na Karayan.
verses.englishMeaning: The one who has mastered the self, having mentally renounced all actions, lives in contentment within the nine-gated city of the body — neither acting nor causing others to act.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo insaan apne mann ko poori tarah kaaboo kar leta hai, woh apne saare kaarnaamon ko mann se hi chhhod deta hai aur nau darwaazon waale is sharir ke shehar mein sukoon ke saath rehta hai — na khud kuch karta hai aur na doosron se karata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna sharir ko ek shehar se tulna de rahe hain — nau darwaaze yaani aankhein, kaan, naak, munh aur baaki indriyaan.

Iss shehar mein jo aatma rehti hai, woh asal mein kuch nahi karti. Kaam toh sharir, mann aur indriyaan karti hain.

Jo insaan yeh samajh leta hai — ki main yeh sab nahi hoon, main toh sirf andar baitha hoon — woh andar se bilkul shaant aur azaad rehta hai. Na kuch karne ki halaachal, na ruk jaane ki uljhan.
verses.lifeLesson: Tu jo sochta hai — main karta hoon — wahi teri sabse badi bhool hai. Jis din jaana ki main sirf dekhne waala hoon, usi din andar ki azaadi mili.

verses.sanskrit:
न कर्तृत्वं न कर्माणि लोकस्य सृजति प्रभुः ।
न कर्मफलसंयोगं स्वभावस्तु प्रवर्तते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Na Kartritvam Na Karmani Lokasya Srijati Prabhuh,
Na Karma Phala Sanyogam Svabhavas Tu Pravartate.
verses.englishMeaning: The Supreme does not create the sense of doership, nor the actions, nor the connection of actions to their results for anyone. It is nature alone that moves and acts.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Ishwar na kissi ke liye karne ka ahankar paida karta hai, na karm paida karta hai, aur na hi karm aur phal ka rishta banata hai.

Yeh sab prakriti khud karti hai — apne niyam se, apni chaal se.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna ek bahut badi bhool door kar rahe hain jo zyaadatar log karte hain — yeh sochna ki Bhagwan hi sab kuch kara raha hai isliye main kuch bhi nahi kar sakta, ya yeh sochna ki main hi sab kuch kar raha hoon.

Dono galat hain. Na Ishwar tumhara ahankar banata hai, na tumhare karm, na natija. Yeh sab prakriti ke niyam hain — aur woh apne aap chalte rehte hain.

Tumhara kaam hai — prakriti ko samjho aur apna bhaav sahi rakho. Bas itna kafi hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Na yeh soch ki Bhagwan sab kar dega, na yeh soch ki main hi sab kuch hoon — dono bharam hain. Apna kaam karo, prakriti apna kaam karti rahegi.

verses.sanskrit:
नादत्ते कस्यचित्पापं न चैव सुकृतं विभुः ।
अज्ञानेनावृतं ज्ञानं तेन मुह्यन्ति जन्तवः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Na Adatte Kasyacit Papam Na Caiva Sukritam Vibhuh,
Ajnanena Avritam Jnanam Tena Muhyanti Jantavah.
verses.englishMeaning: The all-pervading Supreme neither accepts the sin of anyone nor the merit. Knowledge is covered by ignorance — and because of this, all living beings are deluded.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Woh sarvavyaapi Parmatma na kisi ka paap leta hai, na kisi ka punya.

Sachcha gyaan anjaane se dhaka hua hai — aur isi wajah se sab jeev bhatak rahe hain, sahi aur galat mein ulajhe hue hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna ek bahut gehri sachcaai bata rahe hain — Ishwar judge nahi hai. Woh na tumhara paap leta hai, na tumhara punya.

Toh phir insaan galat kyun karta hai? Kyunki sachcha gyaan chhupa hua hai — anjaane ki paraton ke neeche.

Jab tak yeh anjaana nahi hata, insaan sahi-galat mein bhatakta rehta hai. Woh sochta hai jo cheez usse sukh deti dikhti hai woh sahi hai — lekin woh asli sukoon nahi hota. Bas ek dhoka hota hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Galti karne waala bura nahi hota — woh anjaane mein hota hai. Jab gyaan ki roshni aati hai, tab andhera khud mit jaata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञानेन तु तदज्ञानं येषां नाशितमात्मनः ।
तेषामादित्यवज्ज्ञानं प्रकाशयति तत्परम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Jnanena Tu Tad Ajnanam Yesham Nashitam Atmanah,
Tesham Aditya Vaj Jnanam Prakashayati Tat Param.
verses.englishMeaning: But for those whose ignorance has been destroyed by the knowledge of the self — for them, that knowledge shines like the sun and illuminates the Supreme.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Lekin jinke andar ka woh anjaan — jo sachcaai ko dhak raha tha — sachche gyaan se khatam ho jaata hai, unke liye woh gyaan suraj ki tarah chamak uthta hai aur unhe sachchi aur gehra sachai dikha deta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna ek bahut sundar tasweer bana rahe hain — gyaan suraj jaisa hai.

Jis tarah suraj ke aane se poori raat ka andhera ek pal mein mit jaata hai — usi tarah sachcha gyaan aane se saara anjaan ek pal mein door ho jaata hai.

Andhera kuch kaam nahi karta suraj ke saamne — aur usi tarah anjaan kuch nahi kar sakta sachche gyaan ke saamne.

Jab woh roshni andar aati hai — sab kuch saaf ho jaata hai. Kaun hoon main, kyun hoon, kya karna hai — sab ek pal mein spashtho jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Andar ka andhera mitaane ke liye bahut kuch karne ki zaroorat nahi — sirf sachcha gyaan ki ek kiran kaafi hai, poori zindagi roshni se bhar jaati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्बुद्धयस्तदात्मानस्तन्निष्ठास्तत्परायणाः ।
गच्छन्त्यपुनरावृत्तिं ज्ञाननिर्धूतकल्मषाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tad Buddhayah Tad Atmanah Tan Nishthah Tat Parayanah,
Gacchanty Apunar Avritim Jnana Nirdhuta Kalmashah.
verses.englishMeaning: Those whose intellect is absorbed in that supreme truth, whose very self is that truth, who are firmly established in it, who have made it their only goal — they, with all impurities washed away by knowledge, reach the state of no return.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jinki buddhi usi sachcaai mein tiki hai, jinka mann usi mein sama gaya hai, jinka tika rehna usi ek jagah hai, aur usi ko paana jinki zindagi ka ek hi maqsad hai — aur jinke saare paap sachche gyaan se dhul gaye hain — woh us jagah pahunchte hain jahan se phir lautna nahi hota.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna ek aisi zindagi ka naqsha bana rahe hain jo poori tarah ek ek sachcaai mein simit ho gayi ho.

Na iss cheez ki chinta, na uss cheez ki fikar. Sirf ek. Buddhi wahan, mann wahan, vishwas wahan, maqsad wahan.

Aur jab koi itni poori tarah usi ek mein sama jaata hai — tab gyaan andar ki saari gandagi saaf kar deta hai. Aur aisa insaan ek aisi jagah pahunchta hai jahan se phir wapas aana nahi padta — uss bhatkane ka, uss takleef ka, uss chakkar ka koi naam nahi rehta.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab poori zindagi ek hi sachchi cheez ke liye ho jaaye — tab na bhatakna hoga, na takleef hogi. Sirf woh ek, aur sab kuch apne aap theek ho jaayega.

verses.sanskrit:
विद्याविनयसम्पन्ने ब्राह्मणे गवि हस्तिनि ।
शुनि चैव श्वपाके च पण्डिताः समदर्शिनः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Vidya Vinaya Sampanne Brahmane Gavi Hastini,
Shuni Caiva Shvapake Ca Panditah Sama Darshinah.
verses.englishMeaning: The truly wise see with equal eyes a learned and humble brahmin, a cow, an elephant, a dog and even a person of the lowest birth — they see the same living truth in all.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo sachche gyaani hote hain, woh ek padhe-likhe aur vinamra brahmin mein, ek gaay mein, ek haathi mein, ek kutte mein aur ek bahut neeche samjhe jaane waale insaan mein — sab mein ek hi sachcaai dekhte hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Gita ke sabse bade aur gehre shlokkon mein se ek hai.

Shri Krishna keh rahe hain ki sachcha gyaan woh nahi jo kitabon mein bhar jaaye — sachcha gyaan woh hai jo ankhon ka nazar badal de.

Jab koi sach mein gyaani hota hai, tab woh oopar-neeche, sundar-badsoorat, ameer-gareeb nahi dekhta. Woh dekhta hai ki ek hi sachcaai — ek hi rooh — har jagah, har jeev mein hai.

Jab yeh drishti aati hai, tab na nafrat rehti hai, na ghamand. Sirf ek gehra pyaar aur ek gehra sukoon.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab tak hum logon mein farq dekhte hain — hum abhi sachche gyaan se door hain. Sachcha gyaan woh hai jo har insaan mein, har jeev mein ek hi roshni dekhe.

verses.sanskrit:
इहैव तैर्जितः सर्गो येषां साम्ये स्थितं मनः ।
निर्दोषं हि समं ब्रह्म तस्माद् ब्रह्मणि ते स्थिताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Ihaiva Tair Jitah Sargo Yesham Samye Sthitam Manah,
Nirdosham Hi Samam Brahma Tasmad Brahmani Te Sthitah.
verses.englishMeaning: Even here in this life, the cycle of birth and death is conquered by those whose mind is established in equality. Since Brahman is flawless and equal in all — they are already established in Brahman.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Jinke mann mein samata — yaani sab mein ek hi cheez dekhne ki drishti — sthir ho jaati hai, unhone is duniya mein hi janam-maran ka chakkar jeet liya hai.

Kyunki Brahman — woh sachchi aur gehri haqeeqat — nirmal aur sab mein ek jaisi hai. Isliye aisa insaan is duniya mein rahte hue bhi Brahman mein hi sthit hota hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna ek bahut badi khushkhabri de rahe hain — mukti ke liye marna nahi padta. Mukti yahan, isi zindagi mein, isi pal mein mil sakti hai.

Jab mann sab mein samanta dekhne lage — na koi bada, na koi chhota, na koi dushman, na koi paraya — tab andar ki ladaai khatam ho jaati hai. Aur jab andar ki ladaai khatam hoti hai, tab bahar koi lad nahi sakta.

Woh insaan is duniya mein rehta hai — lekin is duniya ka nahi rehta. Woh sachcaai mein tika rehta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Azaadi kisi aur duniya mein nahi milti — jab yahan, iss pal, sab mein ek hi sachcaai dikhne lage — tab samjho azaad ho gaye.

verses.sanskrit:
न प्रहृष्येत्प्रियं प्राप्य नोद्विजेत्प्राप्य चाप्रियम् ।
स्थिरबुद्धिरसम्मूढो ब्रह्मविद् ब्रह्मणि स्थितः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Na Prahrishyet Priyam Prapya Na Udvijet Prapya Ca Apriyam,
Sthira Buddhir Asammudho Brahmavid Brahmani Sthitah.
verses.englishMeaning: One who neither rejoices on receiving what is pleasant nor becomes disturbed on receiving what is unpleasant — who is steady in intellect, free from delusion and who knows Brahman — is established in Brahman.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo insaan achhi baat milne par bahut zyaada khush nahi hota, aur buri baat aane par ghabrata nahi — jiska mann hamesha sthir rehta hai, jo bhram se mukt hai aur jo sachcaai ko jaanta hai — woh sachcaai mein hi tika rehta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna sachche gyaani ki ek aur gehri pehchaan bata rahe hain — woh na bahut zyaada khush hota hai, na bahut zyaada toota hota hai.

Yeh sunta hai toh lagta hai — kya aisa insaan feelingless hai? Nahi. Woh mehsoos karta hai — par doob nahi jaata.

Jaise ek gehra saagar — oopar lehren aati hain jaati hain, lekin andar ki gehraai mein koi halaachal nahi. Usi tarah aisa insaan zindagi ki tarangon ko dekhta hai — par unse bahta nahi.

Yeh sthirta hi sachchi taaqat hai. Aur isi mein sachcha sukoon rehta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab khushi mein phaila nahi aur gham mein toota nahi — tab samjho andar kuch mazboot ho gaya hai. Yahi sachchi taaqat hai, yahi sachcha sukoon hai.

verses.sanskrit:
बाह्यस्पर्शेष्वसक्तात्मा विन्दत्यात्मनि यत्सुखम् ।
स ब्रह्मयोगयुक्तात्मा सुखमक्षयमश्नुते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Bahya Sparshe Shv Asakta Atma Vindaty Atmani Yat Sukham,
Sa Brahma Yoga Yukta Atma Sukham Akshayam Ashnute.
verses.englishMeaning: One whose inner self is not attached to outward pleasures finds joy within the self. Such a person, whose mind is united with Brahman through yoga, attains lasting and unending happiness.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Jis insaan ka mann baahri cheezon se chipka nahi hota, woh apne andar hi ek gehre sukoon ko paata hai.

Aur jo apni aatma ko Brahman se jod leta hai, use ek aisa sukh milta hai jo kabhi khatam nahi hota.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna ek bahut badi sachcaai bata rahe hain — baahri duniya ka sukh aata hai aur chala jaata hai. Ek din naya phone milta hai, khushi hoti hai — agle mahine woh purana lag jaata hai.

Yeh silsila kabhi khatam nahi hota. Kyunki jo sukh baahir se aata hai, woh baahir hi rehta hai — andar tak pahunchta nahi.

Lekin jo insaan apne andar sukh dhundhna seekh leta hai — jo apni aatma se jud jaata hai — use ek aisa sukh milta hai jo na koi de sakta hai, na koi chhin sakta hai. Woh hamesha ke liye hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Baahri duniya mein sukh dhundhna aisa hai jaise pyaas bujhaane ke liye namkeen paani peena — jitna peeo, utni pyaas badhti hai. Sachcha sukh sirf andar hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ये हि संस्पर्शजा भोगा दुःखयोनय एव ते ।
आद्यन्तवन्तः कौन्तेय न तेषु रमते बुधः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Ye Hi Samsparshaja Bhoga Duhkha Yonaya Eva Te,
Ady Antavantah Kaunteya Na Teshu Ramate Budhah.
verses.englishMeaning: The pleasures that arise from contact with the senses are truly sources of suffering alone. They have a beginning and an end, dear Arjun — the wise person does not find lasting delight in them.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Jo sukh baahri cheezon ko chhoone se, sunne se, dekhne se milta hai — woh sab dukh ka hi asal zariya hai.

Kyunki woh shuru hota hai aur khatam bhi ho jaata hai, hey Arjun. Isliye sachcha gyaani unhe apna asli sukh nahi maanta.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna yahan bilkul seedhi baat keh rahe hain — jo sukh baahir se aata hai, woh hamesha dukh leke aata hai.

Kyun? Kyunki woh tikaata nahi. Aaj jo khushi deta hai, kal wahi cheez nahi rahi toh dukh deta hai. Aur phir uss cheez ko dobara paane ki bhookh lagti hai.

Yeh chakkar kabhi khatam nahi hota — aur yahi sabse bada dukh hai.

Sachcha gyaani yeh jaanta hai. Isliye woh in cheezon mein ghus ke nahi baith jaata. Woh inhe use karta hai, lekin inhe apna sab kuch nahi maanta.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo cheez shuru hoti hai, woh khatam bhi hoti hai — agar sukh sirf baahri cheezon se aa raha hai, toh dukh bhi unhi ke saath aayega. Sachcha sukh woh hai jo khone ka darr na ho.

verses.sanskrit:
शक्नोतीहैव यः सोढुं प्राक्शरीरविमोक्षणात् ।
कामक्रोधोद्भवं वेगं स युक्तः स सुखी नरः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Shaknoti Ihaiva Yah Sodhum Prak Sharira Vimokshanat,
Kama Krodha Udbhavam Vegam Sa Yuktah Sa Sukhi Narah.
verses.englishMeaning: One who is able to withstand, right here in this life before leaving the body, the force and impulse born of desire and anger — that person is a true yogi and is truly happy.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo insaan is duniya mein, is zindagi mein hi — sharir chhoodne se pehle — kaama aur krodh ke toofan ko bardaasht kar leta hai aur unhe kaaboo kar leta hai — wahi sachcha yogi hai, wahi sachche mein sukhi insaan hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna yahan ek bilkul seedha aur zaroori sawaal uthaa rahe hain — kya tu apne andar ke toofan ko rok sakta hai?

Kaama — yaani woh tarishna jo uthti hai aur sab kuch bharaana chahti hai. Krodh — yaani woh aag jo tab bhadakti hai jab kuch marzee ke khilaf ho jaata hai.

Dono bahut tez hote hain. Ek pal mein aate hain aur sab kuch badal dete hain.

Jo insaan in dono ko is zindagi mein hi roka sakata hai — woh sachcha yogi hai. Marne ke baad nahi, yahan, abhi. Yahi sachchi kamiyaabi hai. Yahi sachcha sukh hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Duniya ko jeetne se pehle khud ko jeeto — jo apne andar ke kaama aur krodh ko rok sakta hai, woh kisi bhi baahri mushkil ko rok sakta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
योऽन्तःसुखोऽन्तरारामस्तथान्तर्ज्योतिरेव यः ।
स योगी ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं ब्रह्मभूतोऽधिगच्छति ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yo Antah Sukho Antar Aramas Tatha Antar Jyotir Eva Yah,
Sa Yogi Brahma Nirvanam Brahma Bhuto Adhigacchati.
verses.englishMeaning: One who finds happiness within, who finds rest within, and who finds the light of wisdom within — that yogi, becoming one with Brahman, attains the supreme liberation of Brahman.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo insaan apna sukh andar se paata hai, apna sukoon andar se paata hai, aur apni roshni bhi andar se paata hai — aisa yogi Brahman ka hi hissa ban jaata hai aur sachchi aur poori mukti paata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna yahan sachche yogi ki teen khaas nishaniyan bata rahe hain.

Pehli — sukh andar se. Baahri kuch mila toh khushi, nahi mila toh gham — aisa nahi. Sukh hamesha andar se aa raha hai.

Doosri — sukoon andar se. Thakaan hoti hai, mushkilein aati hain — lekin woh andar se hila nahi. Woh apne andar hi apna aaram dhundhta hai.

Teesri — roshni andar se. Kisi ne bataya, kisi ne dikhaya — aisi zaroorat nahi. Uska apna andar ki samajh hi use raah dikhati hai.

Aur jab yeh teeno ek jagah aa jaati hain — tab woh Brahman mein sama jaata hai. Yahi sachchi mukti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab sukh, sukoon aur samajh — teeno baahir se nahi, andar se aane lagein — tab samjho ki tu wahan pahunch gaya jahan koi takleef nahi pahunch sakti.

verses.sanskrit:
लभन्ते ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृषयः क्षीणकल्मषाः ।
छिन्नद्वैधा यतात्मानः सर्वभूतहिते रताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Labhante Brahma Nirvanam Rishayah Kshina Kalmashah,
Chhinna Dvaidha Yata Atmanah Sarva Bhuta Hite Ratah.
verses.englishMeaning: The wise sages whose sins have been destroyed, whose doubts have been cut away, whose minds are disciplined, and who are devoted to the wellbeing of all living beings — they attain the supreme liberation of Brahman.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Woh gyaani jo andar se shuddh ho gaye hain, jinke saare shak khatam ho gaye hain, jinhone apne mann ko kaaboo kar liya hai, aur jo har jeev ki bhalaai mein lage rehte hain — woh Brahman ki sachchi aur poori mukti paate hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna yahan mukti paane waale insaan ki chaar nishaniyan bata rahe hain.

Pehli — andar ki gandagi saaf ho gayi. Na purana gussa, na purana dard, na purani jalaan.

Doosri — shak khatam. Na yeh shak ki main sahi hoon ya galat, na yeh shak ki Ishwar hai ya nahi. Sab saaf ho gaya.

Teesri — mann kaaboo mein. Hawa chalti hai, toofan aata hai — par woh nahi hiltaa.

Chawthi — aur sabse zaroori — woh sirf apne liye nahi jeeta. Har jeev ki bhalaai mein laga rehta hai.

Yeh chaar cheezein jo insaan mein aa gayi — woh sachchi azaadi paata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sachchi mukti tab milti hai jab andar saaf ho, shak mit jaayein, mann sthir ho aur jeena sirf apne liye nahi, doosron ke liye bhi ho.

verses.sanskrit:
कामक्रोधवियुक्तानां यतीनां यतचेतसाम् ।
अभितो ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं वर्तते विदितात्मनाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Kama Krodha Viyuktanam Yatinam Yata Cetasam,
Abhito Brahma Nirvanam Vartate Vidita Atmanam.
verses.englishMeaning: For those seekers who are free from desire and anger, who have mastered their minds, and who have truly known the self — liberation in Brahman exists all around them, on all sides.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo log kaama aur krodh se azaad ho gaye hain, jinhone apne mann ko saadhh liya hai, aur jo apni aatma ko sachchi tarah jaante hain — unke liye sachchi mukti har taraf maujood hai, har pal maujood hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok ek bahut badi umeed deta hai.

Shri Krishna keh rahe hain ki mukti koi door ki jagah nahi hai — woh aasmaani nahi, zameen par hai. Woh marne ke baad nahi, jeete ji milti hai.

Bas teen cheezein chahiye — kaama aur krodh se azaadi, saadhha hua mann, aur apni aatma ki sachchi pehchaan.

Aur jab yeh ho jaata hai, tab mukti kisi ek jagah nahi milti — woh har taraf dikhti hai. Har pal mein, har cheez mein. Kyunki ab andar ki aankhein khul gayi hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Mukti kisi mandir mein nahi, kisi pahad par nahi — jab kaama, krodh aur anjaana kat jaaye, tab jo insaan dhoondh raha tha woh uske andar hi tha, hamesha se.

verses.sanskrit:
स्पर्शान्कृत्वा बहिर्बाह्यांश्चक्षुश्चैवान्तरे भ्रुवोः ।
प्राणापानौ समौ कृत्वा नासाभ्यन्तरचारिणौ ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sparshan Kritva Bahir Bahyams Chakshus Caiva Antare Bhruvoh,
Prana Apanau Samau Kritva Nasa Abhyantara Carinau.
verses.englishMeaning: Keeping all outer objects and sensory contacts outside, fixing the gaze between the two eyebrows, and making the inward and outward breath move equally within the nostrils —
verses.hinglishMeaning: Baahri duniya ki saari cheezon ko baahir hi chhod do — unhe andar mat aane do. Aankhon ki drishti ko dono bhaunon ke beech tika lo. Aur naak ke andar aati-jaati saans ko ek jaisi aur sthir kar lo.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok ek sadhna ki shuruwaat hai — dhyaan ki vidhi.

Shri Krishna teen cheezein bata rahe hain — pehli, baahri duniya ko baahir rehne do. Aankhein band karo ya aa rha kuch dekho mat — sirf andar.

Doosri, aankhon ko bhaunon ke beech tika lo — yeh ek gehri dhyan ki jagah hai jahan mann theharne lagta hai.

Teesri, saans ko sama kar lo — na bahut tez, na bahut dheemi. Seedhi, sthir, ek jaisi.

Yeh teeno kaam ek saath karne se mann dheere-dheere baahri shor se hat kar andar aane lagta hai. Yeh dhyaan ka darwaaza hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab baahri duniya ko baahir chhod do, drishti andar tiko aur saans sthir ho — tab mann apne aap shaant hone lagta hai. Andar jaane ka raasta hamesha saans se hi hota hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यतेन्द्रियमनोबुद्धिर्मुनिर्मोक्षपरायणः ।
विगतेच्छाभयक्रोधो यः सदा मुक्त एव सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yata Indriya Mano Buddhir Munir Moksha Parayanah,
Vigata Iccha Bhaya Krodho Yah Sada Mukta Eva Sah.
verses.englishMeaning: The sage whose senses, mind and intellect are fully mastered, who is devoted to liberation, who is free from desire, fear and anger — that person is forever liberated.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jis muni ne apni indriyaan, mann aur buddhi — teeno ko poori tarah kaaboo kar liya hai, jo sirf mukti ko apna maqsad maanta hai, aur jo ichchha, darr aur gusse se mukta ho gaya hai — woh hamesha ke liye azaad hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna pichle shlok mein dhyaan ki vidhi batai — aur ab uss insaan ka fal bata rahe hain jo woh vidhi sachche mann se jee leta hai.

Woh muni — yaani woh insaan jo andar se jeeta hai — uski indriyaan baahir nahi bhaagti. Uska mann halaachal mein nahi aata. Uski buddhi bhatak nahi jaati.

Aur teen cheezein jo sabse zyaada dukh deti hain — ichchha, darr aur gussa — woh teeno usse chhhod chuke hain.

Aur jab yeh sab ho jaata hai — woh hamesha ke liye mukta hai. Yeh koi bhavishya ki baat nahi — woh abhi, isi pal, azaad hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sachchi azaadi tab milti hai jab ichchha, darr aur gussa — yeh teen andar se nikal jaayein. Phir na koi rok sakta hai, na koi tod sakta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
भोक्तारं यज्ञतपसां सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम् ।
सुहृदं सर्वभूतानां ज्ञात्वा मां शान्तिमृच्छति ॥
verses.transliteration:
Bhoktaram Yajna Tapasam Sarva Loka Maheshvaram,
Suhridam Sarva Bhutanam Jnatva Mam Shantim Ricchati.
verses.englishMeaning: Knowing me as the one who receives all sacrifices and austerities, as the supreme lord of all the worlds, and as the true friend of all living beings — one attains lasting peace.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jab koi yeh sachchi tarah se jaanta hai ki main hi saare yajna aur tapasya ka phalataa hoon, main hi teeno lokon ka sabse bada Ishwar hoon, aur main hi har jeev ka sachcha dost hoon — tab woh sachchi aur tikaau shanti paata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh poore Adhyaay 5 ka aakhiri shlok hai — aur Shri Krishna iss mein apna sabse bada parichay dete hain.

Woh keh rahe hain — main woh hoon jo teri har mehnat, har ibadat, har tapasya ko paata hai. Koi koshish barbaad nahi hoti.

Main hi is poori srishti ka maalik hoon — koi aur nahi.

Aur sabse badi baat — main tera sachcha dost hoon. Na koi shart, na koi laalach. Sirf tera bhala.

Jo insaan yeh teen cheezein sachchi tarah se samajh leta hai — uske andar ek aisi shanti aati hai jo phir kabhi nahi jaati.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab yeh pata chal jaaye ki jo sab kuch dekh raha hai, sab kuch sambhaal raha hai aur jo tera sachcha dost bhi hai — woh ek hi hai — tab dil mein ek aisi shanti aati hai jo koi nahi chhin sakta.

summary: The sixth chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Dhyana Yoga. In this chapter, Krishna reveals the Yoga of Meditation and how to practise this Yoga. He discusses the role of action in preparing for Meditation, how performing duties in devotion purifies one's mind and heightens one's spiritual consciousness. He explains in detail the obstacles that one faces when trying to control their mind and the exact methods by which one can conquer their mind. He reveals how one can focus their mind on Paramatma and unite with the God.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
अनाश्रितः कर्मफलं कार्यं कर्म करोति यः ।
स संन्यासी च योगी च न निरग्निर्न चाक्रियः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Shri Bhagavan Uvacha:
Anashritah Karma Phalam Karyam Karma Karoti Yah,
Sa Sannyasi Ca Yogi Ca Na Niragnir Na Ca Akriyah.
verses.englishMeaning: Shri Krishna said: One who performs their duty without depending on the results of action — that person is both a true renunciant and a true yogi. Not the one who has merely given up fire or stopped all activity.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Shri Krishna ne kaha:

Jo insaan apna zaroori kaam karta hai bina natije ki parwaah kiye — wahi sachcha sanyaasi hai aur wahi sachcha yogi bhi hai. Na ki woh jo sirf baahri cheezein chhhod deta hai ya kaam karna hi band kar deta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna Chapter 6 ki shuruwaat ek bahut badi galti door karte hue karte hain.

Log sochte hain ki sanyaasi woh hota hai jo ghar chhhod de, khaana-peena chhhod de, sab kuch chhhod de. Aur yogi woh hota hai jo sirf aasana lagaake baithta hai.

Lekin Shri Krishna keh rahe hain — nahi. Sachcha sanyaasi woh hai jo kaam karta hai lekin natije se nahi chipakta. Aur sachcha yogi woh hai jo duniya mein rehta hai lekin duniya uske andar nahi rehti.

Yeh shlok dikhata hai ki sachchi sadhana baahri dikhawe mein nahi, andar ke bhaav mein hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Kaam chhhodni sachchi taaqat nahi — kaam karte hue natije se azaad rehna sachchi taaqat hai. Sachcha yogi duniya mein rehta hai, duniya usmein nahi rehti.

verses.sanskrit:
यं संन्यासमिति प्राहुर्योगं तं विद्धि पाण्डव ।
न ह्यसंन्यस्तसङ्कल्पो योगी भवति कश्चन ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yam Sannyasam Iti Prahur Yogam Tam Viddhi Pandava,
Na Hi Asannyasta Sankalpo Yogi Bhavati Kashcana.
verses.englishMeaning: What the wise call renunciation — know that to be yoga itself, Arjun. For no one can become a true yogi without first giving up selfish intentions and desires.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Hey Arjun! Jise log sanyaas kehte hain — us hi ko tum yoga samjho.

Kyunki jo insaan apne swarth bhari soch aur manshaaon ko nahi chhhod sakta, woh kabhi sachcha yogi nahi ban sakta.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna yahan ek bahut badi baat saaf kar rahe hain — sanyaas aur yoga alag-alag nahi hain.

Jo cheez sanyaas mein chhhodi jaati hai — woh hai swarth, natije ki chahat, apni manshaaein. Aur yogi bhi yahi karta hai — kaam karta hai par apni manshaaon ko beech mein nahi laata.

Toh dono ek hi cheez hain — farq sirf naam ka hai.

Aur sabse zaroori baat — jo apni khwaishein aur manshaaein nahi chhhod sakta, woh yogi nahi ban sakta — chahe kitna bhi aasana lagaaye.
verses.lifeLesson: Yoga sirf sharir ka nahi, mann ka kaam hai. Jab tak andar ki khwaishein aur manshaaein nahi chhhodi, koi bhi sachcha yogi nahi ban sakta.

verses.sanskrit:
आरुरुक्षोर्मुनेर्योगं कर्म कारणमुच्यते ।
योगारूढस्य तस्यैव शमः कारणमुच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Arurukshor Muner Yogam Karma Karanam Ucyate,
Yoga Arudhasya Tasya Eva Shamah Karanam Ucyate.
verses.englishMeaning: For a seeker who is beginning to climb the path of yoga, sincere action is said to be the means. But for the same person who has already reached the heights of yoga, inner stillness and quietude become the means.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Jo muni yoga ki seedhi chadhna shuru kar raha hai — uske liye karm karna hi raasta hai.

Lekin jo wahi muni yoga ki oonchaayi par pahunch jaata hai — uske liye andar ki shanti aur sthirata hi aage ka raasta ban jaata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna yahan sadhna ke do pado ki baat karte hain — shuruwaat aur poornata.

Jab koi abhi seekh raha hota hai, abhi chal raha hota hai — tab uske liye karm sabse bada saadhana hai. Kaam karo, mehnat karo, seekhte raho.

Lekin jab woh pahunch jaata hai — tab kaam ki jagah andar ki shanti le leti hai. Ab woh itna sthir ho jaata hai ki koi halaachal nahi hoti.

Yeh shlok sikhata hai ki har safar mein ek waqt aata hai — pehle chalna padta hai, phir thamna padta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shuruwaat mein karm karo, seekhte raho, chalte raho. Lekin jab andar ki shanti aa jaaye — tab woh shanti hi teri sabse badi taaqat ban jaati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यदा हि नेन्द्रियार्थेषु न कर्मस्वनुषज्जते ।
सर्वसङ्कल्पसंन्यासी योगारूढस्तदोच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yada Hi Na Indriya Artheshu Na Karmasu Anushajjate,
Sarva Sankalpa Sannyasi Yoga Arudhah Tada Ucyate.
verses.englishMeaning: When a person no longer clings to sense pleasures or to actions for personal gain, and has completely given up all selfish intentions — that person is then said to have truly ascended to yoga.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jab koi insaan na indriyaan ke sukh mein aur na karmon ke natije mein chipakta hai, aur jab woh apni saari swarth bhari manshaaon ko poori tarah chhhod deta hai — tab kaha jaata hai ki woh sachchi tarah yoga ki oonchaayi par pahunch gaya.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna yahan yogaarudha — yaani yoga ki oonchaayi par pahunche hue insaan — ki sachchi nishani bata rahe hain.

Do cheezein nahi rehti usmein — pehli, indriyaan ke sukh ki lalak. Na achha khaana, na sundar dikhna, na baahri cheezein paane ki bhookh. Doosri, karm ke natije se lagav. Na yeh sochna ki mera kaam kaisa gaya, log kya sochenge.

Aur teesri aur sabse badi — saari manshaaein khatam. Koi agenda nahi. Sirf kaam, sirf seva, sirf sachcaai.

Jab yeh teeno khatam ho jaayein — tab sachcha yogi paida hota hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab na sukh ki bhookh ho, na natije ki chinta, na koi chhupa iraada — tab samjho sachchi yoga shuru hui. Yahi sachchi azaadi ki pehchaan hai.

verses.sanskrit:
उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत् ।
आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Uddhared Atmana Atmanam Na Atmanam Avasadayet,
Atmaiva Hi Atmano Bandhur Atmaiva Ripur Atmanah.
verses.englishMeaning: Let a person lift themselves up by their own self — let them not pull themselves down. For the self alone is the friend of the self, and the self alone is the enemy of the self.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Apne aap ko apne hi dum par uthao — apne aap ko mat girane do.

Kyunki tu hi apna sabse achha dost hai — aur tu hi apna sabse bada dushman bhi.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Gita ke sabse taaqatwar aur seedhe shlokkon mein se ek hai.

Shri Krishna keh rahe hain — tera uddhaar koi aur nahi karega. Na koi dost, na koi guru, na koi Bhagwan tujhe uthane aayega jab tak tu khud nahi uthna chahta.

Tu hi apna dost hai — jab tu sahi sochta hai, sahi kaam karta hai, khud ko sambhalta hai.

Aur tu hi apna dushman hai — jab tu khud ko kosta hai, galat raastonpar chalta hai, apne aap ko girata hai.

Koi baahri duniya zimmedaar nahi — tu hi hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Tera sabse bada dost aur sabse bada dushman — dono tu hi hai. Jis din tune khud ko sambhaala, usi din duniya ne bhi tera saath diya.

verses.sanskrit:
बन्धुरात्मात्मनस्तस्य येनात्मैवात्मना जितः ।
अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Bandhur Atma Atmanas Tasya Yena Atmaiva Atmana Jitah,
Anatmanas Tu Shatrutve Varteta Atmaiva Shatruvat.
verses.englishMeaning: For the one who has conquered the self by the self — the self becomes a true friend. But for the one who has not mastered the self — the self acts as an enemy, just like a foe.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Jis insaan ne apne aap ko — apne mann aur indriyaan ko — apne hi dum par jeeta liya hai, uska apna aap hi uska sachcha dost ban jaata hai.

Lekin jo apne aap ko nahi jeet paya — uske liye woh khud hi ek dushman ki tarah kaam karta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna pichle shlok ki baat aur gehra karte hain.

Jo insaan apne mann ko, apni khwaishon ko, apne gusse ko, apne darr ko — kaaboo kar leta hai — woh apna dost hai. Tab woh khud ko aage badhata hai, khud ko sambhalta hai.

Lekin jo nahi kar paata — woh khud ka dushman hai. Woh khud hi apni neend uraata hai, khud hi apna sukun chhinata hai, khud hi apni taraqqui rokhta hai.

Koi baahri dushman utna nuksan nahi pahunchata jitna andar ka bhatka hua mann pahunchata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apne mann ko jeeto — phir koi bhi tujhe nahi hara sakta. Aur agar mann ne tujhe haraaya — toh koi bhi dost tujhe nahi bacha sakta.

verses.sanskrit:
जितात्मनः प्रशान्तस्य परमात्मा समाहितः ।
शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु तथा मानापमानयोः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Jita Atmanah Prashantasya Paramatma Samahitah,
Shita Ushna Sukha Duhkheshu Tatha Mana Apamanayoh.
verses.englishMeaning: For the one who has conquered the self and attained deep inner peace — the Supreme Self is ever present and fully realised — whether in cold or heat, in joy or sorrow, in honour or dishonour.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Jo insaan apne aap ko jeet chuka hai aur andar se poora shaant hai — uske liye Parmatma har waqt, har jagah maujood rehta hai.

Chahe thandi ho ya garmi, sukh ho ya dukh, izzat mile ya beiizzati — koi fark nahi padta.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna ek bahut sundar aur gehra sach bata rahe hain — Parmatma door nahi hai.

Woh har waqt maujood hai — lekin uss insaan ko dikhta hai jiska andar shaant hai. Jiska mann ulajha hua hai, bhatka hua hai, woh Parmatma ko dekh hi nahi sakta — kyunki woh sheeshe par dhool hai.

Lekin jo andar se jeeta hua hai, jo gar mi-thandi, sukh-dukh, taareef-burai — sab mein ek jaisa rehta hai — uske liye Parmatma kabhi door nahi hota. Woh har pal uss ke saath hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Parmatma ko dhundhne ke liye door jaane ki zaroorat nahi — andar ki shanti aa jaaye, tab woh khud nazaar aata hai. Jo andar sthir hai, use Ishwar har jagah dikhta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञानविज्ञानतृप्तात्मा कूटस्थो विजितेन्द्रियः ।
युक्त इत्युच्यते योगी समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Jnana Vijnana Tripta Atma Kutastho Vijita Indriyah,
Yukta Iti Ucyate Yogi Sama Loshta Ashma Kancanah.
verses.englishMeaning: The yogi who is fully content with knowledge and wisdom, who is unshakeable and unmoved, who has mastered the senses, and who sees a clod of earth, a stone and gold as equal — that person is said to be truly united with the divine.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo yogi gyaan aur anubhav se poori tarah tripta hai, jo kisi bhi cheez se nahi hilda, jisne apni indriyaan kaaboo kar li hain, aur jo mitti, patthar aur sona — teeno ko ek jaisi nazar se dekhta hai — wahi sachcha yukta yogi kehlaata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna sachche yogi ki kuch aur khaas nishaniyan bata rahe hain.

Pehli — woh gyaan se aur anubhav se poora tripta hai. Use aur kuch chahiye nahi.

Doosri — woh kisi bhi haalat mein nahi hilda. Toofan aaye, koi fark nahi.

Teesri — indriyaan uski gulam hain, woh indriyaan ka gulam nahi.

Aur sabse ajeeb aur gehra — mitti, patthar aur sona — teeno mein koi fark nahi. Kyunki jo sachche gyaan waala hai, woh cheezoin ki qeemat se nahi, sachcaai se dekhta hai.

Aur jo yeh sab jeeta hai — woh sachcha yogi hai, sachcha yukta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab sona aur mitti ek jaisi lage — tab samjho sachcha gyaan aa gaya. Cheezein wahi hain, bas nazar badal gayi — aur wahi sachchi azaadi hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सुहृन्मित्रार्युदासीनमध्यस्थद्वेष्यबन्धुषु ।
साधुष्वपि च पापेषु समबुद्धिर्विशिष्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Suhrin Mitra Ari Udasina Madhyastha Dveshya Bandhushu,
Sadhushu Api Ca Papeshu Sama Buddhir Vishishyate.
verses.englishMeaning: One who sees with an equal and steady mind — a well-wisher, a friend, an enemy, a neutral person, a mediator, the hateful, a relative, the righteous and even the sinful — that person truly stands apart and above all.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo insaan apna dost ho ya dushman, jo beech mein ho ya nafrat karne waala, jo riste daaar ho ya pakka bura insaan — sabko ek jaisi nazar se dekhe — aisa insaan sachche mein ooncha aur khaas hota hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna yahan sachchi samanta ki baat kar rahe hain — aur yeh bahut mushkil hai.

Dost ko achha kehna aasaan hai. Dushman ko bura kehna aasaan hai. Lekin dono ko ek jaisi nazar se dekhna — yeh bahut badi sadhana hai.

Aur Shri Krishna keh rahe hain ki jo aise dekh sakta hai — jo achhe insaan aur bure insaan mein bhi ek hi sachcaai dekhta hai — woh sachche mein shreshtha hai. Woh sab se alag hai, sab se ooncha hai.

Yeh vibhajan ki nazar nahi — yeh ekta ki nazar hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab dost aur dushman, achhe aur bure — sab mein ek hi roshni dikhe — tab samjho tu sachchi oonchaayi par pahunch gaya. Yeh nazar aana hi sachchi sadhana ki nishaani hai.

verses.sanskrit:
योगी युञ्जीत सततमात्मानं रहसि स्थितः ।
एकाकी यतचित्तात्मा निराशीरपरिग्रहः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yogi Yunjita Satatam Atmanam Rahasi Sthitah,
Ekaki Yata Citta Atma Nirashir Aparigraham.
verses.englishMeaning: The yogi should constantly keep the mind absorbed in the self, living in a secluded place, alone, with the mind and body disciplined, free from expectations and free from the desire to possess.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yogi ko chahiye ki woh ekant mein rehkar, akela rehkar, apne mann aur sharir ko kaaboo mein rakhte hue, bina kisi umeed ke aur bina kisi cheez ko apnaane ki chahat ke — apne mann ko hamesha aatma mein lagaaye rakhe.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna dhyaan ki shuruwaat ka raasta bata rahe hain — aur ismein chaar cheezein hain.

Pehli — ekant. Shor mein mann nahi theherta. Isliye pehle ek shaant jagah chahiye.

Doosri — akela rehna. Jab doosron ki awaazen nahi hoti, tab andar ki awaaz sunni milti hai.

Teesri — mann aur sharir kaaboo mein. Nahi toh dhyaan bhatak jaata hai.

Chawthi — aur sabse zaroori — koi umeed nahi, koi cheez apnaane ki chahat nahi. Khali haath, khali mann — tab hi Parmatma aata hai.

Yeh chaar cheezein dhyaan ka darwaaza khol deti hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Kuch paane ke liye pehle sab chhhodo — umeed bhi, cheezein bhi, shor bhi. Jab sab kuch khaali ho jaata hai, tab jo bhar jaata hai woh koi cheez nahi le jaati.

verses.sanskrit:
शुचौ देशे प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्थिरमासनमात्मनः ।
नात्युच्छ्रितं नातिनीचं चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Shucau Deshe Pratishthapya Sthiram Asanam Atmanah,
Na Atyucchritam Na Ati Nicam Caila Ajina Kushottaram.
verses.englishMeaning: In a clean and pure place, one should set up a firm seat for oneself — neither too high nor too low — covered with sacred grass, a deer skin and a cloth, one upon the other.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Ek saaf aur pavitra jagah par apna aasana taiyaar karo — na bahut ooncha, na bahut neecha — neeche kusha ghaans, phir mrigacharm, aur uske upar ek kapda.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna dhyaan ki taiyaari ke baare mein bata rahe hain — aur woh pehle jagah se shuru karte hain.

Jagah saaf ho — baahir se bhi, andar se bhi. Jo jagah dhyaan ke liye chunte ho, woh tumhare mann ko prabhavit karti hai.

Aur aasana na itna ooncha ho ki girne ka darr ho, na itna neecha ki zameen ki thandi ya gelaapan pareshan kare. Ek sthir, aaram-deh aur pavitra jagah.

Yeh sirf baahri taiyaari nahi — yeh ek sandesh hai ki andar ke dhyaan ke liye baahri sthirata bhi zaroori hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Koi bhi badi cheez karne se pehle mahaul theek karo — saaf jagah, sthir mann, pavitra bhaav. Taiyaari hi aadhi jeet hoti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्रैकाग्रं मनः कृत्वा यतचित्तेन्द्रियक्रियः ।
उपविश्यासने युञ्ज्याद्योगमात्मविशुद्धये ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tatra Ekagram Manah Kritva Yata Citta Indriya Kriyah,
Upavishya Asane Yunjyad Yogam Atma Vishuddhaye.
verses.englishMeaning: There, sitting on that seat, with the mind focused on a single point, with the activities of the mind and senses brought under control — one should practise yoga for the purification of the inner self.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Wahan us aasane par baith kar, mann ko ek jagah tika kar, apne chitta aur indriyaan ki saari halaachal kaaboo mein karke — apne andar ki shuddhi ke liye yoga ka abhyaas karo.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna ab aasane par baithne ke baad kya karna hai — woh bata rahe hain.

Teen cheezein ek saath karni hain — pehli, mann ko ek jagah tikana. Ek cheez, ek sawaal, ek sachcaai — bas usi par dhyaan.

Doosri, chitta aur indriyaan ki halaachal band karna. Kaan kuch nahi sunenge, aankhein kuch nahi dekhenge — sirf andar.

Teesri aur sabse zaroori — yeh sab karne ka maqsad kya hai? Apne andar ki shuddhi. Koi dikhaawa nahi, koi record banana nahi — sirf andar saaf karna.

Jab yeh teeno ek saath hoti hain, tab sachcha yoga shuru hota hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Dhyaan ka matlab sirf aankhein band karna nahi — mann ko ek jagah tikana, indriyaan ko shaant karna, aur andar saaf karna. Yeh teeno saath hon tab dhyaan sachcha hota hai.

verses.sanskrit:
समं कायशिरोग्रीवं धारयन्नचलं स्थिरः ।
सम्प्रेक्ष्य नासिकाग्रं स्वं दिशश्चानवलोकयन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Samam Kaya Shiro Grivam Dharayan Acalam Sthirah,
Samprekshya Nasikagram Svam Dishas Ca Anavalokayan.
verses.englishMeaning: Holding the body, head and neck erect and still, in a straight line, without movement — gazing steadily at the tip of the nose, without letting the eyes wander in any other direction.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Apna sharir, sar aur gardan — teeno seedhe, ek line mein, bilkul sthir rakhkar — apni naak ki nok par dhyaan lagao aur aankhon ko kisi aur taraf mat jaane do.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna dhyaan ki baithne ki vidhi bata rahe hain — aur yeh bahut sochke batayi gayi hai.

Sharir, sar aur gardan ek seedhi line mein — kyunki jab sharir seedha hota hai, tab saans seedha chalta hai, aur jab saans seedha chalta hai, tab mann seedha hone lagta hai.

Aur naak ki nok par drishti — yeh ek bahut gehra abhyaas hai. Jab aankhein naak ki nok par tikti hain, tab woh na bahut andar jaati hain, na bahut baahir. Mann ek jagah theharna shuru karta hai.

Yeh sirf ek baithne ki vidhi nahi — yeh ek poori sadhna hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab sharir sthir hota hai, tab mann bhi sthir hone lagta hai. Andar ki shanti ki shuruwaat aksar baahri sthirata se hoti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रशान्तात्मा विगतभीर्ब्रह्मचारिव्रते स्थितः ।
मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Prashanta Atma Vigata Bhir Brahmacari Vrate Sthitah,
Manah Samyamya Mac Citto Yukta Asita Mat Parah.
verses.englishMeaning: With the inner self completely at peace, free from all fear, firmly established in the vow of brahmacharya — with the mind fully controlled, let the seeker sit absorbed in me, with me alone as the highest goal.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Andar se bilkul shaant, har tarah ke darr se mukta, aur brahmacharya ke vrat mein tike hue — apne mann ko poori tarah kaaboo karke, chitta mujh mein lagaao aur mujhe hi apna sabse bada maqsad maano.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna dhyaan ke liye andar ki haalat bata rahe hain — baahri aasana theek karne ke baad ab andar theek karna hai.

Pehli baat — andar bilkul shaant hona. Na gussa, na ghabrahat, na bekar ki soch.

Doosri — koi darr nahi. Na bhavishya ka darr, na kho jaane ka darr, na kisi ki fikr.

Teesri — brahmacharya — yaani apni urja ko sahi jagah lagaana, bikhaarne nahi dena.

Aur sabse aakhir — poora chitta sirf Ishwar mein. Koi doosra khayal nahi, koi doosra maqsad nahi — sirf woh ek.

Jab yeh chaar cheezein saath aati hain — tab sachcha dhyaan shuru hota hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sachcha dhyaan tab hota hai jab andar koi darr na ho, koi bikharaav na ho, aur sirf ek ek jagah, ek ek sachcaai par poora dhyaan ho.

verses.sanskrit:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदात्मानं योगी नियतमानसः ।
शान्तिं निर्वाणपरमां मत्संस्थामधिगच्छति ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yunjan Evam Sada Atmanam Yogi Niyata Manasah,
Shantim Nirvana Paramam Mat Samstham Adhigacchati.
verses.englishMeaning: The yogi who constantly keeps the mind thus absorbed in the self, with a disciplined and controlled mind — attains the supreme peace that rests in me, the peace of nirvana, of complete liberation.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo yogi isi tarah se hamesha apne mann ko aatma mein lagaaye rakhta hai, apne mann ko sanyamit rakhta hai — woh mujhman sthit param nirvaana ki shanti ko paata hai — woh shanti jo sachchi aur poori mukti hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna pichle shlokkon ka fal bata rahe hain — agar koi sachchi tarah se yeh sab karta rahe, kya milta hai?

Param nirvaana ki shanti — yaani woh shanti jo kabhi khatam nahi hoti. Woh shanti jo kisi mushkil se nahi tootti, kisi khushi se nahi aati.

Yeh duniyawi shanti nahi hai — woh toh aati jaati rehti hai. Yeh woh shanti hai jo andar se ugti hai aur hamesha rehti hai.

Aur Shri Krishna keh rahe hain — woh shanti mujh mein hai. Iska matlab yeh hai ki jo Ishwar tak pahuncha, us ne yeh shanti paali — jo kabhi nahi chhini ja sakti.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo shanti baahri cheezein de sakti hain woh aarti jaati hai. Sachchi shanti sirf andar se aati hai — aur jab ek baar aa jaaye, koi bhi cheez use nahi le jaati.

verses.sanskrit:
नात्यश्नतस्तु योगोऽस्ति न चैकान्तमनश्नतः ।
न चातिस्वप्नशीलस्य जाग्रतो नैव चार्जुन ॥
verses.transliteration:
Na Ati Ashnatas Tu Yogo Asti Na Ca Ekantam Anashnata,
Na Ca Ati Svapna Shilasya Jagrato Na Eva Ca Arjuna.
verses.englishMeaning: Yoga is not possible for the one who eats too much, nor for the one who does not eat at all. It is not for the one who sleeps too much, nor for the one who is always awake, O Arjun.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Hey Arjun! Yoga us insaan ke liye nahi hota jo bahut zyaada khaata hai — aur na hi us ke liye jo bilkul nahi khaata.

Aur na us ke liye jo bahut zyaada sota hai — aur na us ke liye jo bilkul sona hi nahi chahta.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna yahan ek bahut zaroori baat keh rahe hain — yoga ka raasta sangam ka raasta hai, kisi bhi cheez ki ati nahi.

Na bahut khaao — kyunki zyaada khaane se mann bhari ho jaata hai, bhaari ho jaata hai, dhyaan nahi lagta.

Na bilkul mat khaao — kyunki bhooka mann bhi bhatkta hai, takleef mein rehta hai.

Na bahut soo — kyunki zyaada neend aalas laati hai, mann sust ho jaata hai.

Na bilkul mat soo — kyunki thaka hua sharir aur mann kabhi dhyaan nahi laga sakta.

Santulan — yahi yoga ka raasta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Zindagi mein kisi bhi ek cheez ki ati nahi — na khaane ki, na soone ki, na kaam ki. Jo santulan mein jeeta hai, wahi sachcha yogi hai.

verses.sanskrit:
युक्ताहारविहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु ।
युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा ॥
verses.transliteration:
