Yukta Ahara Viharasya Yukta Ceshtasya Karmasu,
Yukta Svapna Avabodhasya Yogo Bhavati Duhkhaha.
verses.englishMeaning: For the one who eats and moves in the right measure, who acts with the right effort in all tasks, who sleeps and stays awake in the right balance — for such a person, yoga becomes the destroyer of all suffering.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo insaan sahi matra mein khaata aur ghoomta hai, jo apne harr kaam mein sahi mehnat karta hai, aur jo sahi matra mein sota aur jaagta hai — aisa insaan yoga ke zariye apne saare dukh door kar sakta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna pichle shlok ka jawab is mein de rahe hain — na zyaada, na kam. Theek utna, jitna zaroori hai.

Khaana theek utna jo sharir ko urja de — na itna zyaada ki bhaari lag jaaye, na itna kam ki kamzori aa jaaye.

Kaam mein mehnat theek utni jo sahi ho — na zyaada ki toota jaaye, na itni kam ki kuch bane hi nahi.

Neend theek utni jo sharir aur mann ko taza kare — na zyaada ki din barbad ho, na itni kam ki thakan rahe.

Aur jab koi yeh sab sahi tarah se karta hai — tab yoga sirf ek abhyaas nahi rehta, woh ek dukh-nashak ban jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Zindagi ka raaz santulan mein hai — sahi khaana, sahi kaam, sahi neend. Jab yeh teeno sahi hon, tab koi bhi dukh tujhe zyaada der nahi rok sakta.

verses.sanskrit:
यदा विनियतं चित्तमात्मन्येवावतिष्ठते ।
निःस्पृहः सर्वकामेभ्यो युक्त इत्युच्यते तदा ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yada Viniyatam Cittam Atmani Eva Avatishthate,
Nih Sprihah Sarva Kamebhyo Yukta Iti Ucyate Tada.
verses.englishMeaning: When the fully controlled mind rests in the self alone, free from longing for any and all desires — that person is then said to be truly united in yoga.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jab poori tarah kaaboo mein aaya hua chitta sirf aatma mein hi tik jaata hai, aur insaan har tarah ki khwaishon se bilkul mukt ho jaata hai — tab woh sachcha yukta yogi kehlaata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna yahan sachche yogi ki sabse gehra pehchaan bata rahe hain.

Do cheezein ek saath hoti hain — pehli, mann poori tarah aatma mein tik jaata hai. Matlab mann baahri duniya mein nahi bhaagta, woh andar andar rehta hai, andar hi andar.

Doosri — koi bhi khwaish nahi rehti. Na chhoti, na badi. Na yeh chahiye, na woh chahiye. Sirf woh jo hai — wahi kaafi hai.

Aur jab dono ek saath hoti hain — tab Shri Krishna kehte hain — woh sachcha yukta hai. Sachcha yogi hai.

Yeh koi ek din ki baat nahi — yeh ek gehra aur dheema aur tikaau badlaav hai jo andar se hota hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab mann ko koi khwaish nahi khainchti aur woh andar hi tika rehta hai — tab samjho sachcha yoga ho gaya. Woh pal tab aata hai jab lagna shuru ho jaata hai ki jo hai, wahi kaafi hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता ।
योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगमात्मनः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yatha Dipo Nivata Stho Na Ingate Sa Upama Smrita,
Yogino Yata Cittasya Yunjato Yogam Atmanah.
verses.englishMeaning: Just as a lamp placed in a windless spot does not flicker — that is the classic image used for the mind of a yogi whose thoughts are stilled, who is absorbed in the yoga of the self.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jaise hawa se door rakhaa hua ek diya bilkul nahi kaampata — wahi misaal di jaati hai us yogi ke mann ki jo apne chitta ko kaaboo karke aatma ke dhyaan mein poora duba hua hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna yahan ek bahut sundar aur seedhi misaal dete hain — ek diye ki.

Jab diya hawa mein hota hai, tab woh kaampata rehta hai — lau idhhar-udhhaar jaati hai. Lekin jab hawa bilkul nahi hoti — diya bilkul sthir rehta hai. Na idhar, na udhar. Sirf ek seedhi, sthir roshni.

Usi tarah sachche yogi ka mann hota hai. Duniya ki baatein, khwaishein, khayaalaat — yeh sab hawa ki tarah hoti hain. Jab yogi inhe andar aane nahi deta — tab uska mann ek sthir diye ki tarah ho jaata hai.

Na kaampna, na bhatakna — sirf sthir, shaant, roshan.
verses.lifeLesson: Sachcha dhyaan tab hota hai jab mann ka diya bilkul sthir ho — baahri duniya ki hawa andar tak na pahunche. Yeh sthirata hi sachchi roshni hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यत्रोपरमते चित्तं निरुद्धं योगसेवया ।
यत्र चैवात्मनात्मानं पश्यन्नात्मनि तुष्यति ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yatra Uparamate Cittam Niruddham Yoga Sevaya,
Yatra Ca Eva Atmana Atmanam Pashyan Atmani Tushyati.
verses.englishMeaning: That state in which the mind, restrained by the practice of yoga, comes to rest completely — and in which, seeing the self by the self alone, one finds deep contentment within the self.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Woh avastha jisme yoga ke abhyaas se kaaboo mein aaya hua chitta poori tarah shaant ho jaata hai — aur jisme insaan apne aap ko apne aap mein dekhta hai aur apne aap mein hi tripta ho jaata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna woh gehri avastha bata rahe hain jo sachche dhyaan se milti hai.

Pehle chitta ruk jaata hai — bhaagta nahi, bhatakta nahi. Yoga ke lambe aur sachche abhyaas se woh sthir ho jaata hai.

Aur phir kuch aur hota hai — insaan apne aap ko apne aap mein dekhne lagta hai. Na baahri aaine mein, na doosron ki raay mein — apne andar.

Aur jab woh apne aap ko sachchi tarah dekhta hai — tab ek gehri tripti aati hai. Na koi cheez chahiye, na koi insaan chahiye. Sirf apne andar ka woh sukoon — jo kaafi hai, jo poora hai.

Yeh woh jagah hai jahan sachcha dhyaan le jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab andar jaake khud ko dekh lo aur wahan hi tripti mil jaaye — tab samjho sachcha dhyaan ho gaya. Woh jagah koi aur nahi de sakta, sirf tu apne aap ko de sakta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सुखमात्यन्तिकं यत्तद् बुद्धिग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम् ।
वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sukham Atyantikam Yat Tad Buddhi Grahyam Ati Indriyam,
Vetti Yatra Na Ca Eva Ayam Sthitas Calati Tattvatah.
verses.englishMeaning: That infinite and absolute happiness which is beyond the senses and can only be grasped by a purified intellect — once a person knows that happiness and is established in it, they never move away from that truth.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Woh sukh jo anant hai, jo indriyaan se nahi, sirf shuddh buddhi se hi mehsoos hota hai — jab koi uss sukh ko jaanta hai aur usmein tik jaata hai, tab woh sachcaai se kabhi nahi hilda.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna woh sukh bata rahe hain jo is duniya ka nahi hai.

Duniya ka sukh indriyaan se aata hai — aankhon se, kaano se, sparsh se. Woh aata hai aur chala jaata hai.

Lekin jo sukh Shri Krishna yahan bata rahe hain — woh indriyaan se pare hai. Woh tab milta hai jab buddhi shuddh ho jaati hai aur andar ki aankhein khulti hain.

Aur sabse badi baat — jo ek baar uss sukh ko sachchi tarah mehsoos kar leta hai, woh phir kabhi sachcaai se nahi bhatakta. Kyunki ab usse pata chal gaya hai ki sachcha kya hai.

Uske baad baahri duniya ki koi bhi cheez use uss jagah se nahi hila sakti.
verses.lifeLesson: Ek baar andar ka sachcha sukh mehsoos ho jaaye — tab baahri duniya ki koi bhi cheez tujhe zyaada der ke liye nahi bahakaati. Uss sukh ki koi tulna nahi.

verses.sanskrit:
यं लब्ध्वा चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः ।
यस्मिन्स्थितो न दुःखेन गुरुणापि विचाल्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yam Labdhva Ca Aparam Labham Manyate Na Adhikam Tatah,
Yasmin Sthito Na Duhkhena Gurunapi Vicalyate.
verses.englishMeaning: Having attained which, one believes there is no greater gain beyond it — and being established in which, even the heaviest of sorrows cannot shake a person.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jise paakar insaan yeh maanta hai ki isse bada aur koi laabh nahi ho sakta — aur jisme sthit hokar woh bade se bade dukh se bhi nahi hilda.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna woh prapti bata rahe hain jo sab praptiyon se badi hai.

Jab koi cheez milti hai aur mann kehta hai — ab kuch aur chahiye — woh sachchi prapti nahi hoti. Duniya ki saari cheezein aise hi hain — milti hain, thodi der khushi deti hain, phir aur chahiye.

Lekin jo sachcha sukh hai — jab woh milta hai, tab mann kehta hai — bas, yahi kaafi hai. Yisse bada kuch nahi. Koi lalak nahi, koi kami nahi.

Aur phir jo dukh aata hai duniya mein — bada se bada — tab bhi woh insaan nahi hilda. Woh toot nahi jaata. Kyunki jo us ke paas hai, woh koi le nahi sakta.
verses.lifeLesson: Sachcha dhan woh hai jiske milne ke baad aur kuch nahi chahiye — aur jiske hote hue koi bhi dukh tujhe poori tarah tod nahi sakta.

verses.sanskrit:
तं विद्याद् दुःखसंयोगवियोगं योगसंज्ञितम् ।
स निश्चयेन योक्तव्यो योगोऽनिर्विण्णचेतसा ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tam Vidyad Duhkha Sanyoga Viyogam Yoga Sanjnitam,
Sa Nishcayena Yoktavyo Yogo Anirvinna Cetasa.
verses.englishMeaning: Know this to be what is called yoga — the complete separation from all connection with suffering. This yoga must be practised with firm determination and with a mind that does not grow weary or lose heart.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Isi ko 'yoga' samjho — dukh ke har rishte se poori tarah mukti.

Aur is yoga ka abhyaas poori nishchinta aur dridh nishchay se karo — bina thake, bina haare, bina mann mein udaasi laaye.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna yahan yoga ki sabse gehri paribhasha dete hain — yoga kya hai?

Yoga matlab dukh se poori tarah mukti. Na sirf ek dukh, na kuch dukh — balki dukh ke saath jo bhi rishta hai, woh poori tarah khatam ho jaana.

Aur yeh kaise hoga? Sirf ek tarah se — dridh nishchay se. Bina uke, bina thake, bina haar ke.

Kyunki dhyaan aur yoga ek din ka kaam nahi. Kai baar mann bhatakta hai, kai baar thakaan aati hai. Lekin jo rukta nahi, jo haar ke wapas shuru karta hai — woh ek din zaroor pahunchta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Dukh se mukti ek pal mein nahi milti — woh milti hai roz ke dridh aur sabar bhari koshish se. Thako mat, ruko mat — ek din zaroor pahunchoge.

verses.sanskrit:
सङ्कल्पप्रभवान्कामांस्त्यक्त्वा सर्वानशेषतः ।
मनसैवेन्द्रियग्रामं विनियम्य समन्ततः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sankalpa Prabhavan Kaman Tyaktva Sarvan Asheshatah,
Manasaiva Indriya Gramam Viniyamya Samantatah.
verses.englishMeaning: Giving up completely, without any remainder, all desires that arise from selfish intentions — and restraining the entire group of senses from all sides through the mind alone —
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Apni soch aur iraade se paida hone waali saari khwaishon ko poori tarah — bilkul bhi kuch baaki chhhode bina — chhhod do.

Aur apne mann ke zariye hi apni saari indriyaan ko har taraf se kaaboo mein lo.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok ek pukhta qadam hai sachche dhyaan ki taraf — aur Shri Krishna bahut saaf kehte hain.

Pehle — saari khwaishein chhhodni hain. Woh khwaishein jo soch se janam leti hain — yeh milega toh achha hoga, woh hoga toh theek hoga. Inn sab ko — ek-ek karke — poori tarah chhhod dena hai. Koi baaki nahi.

Doosra — indriyaan kaaboo mein leni hain. Aankhein, kaan, naak, haath — sab. Aur yeh sirf mann ke zariye hoga — koi zabardasti nahi, koi bandhan nahi. Andar se kaaboo.

Yeh dono milkar dhyaan ka darwaaza khol dete hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Dhyaan tab shuru hota hai jab saari khwaishein chhoot jaati hain — ek bhi baaki nahi. Ek khwaish bhi andar rahi toh woh mann ko baahir le jaayegi.

verses.sanskrit:
शनैः शनैरुपरमेद् बुद्ध्या धृतिगृहीतया ।
आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किञ्चिदपि चिन्तयेत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Shanaih Shanaih Uparamed Buddhya Dhrti Grhitaya,
Atma Samstham Manah Kritva Na Kincid Api Cintayet.
verses.englishMeaning: Gradually, step by step, with patience held firm by the intellect — let the seeker bring the mind to rest in the self alone, and think of nothing else whatsoever.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Dheere-dheere, ek ek qadam se, dhairya aur mazboot buddhi ke saath — mann ko aatma mein tika lo aur phir kisi bhi cheez ke baare mein kuch mat socho.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok bahut zaroori hai kyunki Shri Krishna yahan keh rahe hain — dheere-dheere.

Koi jaldi nahi. Koi ek raat ka kaam nahi. Mann saalon se bhaagta aaya hai — woh ek din mein nahi thamega.

Isliye buddhi ko mazboot karo aur dhairya rakho. Roz thodi koshish karo — aaj thoda khayal aaya, rok liya. Kal thoda aur. Parso aur thoda.

Aur dheere-dheere, bahut dheere-dheere — mann aatma mein tikne lagta hai. Aur jab tikta hai — tab koi khayal nahi, koi chinta nahi, koi shor nahi. Sirf woh sthirata.

Sabra karo — yeh safar lamba hai par manzil poori tarah worth it hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sachcha badlaav dheere-dheere aata hai — roz ek chhoti koshish, roz thoda aur dhairya. Jo sabr rakhta hai, woh ek din wahan pahunchta hai jahan jaldi karne waale kabhi nahi pahunchte.

verses.sanskrit:
यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम् ।
ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yato Yato Nishcarati Manas Cancalam Asthiram,
Tatas Tato Niyamya Etad Atmani Eva Vasham Nayet.
verses.englishMeaning: Wherever and whenever the restless and unsteady mind wanders away — from each of those directions, bring it back and lead it gently under the control of the self alone.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yeh chanchal aur asthir mann jahan bhi, jab bhi bhaagta hai — wahin se, us waqt hi, ise rokkar wapas aatma ki taraf le aao aur apne kaaboo mein karo.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok har us insaan ke liye hai jo kabhi dhyaan mein baitha ho aur mann bhaaga ho — yaani har koi.

Shri Krishna keh rahe hain — mann bhaagega. Yeh pakka hai. Yeh uski fitrat hai — woh chanchal hai, asthir hai, ek jagah nahi thamta.

Lekin kya karna hai? Ghabrana nahi. Haar nahi maanni. Bas jab bhi bhaage — wapas laao. Jahan bhi jaaye — wapas laao. Dhire se, bina gusse ke, bina khosar ke.

Yeh dhyaan ka sabse zaroori hissa hai — mann ko baar baar wapas laana. Aur jo yeh karta rehta hai — woh ek din sachchi sthirata paata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Mann bhaagega — yeh normal hai. Galti yeh nahi ki woh bhaaga. Galti tab hoti hai jab tum uske peeche bhaag jaate ho. Baar baar wapas laao — yahi sachcha abhyaas hai.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रशान्तमनसं ह्येनं योगिनं सुखमुत्तमम् ।
उपैति शान्तरजसं ब्रह्मभूतमकल्मषम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Prashanta Manasam Hi Enam Yoginam Sukham Uttamam,
Upaiti Shanta Rajasam Brahma Bhutam Akalmashham.
verses.englishMeaning: The highest happiness comes to this yogi whose mind is deeply at peace, whose restlessness has become still, who is free from all impurity and who has become one with Brahman.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jis yogi ka mann poori tarah shaant ho gaya hai, jiske andar ki bechtaini tham gayi hai, jo har tarah ki gandagi se mukt ho gaya hai aur jo Brahman ka hi roop ban gaya hai — aisa insaan sabse oonche sukh ko paata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna yahan woh insaan ka naqsha khinchte hain jo dhyaan ki poori yatra khatam karke pahunch gaya hai.

Uska mann shaant hai — na gussa, na darr, na bekar ki soch. Sirf gehri shanti.

Rajoguna — yaani andar ki bechtaini aur halaachal — woh tham gayi hai. Ab koi toofan andar nahi uthta.

Woh andar se bilkul saaf hai — koi purana daag nahi, koi purani jalaan nahi.

Aur woh Brahman ka hi hissa ban gaya hai — duniya mein rehta hai par duniya usse nahi baandh sakti.

Aur aisa insaan — sabse ooncha sukh paata hai. Woh sukh jo na koi de sakta hai, na koi le sakta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab andar ki bechtaini khatam ho jaaye, mann saaf ho jaaye aur sab mein ek hi sachcaai dikhe — tab jo sukh milta hai woh is duniya ki kisi bhi cheez se milne wala nahi hota.

verses.sanskrit:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदात्मानं योगी विगतकल्मषः ।
सुखेन ब्रह्मसंस्पर्शमत्यन्तं सुखमश्नुते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yunjan Evam Sada Atmanam Yogi Vigata Kalmashah,
Sukhena Brahma Samsparsham Atyantam Sukham Ashnute.
verses.englishMeaning: The yogi who is thus always engaged in uniting the self, who is free from all impurity — such a person effortlessly attains the supreme happiness of touching Brahman, of being in complete contact with the divine.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo yogi isi tarah hamesha apne mann ko aatma mein lagaaye rakhta hai aur andar se bilkul saaf ho gaya hai — woh sukh ke saath Brahman ka sparsh paata hai — woh anant aur poora sukh jo iss duniya mein kisi cheez se nahi milta.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Chapter 6 ke dhyaan ki poori yatra ka fal hai — Brahmasparsha.

Brahmasparsha — yaani Brahman ka sparsh. Matlab uss sachcaai ko, uss gehri aur poori haqeeqat ko — seedha mehsoos karna. Na sirf sunna, na sirf padhna — seedha andar tak mehsoos karna.

Aur yeh jo sukh hai — woh is duniya ka nahi hai. Yeh baahri cheezein deney waala sukh nahi — yeh woh sukh hai jo andar se aa raha hai, Brahman ke sparsh se aa raha hai.

Aur Shri Krishna keh rahe hain — yeh sukh uss yogi ko milta hai jo saaf hai, jo roz koshish karta hai, jo rukata nahi. Woh yogi ek din yeh sparsh paata hai — aur phir kuch baaki nahi rehta.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo roz andar jaata hai, andar saaf karta hai aur bina thake koshish karta rehta hai — ek din woh uss sukh ko chhoota hai jo koi cheez nahi de sakti aur koi cheez le nahi sakti.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि ।
ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शनः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sarva Bhuta Stham Atmanam Sarva Bhutani Ca Atmani,
Ikshate Yoga Yukta Atma Sarvatra Sama Darshanah.
verses.englishMeaning: The yogi whose mind is united in yoga and who sees equally everywhere — perceives the self present in all beings, and all beings present within the self.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo yogi yoga mein tika hua hai aur jis ki nazar sab jagah ek jaisi hai — woh apni aatma ko har jeev mein dekhta hai aur har jeev ko apni aatma mein dekhta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna yahan sachche yogi ki sabse oonchi drishti bata rahe hain — samadarshanata.

Aam insaan dekhta hai — yeh mera hai, yeh paraya hai. Yeh achha hai, yeh bura. Yeh bada, yeh chhota.

Lekin sachcha yogi alag dekhta hai — woh dekhta hai ki jo kuch bhi uske andar hai — wahi sab mein hai. Ek hi aatma, ek hi sachcaai — har jagah, har jeev mein.

Yeh sirf ek soch nahi — yeh ek gehri anubhuti hai. Jab yeh anubhuti aati hai, tab na nafrat rehti hai, na darr, na bair. Kyunki jab dusre mein khud dikhta hai — tab dusre ko takleef dena khud ko takleef dena lagta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jis din har insaan mein, har jeev mein khud ki hi aatma dikhne lage — usi din nafrat, bair aur darr sab apne aap khatam ho jaate hain.

verses.sanskrit:
यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति ।
तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yo Mam Pashyati Sarvatra Sarvam Ca Mayi Pashyati,
Tasya Aham Na Pranashyami Sa Ca Me Na Pranashyati.
verses.englishMeaning: For the one who sees me everywhere and sees everything within me — I am never lost to them, and they are never lost to me.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo insaan mujhe har jagah dekhta hai aur har cheez ko mujh mein dekhta hai — uske liye main kabhi door nahi hota, aur woh mere liye kabhi door nahi hota.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok Gita ke sabse pyaare aur gehre shlokkon mein se ek hai.

Shri Krishna ek bahut bada wada kar rahe hain — jo mujhe har jagah dekhta hai, jo patthar mein bhi, insaan mein bhi, apne dost mein bhi, apne dushman mein bhi mujhe dekhta hai — uske liye main kabhi gum nahi hota.

Aur jo mere liye kabhi gum nahi hota — woh mujhse kabhi alag nahi hota.

Yeh rishta kisi mandir ya pooja ka nahi — yeh nazar ka rishta hai. Jab nazar badal jaati hai — tab Ishwar door nahi, woh har pal, har jagah maujood rehta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Ishwar ko dhundhne ke liye kahin door jaane ki zaroorat nahi — jab har cheez mein usi ki roshni dikhne lage, tab woh hamesha ke liye paas aa jaata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वभूतस्थितं यो मां भजत्येकत्वमास्थितः ।
सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि स योगी मयि वर्तते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sarva Bhuta Sthitam Yo Mam Bhajaty Ekatvam Asthitah,
Sarvatha Vartamano Api Sa Yogi Mayi Vartate.
verses.englishMeaning: The yogi who worships me as dwelling in all beings, established in the vision of oneness — that person, no matter what their outward circumstances, always lives and abides in me.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo yogi har jeev mein mujhe maujood dekh kar, ekta ke bhaav mein tika hua, meri bhakti karta hai — woh yogi zindagi mein jo bhi kar raha ho, har haal mein mujh mein hi rehta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna pichle shlok ki baat aur gehra karte hain.

Jo insaan har jeev mein Ishwar ko dekhta hai — woh bhakti sirf mandir mein nahi karta. Woh jab bhi kisi se milta hai, kisi ki madad karta hai, kisi ko pyaar deta hai — woh Ishwar ki hi bhakti kar raha hota hai.

Aur aisa insaan zindagi mein chahe kuch bhi ho raha ho — chahe safar ho, kaam ho, ghar ho — woh hamesha Ishwar ke saath rehta hai. Kyunki uski nazar hi Ishwar mein tiki hai.

Yeh ek bahut ooncha maqam hai — jahan bhakti kisi ek samay ya jagah tak simit nahi, woh poori zindagi mein phail jaati hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sachchi bhakti mandir mein nahi, zindagi mein hoti hai — jab har insaan mein, har kaam mein Ishwar dikhne lage, tab samjho sachchi pooja shuru hui.

verses.sanskrit:
आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽर्जुन ।
सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं स योगी परमो मतः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Atma Aupamyena Sarvatra Samam Pashyati Yo Arjuna,
Sukham Va Yadi Va Duhkham Sa Yogi Paramo Matah.
verses.englishMeaning: The one who sees everywhere, by comparison with their own self — seeing all equally, whether in joy or in sorrow — that person, O Arjun, is considered the highest yogi.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Jo insaan apne aap ko saamne rakhkar — jaise mujhe sukh hota hai toh doosre ko bhi hota hai, jaise mujhe dukh hota hai toh doosre ko bhi — is soch se har jagah, sabmein ek jaisi nazar rakhta hai — wahi sabse ooncha yogi hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna sabse oonche yogi ki ek aur sundar pehchaan bata rahe hain.

Ek bahut saral soch — jaise mujhe takleef hoti hai, waise doosre ko bhi hoti hai. Jaise mujhe khushi chahiye, waise doosre ko bhi chahiye.

Jo insaan yeh samjhkar sabke sukh-dukh ko apne sukh-dukh jaisa maanta hai — woh dushmani nahi karta, zulm nahi karta, nafrat nahi karta. Kyunki woh jaanta hai ki jo main doosre ko de raha hoon, woh mujhe bhi lautega.

Aur Shri Krishna keh rahe hain — aisa insaan jo sabmein ek jaisi nazar rakhta hai — woh param yogi hai. Sabse ooncha.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab doosre ka dukh apna dukh lagne lage aur doosre ki khushi apni khushi — tab samjho tu sachchi insaniyat aur sachche yoga ke karib pahunch gaya.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
योऽयं योगस्त्वया प्रोक्तः साम्येन मधुसूदन ।
एतस्याहं न पश्यामि चञ्चलत्वात्स्थितिं स्थिराम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Arjuna Uvacha:
Yo Ayam Yogas Tvaya Proktah Samyena Madhusudana,
Etasya Aham Na Pashyami Cancalatvat Sthitim Sthiram.
verses.englishMeaning: Arjun said: O Madhusudana, this yoga of equanimity that you have described — I do not see how it can remain steady and lasting, because the mind is so restless.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Arjun ne kaha:

Hey Madhusudana! Yeh samata ka yoga jo aapne bataya — main nahi dekh pa raha ki yeh sthir kaise rah sakta hai, kyunki mera mann itna chanchal hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun yahan woh sawaal poochh rahe hain jo har koi poochhhna chahta hai lekin poochhhta nahi.

Krishna ne bahut sundar yoga bataya — samata, shaanti, sthirata. Lekin Arjun sachchi baat keh rahe hain — yeh sab sunkar achha lagta hai, lekin karte waqt mann nahi tikta.

Mann bhaagta hai. Khayal aate hain. Dhyaan uthta hai. Toh phir yeh sab kaise hoga?

Yeh shlok dikhata hai ki sachche sawaal poochhna bhi ek taaqat hai. Arjun ne woh kaha jo andar tha — aur isi ki wajah se Krishna ka gehra jawab aata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo andar ata hai woh seedha poochhhna himmat ki nishaani hai — jhoot se kabhi jawab nahi milta, seedhe sawaal se hi sachcha raasta khulta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद् दृढम् ।
तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये वायोरिव सुदुष्करम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Cancalam Hi Manah Krishna Pramathi Balavad Dridham,
Tasya Aham Nigraham Manye Vayor Iva Su Dushkaram.
verses.englishMeaning: The mind is truly restless, O Krishna — turbulent, powerful and stubborn. I believe controlling it is as difficult as trying to control the wind.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Krishna! Yeh mann sachchi mein bahut chanchal hai — bechain karne waala, bahut taaqatwar aur bahut ziddi. Isse kaaboo karna mere liye utna hi mushkil lagta hai jitna hawa ko rokna.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun apni takleef aur seedha bayan karte hain — aur yeh bayan aaj bhi har insaan ka hai.

Mann tez hai. Woh ek pal mein past mein jaata hai, ek pal mein future mein. Ek pal mein khushi ki soch, ek pal mein darr. Koi rok nahi paata.

Aur Arjun ne isse hawa se compare kiya — bahut sahi misaal. Hawa ko na dekha ja sakta hai, na pakada ja sakta hai. Woh apni marzi se chalti hai.

Usi tarah mann — woh apni marzi se chalta hai. Aur isse rokna? Bahut mushkil.

Lekin Arjun ne kaha mushkil — impossible nahi. Aur yahi ek roshni hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Mann ko rokna mushkil zaroor hai — lekin namukin nahi. Jab mushkil ko sweekar kar lo, tab usse jeeto — tab raasta dikhta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलम् ।
अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Shri Bhagavan Uvacha:
Asamshayam Mahabaho Mano Durnigraham Calam,
Abhyasena Tu Kaunteya Vairagyena Ca Grihyate.
verses.englishMeaning: Shri Krishna said: Without doubt, O mighty-armed Arjun, the mind is restless and very difficult to control. But it can be brought under control through practice and through detachment.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Shri Krishna ne kaha:

Hey Arjun! Isme koi shak nahi — mann sachchi mein chanchal hai aur isse kaaboo karna bahut mushkil hai. Lekin hey Arjun, abhyaas aur vairaagya — in dono se isse vash mein laya ja sakta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna Arjun ki baat se na to inkaar karte hain na usse kamzor kehte hain.

Woh pehle maan lete hain — haan, mann bahut mushkil hai. Tum sahi keh rahe ho.

Lekin phir woh do cheezein bata dete hain jo isse theek karte hain.

Pehla — abhyaas. Roz koshish karo. Baar baar karo. Aaj thoda, kal thoda aur. Dheere-dheere.

Doosra — vairaagya. Matlab duniya ki cheezon se zyaada lagav nahi rakhna. Cheezein aayengi jaayengi — par andar ki shanti nahi jaani chahiye.

Yeh do cheezein — abhyaas aur vairaagya — milkar mann ko saadhti hain. Dono zaroori hain — sirf ek se kaam nahi chalta.
verses.lifeLesson: Mann ko sadhne ke liye do cheezein chahiye — roz ki koshish aur duniya se thoda faasla. Ye dono saath hon toh koi bhi mann ko hamesha ke liye nahi bhaaga sakta.

verses.sanskrit:
असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः ।
वश्यात्मना तु यतता शक्योऽवाप्तुमुपायतः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Asanyata Atmana Yogo Dushprapa Iti Me Matih,
Vashya Atmana Tu Yatata Shakyo Avaptum Upayatah.
verses.englishMeaning: For one whose mind is uncontrolled, yoga is very difficult to attain — this is my firm belief. But for one who has mastered the mind and makes effort through the right means, it is certainly possible to achieve.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Jiska mann kaaboo mein nahi hai, uske liye yoga pana bahut mushkil hai — yeh mera pakka manana hai.

Lekin jo apne mann ko saadhta hai aur sahi tarike se mehnat karta hai — uske liye yoga paana poori tarah mumkin hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna pichle shlok ka nicharod dete hain — ek sakht lekin sachchi baat.

Jo apne mann ko kaaboo nahi karta — jiske liye koi abhyaas nahi, koi vairaagya nahi, bas zindagi waise hi chalti rehti hai — uske liye yoga paana bahut mushkil hai. Yeh saaf baat hai.

Lekin jo koshish karta hai — jo roz uthata hai, roz thodi mehnat karta hai, sahi raaste se chalta hai — uske liye yeh mumkin hai.

Farq sirf ek hai — koshish karna ya nahi karna. Aur yeh faisla sirf tumhara hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Yoga kisi ke liye door nahi — sirf un logon ke liye dur hai jo koshish nahi karte. Jo uthta hai aur chalata rehta hai, woh zaroor pahunchta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
अयतिः श्रद्धयोपेतो योगाच्चलितमानसः ।
अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति ॥
verses.transliteration:
Arjuna Uvacha:
Ayatih Shraddhaya Upeto Yogac Calita Manasah,
Aprapya Yoga Samshiddhim Kam Gatim Krishna Gacchati.
verses.englishMeaning: Arjun said: O Krishna, what happens to the one who has faith but lacks complete effort, whose mind slips away from yoga — and who therefore does not attain the full perfection of yoga? What destination do they reach?
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Arjun ne kaha:

Hey Krishna! Jo insaan shraddha toh rakhta hai lekin poori koshish nahi kar paata, jisakaa mann yoga ke raaste se bhatak jaata hai aur jo yoga ki poori siddhi nahi pa sakata — woh insaan kahan jaata hai?
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ek bahut zaroori aur insaani sawaal poochhhte hain — jo aaj bhi kitne logon ke dil mein hoga.

Kya hoga agar kisi ne koshish ki, shraddha bhi rakhi, lekin poori tarah nahi pahunch paya? Kya woh barbad ho jaayega? Kya uski sari mehnat bekaar jaayegi?

Yeh darr bahut natural hai. Kai log isliye shuru hi nahi karte — ki agar poori nahi pahunchi manzil, toh kya fayda?

Arjun ne yeh sawaal poochhhkar un sab ke liye raasta khola jo darr ke wajah se shuruwaat nahi karte.
verses.lifeLesson: Koshish kabhi zyaada nahi hoti — chahe manzil poori na mile, raaste par chalna bhi ek badi kamiyaabi hai. Darr ke shuru na karna sabse badi galti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
कच्चिन्नोभयविभ्रष्टश्छिन्नाभ्रमिव नश्यति ।
अप्रतिष्ठो महाबाहो विमूढो ब्रह्मणः पथि ॥
verses.transliteration:
Kaccin Na Ubhaya Vibhrashtash Chinna Abhram Iva Nashyati,
Apratishtho Mahabaho Vimudho Brahmanah Pathi.
verses.englishMeaning: Does such a person not perish like a torn cloud — fallen from both paths, with no firm ground anywhere, O mighty-armed Krishna, confused and lost on the path to Brahman?
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Hey Krishna! Kya aisa insaan — jo na duniya ka raha, na poori tarah Brahman ke raaste par pahuncha — woh toote hue baadal ki tarah khatam to nahi ho jaata?

Jo na idhar ka raha, na udhar ka — koi sahara nahi, Brahman ke raaste par bhatka hua?
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ka darr aur gehra ho gaya hai — aur woh ek bahut sundar misaal dete hain.

Toota hua baadal — na poora baadal, na poori baarish. Beech mein toot gaya. Na idhar, na udhar. Sirf bikhra hua.

Arjun poochhhte hain — kya aisa insaan bhi aise hi ho jaata hai? Na poori duniya mein raha, na poori Bhakti mein pahuncha. Beech mein reh gaya — toh kya dooba?

Yeh sawaal bahut logon ka hai — jo raah mein hain, manzil door hai, aur darr lagta hai ki kahin beech mein hi reh na jaayein.

Aur ab Krishna ka jawab aane waala hai — jo is darr ko hamesha ke liye khatam kar dega.
verses.lifeLesson: Beech raaste ka darr bahut hota hai — lekin sachchi koshish kabhi zyaada nahi jaati. Ek kadam bhi sahi disha mein uthaya gaya toh woh sirf aage le jaata hai, neeche nahi.

verses.sanskrit:
एतन्मे संशयं कृष्ण छेत्तुमर्हस्यशेषतः ।
त्वदन्यः संशयस्यास्य छेत्ता न ह्युपपद्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Etan Me Samshayam Krishna Chettum Arhasy Asheshatah,
Tvad Anyah Samshayasya Asya Chetta Na Hi Upapadyate.
verses.englishMeaning: O Krishna, please dispel this doubt of mine completely and without remainder — for there is no one other than you who is capable of truly resolving this doubt.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Arjun ne kaha:

Hey Krishna! Yeh jo mera andar ka sanshaya hai — isse poori tarah, bilkul jadd se khatam karne ki taaqat sirf aap mein hai. Aap ke alaawa is duniya mein koi nahi jo mera yeh shak sachchi tarah door kar sake.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ne pichle do shlokkon mein apna sara darr poochh diya — ki jo yoga ke raaste beech mein reh jaaye, kya woh barbad ho jaata hai?

Ab woh ek bahut seedhi aur sachchi baat keh rahe hain — Hey Krishna, yeh sawaal sirf aap se poochhhna chahta hoon. Kyunki sachcha jawab sirf unhi ke paas hota hai jo sachchi haqeeqat jaante hain.

Yeh sirf pooja nahi — yeh ek sachche shishya ka apne guru par poora aur unkucca bharosa hai. Arjun jaante hain ki andar ka sanshaya tab hi khatam hota hai jab jawab sirf gyaan se nahi, sachchi shakti se aaye.

Aur jab koi is tarah — poore dil se, poori nata se — poochhhta hai, tab jawab milta zaroor hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab andar koi gehri shanka ho — toh use dabao mat, chhupaao mat. Sachche man se us tak pahuncho jis par poora bharosa ho. Sachcha sawaal poochhna hi pehla aur sabse zaroori qadam hai sachche jawab ki taraf.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
पार्थ नैवेह नामुत्र विनाशस्तस्य विद्यते ।
न हि कल्याणकृत्कश्चिद् दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति ॥
verses.transliteration:
Shri Bhagavan Uvacha:
Partha Na Eva Iha Na Amutra Vinashas Tasya Vidyate,
Na Hi Kalyana Krit Kashchid Durgatim Tata Gacchati.
verses.englishMeaning: Shri Krishna said: O Partha, there is no destruction for such a person — neither in this world nor in the next. No one who walks the path of goodness, my dear, ever comes to grief.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Shri Krishna ne kaha:

Hey Partha! Aisa insaan — jo achha karne ki koshish karta hai — woh na is duniya mein toot-ta hai, na agle janam mein. Hey mere pyaare! Jo bhi sachchi nekki ke raaste chalta hai, woh kabhi bura anjaam nahi paata — kabhi nahi.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Gita ka ek sabse bada aur sabse gehri reassurance dene wala wada hai.

Arjun ne poochha tha — agar main beech raaste reh gaya toh? Kya sab barbad ho jaayega?

Krishna ne jawab diya — nahi. Koi achha kaam kabhi bekar nahi jaata. Na is janam mein, na agle mein.

Sochiye — ek beej jo zameen mein dab jaata hai — woh ankhon ko nahi dikhta. Lekin woh khatam nahi hota. Woh andar se kaam karta rehta hai, jad faila ta rehta hai, aur ek din poora ped ban jaata hai.

Usi tarah — jo bhi acha kiya, jo bhi sachchi koshish ki — woh kabhi bhi zyaada nahi hoti. Woh sab agle qadam mein kaam aata hai.

Krishna keh rahe hain — darr mat, Partha. Jo seedha chalta hai, woh kabhi ghuma nahi jaata.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo sachchi achhai ki raah chalta hai — woh kabhi toota nahi. Chahe is janam mein manzil na mile — par woh koshish kabhi zyaada nahi hoti. Ek bhi naek kadam poori tarah mahafooz rehta hai — aaj nahi toh kal, is janam mein nahi toh agle mein.

verses.sanskrit:
प्राप्य पुण्यकृतां लोकानुषित्वा शाश्वतीः समाः ।
शुचीनां श्रीमतां गेहे योगभ्रष्टोऽभिजायते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Prapya Punya Kritam Lokan Ushitva Shashvatih Samah,
Shuchinam Shrimatam Gehe Yoga Bhrashtah Abhijayate.
verses.englishMeaning: Having attained the worlds of the meritorious and dwelling there for vast and countless years, the one who has fallen from yoga is then reborn into the home of the pure and the prosperous.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo yoga ki raah se bhatak gaya — woh pehle punya karne waale logon ke jagat mein pahunchta hai aur wahaan bahut lambe samay tak rehta hai. Phir woh wapas aata hai — is baar ek paak, sabhya aur samridh ghar mein janam lekar.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna Arjun ke sawaal ka jawab dena jaari rakhte hain — aur yeh jawab bahut tasalli dene wala hai.

Jo yoga ki raah par tha, lekin poori tarah nahi pahunch paya — woh bura anjaam nahi paata. Pehle woh un logon ke jagat mein jaata hai jinhone achhe kaam kiye hain — ek tarah ki rest aur inaam — bahut lambe samay ke liye.

Phir woh wapas aata hai — lekin kisi mushkil ya takleef-deh jagah mein nahi. Woh ek shuddh, sabhya aur samridh parivar mein janam leta hai.

Kyun? Taaki agli baar ki aatmik yatra aur behtar jagah se shuru ho sake. Achha mahaul, achhe log, achhe sanskaar — yeh sab agle safar ki nींv hain.

Krishna ek gehri baat keh rahe hain — Ishwar ka nizam bahut fair hai. Koshish kabhi zyaada nahi hoti.
verses.lifeLesson: Achhi koshish kabhi poori tarah zyaada nahi hoti — chahe is janam mein poori manzil na mile, agle baar behtar jagah se shuruwaat milti hai. Jo deta hai, woh milta zaroor hai — yeh duniya ka sabse sachcha hisaab hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अथवा योगिनामेव कुले भवति धीमताम् ।
एतद्धि दुर्लभतरं लोके जन्म यदीदृशम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Athava Yoginam Eva Kule Bhavati Dhimatam,
Etad Hi Durlabhataram Loke Janma Yad Idrisham.
verses.englishMeaning: Or they may be born directly into the family of wise and enlightened yogis. Such a birth as this is truly even more rare and precious in this world.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Ya phir — woh seedha kisi gyaani aur prakashit yogi ke parivar mein janam leta hai. Aur aisa janam — yeh is poori duniya mein bahut hi durlabh aur bahut keemat-wala hota hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Pichle shlok mein Krishna ne kaha — woh ek amir aur paak ghar mein janam lega.

Lekin is shlok mein woh ek aur baat kehte hain — jo aur bhi oonchi hai.

Kabhi kabhi yogi seedha ek yogi ya gyaani ke ghar mein janam leta hai. Jahaan se bachpan se hi woh raah milti hai jo pichle janam mein adhoori rahi thi. Dusri baar mauka milta hai — aur is baar sahi mahaul mein.

Aur Krishna keh rahe hain — yeh janam bahut hi durlabh hai. Duniya mein karod logon mein kisi ek ko milta hai.

Yeh ek bahut pyaari baat hai — ki jo log sachchi koshish karte hain, Ishwar khud unke liye aisa ghar deta hai jahan se woh aage ki yatra aur ache se kar sakein.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo koshish sachchi ho — woh hamesha aage le jaati hai. Ishwar khud aise logon ke liye raasta banaata hai — agar is janam mein nahi, toh agle janam mein aur behtar jagah se. Koi sachchi mehnat kabhi zyaada nahi hoti.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्र तं बुद्धिसंयोगं लभते पौर्वदेहिकम् ।
यतते च ततो भूयः संसिद्धौ कुरुनन्दन ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tatra Tam Buddhi Samyogam Labhate Paurva Dehikam,
Yatate Ca Tatah Bhuyah Samsiddhau Kurunandana.
verses.englishMeaning: There, O son of Kuru, they naturally regain the wisdom and inner understanding accumulated in their previous life — and then strive even harder than before toward complete spiritual perfection.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Kuru ke bete! Woh naye janam mein woh sab buddhi aur gyaan wapas khud hi haasil kar leta hai jo pichle janam mein kamaai thi. Aur phir woh pehle se bhi zyaada lagan aur mehnat se poori siddhi paane ki koshish karta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok ek bahut dilchasp aur gehri sachcaai batata hai.

Jo yogi beech raaste reh gaya aur naye janam mein wapas aaya — woh khali haath nahi aata. Uska pichle janam ka gyaan, uski samajh, uska abhyaas — woh sab andar hi andar leke aata hai. Koi lecture nahi, koi kitaab nahi — andar se hi woh samajh jagti hai.

Jaise ek student jo ek baar fail ho jaata hai, lekin phir wahi padhai karta hai — is baar woh pehle se behtar samjhta hai, kyunki ek baar andar tak uttara hua hai.

Usi tarah yogi wapas aata hai — aur pehle se zyaada tayyar, pehle se zyaada mehnat ke saath.

Koi bhi koshish kabhi zero se shuru nahi hoti agar pehle bhi sachchi koshish ki ho.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo kuch bhi sachche dil se seekha, jo bhi samjha — woh kabhi poori tarah zyaada nahi jaata. Ek baar ki sachchi mehnat ruh mein utar jaati hai. Aur jab doosra mauka aata hai, woh seekh apne aap kaam aane lagti hai — bina poochhe, bina yaad kiye.

verses.sanskrit:
पूर्वाभ्यासेन तेनैव ह्रियते ह्यवशोऽपि सः ।
जिज्ञासुरपि योगस्य शब्दब्रह्मातिवर्तते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Purva Abhyasena Tena Eva Hriyate Hi Avasho Api Sah,
Jijnasur Api Yogasya Shabda Brahma Ativartate.
verses.englishMeaning: By the very force of that previous practice, they are naturally drawn toward yoga even without consciously willing it. Even the one who merely inquires sincerely about yoga goes beyond the fruits prescribed in the Vedic scriptures.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Pichle janam ki koshish itni gehra asar karti hai ki woh apne aap yoga ki taraf khincha chala aata hai — chahe woh jaanta bhi na ho kyun.

Aur jo sirf yoga ke baare mein sachche mann se jaanna chahta hai — woh bhi un logon se kahin aage nikal jaata hai jo sirf Vedic rituals aur vidhi-vidhaan karte rehte hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok bahut shaktishaali hai — aur do alag lekin gehra baatein keh raha hai.

Pehli baat — ek baar ki sachchi koshish itni gehra utar jaati hai ki woh agle janam mein bhi kaam karti hai. Koi force nahi, koi reminder nahi — andar se hi khichav hoti hai. Jaise kisi bachche ko bachpan se hi sangeet ki taraf ajeeb sa lagav ho — woh pichle janam ka abhyaas hota hai.

Doosri baat — sirf yoga ko jaanna chahna, sirf sachchi jigyaasa rakhna — yeh bhi Vedic rituals se badi cheez hai. Kyunki rituals bahar se ki jaati hain. Lekin jigyaasa andar se aati hai, andar se badlav laati hai.

Bahari karmkaand andar nahi badalta — sachchi andar ki talab se insaan badalta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Ek baar bhi sachcha raasta pakda ho — toh woh raasta hamesha ke liye andar reh jaata hai. Aur sachchi jigyaasa — sirf poochhna chahna, sirf jaanna chahna — woh bhi ek bahut bada qadam hai. Andar ki aawaz suno — woh kabhi galat raasta nahi dikhati.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रयत्नाद्यतमानस्तु योगी संशुद्धकिल्बिषः ।
अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Prayatnad Yatamanah Tu Yogi Samshuddha Kilbishah,
Aneka Janma Samshiddhah Tatah Yati Param Gatim.
verses.englishMeaning: But the yogi who strives with sincere and sustained effort, who becomes completely purified of all inner impurities, and who is perfected gradually across many lifetimes — that person then attains the supreme and final destination.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Lekin jo yogi sachchi lagan aur mehnat se koshish karta rehta hai — jo andar se dheere dheere shuddh hota jaata hai, aur jo kai janammon ki tapasya ke baad andar se poori tarah siddh ho jaata hai — woh phir us manzil ko paata hai jo is sab se oonchi aur aakhri hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok bahut gehri tasalli deta hai — aur saath hi ek sachcha raasta bhi dikhata hai.

Arjun ne poochha tha — jo beech mein reh jaaye, kya hoga?

Krishna ka jawab yahan poora hota hai — kuch nahi hoga. Koi ek janam mein poori tarah nahi badal jaata. Yeh ek lambi, gehri, kai janammon ki yatra hai.

Lekin jo har janam mein sachchi koshish karta hai — woh andar se saaf hota jaata hai. Paap, ahankar, lobh, darr — yeh sab dheere dheere haTte jaate hain.

Aur ek din — kai janmon ki mehnat ke baad — woh us manzil tak pahunch jaata hai jo sab se oonchi hai. Jahan se lautna nahi hota.

Har ek kadam count karta hai. Koi koshish zyaada nahi hoti — sab jod-jodkar ek din paar utar dete hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Poori duniya ek din mein nahi badalti — aur insaan ka andar bhi nahi badalta. Lekin jo roz thodi sachchi koshish karta rehta hai — woh bhi ek na ek din us jagah pahunch jaata hai jahan sachchi aur hamesha wali shanti hai. Dheere badho — par rukna mat.

verses.sanskrit:
तपस्विभ्योऽधिको योगी ज्ञानिभ्योऽपि मतोऽधिकः ।
कर्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी तस्माद्योगी भवार्जुन ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tapasvibhyo Adhikah Yogi Jnanibhyo Api Matah Adhikah,
Karmibhyash Ca Adhikah Yogi Tasmad Yogi Bhava Arjuna.
verses.englishMeaning: The yogi is greater than the ascetics, greater even than the scholars of knowledge, and greater than those who perform only rituals and outer actions. Therefore, O Arjun, be a yogi — in every sense of the word.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Yogi tapasviyon se bada hai — jo sirf khud ko takleef dekar kuch paana chahte hain. Woh gyaaniyon se bhi bada hai — jo sirf kitaabein padh ke gyaan ikattha karte hain. Woh karmkaandiyon se bhi bada hai — jo sirf baahi rituals aur vidhi-vidhaan karte rehte hain.

Islie — hey Arjun! — tu yogi ban.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh ek bahut bada aur bahut saaf statement hai — aur Krishna ne ise puri taaqat ke saath kaha.

Tapasvi — jo khud ko takleef dekar, badan ko kaskar Ishwar ko paana chahta hai. Gyaani — jo sirf padh-padh ke, sunke jaanna chahta hai. Karmi — jo sirf baahi kriya aur niyam karta rehta hai.

Lekin yogi — woh andar se badal jaata hai. Woh sirf jaanta nahi, sirf karta nahi, sirf takleef nahi uthata — woh poori tarah jeeta hai jo wo samjhta hai. Uski soch, uski nazar, uska zindagi jeene ka tarika — sab kuch badal jaata hai.

Jab jaanna aur jeena ek ho jaayein — tab woh yogi hota hai. Aur tab woh tapasvi se, gyaani se, karmkaandi se bhi ooncha hota hai.

Aur Krishna ne Arjun se seedha kaha — tu yogi ban. Sirf samajhna kaafi nahi — poori tarah jeena seekh.
verses.lifeLesson: Sirf padh lena, sirf jaana lena, sirf kuch kar lena — yeh kaafi nahi. Jo sachcha badlav andar se aata hai, jo zindagi mein bahar dikhta hai — wahi sachchi uplabdhi hai. Gyaan ko sirf dimagh mein mat rakhna — use jeene ki koshish karo.

verses.sanskrit:
योगिनामपि सर्वेषां मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना ।
श्रद्धावान्भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yoginam Api Sarvesham Mad Gatena Antaratmana,
Shraddhavan Bhajate Yo Mam Sa Me Yuktatamo Matah.
verses.englishMeaning: Among all yogis, the one whose inner self is completely absorbed in me and who worships me with deep, unwavering faith and love — that yogi is considered by me to be the most intimately united with me, the highest of all.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Sab yogiyon mein — jo apne andar se, poori tarah mujh mein sama kar, sachchi shraddha aur prem se meri bhakti karta hai — woh mujhe sab se zyaada apna lagta hai. Meri nazar mein wahi sabse bada yogi hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Chapter 6 ka aakhiri aur sabse keemat-wala shlok hai — aur yeh poore chapter ka nicharod hai.

Krishna ne poora adhyay bataya — dhyan karo, abhyaas karo, mann ko saadhna, shaant rehna, sab kuch.

Aur aakhir mein woh ek cheez keh dete hain — jo sab se oonche hain woh kaun hai?

Woh jo andar se — dil ki gehraai se — mere paas aata hai. Poori shraddha ke saath, poore prem ke saath. Jo apni aatma ko mujhme sama kar leta hai.

Yeh koi technique nahi. Yeh koi step nahi. Yeh koi vidhi nahi.

Yeh ek rishta hai — Ishwar aur insaan ka sabse kareeb ka, sabse saccha rishta.

Aur Krishna keh rahe hain — aisa insaan mujhe sabse zyaada apna lagta hai.

Poora chapter isi ek baat par aa ke khatam hota hai — technique nahi, prem chahiye.
verses.lifeLesson: Saari sadhna, saari koshish, sab technique ka ek hi sachcha nicharod hai — andar se Ishwar ke paas aa jao. Poori shraddha se, poore dil se, bina kisi dikhaawe ke. Jab yeh hota hai — koi door nahi rehta, koi faasla nahi bachta.

summary: The seventh chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Gyaan Vigyana Yoga . In this chapter, Krishna reveals that he is the Supreme Truth, the principal cause and the sustaining force of everything. He reveals his illusionary energy in this material world called Maya, which is very difficult to overcome but those who surrender their minds unto Him attain Him easily. He also describes the four types of people who surrender to Him in devotion and the four kinds that don't. Krishna confirms that He is the Ultimate Reality and those who realize this Truth reach the pinnacle of spiritual realization and unite with the Lord.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
मय्यासक्तमनाः पार्थ योगं युञ्जन्मदाश्रयः ।
असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु ॥
verses.transliteration:
Shri Bhagavan Uvacha:
Mayy Asakta Manah Partha Yogam Yunjan Mad Ashrayah,
Asamshayam Samagram Mam Yatha Jnasyasi Tac Chhrinu.
verses.englishMeaning: Shri Krishna said: O Partha, listen to how you shall know me completely and without any doubt — with your mind firmly attached to me, practicing yoga while taking complete refuge in me.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Shri Krishna ne kaha:

Hey Partha! Ab dhyan se suno — jab tera mann mujhme laga ho, tera sahara sirf main hoon, aur tu yoga ka abhyaas kare — tab tu mujhe poori tarah, bina kisi shak ke, sachchi tarah samajhega. Main tujhe woh raasta bataata hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Chapter 7 shuru hota hai ek bahut bade wade ke saath.

Krishna keh rahe hain — Arjun, agar tu sachchi tarah mujhse juda rahe, andar se mujhe apna le, aur is raaste par chale — toh ek din aisa aayega jab tu mujhe poori tarah samjhega. Koi shak nahi bachega.

Yeh sirf gyaan ki baat nahi — yeh sachchi andar ki pehchaan ki baat hai. Jaisi ek maa apne bachche ko bina kitaab padhe jaanti hai — waise hi.

Aur Krishna keh rahe hain — main tujhe yeh bataata hoon. Khud se. Aaj. Yahan.

Kitna bada uphar hai yeh — Ishwar khud keh rahe hain, aaja, main bataata hoon.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab mann kisi se sachchi tarah judta hai — tab samajhna apne aap shuru ho jaata hai. Gyaan ke liye sirf kitaabein nahi chahiye — sachcha lagav chahiye, sachcha bharosa chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञानं तेऽहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः ।
यज्ज्ञात्वा नेह भूयोऽन्यज्ज्ञातव्यमवशिष्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Jnanam Te Aham Sa Vijnanam Idam Vakshyamy Asheshatah,
Yaj Jnatva Neha Bhuyo Anyaj Jnatavyam Avashishyate.
verses.englishMeaning: I shall now reveal to you completely this knowledge together with direct experiential wisdom — knowing which, nothing else in this world shall remain left to be known.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main tujhe poori tarah woh gyaan aur woh anubhav doonga — jise jaanke is duniya mein aur kuch jaanna baaki nahi rah jaata.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna ek bahut badi baat keh rahe hain — Main tujhe do cheezein doonga.

Pehla — gyaan. Woh jo samjha ja sake, bataaya ja sake, shabdon mein kaha ja sake.

Doosra — vigyaan. Woh anubhav jo sirf jeene se aata hai. Jab gyaan sirf dimaag mein nahi rehta — woh ruh mein utar jaata hai.

Aur woh keh rahe hain — dono mil jaayein toh kuch baaki nahi rehta. Koi sawaal nahi, koi shak nahi, koi adhuri khoj nahi.

Sochiye — poori duniya ki har khoj, har sawaal, ek hi sachcaai ki taraf jaate hain. Aur woh sachcaai — main hoon — yahi Krishna keh rahe hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Gyaan aur anubhav — dono zaroori hain. Sirf padhna kaafi nahi, sirf jeena bhi kaafi nahi. Jab dono mile — tab sachchi samajh hoti hai jo insaan ko andar se mukt karti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
मनुष्याणां सहस्रेषु कश्चिद्यतति सिद्धये ।
यततामपि सिद्धानां कश्चिन्मां वेत्ति तत्त्वतः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Manushyanam Sahasreshu Kashchid Yatati Siddhaye,
Yatatam Api Siddhanam Kashcin Mam Vetti Tattvatah.
verses.englishMeaning: Among thousands of human beings, perhaps one strives earnestly for spiritual perfection. And among those who strive and attain perfection, perhaps one truly knows me in my real essence.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hazaron insaanon mein koi ek hi hota hai jo sachchi mukti ke liye koshish karta hai. Aur jo koshish karte hain — unme se bhi koi ek hi hota hai jo mujhe sachchi haqeeqat mein jaanta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok ek gehri sachcaai keh raha hai — lekin darr ki jagah, jaagnepan ki taraf bula raha hai.

Krishna keh rahe hain — bahut kam log sachchi koshish karte hain. Baki sab duniya mein khaye-piye, soye, marlo — yahi zindagi samajhkar chal dete hain.

Jo koshish karte hain — woh bhi kum hain. Aur jo sach mein pahunche — woh aur bhi kum.

Lekin yeh sunke rukna nahi hai — yeh jaagkar chalna hai. Teri koshish hi tujhe un kum logon mein shamil karti hai jo sachche raaste par hain.

Bas yahi kaafi hai — ki tu raaste par hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sachchi koshish karna hi khud mein bahut bada hai. Hazaron mein se ek banna darr ki baat nahi — yeh ek sachchi mehnat ki shuruaat hai. Jo raaste par hai, woh manzil ke karib hai.

verses.sanskrit:
भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च ।
अहंकार इतीयं मे भिन्ना प्रकृतिरष्टधा ॥
verses.transliteration:
Bhumir Apo Analo Vayuh Kham Mano Buddhir Eva Ca,
Ahamkara Iti Iyam Me Bhinna Prakritir Ashtadha.
verses.englishMeaning: Earth, water, fire, air, space, mind, intellect and ego — these eight together constitute my lower material nature, divided into these eight forms.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Dharti, paani, aag, hawa, aakaash, mann, buddhi aur ahankar — yeh aath meri apara prakriti ke roop hain — jinse yeh sari duniya bani hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna yahan duniya ka ek blueprint dete hain — apni zubaan mein.

Panch bhoot — dharti, paani, aag, hawa, aakaash — yeh woh cheezein hain jo duniya ka shareer banate hain. Har cheez inhi se bani hai.

Aur fir teen aur — mann, buddhi, aur ahankar. Yeh woh hain jo hamari andar ki duniya hai. Jo sochta hai, jo faisla karta hai, jo 'main' maanta hai.

Aur Krishna keh rahe hain — yeh sab meri hi prakriti ka hissa hai. Yeh mujhse alag nahi.

Mtlab — jo bhi yahan hai, jo bhi tum ho — sab mujhse hi bana hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Duniya ki har cheez Ishwar ki hi banai hui hai — dharti bhi, mann bhi, ahankar bhi. Jab yeh samajh aaye toh koi cheez chhoti ya badi nahi lagti — sab mein usi ki shakti dikhti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अपरेयमितस्त्वन्यां प्रकृतिं विद्धि मे पराम् ।
जीवभूतां महाबाहो ययेदं धार्यते जगत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Apara Iyam Itas Tv Anyam Prakritim Viddhi Me Param,
Jiva Bhutam Mahabaho Yaya Idam Dharyate Jagat.
verses.englishMeaning: But beyond this lower nature, O mighty-armed Arjun, know my higher nature — the living conscious principle through which all of this world is sustained and held together.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Yeh jo maine aath cheezein bataayi — woh meri chhoti prakriti hai. Lekin iske alawa meri ek aur, oonchi prakriti hai — woh jeev ki chetna — jisse yeh poori duniya tiki hui hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Pichle shlok mein Krishna ne duniya ka maddi hissa bataya — dharti, paani, mann wagera.

Ab woh ek aur baat kehte hain — yeh sab toh meri chhoti prakriti hai. Lekin ek aur prakriti hai jo isse oonchi hai.

Woh hai — jeevan ki chetna. Woh jo patthar ko zinda insaan se alag karti hai. Woh shakti jo ek murda sharir mein nahi hoti lekin zinda mein hoti hai.

Aur yeh jeevan ki chetna — yeh bhi Krishna ki hi hai. Ek maddi hai, ek chetna hai.

Aur dono milkaar is duniya ko chala rahe hain — ek structure deta hai, ek zindagi deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shareer alag hai, jeev alag hai — yeh jaanna hi pehla qadam hai andar ki asli pehchaan ki taraf. Jo sirf shareer ko sab kuch maanta hai woh aadhi duniya mein jeeta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
एतद्योनीनि भूतानि सर्वाणीत्युपधारय ।
अहं कृत्स्नस्य जगतः प्रभवः प्रलयस्तथा ॥
verses.transliteration:
Etad Yonimi Bhutani Sarvany Iti Upadharaya,
Aham Kritsnasya Jagatah Prabhavah Pralay As Tatha.
verses.englishMeaning: Know that all living beings have their origin in these two natures of mine. I am the source from which the entire universe arises, and it is into me alone that it finally dissolves.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jaano ki is duniya ke tamam jeev in dono prakrityon se hi aaye hain. Main hi is poori srishti ka aadhar hoon — aur main hi iska ant bhi hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna yahan ek bahut badi sachcaai ek line mein keh dete hain.

Har cheez jo hai — chahe zinda ho ya bejaan — woh meri apara ya para prakriti se hai. Koi teesri jagah nahi hai. Koi alag source nahi.

Aur jab yeh sab bana — toh mujhse bana. Aur jab khatam hoga — toh mujhme hi samayega.

Jaise ek lehran samundar se uthti hai aur samundar mein hi wapas milti hai — usi tarah sab kuch Ishwar se nikla hai aur Ishwar mein hi wapas jaayega.

Yeh ek bahut gehri baat hai — 'khatam hona' kuch nahi, sirf ghar wapas aana hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo aaya hai woh jaayega — yeh sach hai. Lekin jaana bhi khatam hona nahi, wapas milna hai. Is soch se na kisi se darr hota hai, na kisi cheez se moh — bas ek gehri shanti rehti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
मत्तः परतरं नान्यत्किञ्चिदस्ति धनञ्जय ।
मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव ॥
verses.transliteration:
Mattah Parataram Na Anyat Kincid Asti Dhananjaya,
Mayi Sarvam Idam Protam Sutre Mani Gana Iva.
verses.englishMeaning: O Dhananjaya, there is nothing whatsoever that is higher or greater than me. Everything in this entire universe is strung upon me, like pearls threaded on a string.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Mujhse ooncha, mujhse bada — kuch bhi nahi hai is duniya mein. Yeh poori duniya mujhme piroi hui hai — jaise ek dhage mein motiyon ki mala.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna yahan ek bahut gehri aur khoobsurat misaal dete hain.

Ek mala sochiye — kai motiyan hain. Alag alag rangon ki, alag alag aakaar ki. Lekin ek hi dhage ne unhe joda hua hai. Woh dhaga andar se guzarta hai — dikhta nahi, lekin uski wajah se sab tike hain.

Yahi Krishna keh rahe hain — main woh dhaga hoon. Har insaan, har patthar, har tara, har hawa ka jhonka — sab mujhme piroya hua hai.

Koi cheez mujhse bahar nahi — sab kuch mujhme hai.

Aur jab yeh dikh jaaye — tab kisi cheez se darr nahi hota, kyunki sab ek hi hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo cheez sab ko jodti hai woh andar hoti hai — bahar nahi dikhti. Jab andar ki sachcaai dikh jaaye toh sab kuch ek ho jaata hai. Alag alag nahi lagta — yahi sabse badi samajh hai.

verses.sanskrit:
रसोऽहमप्सु कौन्तेय प्रभास्मि शशिसूर्ययोः ।
प्रणवः सर्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे पौरुषं नृषु ॥
verses.transliteration:
Raso Aham Apsu Kaunteya Prabha Asmi Shashi Suryayoh,
Pranavah Sarva Vedeshu Shabdah Khe Paurusham Nrishu.
verses.englishMeaning: O Kaunteya, I am the taste in water, I am the radiance in the moon and the sun, I am the sacred syllable Om in all the Vedas, the primordial sound in space, and the strength and courage in all human beings.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Kaunteya! Paani mein jo meethas hai — woh main hoon. Chand aur suraj ki roshni — woh main hoon. Vedas mein jo Om hai — woh main hoon. Aakaash mein jo aawaz hai — woh main hoon. Aur insaan mein jo himmat hai — woh bhi main hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Pichle shlok mein Krishna ne kaha — main sab mein hoon. Ab woh misaalein dete hain — taaki samajh aaye.

Jab tum paani peete ho — uski meethas jo feel hoti hai, woh Krishna hain. Jab chand nikalta hai aur roshni failti hai — woh Krishna hain. Jab koi Om bolta hai — woh Krishna ka naam hai. Jab aakaash mein koi awaaz hai — woh Krishna ki hi awaaz hai.

Aur sabse khoobsurat — jab koi insaan himmat se mushkil waqt mein nahi darta — woh taaqat Krishna ki hi hai.

Yeh shlok sikhaata hai — Ishwar ko door mat samjho. Woh teri har cheez mein hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Ishwar ke darshan ke liye mandir jaana zaroori nahi — paani ki meethas mein, roshni mein, apne andar ki himmat mein — woh har jagah hai. Bas aankhen khol kar dekho.

verses.sanskrit:
पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ ।
जीवनं सर्वभूतेषु तपश्चास्मि तपस्विषु ॥
verses.transliteration:
Punyo Gandhah Prithivyam Ca Tejas Ca Asmi Vibhavasau,
Jivanam Sarva Bhuteshu Tapas Ca Asmi Tapasvishu.
verses.englishMeaning: I am the pure and sacred fragrance of the earth, and I am the radiant luminosity in fire. I am the life-force in all living beings and the burning austerity in the hearts of all ascetics.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Dharti ki jo paak khushboo hai — woh main hoon. Aag ki jo chamakdar roshni aur teja hai — woh main hoon. Har jeev ke andar jo zindagi ki lau jalti hai — woh main hoon. Aur jo tapasvi apni tapasya karta hai, uske andar ki woh aag — woh bhi main hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna apni pehchaan aur gehri karte jaate hain.

Woh dharti ki mitti ki khushboo hain — woh jo barish ke baad aati hai aur dil kush ho jaata hai. Woh aag ka chamakaata hua tej hain — jiske bina na pakana hota, na andhera haaTta.

Woh har jeev ki saans hain — woh taaqat jo andar se chalti rehti hai, bina kisi ki marzi ke.

Aur jo log saadhna karte hain, mushkilein uthate hain andar se saaf hone ke liye — woh tapasya bhi Krishna ki hi shakti hai.

Mtlab — andar ki tapish bhi Ishwar ki hai. Bahar ki duniya bhi Ishwar ki hai. Koi jagah khali nahi.
verses.lifeLesson: Mitti ki khushboo, aag ki roshni, apni saans — yeh sab Ishwar ke nishan hain. Jab yeh dikh jaaye toh zindagi ek ibaadat ban jaati hai — sirf mandir mein nahi, har jagah.

verses.sanskrit:
बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम् ।
बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Bijam Mam Sarva Bhutanam Viddhi Partha Sanatanam,
Budhir Buddhi Matam Asmi Tejas Tejasvinam Aham.
verses.englishMeaning: Know me, O Partha, as the eternal and primordial seed of all living beings. I am the intelligence of the intelligent and the radiant brilliance of all those who truly shine.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Partha! Jaano ki har jeev ka jo asal aur sanaatan beej hai, woh main hoon. Jitne bhi samajhdar hain — unki buddhi main hoon. Jitne bhi tej hain — unka tej main hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Ek beej sochiye. Ek aanv mein poora ped chhupa hua hota hai. Bahar se nahi dikhta, lekin woh hai — andar se.

Krishna keh rahe hain — main woh beej hoon jo har jeev mein chhupa hua hai. Har insaan, har prani, har tara — sab mujhse shuru hue hain.

Aur jo insaan bahut tez sochta hai — uski woh tez buddhi mujhse hai. Jo duniya mein chamakta hai, jo kuch alag karta hai — woh chamak bhi mujhse hai.

Koi bhi taakat apni nahi — sab usi ki di hui hai. Yeh jaanna ahankar khatam karta hai aur shukr paida karta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo bhi kuch tum mein khoobi hai — woh tumse nahi, Ishwar se aayi hai. Yeh jaanna ahankar ko khatam karta hai aur gehri shukraana paida karta hai. Sab diya hua hai — khoya hua kuch nahi.

verses.sanskrit:
बलं बलवतां चाहं कामरागविवर्जितम् ।
धर्माविरुद्धो भूतेषु कामोऽस्मि भरतर्षभ ॥
verses.transliteration:
Balam Balavatam Ca Aham Kama Raga Vivarjitam,
Dharma Aviruddho Bhuteshu Kamo Asmi Bharatarshabha.
verses.englishMeaning: O best of the Bharatas, I am the strength of the strong — strength that is free from desire and personal attachment. And among all beings, I am that desire which does not contradict dharma — the sacred and righteous longing.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Taaqatwar logon ki jo taaqat hai — lekin jo kisi ichcha ya lagav ke bina ho — woh main hoon. Aur har jeev mein jo ichcha hai jo dharma ke khilaf nahi — woh bhi main hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok ek khoobsurat nukte par roshni dalta hai.

Taaqat buri nahi — jo taaqat sirf khud ke fayade ke liye, dusron ko dabaane ke liye use ki jaaye woh buri hai. Lekin jo taaqat sahi kaam ke liye ho — woh Krishna ki hai.

Aur ichcha buri nahi — jo ichcha dharma ke raaste ho, jo achha paane ki sachchi talab ho — woh bhi Krishna ki hai.

Krishna ek bahut gehra farq keh rahe hain — jo bhi sahi tarike se ho, sahi iraade se ho — woh sab mujh mein se hai. Sirf jo galat hai, jo nuksaan ka hai — woh mujhse nahi.

Mtlab — sab kuch galat nahi. Sachchi ichcha bhi Ishwar hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Ichcha buri nahi — galat ichcha buri hai. Jo sachchi, dharma wali ichcha hai — woh Ishwar ki taraf jaati hai. Apni talab ko pehchano — aur dekhna ki woh kahin le jaati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये ।
मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि न त्वहं तेषु ते मयि ॥
verses.transliteration:
Ye Ca Eva Sattvika Bhava Rajasas Tamasash Ca Ye,
Matta Eva Iti Tan Viddhi Na Tv Aham Teshu Te Mayi.
verses.englishMeaning: Whatever states of being exist — whether of sattva, of rajas, or of tamas — know that they all arise from me alone. I am not contained within them, but they all exist within me.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo bhi bhaav hain is duniya mein — satvic ho, rajasic ho ya tamasic — jaano ki woh sab mere se hi peda hote hain. Lekin main unme nahi hoon — woh mujhme hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Teen gunon ki baat — sattva (shuddhata, prakaash), rajas (kriyaashilta, halaachal), tamas (aalas, andhera).

Har insaan mein teeno hain — kabhi ek zyaada hota hai, kabhi doosra. Kabhi hum bahut shaant hote hain, kabhi bahut active, kabhi bilkul down.

Krishna keh rahe hain — yeh teeno mujhse aate hain. Mujhse bane hain. Lekin main inme nahi hoon — yeh mujhme hain.

Farq samajhna zaroori hai — jaise samundar lehraon ko dharta hai, lekin lehrain samundar nahi hoti. Ishwar in sabko dharta hai, lekin inse woh alag hai.

Aur jab yeh samajh aaye — toh na sattva mein ghamand hoga, na tamas mein nirasha.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni sthiti — chahe achhi ho ya buri — hamesha ke liye nahi hai. Yeh teeno guna aate jaate hain. Jo tum sachchi mein ho woh in gunon se pare ho — yeh yaad rahe.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रिभिर्गुणमयैर्भावैरेभिः सर्वमिदं जगत् ।
मोहितं नाभिजानाति मामेभ्यः परमव्ययम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tribhir Guna Mayair Bhavair Ebhih Sarvam Idam Jagat,
Mohitam Na Abhijanati Mam Ebhyah Param Avyayam.
verses.englishMeaning: Deluded by these three states of being arising from the three qualities of nature, this entire world fails to recognise me — who am imperishable and far beyond all of these qualities.
verses.hinglishMeaning: In teeno gunoN se bane in bhaavon mein uljhkar yeh poori duniya mujhe nahi pahchaan paati — jo in sab se pare, avyaya aur sanaatan hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok bahut sachchi baat keh raha hai.

Hum sab teen gunon ke chakkar mein phasey hain. Kabhi sattva mein hain — achha lag raha hai. Kabhi rajas mein — bahut kuch karna hai. Kabhi tamas mein — kuch nahi karna.

Aur is aane-jaane mein hum itne ulajhte hain ki jo inke peeche hai — jo stable hai, jo change nahi hota — woh Ishwar — woh dikhta nahi.

Jaise andheri raat mein taaro ke bhi peeche aasmaan hota hai — par roshni mein hi dikhta hai.

Ishwar tab dikhta hai jab hum gunon ki aadhi nazar se bahar aate hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo hamesha badalta rehta hai — woh sachcha nahi. Jo kabhi nahi badla — woh sachcha hai. Andar ki woh sthir jagah dhundho — woh Ishwar hai.

verses.sanskrit:
दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया ।
मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Daivi Hy Esha Guna Mayi Mama Maya Duratyaya,
Mam Eva Ye Prapadyante Mayam Etam Taranti Te.
verses.englishMeaning: This divine Maya of mine, consisting of the three qualities of nature, is truly very difficult to cross. But those who surrender completely to me alone — they cross over this Maya with ease.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Meri yeh daivi Maya — jo teen gunon se bani hai — isse paarna bahut hi mushkil hai. Lekin jo sirf mujh mein hi sharan lete hain — woh is Maya ko paar kar jaate hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Maya — woh dhoka hai jo hame lagta hai ki duniya hi sab kuch hai. Ki paisa hi sab kuch hai, body hi sab kuch hai, relationships hi sab kuch hain.

Aur Krishna saaf keh rahe hain — yeh cross karna bahut mushkil hai. Akele karne ki koshish karo — bahut mushkil hai.

Lekin ek raasta hai — sirf mujhe pakad lo. Mujhme sharan lo.

Jaise toofan mein ek haath pakad lo jo sach mein mazboot ho — toh baaki ki parvaah nahi hoti.

Yeh sharan lena kamzori nahi — yeh sabse badi samajhdaari hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Duniya ki moh-maya se akele ladna mushkil hai. Jab Ishwar ka haath pakad liya — toh Maya se darne ki zaroorat nahi. Sachcha sahara woh hai jo kabhi nahi chhhota.

verses.sanskrit:
न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः ।
माययापहृतज्ञाना आसुरं भावमाश्रिताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Na Mam Dushkritino Mudhah Prapadyante Naradhamah,
Mayayapahruta Jnana Asuram Bhavam Ashritah.
verses.englishMeaning: Those who do evil, the foolish, the lowest among humans, and those whose wisdom has been stolen by Maya — none of them seek refuge in me, as they have taken shelter in the demonic nature.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo bura karte hain, jo mooh ghuma lete hain, jo insaaniyat se gire hue hain, jinki samajh Maya ne chhin li hai aur jo asuri bhaav mein jee rahe hain — aaise log mujhe nahi dhundhte.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna yahan ek dard bhari sachcaai keh rahe hain.

Kuch log hain jo sachcaai ki taraf munh nahi karte. Woh duniya mein itne ulajhe hain, itne bure raaste par chal rahe hain ki unhe dikhai hi nahi deta ki kuch aur bhi ho sakta hai.

Krishna unhe chhod nahi rahe — woh sirf bata rahe hain ki jo apne aap ko Ishwar se alag kar leta hai, wo khud ke liye mushkil khade kar leta hai.

Yeh kisi ko judge karna nahi — yeh ek practical sachcaai hai. Jo aankhein band rakhta hai, woh roshni nahi dekh sakta.

Aur jo yeh shlok padh raha hai — woh pehle se hi ek qadam aage hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Bura karna sirf doosron ko nuksaan nahi pahunchata — woh insaan ki apni andar ki drishti ko bhi dhundhla karta hai. Achha karna Ishwar ki taraf khidki kholna hai.

verses.sanskrit:
चतुर्विधा भजन्ते मां जनाः सुकृतिनोऽर्जुन ।
आर्तो जिज्ञासुरर्थार्थी ज्ञानी च भरतर्षभ ॥
verses.transliteration:
Chatur Vidha Bhajante Mam Janah Sukritino Arjuna,
Arto Jijnaasur Arthaarthi Jnani Ca Bharatarshabha.
verses.englishMeaning: O Arjun, O best of the Bharatas — four kinds of virtuous and meritorious people worship me: the distressed who seek relief, the seeker of spiritual knowledge, the one who seeks material benefit, and the truly wise.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Chaar tarah ke achhe log mujhe bhajate hain — jo dukh mein hai aur madad maangta hai, jo jaanna chahta hai, jo kuch chahta hai, aur jo gyaani hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bahut khoobsurat baat — Krishna keh rahe hain, chahe jo bhi wajah ho, jis bhi haal mein aao — aao.

Jo dukh mein hai — woh bhi aata hai. Jo jaanana chahta hai — woh bhi. Jo kuch maang raha hai — woh bhi. Aur jo sachchi samajh rakhta hai — woh bhi.

Krishna ne kisi ko door nahi kiya. Har ek ka aana — sahi hai.

Bas aana chahiye. Aane ki wajah baad mein theek ho jaayegi. Pehle darwaza khaTkhaao.

Yeh Chapter 7 ki sabse inclusive baat hai — har koi welcome hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Ishwar ke paas jaane ke liye tayyar hona zaroori nahi. Chahe dukh mein jao, chahe sawaal leke jao, chahe kuch maangne jao — jaao. Darwaza hamesha khula hai.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां ज्ञानी नित्ययुक्त एकभक्तिर्विशिष्यते ।
प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tesham Jnani Nitya Yukta Eka Bhaktir Vishishyate,
Priyo Hi Jnanino Atyartham Aham Sa Ca Mama Priyah.
verses.englishMeaning: Among all these, the wise person who is ever steadfast in devotion to me alone stands out as the most excellent. I am supremely dear to the wise, and the wise is supremely dear to me.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Inme se sabse ooncha woh gyaani hai jo hamesha mujhse juda rehta hai aur sirf mujhse hi prem karta hai. Main gyaani ko bahut pyaara hoon — aur woh mujhe bahut pyaara hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Chaar tarah ke log aate hain — lekin Krishna ek ko sabse ooncha kehte hain — gyaani.

Gyaani woh jo sirf maangne ke liye nahi aata, sirf dukh mein nahi aata, sirf jaanna chahne ke liye nahi — woh sirf pyaar se aata hai. Bas woh Krishna ko pyaar karta hai — kuch maangne ke liye nahi.

Aur Krishna kehte hain — aisa gyaani mujhe bahut pyaara hai. Aur main use bahut pyaara hoon.

Yeh ek do-tarf ka rishta hai. Jo insaan Ishwar se pyaar karta hai, Ishwar bhi usi se pyaar karta hai.

Koi deal nahi — sirf prem.
verses.lifeLesson: Ishwar ke paas kuch maangne jaoge toh woh dega. Lekin agar sirf pyaar se jaoge — toh jo milega woh kisi ne maanga bhi nahi tha. Sachcha rishta maangnon se nahi, prem se banta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम् ।
आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Udarah Sarva Eva Ete Jnani Tv Atma Eva Me Matam,
Asthitah Sa Hi Yuktatma Mam Eva Anuttamam Gatim.
verses.englishMeaning: All of these are indeed noble and generous souls. But the wise I consider to be my very own self — for such a person, with a steady and resolved mind, has taken me alone as the highest and most excellent destination.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yeh sab — charon tarah ke log — sab ache hain. Lekin gyaani toh mera apna svaroopa hi hai — aise maanta hoon main. Kyunki woh sthir mann waala gyaani mujhe hi sabse oonchi manzil maanta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Pichle shlok mein Krishna ne gyaani ko sabse zyaada pyaar diya. Ab woh aur gehre jaate hain.

Woh kehte hain — gyaani toh mera apna hi roop hai. Main aur gyaani alag nahi hain.

Yeh bahut badi baat hai. Jab koi itna gehr mein doob jaaye ki Krishna aur woh ek ho jaayein — tab rishta alag ka nahi rehta — donon ek ho jaate hain.

Jaise paani aur samundar alag nahi hote — waise gyaani aur Krishna.

Yeh insaan ka highest point hai — jahan 'main' aur 'woh' ka farq khatam ho jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sabse badi uplabdhi yeh nahi ki Ishwar se miloge — balki woh khud ban jaao. Jab andar itna prem ho ki 'main' aur 'woh' ka farq khatam ho — wahi sacchi mukti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
बहूनां जन्मनामन्ते ज्ञानवान्मां प्रपद्यते ।
वासुदेवः सर्वमिति स महात्मा सुदुर्लभः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Bahunam Janmanam Ante Jnanavaan Mam Prapadyate,
Vasudevah Sarvam Iti Sa Mahatma Su Durlabhah.
verses.englishMeaning: At the end of many lifetimes of seeking and striving, the truly wise person finally surrenders to me with the complete understanding that 'Vasudeva — Krishna — is everything.' Such a great soul is extraordinarily rare.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Bahut saare janammon ke baad — ek din jo sachcha gyaani hota hai — woh mujhme sharan leta hai is samajh ke saath ki 'Vasudeva — Krishna — hi sab kuch hai.' Aisa mahatma bahut hi durlabh hota hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Chapter 7 ke sabse gehre shlokkon mein se ek hai.

Kai janamon ki yatra — kai baar janma, kai baar marna, kai baar koshish — aur ek din ek samajh aati hai jo sab kuch badal deti hai — 'Vasudeva sarvam' — Krishna hi sab kuch hai.

Yeh sirf ek thought nahi — yeh ek anubhav hai. Jab duniya ki har cheez mein Ishwar dikhe — patthar mein, insaan mein, dushman mein, apne mein — tab yeh sachcaai jeevant ho jaati hai.

Aur Krishna keh rahe hain — aisa insaan bahut durlabh hai. Kyunki yeh ek baar ki koshish nahi — yeh puri zindagi ka aur kai zindagiyon ka nateeja hai.

Lekin jo is raaste par hai — woh seedhe isi taraf ja raha hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab duniya ki har cheez mein ek hi sachcaai dikhne lage — dharti mein bhi, dushman mein bhi, khud mein bhi — tab samajh lo sachchi drishti aa gayi. Yahi zindagi ka sabse bada kaam hai.

verses.sanskrit:
कामैस्तैस्तैर्हृतज्ञानाः प्रपद्यन्तेऽन्यदेवताः ।
तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया ॥
verses.transliteration:
Kamaih Tais Tair Hrita Jnanah Prapadyante Anya Devatah,
Tam Tam Niyamam Asthaya Prakrityaa Niyatah Svaya.
verses.englishMeaning: Those whose wisdom has been carried away by various desires resort to other deities, following this or that ritual and rule — driven and controlled by their own material nature.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo log alag alag ichhaon mein apni samajh kho baithte hain — woh alag alag devtaaon ke paas jaate hain, alag alag niyamon ko maante hain — apni prakriti se majboor hoke.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Kuch log alag devataaon ko poojte hain — mannat maangne ke liye, ek khaas cheez paane ke liye.

Krishna keh rahe hain — woh bura nahi kar rahe. Lekin unki samajh sirf utni hai. Woh woh paate hain jo maanga — lekin jo maanga hi nahi, woh nahi milta.

Jaise koi doctor ke paas painkiller lene jaaye — woh milegi. Lekin bimari ki jadd theek nahi hogi.

Krishna ke paas aao — woh root treat karta hai. Woh poori sachcaai deta hai — koi ek wish nahi.

Farq hai — kya maangoge, kahan jaoge.
verses.lifeLesson: Ichha poori honi zaroori hai — lekin pehle dekhna ki woh ichha kahan le jaayegi. Jo sachche source ke paas jaata hai — woh sab paata hai. Jo sirf fal chaahhta hai — woh fal milega, aur uss mein hi reh jaayega.

verses.sanskrit:
यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति ।
तस्य तस्याचलां श्रद्धां तामेव विदधाम्यहम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yo Yo Yam Yam Tanum Bhaktah Shraddhaya Arcitum Icchati,
Tasya Tasya Acalam Shradham Tam Eva Vidadhamy Aham.
verses.englishMeaning: Whatever divine form any devotee wishes to worship with sincere faith — I make that very faith of theirs firm, steady and unwavering.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo jo bhakta jis bhi roope mein shraddha se Ishwar ko poojana chahta hai — unki us roope ke prati shraddha main khud mazboot karta hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok bahut important hai — kyunki yeh batata hai ki Krishna kitne udaar hain.

Chahe koi Ganesha pooje, koi Durga pooje, koi Shiva pooje — unki woh shraddha Krishna khud dridh karte hain. Woh shraddha ko torna nahi chahte.

Kyunki shraddha hi pehla qadam hai. Chahe kisi bhi raaste se chalo — agar sachchi shraddha hai — toh woh ek din sahi jagah pahunchati hai.

Krishna sabka sahara hain — sirf apni pooja karne walon ka nahi.
verses.lifeLesson: Kisi bhi roop mein ki gayi sachchi shraddha Ishwar tak pahunchti hai. Raaste alag ho sakte hain — manzil ek hai. Dil ki sachcaai cheez maayane rakhti hai, darwaza nahi.

verses.sanskrit:
स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते ।
लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान्हि तान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sa Taya Shraddhaya Yuktas Tasya Aradhanam Ihate,
Labhate Ca Tatah Kaman Maya Eva Vihitan Hi Tan.
verses.englishMeaning: Endowed with that steadfast faith, the devotee worships that chosen deity and through that devotion obtains the desired objects — which are in truth granted and dispensed by me alone.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Us shraddha se tika hua woh bhakta us devataa ki pooja karta hai aur wahan se apni mannat paata hai — lekin asli mein woh sab meri taraf se hi milta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Chahe koi bhi devataa poojo — jo milta hai woh sab Krishna ki taraf se milta hai. Woh hi asli daata hain.

Jaise ek hi bijli ka current alag alag bulbon se alag alag roshni deta hai — waise hi ek hi Ishwar ki shakti alag alag roopon mein fal deti hai.

Lekin Krishna ek gehri baat keh rahe hain — jo sirf mannat maangta hai, woh fal paata hai. Jo sachchi bhakti karta hai — woh fal se pare, Ishwar ko paata hai.

Dono milte hain — lekin paane ki gehraai alag hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo deta hai woh ek hai — raaste alag hain. Lekin raasta jitna seedha hoga, utna zyaada milega. Sachcha raasta — seedha Ishwar ki taraf jaana.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्तवत्तु फलं तेषां तद्भवत्यल्पमेधसाम् ।
देवान्देवयजो यान्ति मद्भक्ता यान्ति मामपि ॥
verses.transliteration:
Anta Vat Tu Phalam Tesham Tad Bhavaty Alpa Medhasam,
Devan Deva Yajo Yanti Mad Bhakta Yanti Mam Api.
verses.englishMeaning: But the fruit obtained by those of limited understanding is perishable and temporary. Those who worship the devas reach the devas — and my devotees ultimately reach me.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Lekin un alpa-buddhi logon ka jo fal milta hai — woh khatam ho jaata hai. Jo devataaon ko bhajte hain — woh devataaon tak pahunchte hain. Aur mere bhakt — woh mujh tak pahunchte hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Alag-alag manzilen — alag-alag nateeje.

Jo kisi devataa ko mannat maang ke kuch paata hai — woh milega, lekin khatam bhi ho jaayega. Saans khatam hogi, daulat khatam hogi, rishte khatam honge.

Lekin jo Ishwar — sachchi sachcaai — ko paata hai — woh hamesha ke liye milta hai. Woh nahi khatam hota.

Farq yeh nahi ki doosra devataa bura hai — farq yeh hai ki manzil kya hai.

Agar temporary ka fayeda chahiye — milega. Agar hamesha wala chahiye — toh seedha aao.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo temporary cheez maango — temporary milegi. Jo hamesha wali aarzoo karo — woh bhi milegi. Sawaal yeh hai ki teri aarzoo kitni badi hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अव्यक्तं व्यक्तिमापन्नं मन्यन्ते मामबुद्धयः ।
परं भावमजानन्तो ममाव्ययमनुत्तमम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Avyaktam Vyaktim Aapannam Manyante Mam Abuddhayah,
Param Bhavam Ajananto Mama Avyayam Anuttamam.
verses.englishMeaning: Those lacking true understanding think that I, the unmanifest, have merely taken on a human form — not knowing my supreme, imperishable and transcendent nature that lies far beyond.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo log sachchi samajh nahi rakhte — woh maante hain ki main sirf ek insaan ka roop liya hua hoon. Woh nahi jaante meri woh oonchi, avyaya aur sabse badi sachcaai ko.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Kuch log sochte hain — Krishna sirf ek insaan tha. Arjun ka dost, yudh mein rath chalane waala.

Lekin Krishna keh rahe hain — jo sirf yeh dekhta hai, woh half picture dekh raha hai. Main sirf yeh shareer nahi hoon. Main woh hoon jo hamesha tha, hamesha hai, hamesha rahega.

Jab koi bada musician bajata hai — sirf woh nahi sunta jo sirf notes sun raha hai, woh sunta hai jo sangeet ki rooh ko mahsoos karta hai.

Usi tarah — Krishna ko sirf ek historical figure samajhna unhe jaanna nahi hai. Unhe jaanna hai andar se — sachcaai ke roop mein.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo ankhon se dikh raha hai woh sab nahi hai. Andar ki aankh se dekhna seekho — wahan woh sachcaai hai jo dikhne wali duniya se kahin badi hai.

verses.sanskrit:
नाहं प्रकाशः सर्वस्य योगमायासमावृतः ।
मूढोऽयं नाभिजानाति लोको मामजमव्ययम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Na Aham Prakash Sarvasya Yoga Maya Samavritah,
Mudho Ayam Na Abhijanati Loko Mam Ajam Avyayam.
verses.englishMeaning: Veiled by my divine Yoga-Maya, I am not revealed to everyone. This deluded world does not recognise me — who am unborn and imperishable.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Apni Yoga-Maya se dhaka hua main sab ko zahir nahi hota. Yeh mohit duniya mujhe — jo ajanma aur avyaya hoon — nahi pahchaan paati.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Ishwar kyun nahi dikhte? Yeh sawaal bahut logon ke dil mein hoga.

Krishna jawab dete hain — main yoga-maya se dhaka hoon. Main sab ko ek jaisi tarah nazar nahi aata.
