Jaise sun ke peeche baadal ho toh roshni kum ho jaati hai — lekin sun wahan hi hai. Usi tarah Ishwar har jagah hai — lekin Maya ne ankhon par parda dala hua hai.

Aur kab utarta hai yeh parda? Jab andar se sachchi khoj shuru hoti hai. Jab sirf duniya ki cheezein nahi chahiye — tab andar ki roshni dikhni shuru hoti hai.

Maya haTti hai sachchi pyaas se.
verses.lifeLesson: Ishwar door nahi — hum door ho gaye hain. Duniya ki bheed mein andar ki aawaz dabti hai. Jab khamosh ho jaao — woh sunta hai, aur tum bhi sun sakte ho.

verses.sanskrit:
वेदाहं समतीतानि वर्तमानानि चार्जुन ।
भविष्याणि च भूतानि मां तु वेद न कश्चन ॥
verses.transliteration:
Veda Aham Samatitani Vartamanani Ca Arjuna,
Bhavishyani Ca Bhutani Mam Tu Veda Na Kashcana.
verses.englishMeaning: O Arjun, I know all beings that have existed in the past, that exist in the present, and that will exist in the future — but no one truly knows me in my full reality.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Jo bhi tha, jo bhi hai, jo bhi hoga — sab ko main jaanta hoon. Lekin mujhe koi sachchi tarah se nahi jaanta.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok ek ajeeb aur gehri baat keh raha hai.

Krishna jaante hain — sab ko. Har ek insaan jo kabhi tha, jo abhi hai, jo aayega — sab. Poora itihaas, poora vartamaan, poora bhavishy — unki palak mein hai.

Lekin woh khud? Unhe koi nahi jaanta — poori tarah.

Yeh islie nahi ki woh chhupa kar rakhte hain. Yeh isliye hai ki jo unlimited hai, woh limited zindagi mein poori tarah nahi jaana ja sakta.

Jaise ek cup mein samundar nahi aa sakta — waise ek insaan ke mann mein Ishwar ki poori sachcaai nahi samaati.

Lekin jo thodi bhi samajh milti hai — woh bhi bahut badi naimat hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sab kuch jaanna zaroori nahi — jo thoda jaan gaye, use jeena zaroori hai. Ishwar ko poori tarah koi nahi jaanta — lekin thodi bhi pehchaan zindagi badal deti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
इच्छाद्वेषसमुत्थेन द्वन्द्वमोहेन भारत ।
सर्वभूतानि सम्मोहं सर्गे यान्ति परन्तप ॥
verses.transliteration:
Iccha Dvesha Samutthena Dvandva Mohena Bharata,
Sarva Bhutani Sammokham Sarge Yanti Parantapa.
verses.englishMeaning: O Bharata, O scorcher of enemies — all living beings fall into complete delusion from the very moment of birth, deluded by the illusion of duality that arises from desire and aversion.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Is duniya mein aate hi — ichha aur dvesha se jo duality ka moha hai — usi mein sab jeev baar baar phans jaate hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Jab ek bachcha duniya mein aata hai — woh sirf hota hai. Lekin kuch hi waqt mein woh seekh jaata hai — yeh achha lagta hai, woh bura lagta hai. Yeh chahiye, woh nahi chahiye.

Aur yahi shuru hoti hai — dvandva. Duality. Achha-bura, sukh-dukh, apna-paraya.

Aur Krishna keh rahe hain — yeh moha janm se hi aata hai. Yeh prakriti ka hissa hai.

Lekin jo jaanta hai ki yeh moha hai — woh dheere dheere isse upar uth sakta hai. Pahchaan hi azadi ka pehla qadam hai.

Jo jaan gaya ki yeh game ho raha hai — woh game se bahar aa sakta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sukh-dukh, achha-bura — yeh duniya ke do rukh hain. Jo sirf ek pakad rakhta hai, woh dusre se darta rehta hai. Jo donon dekh le bina pakde — woh dono se azaad hai.

verses.sanskrit:
येषां त्वन्तगतं पापं जनानां पुण्यकर्मणाम् ।
ते द्वन्द्वमोहनिर्मुक्ता भजन्ते मां दृढव्रताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yesham Tv Anta Gatam Papam Jananam Punya Karmanam,
Te Dvandva Moha Nirmukta Bhajante Mam Dridha Vratah.
verses.englishMeaning: But those people of righteous actions whose accumulated sins have come to an end — they are freed from the delusion of duality and worship me with firm and resolute devotion.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Lekin jo log punya karte hain aur jinke paap khatam ho gaye hain — woh dvandva ke moha se azaad hokar mujhe dridh nishchay se bhajte hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Pichle shlok mein Krishna ne kaha — dvandva mein sab phanse hain.

Ab woh bata rahe hain — kuch log hain jo isse bahar aa jaate hain. Kaise? Sachchi koshish, sachche achhe kaam, andar ki saf-safai se.

Jab koi sachchi tarah se achha karta rehta hai — dheere dheere andar ki gandagi saaf hoti hai. Aur jab woh saaf hoti hai — tabhi dvandva ka moha ghatne lagta hai.

Aur phir woh log mujhe sirf prem se bhajte hain — kisi darr se nahi, kisi maannat se nahi — bas prem se.

Yeh ek cycle hai — achha karo, saaf ho, Ishwar ke karib aao.
verses.lifeLesson: Andar ki safai bahar ki zindagi se hoti hai — achhe kaam, sachchi niyat, dusron ke liye kuch karo. Dheere dheere woh safai Ishwar ke darshan khol deti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
जरामरणमोक्षाय मामाश्रित्य यतन्ति ये ।
ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Jara Marana Mokshaya Mam Ashritya Yatanti Ye,
Te Brahma Tad Viduh Kritsnam Adhyatmam Karma Ca Akhilam.
verses.englishMeaning: Those who strive with sincere effort for liberation from old age and death by taking refuge in me — they come to know Brahman completely, the entire nature of the self, and the full truth of karma.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo log budhapa aur maut se mukti paane ke liye mujhme sharan lete hain aur koshish karte hain — woh Brahman ko, poore adhyatma ko aur poore karma ko sachchi tarah samajh jaate hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok ek bahut gehri raah dikhata hai.

Har insaan ke dil mein ek darr hota hai — budhaapa aur maut ka. Koi na koi ek din yeh sawaal aata hai — kya main khatam ho jaaunga? Kya yeh sab ek din khatam ho jaayega?

Krishna keh rahe hain — jo is sawaal ke saath mujhme aata hai, jo is darr ke saath mujhe pakadta hai — woh na sirf darr se mukta hota hai, woh poori sachcaai samajh jaata hai.

Brahman — sachchi haqeeqat. Adhyatma — apna asli svaroopa. Karma — kaam ka sachcha raaz.

Sab ek saath khulta hai — jab andar se sachchi khoj hoti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Maut ka darr hone mein sharm nahi — woh insaan ka sabse sahaj sawaal hai. Lekin agar us sawaal ko Ishwar ki taraf le jaao — toh woh darr hi raasta ban jaata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः ।
प्रयाणकालेऽपि च मां ते विदुर्युक्तचेतसः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sa Adhi Bhuta Adhi Daivam Mam Sa Adhi Yajnam Ca Ye Viduh,
Prayana Kale Api Ca Mam Te Vidur Yukta Chetasah.
verses.englishMeaning: Those who know me in my aspects as adhibhuta, adhidaiva and adhiyajna — with minds steady and fully united, they know me even at the final moment of departure from this world.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo log mujhe adhibhuta, adhidaiva aur adhiyajna ke saath jaante hain — woh log sthir chitt ke saath mujhe mrityu ke samay bhi jaanate hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Chapter 7 ka aakhiri shlok hai — aur yeh agle chapter ke sawaalon ki peethika hai.

Teen cheezein — adhibhuta (har cheez ki maddi sachcaai), adhidaiva (brahmand ki chetna), adhiyajna (har yajna ka asli mahatva) — jo inhe sachchi tarah jaanta hai, woh Ishwar ko poori tarah samajhta hai.

Aur aisi samajh aakhir waqt mein bhi nahi jaati. Maut ke samay bhi woh Ishwar ko hi yaad karta hai.

Yeh chapter 7 ki final baat hai — sachcha gyaan sirf zindagi mein nahi, maut ke waqt bhi kaam aata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo sachcha gyaan andar utar jaata hai — woh aakhri waqt mein bhi saath rehta hai. Zindagi ko Ishwar ke saath jeene ki koshish karo — toh maut bhi darne ki cheez nahi, milne ka waqt hai.

summary: The eighth chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Akshara Brahma Yoga. In this chapter, Krishna reveals the importance of the last thought before death. If we can remember Krishna at the time of death, we will certainly attain him. Thus, it is very important to be in constant awareness of the Lord at all times, thinking of Him and chanting His names at all times. By perfectly absorbing their mind in Him through constant devotion, one can go beyond this material existence to Lord's Supreme abode.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
किं तद् ब्रह्म किमध्यात्मं किं कर्म पुरुषोत्तम ।
अधिभूतं च किं प्रोक्तमधिदैवं किमुच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Arjuna Uvacha:
Kim Tad Brahma Kim Adhyatmam Kim Karma Purushottama,
Adhi Bhutam Ca Kim Proktam Adhi Daivam Kim Ucyate.
verses.englishMeaning: Arjun said: O Purushottama — best among all persons — what is Brahman? What is the self? What is karma? What is described as adhibhuta? And what is called adhidaiva?
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Arjun ne kaha:

Hey Purushottama! Yeh Brahman kya hai? Adhyatma kya hai? Karma kya hai? Adhibhuta kya kehte hain? Aur adhidaiva kya hai?
verses.simpleExplanation:
Chapter 7 ke aakhiri shlok mein Krishna ne kuch khaas alfaaz use kiye — Brahman, adhyatma, adhibhuta, adhidaiva, adhiyajna.

Arjun ne suna — aur ek saccha shishya ki tarah poochh liya — yeh sab kya hai?

Yeh ek bahut zaruri sawaal hai. Bade bade alfaaz sunne mein achhe lagte hain — lekin samajhna aur zyaada zaroori hai.

Aur Arjun ne poochh liya — bina sharmaye. Yahi sachche shishya ki pehchaan hai — jo nahi samjha, woh seedha poochhhta hai.

Agle kaafi shloks ka jawab in sawaalon ka hi hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo nahi samjha woh poochhna chahiye — sharm kisi kaam ki nahi. Sachcha sawaal poochhna — yahi sachche seekhne ki shuruaat hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अधियज्ञः कथं कोऽत्र देहेऽस्मिन्मधुसूदन ।
प्रयाणकाले च कथं ज्ञेयोऽसि नियतात्मभिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Arjuna Uvacha:
Adhi Yajnah Katham Ko Atra Dehe Asmin Madhusudana,
Prayana Kale Ca Katham Jneyo Asi Niyata Atmabhih.
verses.englishMeaning: Arjun said: O Madhusudana — who is the adhiyajna here in this body, and how? And how are you to be known at the time of death by those of controlled and steady mind?
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Madhusudana! Adhiyajna yahan is shareer mein kaun hai aur kaise? Aur antim samay mein aapko sachche mann waale kaise jaante hain?
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ke do aur sawaal — aur dono bahut zaroori.

Pehla — jo yajna hota hai, jo sacrifice hoti hai — woh is shareer mein kahan hai, kaun hai?

Doosra — aur yeh sabse zaroori sawaal — aakhri waqt mein, jab saans chhut rahi ho, aapko kaise yaad karte hain jo sachchi koshish karte hain?

Yeh sawaal sirf gyaan ka nahi — yeh zindagi aur maut ka sawaal hai. Aur Krishna iska jawab denge — jo agle kaafi shloks ka dil hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Maut ke waqt kya yaad aayega — yeh socho aaj. Aur phir aisi zindagi jiyo ki woh sab yaad aaye jo sachcha hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
अक्षरं ब्रह्म परमं स्वभावोऽध्यात्ममुच्यते ।
भूतभावोद्भवकरो विसर्गः कर्मसंज्ञितः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Shri Bhagavan Uvacha:
Aksharam Brahma Paramam Svabhavo Adhyatmam Ucyate,
Bhuta Bhava Udbhava Karo Visargah Karma Samjnitah.
verses.englishMeaning: Shri Krishna said: Brahman is the supreme, indestructible reality. The intrinsic nature of the individual self is called adhyatma. The creative offering that brings forth the existence and nature of all beings is what is known as karma.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Shri Krishna ne kaha:

Brahman woh hai jo kabhi nahi badla, kabhi nahi khatam hoga — akshara, sanaatan. Adhyatma — apna asli svaroopa. Aur jo shakti har jeev ko utpanna karne ke liye kaam karti hai — woh karma hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna Arjun ke sawaalon ke jawab dena shuru karte hain.

Brahman — woh sachcaai jo kabhi nahi kaati. Na shuru hua, na khatam hoga. Woh jo sab mein tha, sab mein hai, sab mein rahega.

Adhyatma — apna asli svaroopa. Woh jo tumhara shareer nahi — jo tum sachchi mein ho. Andar ki woh chetna.

Karma — jo shakti jeevon ko utpanna karti hai, unhe badlav deti hai. Yeh sirf kaam nahi — yeh woh force hai jisse duniya chalti hai.

Teen baatein — ek baar jaano toh bahut kuch samajh aa jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apne asli svaroopa ko jaanna — yahi adhyatma ka raaz hai. Jo andar ka sachcha hissa hai, woh kabhi marta nahi. Yeh jaanke maut ka darr khatam hota hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अधिभूतं क्षरो भावः पुरुषश्चाधिदैवतम् ।
अधियज्ञोऽहमेवात्र देहे देहभृतां वर ॥
verses.transliteration:
Adhi Bhutam Ksharo Bhavah Purushas Ca Adhi Daivatam,
Adhi Yajno Aham Eva Atra Dehe Deha Bhritam Vara.
verses.englishMeaning: The ever-changing and perishable physical nature is called adhibhuta. The cosmic consciousness is adhidaiva. And O best among those who bear a body — I myself am adhiyajna, dwelling right here within this body.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo bhi badalta rehta hai, naash hota hai — woh adhibhuta hai. Brahmand ki chetna — woh adhidaiva hai. Aur hey dehadhaariyon mein shreshtha! — Adhiyajna main khud hoon, is shareer mein.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna pichle shlok ke aage jaate hain.

Adhibhuta — yeh duniya, yeh shareer, yeh sab jo dikhta hai — khatam hoga. Permanent nahi.

Adhidaiva — poori srishti ki chetna. Woh jo sab cheezon ko chala raha hai — cosmic order.

Adhiyajna — yaani jo andar ki sacrifice hai, jo devotion hai — woh main khud hoon. Teri har koshish, teri har bhakti — uska asli hissa main hoon.

Mtlab — bahar kuch bhi poojo, andar ki devotion ki asli jagah wahi hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Bahari pooja rasm hai — andar ki bhavna asli hai. Jo andar saaf niyat se Ishwar ki taraf muda — woh sachchi pooja hui.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन्मुक्त्वा कलेवरम् ।
यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Anta Kale Ca Mam Eva Smaran Muktva Kalevaram,
Yah Prayati Sa Mad Bhavam Yati Na Asty Atra Samshayah.
verses.englishMeaning: And whoever, at the very time of death, departs from the body while remembering me alone — that person attains my state of being. Of this, there is absolutely no doubt.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aur jo insaan aakhri waqt mein sirf mujhe yaad karte hue shareer chhod jaata hai — woh mere svaroopa ko paata hai. Isme koi shak nahi.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Chapter 8 ka sabse powerful shlok hai.

Krishna ek wada kar rahe hain — jo aakhir mein mujhe yaad kare, woh mujh tak aata hai.

Lekin yahan ek bahut zaroori baat hai — 'aakhir mein' ka matlab poori zindagi ki training hai. Jo poori zindagi Ishwar ko yaad karta raha — wahi aakhri waqt mein yaad rakhega.

Jaise ek musician — jo saalon se saadh kiya — jab stage par aata hai, angliyan khud chalti hain. Training khud show hoti hai.

Usi tarah — poori zindagi ki bhakti aakhri waqt mein khud kaam aati hai.

Isliye — abhi se shuru karo.
verses.lifeLesson: Maut ke waqt kya yaad aayega — woh poori zindagi decide hoti hai. Jo abhi Ishwar ko yaad karta hai — woh akhiri pal mein bhi yaad karega. Aaj ki koshish kal kaam aayegi.

verses.sanskrit:
यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम् ।
तं तमेवैति कौन्तेय सदा तद्भावभावितः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yam Yam Va Api Smaran Bhavam Tyajaty Ante Kalevaram,
Tam Tam Eva Aiti Kaunteya Sada Tad Bhava Bhavitah.
verses.englishMeaning: O Kaunteya — whatever state of being one remembers and holds in mind at the time of departing from the body — to that very state alone does one attain, having been constantly shaped and formed by that thought throughout life.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Aakhiri waqt mein jo bhi bhaav yaad karte hue shareer chhoda — wahi bhaav woh paata hai — kyunki poori zindagi usi bhaav ne use banaya hota hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok pichle shlok ka explanation hai — aur bahut zaroori hai.

Aakhiri waqt mein jo yaad aayega — woh chance nahi hoga. Woh wahi hoga jo poori zindagi gahrai mein tha.

Jo insaan poori zindagi paisa sochta raha — woh aakhri waqt mein paisa sochega. Jo poori zindagi rishte sochta raha — woh rishte. Jo Ishwar sochta raha — woh Ishwar.

Yeh ek simple psychological sachcaai hai — jo hum baar baar sochte hain, woh andar ghus jaata hai.

Isliye sochna kya hai — yeh poori zindagi ka sabse bada faisla hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Zindagi mein jo baar baar sochte ho — wahi aakhir mein saath aayega. Jo Ishwar ko rozmarra mein yaad rakho — woh maut ke waqt bhi saath hoga.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च ।
मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tasmat Sarvesu Kaleshu Mam Anusmara Yudhya Ca,
Mayy Arpita Mano Buddhi Mam Eva Aishyasy Asamshayam.
verses.englishMeaning: Therefore, at all times, remember me and also perform your duty. With your mind and intellect completely surrendered and dedicated to me — you will surely come to me alone, without any doubt whatsoever.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Isliye — har waqt mujhe yaad karo aur apna kaam karo. Apna mann aur buddhi mujh mein arpan karo — toh tu zaroor mujh tak aayega, isme koi shak nahi.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Gita ki ek sabse practical baat hai.

Krishna keh rahe hain — main nahi keh raha ki sab chhod do, jungle mein baith jao, dhyan karo. Nahi.

Main keh raha hoon — apna kaam karo. Jo teri zimmedaari hai woh nibhaao. Lekin andar se — mann aur buddhi mujhme laga ke karo.

Kaam alag, yaad alag nahi.

Ghar chalao — yaad rakhke. Karobaar karo — yaad rakhke. Rishte nibhao — yaad rakhke.

Yeh dual consciousness — yahi yoga hai. Kaam bahar se, Ishwar andar se.
verses.lifeLesson: Zindagi aur bhakti alag nahi hain — ek hi hain. Jo apna kaam Ishwar ki yaad mein karta hai — woh nahi haarta. Har kaam ek ibadat ban jaata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अभ्यासयोगयुक्तेन चेतसा नान्यगामिना ।
परमं पुरुषं दिव्यं याति पार्थानुचिन्तयन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Abhyasa Yoga Yuktena Cetasa Na Anya Gamina,
Paramam Purusham Divyam Yati Partha Anucintayan.
verses.englishMeaning: With the mind continuously disciplined through the practice of yoga, not wandering toward anything else — one who meditates constantly on the supreme divine Purusha, O Partha, attains that very supreme being.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Partha! Abhyaas yoga se siddh kiya hua mann — jo kahin aur nahi bhaagta — aur jo nirantar us Param Divya Purusha ka dhyan karta rehta hai — woh usi ko paata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Pichle shlok mein Krishna ne kaha — yaad karo aur kaam karo.

Ab woh batate hain kaise — abhyaas se.

Abhyaas — roz ki koshish. Roz thoda dhyan. Roz thodi yaad. Ek baar nahi — baar baar.

Aur dhyan bhi focused — kahin aur nahi jaata. Ek jagah tikta hai.

Jaise paani ek jagah rok ke rakhna ho toh nali banani padti hai — usi tarah mann ko ek jagah rok ke rakhna padta hai abhyaas se.

Aur aise mann se jo Ishwar ka dhyan karta hai — woh usi mein sama jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Ek baar ki koshish se nahi — baar baar ki koshish se raasta banta hai. Roz thoda — roz. Consistent hona hi yoga hai.

verses.sanskrit:
कविं पुराणमनुशासितार-
मणोरणीयंसमनुस्मरेद्यः ।
सर्वस्य धातारमचिन्त्यरूप-
मादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Kavim Puranam Anushashitaram Anor Aniyamsam Anusmared Yah,
Sarvasya Dhataram Acintya Rupam Aditya Varnam Tamasah Parastat.
verses.englishMeaning: The one who meditates upon the omniscient and ancient, the supreme ruler, subtler than the subtlest, the sustainer of all, of inconceivable form, luminous like the sun, beyond all darkness —
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo insaan us Param Tattva ka dhyan karta hai — jo sarvajnya hai, jo puraana-se-puraana hai, jo sab ka niyantaa hai, jo sookshma se bhi sookshma hai, jo sab ka dhaarnn karne waala hai, jo achintyaroop hai, jo suraj jaisi roshni hai aur jo andheron se pare hai —
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok Ishwar ke kuch alag gunoN ko describe karta hai — aur yeh bahut gehri tasveer hai.

Kavi — woh jo sab kuch jaanta hai, sab kuch dekhta hai. Puraana — woh jo sab se pehle tha, aur hamesha rahega. Anu se bhi anu — woh jo itna sookshma hai ki kisi chakku se nahi kaata ja sakta. Sabka dhaarrann karne waala — jis par sab kuch tika hua hai.

Aur phir — suraj jaisi roshni, andheron se pare.

Yeh Ishwar ki woh tasveer hai jo kisi ne banai nahi — jo sachcaai hai. Aur jo yeh dhyan karta hai — agle shlok mein uska fal batayenge Krishna.
verses.lifeLesson: Ishwar ko kisi ek roop mein mat bandho. Woh anant hai — sookshma bhi, vishaal bhi, roshni bhi, niyantaa bhi. Jitni badi nazar — utna bada Ishwar dikhta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रयाणकाले मनसाऽचलेन
भक्त्या युक्तो योगबलेन चैव ।
भ्रुवोर्मध्ये प्राणमावेश्य सम्यक्
स तं परं पुरुषमुपैति दिव्यम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Prayana Kale Manasa Acalena Bhaktya Yukto Yoga Balena Ca Eva,
Bhruvor Madhye Pranam Aveshya Samyak Sa Tam Param Purusham Upaiti Divyam.
verses.englishMeaning: At the time of death — with an unwavering mind, filled with devotion, with the power of yoga — having rightly fixed the life breath between the two eyebrows — that yogi attains that supreme divine Purusha.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Antim samay mein — nishchal mann ke saath, bhakti se bhara hua, yoga ki shakti ke saath — praana ko bhrukutiyon ke beech sahi tarah sthapit karke — woh yogi us Param Divya Purusha ko paata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Pichle shlok ne Ishwar ki tasveer banayi — ab yeh shlok batata hai ki jo us tasveer ka dhyan karta hua antim waqt mein jaata hai — woh kya paata hai.

Nishchal mann — jo doob gaya ho us dhyan mein. Bhakti — jo sirf prem se aa rahi ho. Yoga ki shakti — poori zindagi ki sadhna.

Aur woh praana ko bhrukutiyon ke beech sthapit karta hai — yeh yogic practice hai — aur us awareness ke saath shareer chhod ta hai.

Aisa insaan Param Purusha ko paata hai — jo suraj ki roshni jaisa hai, andheron se pare.

Yeh sirf mrityu nahi — yeh ek sachchi mukti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Maut ka waqt ek aakhri pariksha nahi — woh poori zindagi ka nateeja hai. Jo abhi se saadhta hai — woh tab bhi tayyar hoga. Poori zindagi hi preparation hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यदक्षरं वेदविदो वदन्ति
विशन्ति यद्यतयो वीतरागाः ।
यदिच्छन्तो ब्रह्मचर्यं चरन्ति
तत्ते पदं संग्रहेण प्रवक्ष्ये ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yad Aksharam Veda Vido Vadanti Vishanti Yad Yatayo Vita Ragah,
Yad Icchanto Brahmacharyam Caranti Tat Te Padam Samgrahena Pravakshye.
verses.englishMeaning: That which the knowers of the Vedas call the Imperishable Akshara — that into which the self-controlled strivers free from attachment enter — and desiring which they practice brahmacharya — I shall tell you of that state briefly.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo Vedaon ke jaankar 'Akshara' kehte hain — jisme vitarag aur koshish karne wale pravesh karte hain — jiske liye woh brahmacharya ka paaln karte hain — woh manzil main tujhe sankshepa mein batata hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna ab ek aur depth tak jaate hain.

Akshara — woh jo kabhi nahi kaaTta. Poore Vedaon mein isi ki khoj hai. Saadhak usi mein samaana chahte hain.

Brahmacharya — yeh sirf celibacy nahi. Yeh woh jeene ka tarika hai jo energy ko Ishwar ki taraf lagaata hai, bahar baTne nahi deta.

Aur Krishna keh rahe hain — woh jagah main tumhe batata hoon — sankshepa mein. Agle do shlok us raaste ki practice batate hain.

Pehle manzil jaano — phir raasta aasaan lagta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo manzil ka pata nahi — woh hamesha bhaagta rehta hai. Pehle jaano ki jaana kahan hai — phir raasta apne aap milta jaata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हृदि निरुध्य च ।
मूर्ध्न्याधायात्मनः प्राणमास्थितो योगधारणाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sarva Dvarani Samyamya Mano Hridi Nirudhya Ca,
Murdhny Adhaya Atmanah Pranam Asthito Yoga Dharanam.
verses.englishMeaning: Restraining all the gates of the body — the senses — fixing the mind within the heart, withdrawing one's life breath to the crown of the head, and established firmly in yogic concentration —
verses.hinglishMeaning: Sab indriyon ke dvaaron ko band karke, mann ko hridaya mein rokke, praana ko sirr ke upar sthapit karke — yogic dharana mein sthir hoke —
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok ek yogic practice describe karta hai — aur yeh agle shlok ke saath milkaar poori hai.

Sab indriyon ko bahar se rokna — baahri duniya se dhyan hatana. Mann ko hridaya mein tikana — andar ki taraf kheencha jaata hai. Praana ko sirr ke upar laana — urdhva gati — upar ki taraf.

Yeh ek advanced yogic method hai jo antim waqt mein — ya gehre dhyan mein — use ki jaati hai.

Lekin iska sadhan — roz ki zindagi mein hota hai. Jo roz thoda practice karta hai — woh aakhri waqt mein bhi kar sakta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Andar ki taraf mudna seekhna padta hai — ek din mein nahi hota. Jo roz kuch waqt andar jaata hai — woh dheere dheere woh rasta seekh jaata hai jo sab se zaroori hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म व्याहरन्मामनुस्मरन् ।
यः प्रयाति त्यजन्देहं स याति परमां गतिम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Om Iti Eka Aksharam Brahma Vyaharan Mam Anusmaran,
Yah Prayati Tyajan Deham Sa Yati Paramam Gatim.
verses.englishMeaning: Uttering the single syllable Om — which is Brahman — and remembering me — whoever departs from the body thus, attains the supreme and final destination.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Om — yeh ek akshar jo Brahman ka hi naam hai — ise bolte hue aur mujhe yaad karte hue — jo shareer chhod ta hai — woh parama gati ko paata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Pichle shlok mein jo method bataya — ab uska conclusion.

Om — duniya ki sabse puraani awaaz. Sabse sookshma, sabse gehra. Vedaon ka sara saar is ek akshar mein hai.

Aur Krishna keh rahe hain — Om bolo, mujhe yaad karo — aur is haal mein shareer chhodo.

Yeh ek bahut pyaara wada hai — ki sirf ek akshar, sirf ek yaad — aur manzil mil jaati hai.

Lekin yeh ek akshar tabhi kaam karta hai jab poori zindagi usi mein tiki ho. Zubaan ka Om alag hai, rooh ka Om alag.
verses.lifeLesson: Om sirf ek shabd nahi — woh ek taaluq hai. Jab woh sirf zubaan par nahi, rooh mein utar jaaye — tab woh haqeeqi Om hai. Roz bolo — roz aur gehre.

verses.sanskrit:
अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः ।
तस्याहं सुलभः पार्थ नित्ययुक्तस्य योगिनः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Ananya Cetah Satatam Yo Mam Smarati Nityashah,
Tasya Aham Sulabhah Partha Nitya Yuktasya Yoginah.
verses.englishMeaning: O Partha — I am easily attainable for that yogi who is ever-steadfast, who thinks of me at all times with a mind devoted to nothing else — for that ever-united yogi, I am easily reached.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Partha! Jo ananya chitt waala yogi hamesha mujhe — aur sirf mujhe — yaad karta rehta hai — aisa nityayukta yogi ke liye main bahut aasaani se milta hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok Gita ke sabse achchi umeed dene wale shlokkon mein se ek hai.

Krishna keh rahe hain — jo mujhe hamesha yaad rakhta hai, jo kabhi aur nahi sochta — use main bahut aasaani se milta hoon.

Sulabhah — aasaan. Krishna khud keh rahe hain — jo ek taar pe mujhe pakdta hai — use main aasaani se mil jaata hoon.

Yeh wada itna gehra hai ki samajhne mein der lagti hai. Ishwar ko paana mushkil nahi — bas ek taar pakadhni hai. Sirf ek — har waqt.
verses.lifeLesson: Ishwar ko paana bahut mushkil nahi lagta jab ek taar pakad lo. Ek taar — hamesha yaad. Aur phir jo milta hai — woh koi bhool nahi sakta.

verses.sanskrit:
मामुपेत्य पुनर्जन्म दुःखालयमशाश्वतम् ।
नाप्नुवन्ति महात्मानः संसिद्धिं परमां गताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Mam Upetya Punar Janma Duhkha Alayam Ashashvatam,
Na Apnuvanti Mahatmanah Samsiddhim Paramam Gatah.
verses.englishMeaning: Having attained me — the great souls who have reached the highest perfection — they do not undergo rebirth into this transient world, which is a home of suffering.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Mujhe paane ke baad woh mahatma log — jo parama siddhi ko pahunch gaye hain — woh is duniya mein dobara janam nahi lete — jo dukh ka ghar hai aur jo kabhi permanent nahi raha.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna ek bahut badi baat keh rahe hain.

Yeh duniya — dukh ka ghar hai. Chahe kitna bhi khushi dene ki koshish karo — woh permanent nahi rehti. Har khushi ke saath thoda andhera aata hai. Har milan ke baad bichchhad hota hai.

Lekin jo Ishwar ko paa liya — woh iss chakkar mein nahi aata. Woh dobara is duniya mein nahi aata.

Yeh dar ki baat nahi — yeh mukti ki baat hai. Ki ek baar sachchi jagah pahunch gaye — toh yeh aana-jaana khatam.

Aur yeh highest aspiration hai — na baar baar aana, na baar baar jaana.
verses.lifeLesson: Yeh duniya mein sukh paane ki koshish zaroori hai — lekin asli sukh yahan permanent nahi. Jo hamesha waala dhundhna chahte ho — woh andar hai, bahar nahi. Andar ki manzil pakdo.

verses.sanskrit:
आब्रह्मभुवनाल्लोकाः पुनरावर्तिनोऽर्जुन ।
मामुपेत्य तु कौन्तेय पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
A Brahma Bhuvanal Lokah Punar Avartino Arjuna,
Mam Upetya Tu Kaunteya Punar Janma Na Vidyate.
verses.englishMeaning: O Arjun, all worlds including the realm of Brahma are subject to return. But having attained me, O Kaunteya, there is no rebirth.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Brahma lok tak ke sare jagat — sab mein wapas aana hota hai. Lekin hey Kaunteya! Mujhe paane ke baad — dobara janam nahi hota.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh ek bahut important baat hai — jo log sochte hain ki swarg ya Brahmalok pahunch gaye toh kaam khatam — Krishna keh rahe hain, nahi.

Brahma lok bhi — jo sabse oonche loke hain — wahan bhi ek din wapas aana hota hai. Koi bhi jagah permanent nahi — sirf ek jagah chhod kar.

Aur woh jagah — main hoon. Mujhe paa lo — phir koi wapasi nahi.

Yeh sirf aastha ki baat nahi — yeh ek philosophical sachcaai hai. Jo consciousness ki sabse gehri jagah pahunch jaati hai — woh wapas nahi aati.
verses.lifeLesson: Koi bhi temporary jagah hamesha ke liye nahi hai — na duniya, na swarg. Jo hamesha waali jagah chahiye — woh andar hai. Wahi manzil hai jo lautai nahi jaati.

verses.sanskrit:
सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तमहर्यद् ब्रह्मणो विदुः ।
रात्रिं युगसहस्रान्तां तेऽहोरात्रविदो जनाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sahasra Yuga Paryantam Ahar Yad Brahmanah Viduh,
Ratrim Yuga Sahasrantam Te Aho Ratra Vido Janah.
verses.englishMeaning: Those who truly know that a single day of Brahma lasts for a thousand yugas, and a single night of Brahma also lasts a thousand yugas — they are the ones who truly understand what day and night mean in the cosmic sense.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo log jaante hain ki Brahma ka ek din hazaar yugon ka hota hai aur ek raat bhi hazaar yugon ki — woh log din aur raat ko sachchi tarah jaanne waale hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok hamen waqt ka ek alag perspective deta hai.

Hamara din — 24 ghante. Brahma ka din — hazaron saalon ka. Srishti banti hai — Brahma ka din. Srishti pralaya hoti hai — Brahma ki raat.

Krishna yeh kyun keh rahe hain? Taaki hum samjhein — jo hum 'hamesha' samajhte hain, woh actually bahut chhota period hai.

Aur jo sach mein hamesha hai — woh Brahma se bhi pare hai. Woh main hoon — yahi unhe batana tha.

Yeh shlok insaan ko time perspective deta hai — taaki woh temporary ko permanent na maane.
verses.lifeLesson: Yeh duniya, yeh zindagi — ek bahut chhote waqt ki baat hai. Jo hamesha waala hai woh isse kahin bada hai. Is chhote waqt ko sachche kaam mein lagao.

verses.sanskrit:
अव्यक्ताद् व्यक्तयः सर्वाः प्रभवन्त्यहरागमे ।
रात्र्यागमे प्रलीयन्ते तत्रैवाव्यक्तसंज्ञके ॥
verses.transliteration:
Avyaktat Vyaktayah Sarvah Prabhavanty Ahara Game,
Ratry Agame Praliyante Tatra Eva Avyakta Samjnake.
verses.englishMeaning: At the coming of Brahma's day, all manifest existence arises from the unmanifest. At the coming of Brahma's night, it all dissolves back into that very unmanifest.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Brahma ke din ke aagamana par — avyakta se yeh poora vyakta jagat utpanna hota hai. Aur Brahma ki raat aane par — woh sab usii avyakta mein wapas leen ho jaata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Ek bahut bada cycle — srishti aur pralaya.

Brahma ke din mein — sab kuch zahir hota hai. Dharti, aasmaan, insaan, jaanwar — sab kuch avyakta se nikalta hai. Jaise neend se jaagna — duniya phir se dikhti hai.

Brahma ki raat mein — sab kuch wapas andar chala jaata hai. Wapas avyakta mein. Jaise neend mein sab kuch kho jaata hai.

Aur yeh cycle bahut lambi hai — hazaron saalon ki.

Yeh batata hai — jo dikhta hai woh permanent nahi. Jo nahi dikhta woh hamesha hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo dikhta hai woh aata jaata hai — jo nahi dikhta woh hamesha rehta hai. Dikhne waali duniya ki peeche ki sachcaai dhundho — wahi asli hai.

verses.sanskrit:
भूतग्रामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते ।
रात्र्यागमेऽवशः पार्थ प्रभवत्यहरागमे ॥
verses.transliteration:
Bhuta Gramah Sa Eva Ayam Bhutva Bhutva Praliyate,
Ratry Agame Avashah Partha Prabhavaty Ahara Game.
verses.englishMeaning: This very same multitude of beings, having arisen again and again, dissolves helplessly at the coming of night — O Partha — and arises again at the coming of day.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Partha! Yahi woh sab jeev hain — jo baar baar janmte hain aur baar baar nasha paate hain. Raat aane par helplessly lein ho jaate hain — aur din aane par phir wapas zahir hote hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Pichle shlok mein srishti-pralaya ka cycle bataya. Ab Krishna ek aur gehri baat kehte hain.

Woh sab jeev jo baar baar aate hain — wahi hain. Wohi log, wohi patterns, wohi khwaahishein, wohi galtiyaan — baar baar.

Aur 'avasha' — helplessly. Unhe khud pata nahi kyon aate hain, kyon jaate hain.

Yeh isliye bataya — ki jo is cycle se bahar nikalna chahta hai, woh sirf ek kaam kare — Ishwar ke paas jao.

Warna yeh cycle chalti rehti hai — baar baar, bina reason ke.
verses.lifeLesson: Baar baar wahi galti karna, wahi patterns mein jeena — yeh helplessly hota hai. Lekin jo jaag gaya — jo samajh gaya — woh is cycle se bahar aa sakta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
परस्तस्मात्तु भावोऽन्योऽव्यक्तोऽव्यक्तात्सनातनः ।
यः स सर्वेषु भूतेषु नश्यत्सु न विनश्यति ॥
verses.transliteration:
Paras Tasmat Tu Bhavo Anyo Avyakto Avyaktat Sanatanh,
Yah Sa Sarveshu Bhuteshu Nashyatsu Na Vinashyati.
verses.englishMeaning: But beyond that unmanifest, there is another eternal and unmanifest existence — which does not perish even when all beings perish.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Lekin us avyakta se bhi pare ek aur avyakta sanaatan tattva hai — jo sab jeevon ke naash hone par bhi nashta nahi hota.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Jab sab kuch khatam hota hai — Brahma ki raat mein — tab ek cheez nahi khatam hoti.

Woh hai woh Param Tattva — jo avyakta se bhi pare hai. Woh jo srishti se pehle tha, pralaya ke baad bhi hai.

Yeh woh sachcaai hai jo time ke bahar hai. Jab time bhi nahi tha — woh tha. Jab time nahi rahega — woh hoga.

Aur Krishna keh rahe hain — woh main hoon. Main woh hoon jo kabhi nahi kaaTta.

Yeh jaanke ek gehri shanti aati hai — ki jo sachcha hai, woh hamesha hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo sach mein hai woh kabhi khatam nahi hota. Andar ki sachcaai — jo tum sachchi mein ho — woh bhi kabhi nahi kaaTti. Sirf roop badalta hai, sachcaai nahi.

verses.sanskrit:
अव्यक्तोऽक्षर इत्युक्तस्तमाहुः परमां गतिम् ।
यं प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम ॥
verses.transliteration:
Avyakto Akshara Iti Uktas Tam Ahuh Paramam Gatim,
Yam Prapya Na Nivartante Tad Dhama Paramam Mama.
verses.englishMeaning: That unmanifest is called the Imperishable Akshara — it is spoken of as the highest and ultimate destination. Those who attain it do not return. That is my supreme and eternal abode.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo avyakta hai, akshar hai — use parama gati kehte hain. Jise paane ke baad koi wapas nahi aata — wahi mera param dhaama hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Pichle shlok mein bataya — ek avyakta sachcaai hai jo kabhi nahi kaaTti.

Ab Krishna keh rahe hain — yahi mera ghar hai. Yahi Akshara Brahman hai. Yahi parama gati hai.

Aur jo wahan pahunch jaata hai — woh wapas nahi aata. Kyunki wapas kya aayega? Woh toh mil gaya jo tha hi hamesha.

Jaise ek darya ka paani samundar mein mil jaaye — woh wapas darya nahi banta. Woh samundar ho jaata hai.

Usi tarah — jo Ishwar mein sama gaya — woh wapas alag nahi hota.
verses.lifeLesson: Asli ghar woh nahi jo in aankhon se dikhta hai. Asli ghar woh hai jahan se aaye hain aur jahan wapas jaana hai. Woh andar hai — woh Ishwar hai.

verses.sanskrit:
पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया ।
यस्यान्तःस्थानि भूतानि येन सर्वमिदं ततम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Purushah Sa Parah Partha Bhaktya Labhyas Tv Ananyaya,
Yasya Antah Sthani Bhutani Yena Sarvam Idam Tatam.
verses.englishMeaning: That Supreme Purusha, O Partha — within whom all beings exist, and by whom all of this is pervaded — is attainable only through undivided and exclusive devotion.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Partha! Woh Param Purusha — jisme sab jeev samaaye hain aur jisse yeh poori srishti bhari hui hai — woh sirf ananya bhakti se hi paaya ja sakta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Itna bada Ishwar — jo sab mein hai, sab mein basa hua hai — use kaise paayein?

Krishna ka jawab ek hi hai — ananya bhakti. Ananya yaani 'koi doosra nahi.' Sirf woh — aur koi nahi.

Na kisi aur se, na kisi aur cheez se — sirf us ek se prem.

Yeh simplest aur deepest raasta hai.

Koi technique nahi, koi ritual nahi — sirf sachcha, ananya prem. Aur woh itna bada Param Purusha — sirf is prem se milta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Ishwar ko paane ke liye sabse bari talwar nahi chahiye, sabse zyaada gyaan nahi chahiye — sirf sachcha, ananya prem chahiye. Woh toh prem ka hi roop hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यत्र काले त्वनावृत्तिमावृत्तिं चैव योगिनः ।
प्रयाता यान्ति तं कालं वक्ष्यामि भरतर्षभ ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yatra Kale Tv Anavritim Avritim Ca Eva Yoginah,
Prayata Yanti Tam Kalam Vakshyami Bharatarshabha.
verses.englishMeaning: O best of the Bharatas — I shall now tell you of the time and path by departing at which the yogis attain non-return, and also the path that leads to return.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Jis raaste se jaane par yogi wapas nahi aate — aur jis raaste se jaane par wapas aana hota hai — woh main tujhe bataata hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna ab ek aur dimension mein jaate hain — mrityu ke baad kya hota hai.

Do raaste hain — ek jahan se wapas nahi aate, ek jahan se wapas aana hota hai.

Yeh sirf ek story nahi — yeh ek teaching hai ki kaise jeeyein.

Jis taraf jaana ho — usi taraf ki zindagi jeeo. Agar hamesha wala chahiye — toh hamesha wale ki taraf chalo.

Agle teen shlok in dono raston ka detail batayenge.
verses.lifeLesson: Maut ke baad kya hoga — yeh sirf curiosity nahi, yeh zindagi ka guide hai. Jo manzil pakad li — wahi ki taraf chalo.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्निर्ज्योतिरहः शुक्लः षण्मासा उत्तरायणम् ।
तत्र प्रयाता गच्छन्ति ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदो जनाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Agnir Jyotir Ahah Shuklah Shanmasah Uttarayanam,
Tatra Prayata Gacchanti Brahma Brahma Vido Janah.
verses.englishMeaning: Fire, light, day, the bright fortnight, the six months of the northern course of the sun — those Brahman-knowing seekers who depart by this path go to Brahman and are not reborn.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aag, roshni, din, shukla paksha, uttarayan ke chhe maheene — jo Brahman ko jaanne wale saadhhak is raaste se jaate hain, woh Brahman ko paate hain aur wapas nahi aate.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok cosmic symbolism use karta hai — jo yahan cheezein hain woh actually consciousness ki states hain.

Aag, roshni, din, shukla paksha, uttarayan — yeh sab prakaash ke symbols hain. Gyaan ka, chetna ka, jaagnepan ka.

Jo insaan apni poori zindagi prakaash ki taraf raha — gyaan ki taraf, sachcaai ki taraf — woh mrityu ke baad bhi prakaash ki raah se jaata hai. Aur Brahman ko paata hai.

Yeh ek deep truth hai — maut ke baad woh hi milta hai jis taraf poori zindagi rahi.
verses.lifeLesson: Poori zindagi jo direction choose karte ho — wahi maut ke baad bhi direction hoti hai. Prakaash ki taraf raho — gyaan ki taraf, sachcaai ki taraf.

verses.sanskrit:
धूमो रात्रिस्तथा कृष्णः षण्मासा दक्षिणायनम् ।
तत्र चान्द्रमसं ज्योतिर्योगी प्राप्य निवर्तते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Dhumo Ratris Tatha Krishnah Shanmasah Dakshinayanam,
Tatra Candramasam Jyotir Yogi Prapya Nivartate.
verses.englishMeaning: Smoke, night, the dark fortnight, the six months of the southern course of the sun — the yogi departing by this path reaches the lunar world and then returns.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Dhuaan, raat, krishna paksha, dakshinayan ke chhe maheene — is raaste se jaane waala yogi chandrama ki roshni tak pahunchta hai — aur phir wapas aa jaata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh dusra raasta hai — dhundla, andhera.

Dhuaan, raat, krishna paksha, dakshinayan — yeh sab andheron ke, uncertainty ke symbols hain.

Jo insaan poori zindagi sirf duniya ki cheezein sochta raha — paisa, naamdaami, bhaog — woh mrityu ke baad chandralok tak jaata hai. Wahaan kuch sukh milta hai. Lekin fir wapas aana hota hai.

Kyunki jo kama tha — woh khatam hua. Ab phir se.

Yeh dono raaste dikhate hain — zindagi ki direction hi maut ki direction decide karti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo sirf duniya ki cheezein paane mein lagta hai — woh temporary hi pata hai. Jo sachchi sachcaai ki taraf chalthe hain — woh hamesha waala paate hain.

verses.sanskrit:
शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते ।
एकया यात्यनावृत्तिमन्ययावर्तते पुनः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Shukla Krishne Gati Hy Ete Jagatah Shaashvate Mate,
Ekaya Yaty Anavritim Anyaya Avartate Punah.
verses.englishMeaning: These two paths — the bright and the dark — are considered the eternal paths of this world. By one path, one does not return; by the other, one returns again.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yeh do raaste — ujjwal aur andhera — is duniya ke sanaatan raaste maane gaye hain. Ek se jaana — wapas nahi aana. Doosre se jaana — phir aana.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna dono rastes ka summary dete hain.

Do raaste — hamesha se hain, hamesha rahenge. Koi teesra nahi.

Ek — prakaash ka. Jahan se wapasi nahi. Brahman ki taraf.

Doosra — andheron ka. Jahan se wapas aana hota hai — phir aana, phir jaana.

Aur in dono mein se choice — poori zindagi ki direction decide karti hai.

Krishna sirf information nahi de rahe — woh hamen choose karne ke liye inspire kar rahe hain. Kaunsa raasta chahiye — woh ab clear hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Zindagi mein do raaste hamesha the — duniya ka aur Ishwar ka. Dono open hain. Tum kaunsa choose karte ho — woh tumhari zindagi ka sabse bada faisla hai.

verses.sanskrit:
नैते सृती पार्थ जानन्योगी मुह्यति कश्चन ।
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु योगयुक्तो भवार्जुन ॥
verses.transliteration:
Na Ete Sriti Partha Janan Yogi Muhyati Kashcana,
Tasmat Sarvesu Kaleshu Yoga Yukto Bhava Arjuna.
verses.englishMeaning: O Partha — knowing these two paths, no yogi is ever deluded or confused. Therefore, O Arjun, at all times be established in yoga.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Partha! In dono raston ko jaanne wala koi bhi yogi moha mein nahi pdata. Isliye hey Arjun — har waqt yogayukta raho.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Jab raaste pata hon — toh confusion nahi hota.

Krishna keh rahe hain — jo in dono raston ko sachchi tarah jaanta hai — jo samajhta hai ki prakaash ka raasta Brahman tak le jaata hai aur andheron ka raasta wapas laata hai — woh kabhi moha mein nahi pdata.

Aur phir woh Arjun ko seedha kehte hain — isliye yogayukta raho. Har waqt.

Yeh chapter 8 ka message hai — zindagi mein har pal yoga mein raho — yaad mein raho — aur phir koi raasta galat nahi hota.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab raasta pata hota hai — tab confusion nahi hota. Apni direction clear karo — phir har mushkil mein bhi raasta dikhta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
वेदेषु यज्ञेषु तपःसु चैव
दानेषु यत्पुण्यफलं प्रदिष्टम् ।
अत्येति तत्सर्वमिदं विदित्वा
योगी परं स्थानमुपैति चाद्यम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Vedeshu Yajneshu Tapah Su Ca Eva Daneshu Yat Punya Phalam Pradish Tam,
Atyeti Tat Sarvam Idam Viditva Yogi Param Sthanam Upaiti Ca Adyam.
verses.englishMeaning: The yogi who knows all this transcends all the meritorious fruits proclaimed for the study of the Vedas, for sacrifices, for austerities and for charity — and attains the supreme, primordial and eternal state.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yogi jo yeh sab jaanta hai — woh Vedaon ke padhne, yajnon ke karne, tapasya karne aur daan dene ke jo punya fal bataye gaye hain — woh sab se aage nikal jaata hai — aur uss Param, Aadya, Sanaatan jagah ko paata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Chapter 8 ka aakhiri aur sabse sameti hua shlok hai.

Krishna keh rahe hain — jo yogi in dono raston ko jaanta hai, jo Akshara Brahman ko jaanta hai, jo antim waqt mein Ishwar ko yaad karta hai — woh sirf yajnon aur tapasya ke fal se aage nikal jaata hai.

Woh poori duniya ki sab se badi uplabdhi se bhi bada haasil karta hai — Parama Sthaanam — woh jagah jo aadya hai, sanaatan hai, hamesha se hai.

Yeh chapter ka nicharod hai — sirf jaano, sirf yaad rakhho, sirf prem karo — aur sab kuch mil jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Poori zindagi ka sabse bada kaam yeh nahi ki kitna kiya — balki yeh hai ki kis taraf chale. Jo sachchi taraf chale — woh sab se ooncha paate hain. Direction hi destiny hai.

summary: The ninth chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Raja Vidya Yoga. In this chapter, Krishna explains that He is Supreme and how this material existence is created, maintained and destroyed by His Yogmaya and all beings come and go under his supervision. He reveals the Role and the Importance of Bhakti (transcendental devotional service) towards our Spiritual Awakening. In such devotion, one must live for the God, offer everything that he possesses to Him and do everything for Him only. One who follows such devotion becomes free from the bonds of this material world and unites with the Lord.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
इदं तु ते गुह्यतमं प्रवक्ष्याम्यनसूयवे ।
ज्ञानं विज्ञानसहितं यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Shri Bhagavan Uvacha:
Idam Tu Te Guhyatamam Pravakshyamy Anasooyave,
Jnanam Vijnana Sahitam Yaj Jnatva Mokshyase Ashubhat.
verses.englishMeaning: Shri Krishna said: To you who are free from fault-finding and malice, I shall now impart this most confidential wisdom along with direct realization — knowing which you shall be completely freed from all the miseries of material existence.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Shri Krishna ne kaha:

Kyunki tumhare dil mein mere prati koi dosh-drishti ya jalan nahi hai, isliye main tumhe yeh sabse gupt gyaan — anubhav aur vigyaan ke saath bataunga — jise jaankar tum sansaar ke saare ashubh bandhanon se mukt ho jaoge.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Chapter 9 Gita ka sabse pavitra aur gehra adhyay maana jaata hai — ise Raja Vidya kaha gaya hai.

Krishna yahan ek bahut badi baat se shuruaat karte hain: "Main yeh gyaan tumhe isliye de raha hoon kyunki tum anasooya ho" — yaani tumhare andar nafrat, jalan ya kisi mein kamiya nikaalne ki aadat nahi hai.

Jab tak dil mein ahankar ya jalan hoti hai, tab tak gehra gyaan andar nahi utarta. Lekin jab mann nirmal ho, tabhi sachcha gyaan samajh aata hai.

Krishna sirf theoretical gyaan nahi, balki "vigyaan" — yaani seedha anubhav dene ka wada karte hain, jisse insaan har dukh aur bandhan se chhoot sake.
verses.lifeLesson: Gehra gyaan paane ki pehli shart dimagi taaqat nahi, balki nirmal dil hai. Jo doosron mein kamiyaan dhundhta hai uska gyaan ruk jaata hai, aur jo nishkapat dil se seekhta hai woh mukt ho jaata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
राजविद्या राजगुह्यं पवित्रमिदमुत्तमम् ।
प्रत्यक्षावगमं धर्म्यं सुसुखं कर्तुमव्ययम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Raja Vidya Raja Guhyam Pavitram Idam Uttamam,
Pratyaksha Avagamam Dharmyam Susukham Kartum Avyayam.
verses.englishMeaning: This is the king of all knowledge, the king of all secrets, the supreme purifier. It is directly realizable by personal experience, virtuous, very easy and joyful to practice, and everlasting.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yeh saari vidyaon ka raja hai, sabhi rahasyon ka raja hai, param pavitra aur sarvashreshtha hai. Iska anubhav seedhe aatma se kiya ja sakta hai, yeh dharma ke anukool hai, iska aacharan karna atyant sukhad hai aur yeh kabhi nasht nahi hota.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna is gyaan ki chhah anokhi khoobiyan batate hain:
1. Raja Vidya — yeh saari vidyaon mein sabse shreshtha hai.
2. Raja Guhyam — yeh sabse bada aur rahasyamayi sach hai.
3. Pavitram Uttamam — yeh mann aur aatma ko poori tarah shuddh kar deta hai.
4. Pratyaksha Avagamam — yeh koi andhavishwas nahi, balki aisi sachchaai hai jise insaan apne andar seedhe mehsoos kar sakta hai.
5. Susukham Kartum — is bhakti aur prem ke raaste par chalna dukh bhara nahi, balki param anandmayi hai.
6. Avyayam — iska fal kabhi khatam nahi hota, yeh sada rehne wala hai.

Sansaar ki vidya insaan ko roti kamana sikhati hai, par yeh Raja Vidya insaan ko jeena aur mukt hona sikhati hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sachcha aadhyaatma koi bojh ya kathin tapashcharya nahi hai, balki anand se bhara safar hai. Jo cheez dil ko pavitra kare aur sahaj anand de, wahi sachcha dharma hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा धर्मस्यास्य परन्तप ।
अप्राप्य मां निवर्तन्ते मृत्युसंसारवर्त्मनि ॥
verses.transliteration:
Ashraddadhanah Purusha Dharmasyasya Parantapa,
Aprapya Mam Nivartante Mrityu Samsara Vartmani.
verses.englishMeaning: O scorcher of enemies, those people who have no faith in this sacred dharma do not attain me; they remain trapped and return again and again to the path of death and rebirth in this mortal world.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Parantapa Arjun! Jo log is divya dharma par shraddha aur vishwas nahi rakhte, woh mujhe praapt nahi kar paate, aur janma-mrityu ke is dukh bhare sansaar-chakra mein baar-baar bhatakate rehte hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shraddha ka matlab andhabhakti nahi, balki andar ka sachcha vishwas hai.

Krishna kehte hain ki bina vishwas ke insaan kisi bhi gehre sach tak nahi pahunch sakta. Agar koi beej ko zameen mein daale aur har ghante mitti khodkar dekhe ki paudha uga ya nahi, toh woh beej kabhi ped nahi banega.

Thik waise hi, jinke andar shraddha nahi hoti, unka dhyan hamesha bhatakta rehta hai. Woh kabhi sthirta aur shanti nahi paate, aur sansaar ke naye naye chakkar mein uljhe rehte hain.

Vishwas hi woh pul hai jo insaan ko darr se nikaalkar param shanti tak le jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Zindagi mein badi uplabdhiyon aur aatmik shanti ke liye shraddha sabse pehla kadam hai. Sandeh se sirf bhatkan milti hai, jabki sachcha vishwas manzil tak pahunchata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
मया ततमिदं सर्वं जगदव्यक्तमूर्तिना ।
मत्स्थानि सर्वभूतानि न चाहं तेष्ववस्थितः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Maya Tatam Idam Sarvam Jagad Avyakta Murtina,
Mat Sthani Sarva Bhutani Na Caham Teshv Avasthitah.
verses.englishMeaning: By me, in my unmanifest form, this entire universe is pervaded. All beings exist within me, yet I do not dwell contained within them.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Mere niraakaar aur avyakta roop se yeh poora brahmand samaya hua hai. Saare praani mujh mein sthit hain, parantu main unke bheetar samet kar bandha hua nahi hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok Ishwar aur sansaar ke sambandh ko samajhne ki sabse badi chaabi hai.

Jaise samundar ke bheetar lakhon machhliyan, paudhe aur lahrein hoti hain — sab kuch paani ke andar hai, par paani kisi ek machhli mein simat kar nahi reh jaata.

Waise hi Krishna keh rahe hain: "Yeh poori srishti mere andar phaili hui hai, par main is srishti ki seemaon se kahin bada hoon. Main kisi cheez ka mohtaaj nahi hoon."

Ishwar har jagah maujood hain, par unhe kisi ek aakar ya cheez mein baandhkar nahi dekha ja sakta.
verses.lifeLesson: Ishwar se door kahin koi jagah nahi hai, har kan mein unhi ki upasthiti hai. Par jaise suraj apni dhoop se alag rehta hai, waise hi aatma ko bhi sansaar mein rehte hue asakt aur swatantra rehna chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम् ।
भूतभृन्न च भूतस्थो ममात्मा भूतभावनः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Na Ca Mat Sthani Bhutani Pashya Me Yogam Aishvaram,
Bhuta Bhrij Na Ca Bhutastho Mamatma Bhuta Bhavanah.
verses.englishMeaning: And yet, all created beings do not dwell physically attached in me — behold my divine sovereign mystery! Although I am the sustainer and creator of all beings, my supreme Self does not remain entangled in them.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aur vastutah saare praani mujh mein chipke hue sthit nahi hain — meri is divya aishvarya shakti ko dekho! Meri aatma sabhi praaniyon ka palan-poshan karne wali aur unhe utpanna karne wali hote hue bhi, unmein aasakto hokar nahi rehti.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Pichhle shlok mein Krishna ne kaha tha ki sab mujhme hain, aur ab kehte hain ki "Dekho meri divya leela — woh mujh par koi bojh nahi bante."

Ise samajhne ke liye aakaash ka udaharan lijiye. Aakaash mein baadal aate hain, bijli kadakti hai, dhool udti hai — par kya aakaash geela hota hai ya maila hota hai? Kabhi nahi! Aakaash sabko jagah deta hai par kisi mein lipatta nahi.

Krishna yahi keh rahe hain: "Main poori srishti ko rachata hoon aur paalta hoon, par uske sukh-dukh ya badlav mujh par asar nahi daalte."

Yeh Ishwar ka adbhut yog hai — poori tarah jod kar bhi poori tarah azaad rehna.
verses.lifeLesson: Apno ki dekhbhaal karo, sabka sahara bano aur apna har farz nibhao — par andar se aakaash ki tarah nirmal aur nirlip rehna seekho. Sachcha prem bina kisi moh ke sahara deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यथाकाशस्थितो नित्यं वायुः सर्वत्रगो महान् ।
तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि मत्स्थानीत्युपधारय ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yatha Akasha Sthito Nityam Vayuh Sarvatra Go Mahan,
Tatha Sarvani Bhutani Mat Sthanity Upadharaya.
verses.englishMeaning: Just as the mighty wind blowing everywhere always abides in vast open space, know that in the very same manner, all created beings abide eternally within me.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jaise har taraf chalne wali vishaal aur shaktishaali hawa hamesha aakaash mein hi sthit rehti hai, waise hi saare praani mujh mein sthit hain — aisa tum samjho.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna pichhle shlok ki baat ko ek aasan aur khoobsurat udaharan se samjhaate hain — hawa aur aakaash ka sambandh.

Hawa kitni bhi tez chale, toofan laye, par woh hamesha aakaash ke bheetar hi rehti hai. Aakaash ko hawa se koi fark nahi padta — aakaash sthir rehta hai, khula rehta hai, nirdosh rehta hai.

Isi tarah, sansaar ke saare praani, unke dukh, sukh, karam aur parinaam sab Ishwar ki chetna ke andar hi chalte hain. Ishwar unhe sthaan dete hain, jeevan dete hain, par khud unke chakkar mein bandhte nahi hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Jaise aakaash hawa ko sambhalta hai bina uske asar mein aaye, waise hi insaan ko sansaar ki uthal-puthal ke beech apne mann ko shant aur nishchal rakhna chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वभूतानि कौन्तेय प्रकृतिं यान्ति मामिकाम् ।
कल्पक्षये पुनस्तानि कल्पादौ विसृजाम्यहम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sarva Bhutani Kaunteya Prakritim Yanti Mamikam,
Kalpa Kshaye Punas Tani Kalpadau Visrijamy Aham.
verses.englishMeaning: O Kaunteya, at the end of a cosmic cycle (kalpa), all created beings merge back into my primordial nature. And at the beginning of the next cycle, I manifest and project them forth once again.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Kaunteya Arjun! Kalpa ke ant mein saare praani meri prakriti mein leen ho jaate hain. Aur kalpa ke shuruwaat mein main unhe fir se rachta hoon aur prakat karta hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yahan srishti aur pralaya ka gehra rahasya bataya gaya hai.

Srishti ka aana aur jaana koi achanak ghatne wali ghatna nahi hai, balki ek shashwat chakra hai. Jaise beej se ped banta hai aur ped fir beej mein simat jaata hai, waise hi poora brahmand ek nishchit samay ke baad prakriti mein vileen ho jaata hai aur samay aane par fir se prakat hota hai.

Krishna keh rahe hain ki yeh sara kram mere adheen chalta hai. Maut kisi cheez ka ant nahi hai, balki agle navjeevan ki taiyaari hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jeevan mein koi bhi ant aakhiri nahi hota; har anth ek nayi shuruaat ka beej hota hai. Badlav se darna chhodkar srishti ke is shashwat niyam ko swikar karo.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रकृतिं स्वामवष्टभ्य विसृजामि पुनः पुनः ।
भूतग्राममिमं कृत्स्नमवशं प्रकृतेर्वशात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Prakritim Svam Avashtabhya Visrijami Punah Punah,
Bhuta Gramam Imam Kritsnam Avasham Prakriter Vashat.
verses.englishMeaning: Taking hold of my own material nature, I project forth again and again this entire multitude of beings, who are helpless under the binding sway of their own nature and past karma.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main apni prakriti ko niyamit karke, apne-apne swabhav aur karmon ke vash mein pade hue is asahay praaniyon ke samuh ko baar-baar rachta hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Praani "avasham" kyun hain — yaani bebas kyun hain?

Kyunki unke purane karm, unki aadat aur sanskaar unhe naye janma mein kheench laate hain. Jaise jab barish aati hai toh zameen mein chhupe hue purane beej apne aap phoot padte hain, waise hi praani apne purane karmon ke phal bhogne ke liye dobara janma lete hain.

Krishna prakriti ko shakti dete hain, par jeev apne hi karmon ke dharatal par banta aur chalta hai. Ishwar kisi par jabardasti kismat nahi thopte — praani khud apni niyati banta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Hum jo aaj sochte aur karte hain, wahi kal humari niyati banti hai. Apne swabhav aur aadat ko samjho, kyunki bina aatam-sudhar ke insaan apne hi karmon ka gulam bana rehta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय ।
उदासीनवदासीनमसक्तं तेषु कर्मसु ॥
verses.transliteration:
Na Ca Mam Tani Karmani Nibadhnanti Dhananjaya,
Udasinavad Asinam Asaktam Teshu Karmasu.
verses.englishMeaning: And yet, O Dhananjaya, these cosmic actions do not bind me at all; remaining seated like one unconcerned and detached, I am completely free from any attachment to these works.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Dhananjaya! Srishti ki rachna aur pralaya ke yeh karam mujhe baandhte nahi hain, kyunki main in sabhi karmon mein bilkul nirlip aur udaaseen ki tarah asakt baitha rehta hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok batata hai ki bina bandhe kaam kaise kiya jaata hai.

Krishna itna vishaal brahmand chalate hain, kharbon praniyon ko jeevan dete hain, fir bhi unhe koi bojh ya tanav nahi hota. Kyun? Kyunki unke andar koi swarth, koi fal ki ichha ya ahankar nahi hai.

"Udasinavat" ka matlab laaparwaah hona nahi hai, balki nishkaam hona hai — jaise suraj sabko roshni deta hai par kisi se badle mein shukriya ya daam nahi maangta. Suraj bina aasakto hue apna kaam karta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Kaam insaan ko nahi baandhta, kaam ke peeche ka ahankar aur fal ki chinta insaan ko baandhti hai. Poori lagan se farz nibhao, par nateeje par pakad chhod do — tabhi sachchi azaadi milti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
मयाध्यक्षेण प्रकृतिः सूयते सचराचरम् ।
हेतुनानेन कौन्तेय जगद्विपरिवर्तते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Mayadhyakshena Prakritih Sooyate Sacaracaram,
Hetunanena Kaunteya Jagad Viparivartate.
verses.englishMeaning: Under my supreme supervision and presence, material nature generates the entire cosmos of the moving and non-moving beings. By this very reason, O Kaunteya, the cosmic wheel keeps continually revolving.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Meri adhyakshata aur upasthiti mein hi prakriti samast char aur achar jeevon ki srishti karti hai; aur isi kaaran, hey Kaunteya, yeh sansaar-chakra nirantar ghoomta rehta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yahan Krishna ne "Adhyakshena" shabd ka istemal kiya hai — yaani supreme observer, adhyaksh.

Jaise ek factory mein bijli ki upasthiti se saari machinein apne aap chalne lagti hain. Bijli khud jakar pahiya nahi ghumati, par uski shakti ke bina kuch nahi chal sakta.

Thik waise hi, Ishwar ki divya chetna aur upasthiti ke sahare hi prakriti (nature) apna kaam karti hai — ped ugate hain, nadiyan behti hain, ritu badalti hain aur jeevan chalta hai. Ishwar ke bina prakriti bejaan hai, aur prakriti ke bina srishti roop nahi le sakti.
verses.lifeLesson: Jeevan ki har vyavastha ke peeche ek adrishya divya shakti kaam kar rahi hai. Is sach ko jaankar vinamra bano aur prakriti ke har niyam ka aadar karo.

verses.sanskrit:
अवजानन्ति मां मूढा मानुषीं तनुमाश्रितम् ।
परं भावमजानन्तो मम भूतमहेश्वरम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Avajananti Mam Mudha Manushim Tanum Ashritam,
Param Bhavam Ajananto Mama Bhuta Maheshvaram.
verses.englishMeaning: The foolish and undiscerning disrespect and despise me when I descend in human form, being unaware of my supreme, transcendental nature as the ultimate Lord of all existence.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Agyani aur moorkh log manushya shareer dharan kiye hue mera anaadar karte hain, kyunki woh samast praniyon ke param Ishwar ke roop mein mere sarvochha bhav ko nahi jaante.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Jab Krishna insaan ke roop mein Arjun ke saarthi bante hain, toh bahut se log unhe sirf ek sadharan insaan samajhkar unka apmaan karte hain ya unhe pehchaan nahi paate.

Insaan ki aadat hoti hai ki woh bahari roop, kapde aur status dekhkar faisla karta hai. Agyani insaan yeh nahi dekh paata ki is sadharan sharir ke bheetar param aatma aur anant chetna virajmaan hai.

Krishna keh rahe hain ki jo log sirf bahari chamak-damak dekhte hain, woh aadhyaatmik sachchaai ko kabhi nahi samajh paate.
verses.lifeLesson: Kisi ko bhi uske bahari roop, sadharan aacharan ya status se mat aanko. Sachchi mahanata aksar sadharanta ke parde ke peeche chhupi hoti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
मोघाशा मोघकर्माणो मोघज्ञाना विचेतसः ।
राक्षसीमासुरीं चैव प्रकृतिं मोहिनीं श्रिताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Moghasha Mogha Karmano Mogha Jnana Vicetasah,
Rakshasim Asurim Caiva Prakritim Mohinim Shritah.
verses.englishMeaning: Harboring vain hopes, performing futile actions, and clinging to delusive knowledge without discernment, they fall under the bewitching sway of demonic and monstrous traits of delusion.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aise vivekheen log vyarth ki aashayein, nishfal karm aur bhatkane wala gyaan rakhte hain; woh asuron aur daityon ke mohit karne wale ahankari swabhav ko apnate hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Jab insaan Ishwar aur aatma ki sachchaai se mooh mod leta hai, toh uska kya haal hota hai?

1. "Moghasha" — uski saari ummeedein bekaar saabit hoti hain, kyunki woh aisi cheezon se sukh chaahta hai jo kshanbhangur hain.
2. "Mogha Karmano" — uske saare kaam vyarth chale jaate hain, kyunki unme koi nishkaam bhav ya paropkar nahi hota.
3. "Mogha Jnana" — uski sari padhai-likhai bekaar ho jaati hai, kyunki woh uske ahankar ko badhati hai, shanti nahi deti.

Aise log asuri swabhav — yaani swarth, ghamand aur hinsa ke jaal mein phans jaate hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Bina aatmik aadhar ke na ummeedein poori hoti hain, na mehnat fal deti hai. Ahankar aur swarth insaan ki saari samajh ko bekaar kar dete hain.

verses.sanskrit:
महात्मानस्तु मां पार्थ दैवीं प्रकृतिमाश्रिताः ।
भजन्त्यनन्यमनसो ज्ञात्वा भूतादिमव्ययम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Mahatmanas Tu Mam Partha Daivim Prakritim Ashritah,
Bhajanty Ananya Manaso Jnatva Bhutadim Avyayam.
verses.englishMeaning: On the other hand, O Partha, the great souls take shelter in my divine spiritual nature; knowing me to be the eternal, imperishable source of all beings, they worship me with single-minded devotion.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Parantu hey Partha! Jo mahan aatmaayein hain, woh divya prakriti ka aashray lekar, mujhe samast jeevon ka avinashi aadi-kaaran jaankar, ekagra mann se meri bhakti karti hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Pichhle shlok ke agyani logon ke viparit, Krishna ab "Mahatma" yaani vishal hriday wale logon ki baat karte hain.

Mahatma kaun hai? Jo daivi prakriti ka aashray leta hai — jiske andar prem, daya, sachchaai aur vinamrata hoti hai. Aise log jaante hain ki sansaar ki har cheez aane-jaane wali hai, par Ishwar hamesha rehne wale hain.

Isliye unka mann kisi aur cheez mein nahi bhatakta, woh ekagrachitta hokar param sachchaai se jud jaate hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Mahanata bahari uplabdhiyon se nahi, andar ki nirmal drishti se aati hai. Jab dil mein prem aur satya bas jaata hai, tab insaan ko har jagah Ishwar hi dikhta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सततं कीर्तयन्तो मां यतन्तश्च दृढव्रताः ।
नमस्यन्तश्च मां भक्त्या नित्ययुक्ता उपासते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Satatam Kirtayanto Mam Yatantash Ca Dridha Vratah,
Namasyantash Ca Mam Bhaktya Nitya Yukta Upasate.
verses.englishMeaning: Constantly chanting my divine glories, striving with firm resolve, and bowing down to me with deep reverence, they worship me ever united in loving devotion.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Woh nirantar meri kirti ka gungaan karte hue, dridh sankalp ke saath prayatna karte hue, aur prem-bhakti se mujhe pranaam karte hue sada mujhse judkar meri upasana karte hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok sachche bhakta ki daily routine aur aantarik sthiti batata hai:
1. "Satatam Kirtayanto" — unke dil aur zuban par hamesha Ishwar ka naam aur shukrana rehta hai.
2. "Yatantash Ca Dridha Vratah" — woh sirf baatein nahi banate, balki nek raaste par chalne ke liye poori mehnat aur dridh sankalp karte hain.
3. "Namasyantash Ca" — unke andar koi ahankar nahi hota, woh vinamra hokar pranaam karte hain.
4. "Nitya Yuktah" — unka connection part-time nahi, balki 24 ghante ka hota hai.

Bhakti aalas ka naam nahi hai, balki dridh nishchay aur lagatar prayas ka naam hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Rozana ka niyam, dridh sankalp aur vinamrata — yeh teen gun insaan ko har kshetra mein shikhar par le jaate hain. Shradha tabhi rang laati hai jab uske peeche nishtha aur prayas ho.

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्यन्ये यजन्तो मामुपासते ।
एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुधा विश्वतोमुखम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Jnana Yajnena Capy Anye Yajanto Mam Upasate,
Ekatvena Prithaktvena Bahudha Vishvatomukham.
verses.englishMeaning: Others worship me through the sacrifice of wisdom (Jnana Yajna) — contemplating me as the non-dual One, or as distinct and manifest in countless forms with faces in all directions.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Doosre saadhak gyaan-yajna ke dwara meri upasana karte hain — kuch mujhe advaita yaani ek roop mein dekhte hain, kuch alag-alag roopon mein, aur kuch vishwaroop ke anant roopon mein poojate hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna ki udaarta dekhiye — woh kisi ek raste ko sab par nahi thopte!

Har insaan ka swabhav alag hota hai, isliye Ishwar tak pahunchne ke raste bhi anant hain:
1. "Ekatvena" — kuch gyaani samajhte hain ki aatma aur paramatma ek hi hain (Advaita).
2. "Prithaktvena" — kuch bhakta Ishwar ko apna swami aur khud ko sevak maankar prem karte hain (Dvaita).
3. "Bahudha Vishvatomukham" — kuch log prakriti, suraj, nadiyon aur samast srishti ke har kan mein Ishwar ko dekhkar poojte hain.

Krishna keh rahe hain: "Tum jis bhi sachche raste se aao, tum mujh tak hi pahunchte ho."
verses.lifeLesson: Ishwar tak pahunchne ka koi ek akela rasta nahi hai. Doosron ke vishwas aur raste ka aadar karo; shradha ka dhang chahe jo ho, sachchi niyat se chala har kadam Ishwar tak le jaata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अहं क्रतुरहं यज्ञः स्वधाहमहमौषधम् ।
मन्त्रोऽहमहमेवाज्यमहमग्निरहं हुतम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Aham Kratur Aham Yajnah Svadhaham Aham Aushadham,
Mantro Aham Aham Evajyam Aham Agnir Aham Hutam.
verses.englishMeaning: I am the Vedic ritual, I am the sacrifice, I am the ancestral offering, and I am the healing herb. I am the sacred chant, I am the clarified butter, I am the sacred fire, and I am the offering poured into it.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Vedic anushthan main hoon, yajna main hoon, pitron ka tarpan main hoon, aur aushadhi main hoon. Mantra main hoon, havan ka ghee main hoon, agni main hoon aur aahuti bhi main hi hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok poori pooja aur yajna ka adbhut sach prakat karta hai.

Log sochte hain ki pooja mein sirf agni aur samagri hoti hai. Par Krishna keh rahe hain: "Is poori vidhi mein jo kuch bhi hai, woh sab main hi hoon."
Mantra bolne wala, mantra ke shabd, ghee ki dhaar, jalne wali agni, aur aahuti se nikalne wali sugandh — sab kuch Ishwar ki hi vibhuti hai.

Jab saadhak ko yeh samajh aa jaata hai, toh pooja koi karam-kaand nahi rehti, balki poori chetna ka samparpan ban jaati hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab har kriya, har aahuti aur har prayas mein Ishwar ka anubhav hone lage, toh insaan ka har karm ek pavitra yajna ban jaata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
पिताहमस्य जगतो माता धाता पितामहः ।
वेद्यं पवित्रमोंकार ऋक्साम यजुरेव च ॥
verses.transliteration:
Pita Aham Asya Jagato Mata Dhata Pitamahah,
Vedyam Pavitram Omkara Rik Sama Yajur Eva Ca.
verses.englishMeaning: I am the father of this world, the mother, the sustainer, and the grandsire. I am that which is to be known, the sacred purifier, the holy syllable Om, and the Rig, Sama, and Yajur Vedas.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main hi is sansaar ka pita hoon, mata hoon, dharan-poshan karne wala dhata hoon aur dada (pitamaha) hoon. Main hi janne yogya pavitra tatva, Omkar, tatha Rigveda, Samaveda aur Yajurveda hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Insaan ka sabse karibi rishta uske mata-pita aur parivar se hota hai. Krishna keh rahe hain ki srishti ke har rishte ka mool aadhar main hoon.

Maa ki tarah prem aur mamta dene wale, pita ki tarah suraksha aur margdarshan dene wale, aur srishti ke aadi-purush hone ke naate dada ki tarah sabke mool main hi hoon.

Aur gyaan ki duniya mein jo Omkar sabse pavitra dhwani hai, aur jin Vedon mein sara gyaan samaya hai — woh bhi meri hi abhivyakti hain. Ishwar door baithe koi nyayadhish nahi, balki humara apna sabse gehra parivar hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Ishwar se bada koi sahara aur aatmik sanrakshak nahi hai. Apne har rishte mein aur har shlok mein us param aadhar ko mehsoos karo jo hamesha tumhari dekhbhaal kar raha hai.

verses.sanskrit:
गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत् ।
प्रभवः प्रलयः स्थानं निधानं बीजमव्ययम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Gatir Bharta Prabhuh Sakshi Nivasah Sharanam Suhrit,
Prabhavah Pralayah Sthanam Nidhanam Bijam Avyayam.
verses.englishMeaning: I am the ultimate goal, the sustainer, the master, the silent witness, the true abode, the refuge, and the dearest friend. I am the origin, the dissolution, the foundation, the resting treasure, and the imperishable seed.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main hi param lakshya hoon, palanhaar hoon, swami hoon, sabka sakshi hoon, sachcha niwas hoon, sharanagti hoon aur prem karne wala mitra hoon. Srishti ki utpatti, pralaya, aadhar, vishram-sthal aur avinashi beej bhi main hi hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Bhagavad Gita ke sabse sundar shlokon mein se ek hai, jahan Krishna Ishwar aur aatma ke 12 anmol sambandhon ko batate hain:
1. Gatih — humari aakhiri manzil.
2. Bharta — palan-poshan karne wale.
3. Prabhuh — sabke niyamak swami.
4. Sakshi — humare har pal ke mukhya gawah.
5. Nivasah — humara asli aashray aur ghar.
6. Sharanam — sankat mein sharan dene wale.
7. Suhrit — bina kisi swarth ke bhalai chahne wale sachche mitra.
8. Prabhavah & Pralayah — utpatti aur laya ka kendra.
9. Sthanam & Nidhanam — sthir aadhar aur khazana.
10. Bijam Avyayam — anant beej.

Khas taur par "Suhrit" shabd — Ishwar humare aise dost hain jo bina shart prem karte hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab sansaar mein sab chhoot jaaye, tab bhi ek sathi hamesha saath rehta hai — woh Ishwar hai. Unhe apna sabse karibi dost bana lo, fir kabhi akelapan ya darr nahi sataayega.

verses.sanskrit:
तपाम्यहमहं वर्षं निगृह्णाम्युत्सृजामि च ।
अमृतं चैव मृत्युश्च सदसच्चाहमर्जुन ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tapamy Aham Aham Varsham Nigrihnamy Utsrijami Ca,
Amritam Caiva Mrityush Ca Sad Asac Caham Arjuna.
verses.englishMeaning: I radiate heat as the sun, I withhold and pour forth the rain. I am immortality as well as death, and I am both being (the manifest) and non-being (the unmanifest), O Arjun.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main suraj bankar tapta hoon, main hi varsha ko rokta hoon aur barasta hoon. Hey Arjun! Moksha-roopi amrit aur mrityu dono main hi hoon; sat (jo sthool roop mein hai) aur asat (jo sookshma roop mein hai), sab main hi hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna nature ke saare virodhabhaso (polarities) ko apne andar samet kar dikha rahe hain:
- Dhoop bhi wahi hain, aur baadal ban kar barasne wala paani bhi wahi hain.
- Jeevan ka amrit bhi wahi hain, aur sharir ki mrityu bhi unhi ki leela ka hissa hai.
- Jo dikhta hai (sat) aur jo an-dekha reh jaata hai (asat) — sab kuch unhi ka vistar hai.

Insaan aksar dhoop chaahta hai par garmi se darta hai, jeevan chaahta hai par mrityu se ghabrata hai. Par dono ek hi sikke ke do pehlu hain, aur dono ka aadhar wahi ek param tatva hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jeevan ke dhoop-chhaon aur sukh-dukh dono ko Ishwar ka prasad samajhkar swikar karo. Jo har sthiti mein ek hi shakti ko dekhta hai, woh darr aur nirasha se paar pa jaata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रैविद्या मां सोमपाः पूतपापा
यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा स्वर्गतिं प्रार्थयन्ते ।
ते पुण्यमासाद्य सुरेन्द्रलोक-
मश्नन्ति दिव्यान्दिवि देवभोगान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Traividya Mam Somapah Puta Papa Yajnair Ishtva Svargatim Prarthayante,
Te Punyam Asadya Surendra Lokam Ashnanti Divyan Divi Deva Bhogan.
verses.englishMeaning: Those who know the three Vedas, drinking the soma juice and purified of sins, worship me through sacrifices seeking attainment to heaven. Reaching the holy world of Indra, they enjoy the celestial pleasures of the gods in heaven.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Teenon Vedon ke gyani, nishpaap hokar yajnon ke dwara meri pooja karke swarga paane ki prarthana karte hain. Woh apne punya ke phal-swaroop indralok ko praapt karke swarga ke divya bhogon ka anand lete hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Pichhle shlokon mein aatam-gyaan batane ke baad, Krishna ab sakam-bhakti (desire-driven worship) ki seema samjhaate hain.

Kuch log bahut niyamit dhang se puja-path karte hain, punya kamate hain, aur unka lakshya swarg jana hota hai taaki wahan achhe bhog aur sukh mil sakein.

Krishna kehte hain: "Haan, unhe unke punya ka phal milta hai, woh swarg bhi chale jaate hain aur divya anand bhi bhogte hain." Par yeh aakhiri manzil nahi hai. Agle shlok mein Krishna batayenge ki iske aage kya hota hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Punya karma achhe fal zaroor dete hain, lekin agar lakshya sirf bhautik ya swargik sukh ho, toh aatma ki asli mukti nahi hoti. Sawaal fal ka nahi, humari aashakti ka hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ते तं भुक्त्वा स्वर्गलोकं विशालं
क्षीणे पुण्ये मर्त्यलोकं विशन्ति ।
एवं त्रयीधर्ममनुप्रपन्ना
गतागतं कामकामा लभन्ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Te Tam Bhuktva Svarga Lokam Vishalam Kshine Punye Martya Lokam Vishanti,
Evam Trayi Dharmam Anuprapanna Gatagatam Kama Kamah Labhante.
verses.englishMeaning: Having enjoyed that vast heavenly realm, when their accumulated merit is exhausted, they return once again to this mortal world. Thus, following the ritualistic path of the three Vedas with worldly desires, they only attain coming and going.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Uss vishaal swargalok ke bhogon ko bhogkar, punya ksheen hone par, woh fir se is mrityulok mein laut aate hain. Is prakaar teenon Vedon ke sakam dharmo ka palan karne wale bhog-kaami log aane-jaane (janma-maran) ke chakra mein hi phanse rehte hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok sansaar ki sabse badi sachchaai batata hai — har temporary sukh ka ant hota hai.

Jaise jab tak mobile mein recharge hai, tab tak baat hoti hai, aur balance khatam hote hi call cut jaati hai. Thik waise hi, insaan ne jitne punya kamaye the, utne din woh swarg mein raha, aur jaise hi punya khatam hue — wapas dharti par gir gaya!

Krishna keh rahe hain: "Jo log sirf bhog maangte hain, chahe dharti ka ho ya swarg ka, woh aane-jaane ke is chakkar (gatagatam) se kabhi azaad nahi ho paate." Mukti bhogon se nahi, Ishwar ke nishkaam prem se milti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Koi bhi bhautik sukh ya sthan shashwat nahi hai; punya ka phal bhi ek din khatam hota hai. Asli samajhdari temporary sukhon ke peeche bhaagne mein nahi, balki shashwat mukti paane mein hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते ।
तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Ananyash Cintayanto Mam Ye Janah Paryupasate,
Tesham Nitya Abhiyuktanam Yoga Kshemam Vahamy Aham.
verses.englishMeaning: To those who always remember and worship me with undivided devotion, meditating upon me alone — to those constantly united with me, I personally carry and secure what they lack and preserve what they have.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo bhakta ananya bhav se mera chintan karte hue nishkaam roop se meri upasana karte hain, un sada mujh mein lage hue bhakton ke yogakshem (jo nahi hai use dena aur jo hai uski raksha karna) ka bojh main khud uthata hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Bhagavad Gita ka sabse prasiddh aur vishwas jagane wala shlok hai — Krishna ka "Maha-Wada"!

Do shabdon ko samjhiye:
1. "Yoga" — jo aashray, sadhan ya aavashyakta tumhare paas nahi hai, use Ishwar tum tak pahunchate hain.
2. "Kshemam" — jo tumhare paas pehle se achha hai (shanti, sadguna, suraksha), uski raksha karte hain.
Aur sabse bada shabd hai "Vahamy Aham" — yaani "Main khud sir par dho kar laata hoon!"

Shart bas ek hai — "Ananyash", yaani poora bharosa, bina kisi chal-kapat ke. Jaise ek nanha bachcha apni maa par poora bharosa rakhta hai aur maa uska har dhyan rakhti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab insaan apni chinta aur bharosa poori tarah Ishwar ko saump deta hai, toh Ishwar uski har zaroorat ki zimmedari khud utha lete hain. Chinta chhodkar vishwas karo, rasta apne aap banega.

verses.sanskrit:
येऽप्यन्यदेवता भक्ता यजन्ते श्रद्धयान्विताः ।
तेऽपि मामेव कौन्तेय यजन्त्यविधिपूर्वकम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Ye Py Anya Devata Bhakta Yajante Shraddhayanvitah,
Te Pi Mam Eva Kaunteya Yajanty Avidhipurvakam.
verses.englishMeaning: Even those devotees who worship other deities with sincere faith — they too, O Kaunteya, are worshipping me alone, though not in the direct and fully enlightened manner.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Kaunteya! Jo bhakta shraddha se doosre devtaon ki pooja karte hain, woh bhi vastutah meri hi pooja karte hain, yadyapi unka tareeka avidhipoorvak (adhura aur apratyaksha) hota hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Gita ki vishalta dekhiye — koi doosre roop ko poojta ho toh bhi Krishna use galat nahi kehte.

Kyunki sabhi devta usi ek param aatma ki shaktiyon ke vibhinn aakar hain. Jaise ped ki alag-alag pattiyon aur daaliyon par paani daalne ki jagah agar seedhe jad mein paani daala jaaye, toh sabhi daaliyon ko apne aap mil jaata hai.

Jo log devtaon ko alag samajhkar poojte hain, woh bhi usi ek shakti tak pahunchte hain, par unhe lagta hai ki fal kisi aur ne diya. Seedhe jad ko pehchaanna hi sahi vidhi hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Kisi ki shraddha ko kam mat samjho, sabhi nadiya aakhirkaar usi ek samundar mein milti hain. Par sabse shreshtha rasta wahi hai jo seedhe mool srot se judta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च ।
न तु मामभिजानन्ति तत्त्वेनातश्च्यवन्ति ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Aham Hi Sarva Yajnanam Bhokta Ca Prabhur Eva Ca,
Na Tu Mam Abhijananti Tattvenatash Cyavanti Te.
verses.englishMeaning: For I alone am the ultimate enjoyer and master of all sacrifices. But they do not recognize me in my true divine essence, and therefore they fall back into the cycle of rebirth.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Kyunki samast yajnon ka asli bhokta aur swami main hi hoon. Parantu woh mere mool tattva ko sachchaai se nahi pehchaante, isliye sansaar ke phero mein girte hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Chahe kisi bhi devta ko havan diya jaaye, uska aakhiri swami aur bhokta kaun hai? Wahi ek Paramatma.

Lekin jo log sirf choti-moti manokamanaon mein ulajh kar rah jaate hain, woh yeh nahi samajhte ki devtaon ke peeche ki shakti bhi wahi Ishwar hain.

Is agyaan ke kaaran unka dhyan chote falon par rehta hai aur woh param shanti ko kho dete hain. Krishna keh rahe hain: "Mujhe pehchano, fal maangna band karo aur data se seedhe jud jao."
verses.lifeLesson: Sadhano aur madhyamo ko hi sab kuch mat maan baitho; unke peeche chhupe mool srot ko pehchano. Choti cheezon mein ulajhne se insaan asli manzil se bhatak jaata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यान्ति देवव्रता देवान्पितॄन्यान्ति पितृव्रताः ।
भूतानि यान्ति भूतेज्या यान्ति मद्याजिनोऽपि माम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yanti Deva Vrata Devan Pitrin Yanti Pitri Vratah,
Bhutani Yanti Bhutejya Yanti Mad Yajino Pi Mam.
verses.englishMeaning: Those who worship the celestial gods go to the gods; those who worship the ancestors go to the ancestors; those who worship spirits and entities go to the spirits; but those who worship me come directly unto me.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Devtaon ko poojne wale devtaon ko paate hain; pitron ko poojne wale pitron ko praapt hote hain; bhoot-pret aur tatvon ko poojne wale unhi mein jaate hain; aur meri bhakti karne wale mujh tak hi aate hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh spiritual science ka universal rule hai: "Tum jise dhyate ho, tum wahi ban jaate ho!"

- Agar kisi ka dhyan swargik aishvarya par hai, toh woh devlok jayega.
- Agar kisi ka lagav purvajon aur paramparaon se hai, toh pitrilok jayega.
- Agar koi prakriti ke sookshma tatvon mein uljha hai, toh wahi rahega.
- Aur jo param chetna, sachche Ishwar ko dhyata hai — woh seedhe Ishwar ko paata hai!

Tumhara focus hi tumhara future decide karta hai. Jaisi ichha, waisi manzil.
verses.lifeLesson: Zindagi mein apna lakshya soch-samajhkar chuno, kyunki insaan jisme apna mann lagata hai, ant mein wahi ban jaata hai. Chhote dhyan se chhota parinaam milta hai, param lakshya se param mukti milti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
