पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति ।
तदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Patram Pushpam Phalam Toyam Yo Me Bhaktya Prayacchati,
Tad Aham Bhakty Upahritam Ashnami Prayatatmanah.
verses.englishMeaning: Whoever offers me with genuine devotion a mere leaf, a flower, a fruit, or even just water — that loving offering of pure intent, given by a dedicated soul, I accept with immense joy.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo koi bhakta prem aur bhakti ke saath mujhe ek patta, ek phool, ek phal ya sirf thoda sa paani bhi arpan karta hai — us nirmal mann wale bhakta ke prem-bhare upahar ko main saadar aur anand se swikar karta hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Gita ka sabse meetha aur prem se bhara shlok hai.

Ishwar ko amiri, sone-chandi ya mehenge chadhawon ki zaroorat nahi hai. Krishna keh rahe hain: "Mujhe koi badi cheez nahi chahiye — ek patta (tulsi ka patta), ek sadharan phool, koi bhi chota phal, ya agar kuch na ho toh bas aankh ka ek aansu ya thoda paani le aao."

Lekin ek shart hai — "Bhaktya Prayacchati" — uske peeche sachcha prem hona chahiye!
Duniya chadhawa dekhti hai, Ishwar bhav dekhte hain. Shabari ke ber aur Vidurani ke kele ke chhilke isi prem ke saboot hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Ishwar ke darbar mein kimat cheez ki nahi, dil ke bhav ki hoti hai. Sacchi shradha aur nishkapat prem se diya gaya chhota sa prayas bhi param shanti aur anugrah lata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यत्करोषि यदश्नासि यज्जुहोषि ददासि यत् ।
यत्तपस्यसि कौन्तेय तत्कुरुष्व मदर्पणम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yat Karoshi Yad Ashnasi Yaj Juhoshi Dadasi Yat,
Yat Tapasyasi Kaunteya Tat Kurushva Mad Arpanam.
verses.englishMeaning: Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer in sacrifice, whatever you give away in charity, and whatever austerities you perform, O Kaunteya — do that as an offering unto me.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Kaunteya! Tum jo kuch bhi kaam karte ho, jo kuch khate ho, jo havan karte ho, jo daan dete ho aur jo bhi tap karte ho — woh sab mujhe arpan karke karo.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna poori zindagi ko pooja banane ka sabse aasan formula dete hain.

Bhakti ke liye kaam-dhandha ya parivar chhodkar jungle jaane ki zaroorat nahi hai. Bas apni niyat aur bhavna badal lo:
- Jo kaam kar rahe ho, socho: "Yeh Ishwar ka kaam hai."
- Jo khana kha rahe ho, socho: "Yeh sharir Ishwar ka mandir hai, isme prasad daal raha hoon."
- Kisi ki madad ki, toh socho: "Yeh Ishwar ke liye kiya gaya arpan hai."

Jab har kriya Ishwar ko samarpit ho jaati hai, toh kriya se bandhan nahi banta, balki har pal pooja ban jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Zindagi se bhaagna aadhyaatma nahi hai; apne har roz ke kaam ko imaandari aur nishkaam bhav se Ishwar ki seva bana dena hi sabse badi bhakti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
शुभाशुभफलैरेवं मोक्ष्यसे कर्मबन्धनैः ।
संन्यासयोगयुक्तात्मा विमुक्तो मामुपैष्यसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
Shubhashubha Phalair Evam Mokshyase Karma Bandhanaih,
Sannyasa Yoga Yuktatma Vimukto Mam Upaishyasi.
verses.englishMeaning: In this way, you shall be completely freed from the binding chains of actions and their auspicious and inauspicious fruits. With your mind firmly anchored in the yoga of renunciation, liberated, you shall come unto me.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Is prakaar arpan karke tum achhe aur bure falon wale karmon ke saare bandhanon se azaad ho jaoge; aur sannyas-yog se yukta chitt hokar, mukt bankar mujhe hi praapt karoge.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Karm bandhan kaise banta hai? Jab hum sochte hain ki "Yeh maine kiya hai aur iska fal mujhe milna chahiye."

Lekin jab hum pichhle shlok ke anusaar apna har kaam Ishwar ko arpit kar dete hain, toh na achhe fal ka ahankar rehta hai, na bure nateeje ka dukh.
Jaise ek daakiya (postman) hazaron rupaye ke check ya chitthi doosron ko deta hai, par woh na amir banta hai na gareeb — kyunki woh sirf apna farz nibha raha hota hai.

Aise nishkaam bhav ko hi "Sannyas Yoga" kaha gaya hai. Aisa insaan sansaar mein jeete hue bhi poori tarah mukt rehta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab fal ka ahankar chhod doge, tab kaam ka tanav apne aap khatam ho jayega. Nishkaam bhav se kiya gaya har farz mukti ka dwar khol deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः ।
ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते तेषु चाप्यहम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Samo Ham Sarva Bhuteshu Na Me Dveshyo Asti Na Priyah,
Ye Bhajanti Tu Mam Bhaktya Mayi Te Teshu Capy Aham.
verses.englishMeaning: I am equally present in all living beings; to me none is hateful and none is favored. But those who worship me with loving devotion abide in me, and I am ever present within them.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main samast praaniyon mein saman roop se sthit hoon; na koi mera dushman hai aur na koi khaas priya. Parantu jo prem-bhakti se mera bhajan karte hain, woh mujh mein hain aur main unke bheetar hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok ek gehre vishay ko suljhata hai — kya Ishwar bhedbhav karte hain?

Krishna kehte hain: "Bilkul nahi! Main suraj ki dhoop ki tarah sabke liye barabar hoon." Suraj kisi mehal ya jhopdi mein fark nahi karta.
Lekin agar koi apne kamre ki khidkiyan band karke andhere mein baitha rahe, toh isme dhoop ka dosh nahi hai!

Jo khidki khol kar suraj ke samne aata hai, woh roshni se bhar jaata hai. Bhakti wahi khidki kholna hai. Ishwar sabke hain, par jo unhe prem karta hai, woh unki upasthiti ko mehsoos kar paata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Ishwar ki kripa sabke liye saman hai, par use mehsoos karne ke liye apne dil ke darwaze kholne padte hain. Prem do aur prem paao — yahi aatmik anubhav ka saral niyam hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अपि चेत्सुदुराचारो भजते मामनन्यभाक् ।
साधुरेव स मन्तव्यः सम्यग्व्यवसितो हि सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Api Cet Suduracaro Bhajate Mam Ananyabhak,
Sadhur Eva Sa Mantavyah Samyag Vyavasito Hi Sah.
verses.englishMeaning: Even if the most fallen or depraved person turns to worship me with exclusive, undivided devotion, they must still be regarded as truly righteous and noble, for they have resolved upon the right path.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yadi koi ghor durachari (paapi) bhi ananya bhav se mujhse judkar meri bhakti shuru kar deta hai, toh use sadhu hi maanna chahiye, kyunki usne sahi disha mein dridh sankalp kar liya hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok bhatke hue har insaan ke liye aasha aur kripa ka sabse bada sandesh hai.

Duniya kisi ki galti ko zindagi bhar yaad rakhti hai aur uspar thappa laga deti hai. Par Ishwar kehte hain: "Chahe kisi ne kitni bhi badi galti kyun na ki ho, jis pal usne sachche dil se badalne ka faisla kiya aur Ishwar ki sharan li, usi pal se woh naya insaan ban gaya."

"Samyag Vyavasito" — kyunki uski disha badal gayi hai! Jaise Valmiki ji pehle daku the par disha badalte hi mahan rishi ban gaye. Ishwar ateet nahi dekhte, badalne ka sachcha sankalp dekhte hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Ateet ki galtiyan tumhara bhavishya tay nahi karti. Ek sachcha pashchatap aur sahi raste par chalne ka dridh nishchay kisi bhi insaan ki zindagi badal sakta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
क्षिप्रं भवति धर्मात्मा शश्वच्छान्तिं निगच्छति ।
कौन्तेय प्रतिजानीहि न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति ॥
verses.transliteration:
Kshipram Bhavati Dharmatma Shashvac Chantim Nigacchati,
Kaunteya Pratijanihi Na Me Bhaktah Pranashyati.
verses.englishMeaning: Quickly such a soul becomes righteous and attains eternal, abiding peace. O Kaunteya, proclaim this boldly to the world: my devotee shall never perish!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Woh shighra hi dharmatma ban jaata hai aur shashwat shanti ko praapt hota hai. Hey Kaunteya! Danka bajakar ghoshna kar do ki mere bhakta ka kabhi vinash nahi hota!
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna Arjun ko ek aisi baat kehne ko kehte hain jo itihaas ki sabse badi garv-bhari ghoshna hai: "Na Me Bhaktah Pranashyati" — mere bhakta ka kabhi patan ya vinash nahi hota!

Krishna ne khud bolne ki jagah Arjun se ghoshna kyun karwayi?
Kyunki Krishna apna wada bhale hi tod dein (jaise yuddh mein hathiyaar na uthane ka wada unhone Bhishma ke prem mein toda tha), par apne bhakta ki zuban aur wada woh kabhi tootne nahi dete!

Bhakti mein aisi shakti hai ki woh bure se bure sanskaar ko jala deti hai aur insaan ke andar shashwat shanti bhar deti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sachche vishwas aur shradha mein aisi shakti hai jo insaan ko har toofan mein surakshit rakhti hai. Ishwar par bharosa rakhne wale ka kabhi aatmik vinash nahi hota.

verses.sanskrit:
मां हि पार्थ व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः ।
स्त्रियो वैश्यास्तथा शूद्रास्तेऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Mam Hi Partha Vyapashritya Ye Pi Syuh Papa Yonayah,
Striyo Vaishyas Tatha Shudras Te Pi Yanti Param Gatim.
verses.englishMeaning: By taking complete refuge in me alone, O Partha, even those of disadvantaged birth, women, merchants, or laborers — indeed anyone — can certainly attain the supreme spiritual destination.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Partha! Mera aashray lekar chahe koi kisi bhi jati, varna, ling ya sthiti ka kyun na ho — striyan, vaishya ya shudra — sabhi param gati ko praapt karte hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok aadhyaatmik samanta (spiritual equality) ka sabse bada kanoon hai.

Us zamaane ke samajik niyam jo bhi rahe hon, Krishna yahan saaf kar dete hain ki Ishwar ke darbar mein koi bhedbhav nahi hai. Na jati ka, na ling ka, na amiri-garibi ka.
Aatma ka koi ling (gender) ya jati nahi hoti. Jo bhi Ishwar ki sharan mein aayega, sabke liye mukti ka darwaza barabar khula hai.

Shabari, Vidur, Raidas, Meerabai — in sabne bina kisi samajik vishadhikar ke bhakti ke bal par param pad paaya.
verses.lifeLesson: Ishwar ke samne sabhi barabar hain. Janma, jati ya ling se nahi, aatma ke prem aur pavitrata se insaan ki asli pehchaan aur mahanata tay hoti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
किं पुनर्ब्राह्मणाः पुण्या भक्ता राजर्षयस्तथा ।
अनित्यमसुखं लोकमिमं प्राप्य भजस्व माम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Kim Punar Brahmanah Punya Bhakta Rajarshayas Tatha,
Anityam Asukham Lokam Imam Prapya Bhajasva Mam.
verses.englishMeaning: How much more then is this true for holy sages and devout royal seers! Therefore, having arrived in this transient, joyless world, devote yourself wholeheartedly unto me.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Toh fir punya-aatma brahmanon aur bhakta rajarshiyon ke vishay mein kehna hi kya! Isliye is kshanbhangur aur dukhon se bhare sansaar mein aakar, tum ananya bhav se meri bhakti karo.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna kehte hain ki jab sadharan se sadharan vyakti bhi mukti paa sakta hai, toh jinke paas sadhana ki anukoolta hai unka toh kehna hi kya.

Par yahan ek bahut bada shabd use kiya gaya hai — "Anityam Asukham Lokam".
Yeh sansaar do cheezon se bana hai:
1. Anityam — yahan kuch bhi hamesha nahi tikta; sab badalta rehta hai.
2. Asukham — yahan ka koi bhi sukh poora ya sthir nahi hai, har sukh ke peeche dukh chhupa hai.

Jab hum samajh jaate hain ki yeh duniya temporary aur badalnewali hai, tab hum yahan ke chhote jhagdon aur moh se azaad hokar sachche aadhyaatma ki taraf mudte hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Yeh sansaar ek temporary padav hai, aakhiri manzil nahi. Yahan ki kshanik cheezon mein ulajhne ki jagah, shashwat sach aur aatmik shanti ko apna lakshya banao.

verses.sanskrit:
मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु ।
मामेवैष्यसि युक्त्वैवमात्मानं मत्परायणः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Manmana Bhava Mad Bhakto Mad Yaji Mam Namaskuru,
Mam Evaishyasi Yuktvaivam Atmanam Matparayanah.
verses.englishMeaning: Engage your mind always in thinking of me, become my devotee, worship me, and bow down unto me. Absorbing your inner self completely in me and holding me as the supreme goal, you shall surely come to me.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Apna mann mujh mein lagao, mere bhakta bano, meri pooja karo aur mujhe pranaam karo. Is prakaar apni aatma ko poori tarah mujh se jodkar aur mujhe param lakshya maankar, tum nishchit hi mujhe praapt karoge.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Chapter 9 ka aakhiri aur poore adhyay ka nichod shlok hai.
Krishna yahan char saral aur gehre aadesh dete hain:
1. "Manmana Bhava" — apne mann ko mujh se jodo; har kaam mein mera smaran rakho.
2. "Mad Bhakto" — mujhse prem karo; rishta sirf darr ya lalach ka nahi, prem ka ho.
3. "Mad Yaji" — har prayas aur karm ko mere liye ek aahuti bana do.
4. "Mam Namaskuru" — vinamra bano; ahankar ko mere samne jhuka do.

Jab yeh charon cheezein ek saath aati hain, toh insaan ka astitva Ishwar ki chetna mein leen ho jaata hai. Yeh Krishna ka atal wada hai ki aisa saadhak zaroor Ishwar ko paata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni soch, prem, karam aur vinamrata ko ek disha de do — param sachchaai ki taraf. Jab mann aur karam ek disha mein chalte hain, tab manzil tak pahunchna atal ho jaata hai.

summary: The tenth chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Vibhooti Yoga. In this chapter, Krishna reveals Himself as the cause of all causes. He describes His various manifestations and opulences in order to increase Arjuna's Bhakti. Arjuna is fully convinced of Lord's paramount position and proclaims him to be the Supreme Personality. He prays to Krishna to describe more of His divine glories which are like nectar to hear.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
भूय एव महाबाहो शृणु मे परमं वचः ।
यत्तेऽहं प्रीयमाणाय वक्ष्यामि हितकाम्यया ॥
verses.transliteration:
Shri Bhagavan Uvacha:
Bhuya Eva Maha Baho Shrinu Me Paramam Vacah,
Yat Te Ham Priyamanaya Vakshyami Hita Kamyaya.
verses.englishMeaning: Shri Krishna said: Listen once again, O mighty-armed Arjuna, to my supreme words. Because you take immense delight in hearing of me, I speak this unto you for your highest spiritual well-being.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Shri Krishna ne kaha:

Hey mahabahu Arjun! Mere param shreshtha vachano ko ek baar fir dhyan se suno. Kyunki tum mere priya ho aur meri baatein sunne mein anand lete ho, isliye main tumhare param kalyaan ki ichha se yeh gyaan keh raha hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Chapter 10 ki shuruaat Krishna ke apaar prem se hoti hai.
Krishna Arjun ko kehte hain: "Priyamanaya" — yaani tum mere se prem karte ho, aur jab tum meri baatein sunte ho toh tumhara chehra khil uthta hai!

Jab sikhne wale ke andar sachchi ruchi aur prem ho, tab sikhane wale ka dil khul jaata hai. Krishna Arjun ke aatmik hit aur bhalai ke liye yeh adhyay shuru karte hain.

Yahan Krishna apni aisi vibhootiyon ke baare mein batayenge jinhe sunkar mann vishwas aur bhakti se bhar jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Prem aur lagan se seekha gaya gyaan hi andar utarta hai. Jo sachche dil se seekhna chahta hai, uske liye gyaan ke saare bhed apne aap khulne lagte hain.

verses.sanskrit:
न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः ।
अहमादिर्हि देवानां महर्षीणां च सर्वशः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Na Me Viduh Sura Ganah Prabhavam Na Maharshayah,
Aham Adir Hi Devanam Maharshinam Ca Sarvashah.
verses.englishMeaning: Neither the hosts of celestial gods nor the great rishis know of my divine origin, for I am the primordial source and origin of all the gods and great sages in every respect.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Meri utpatti aur aadi-swaroop ko na devtaon ke samuh jaante hain aur na mahan rishijan; kyunki main sabhi prakaar se devtaon ka aur mahan rishiyon ka bhi aadi-kaaran hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok insaan ko ahankar se bachaata hai.
Log sochte hain ki hum apni buddhi ya kitabon ke bal par Ishwar ko poora samajh lenge. Par Krishna keh rahe hain: "Bade-bade devta aur hazaron saal tap karne wale mahan rishi bhi mere mool ko poori tarah nahi samajh sakte."

Kyun? Kyunki jaise ek bachcha apne pita ke janma ko nahi dekh sakta (kyunki bachcha baad mein aaya hai), waise hi devta aur rishi bhi Ishwar ke baad prakat hue hain. Ishwar sabka aadi (origin) hain.

Ishwar ko dimag se napna namumkin hai; unhe sirf prem aur shradha se anubhav kiya ja sakta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Gyaan ka ahankar mat karo; dimag ki ek seema hai. Param sachchaai ko samajhne ke liye vinamrata aur samparpan chahiye, tarka aur ghamand nahi.

verses.sanskrit:
यो मामजमनादिं च वेत्ति लोकमहेश्वरम् ।
असम्मूढः स मर्त्येषु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yo Mam Ajam Anadim Ca Vetti Loka Maheshvaram,
Asammudhah Sa Martyeshu Sarva Papaih Pramucyate.
verses.englishMeaning: Whoever knows me as the unborn, beginningless, and supreme sovereign of all worlds — that undeluded soul among mortals is completely freed from all sins.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo mujhe ajanma, anadi aur samast lokon ka mahan Ishwar (Maheshwar) jaanta hai, manushyon mein woh moh-rahit gyani sabhi paapon se mukt ho jaata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna teen shabdon mein apna param swaroop batate hain:
1. "Ajam" — jinka kabhi janma nahi hota, jo hamesha se hain.
2. "Anadim" — jinka koi shuruaati bindu nahi hai.
3. "Loka Maheshvaram" — samast brahmandon ke supreme swami.

Jo insaan is sach ko antar-aatmik drishti se jaan leta hai, woh "Asammudhah" ban jaata hai — yaani uske mann ka moh aur bhatkan door ho jaati hai.
Jab pata chal jaaye ki sabka maalik ek hi avinashi tatva hai, toh insaan ke saare paap, darr aur chintayein vileen ho jaati hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab insaan sansaar ke jhoothe srot ko chhodkar param sachche aadhar ko pehchaan leta hai, tab uske saare darr aur bhatkan khatam ho jaate hain aur aatma nishpaap ban jaati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
बुद्धिर्ज्ञानमसम्मोहः क्षमा सत्यं दमः शमः ।
सुखं दुःखं भवोऽभावो भयं चाभयमेव च ॥
verses.transliteration:
Buddhir Jnanam Asammohah Kshama Satyam Damah Shamah,
Sukham Duhkham Bhavo Bhavo Bhayam Cabhayam Eva Ca.
verses.englishMeaning: Intellect, spiritual knowledge, freedom from delusion, forgiveness, truthfulness, control of senses, tranquility of mind, happiness, sorrow, birth, death, fear, and fearlessness...
verses.hinglishMeaning: Buddhi, gyaan, moh ka abhav, kshama, satya, indriyo ka daman, mann ki shanti, sukh, dukh, utpatti, vinash, bhay aur abhay...
verses.simpleExplanation:
Verse 4 aur 5 ek saath padhe jaate hain. Krishna human consciousness ke har bhav ko batate hain:
- "Buddhi" — sahi aur galat ka faisla karne ki samajh.
- "Jnanam" — aatma aur paramatma ka gyaan.
- "Asammohah" — dridh sthirta, bina uljhan ke.
- "Kshama" — doosron ki galtiyon ko maaf karne ki taaqat.
- "Satyam" — sachchaai par tikna.
- "Damah & Shamah" — indriyon aur mann par control.
- "Sukh & Dukh, Bhay & Abhay" — jeevan ke saare anubhav.

Yeh saare bhav kahan se aate hain? Krishna batate hain ki yeh sab unhi ki shakti se nikalte hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Humare mann ke har bhav, chintan aur anubhav ka mool srot Ishwar hi hai. Apni buddhi aur indriyon ko nek disha mein lagana hi aatmik unnati ka rahasya hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अहिंसा समता तुष्टिस्तपो दानं यशोऽयशः ।
भवन्ति भावा भूतानां मत्त एव पृथग्विधाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Ahimsa Samata Tushtis Tapo Danam Yasho Yashah,
Bhavanti Bhava Bhutanam Matta Eva Prithag Vidhah.
verses.englishMeaning: Non-violence, equanimity, contentment, austerity, charity, fame, and ill-fame — all these diverse states of being of living entities arise from me alone.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Ahimsa, samta (samanata), santosh, tap, daan, yash aur apyash — praaniyon ke yeh vibhinn prakaar ke bhav mujh se hi utpanna hote hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna is soochi ko aage badhaate hain:
- "Ahimsa" — kisi ko dukh na pahunchana.
- "Samata" — har sthiti mein santulan rakhna.
- "Tushtih" — jo mila hai usme santosh rakhna.
- "Tapah" — aatm-anushashan.
- "Danam" — nishkaam bhav se baantna.
- "Yash & Ayash" — shohrat aur badnaami.

Krishna keh rahe hain: "Yeh sabhi vibhinn bhav mere hi sankalp aur shakti se utpanna hote hain."
Iska matlab yeh hai ki jeevan mein jo kuch bhi achha ya chunautipoorn aata hai, uske peeche ek divya niyam hai. Insaan ko har sthiti mein Ishwar ka smaran rakhna chahiye.
verses.lifeLesson: Santosh, ahimsa aur daan jaise gun aatma ko ujjwal banate hain. Yash ho ya apyash, har sthiti mein sthir rehkar Ishwar ke prati samarpit raho.

verses.sanskrit:
महर्षयः सप्त पूर्वे चत्वारो मनवस्तथा ।
मद्भावा मानसा जाता येषां लोक इमाः प्रजाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Maharshayah Sapta Purve Catvaro Manavas Tatha,
Mad Bhava Manasa Jata Yesham Loka Imah Prajah.
verses.englishMeaning: The seven great sages of ancient times, the four primal mind-born rishis (Kumaras), and the Manus were all born of my cosmic mind and endowed with my power. From them all the living beings of this world have descended.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Prachin kaal ke saat maharshi, unse bhi pehle ke chaar sanakadi rishi aur chauhad manu — yeh sab mere sankalp se, mere mann se utpanna hue hain, jinse sansaar ki yeh saari praja phaili hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yahan srishti ki vishal vanshavali (cosmic lineage) ka varnan hai.
Saat rishi (Saptrishi), chaar sanakadi muni (Sanak, Sanandan, Sanatan, Sanatkumar), aur manushya jati ke nirmata Manu — yeh sab Ishwar ke maanas putra hain, yaani unke sankalp se prakat hue.

Iska aadhyaatmik matlab yeh hai ki poora manav samaj aur srishti ek hi divya srot se aayi hai. Hum sab ek hi vishwa-parivar ke hissa hain. Koi bhi paraya ya alag nahi hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Poori manavta aur srishti ek hi srot se nikli hai. Sabhi jeevon ke prati apnaapan aur aadar rakho, kyunki sabke andar usi ek param tatva ka ansh hai.

verses.sanskrit:
एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः ।
सोऽविकम्पेन योगेन युज्यते नात्र संशयः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Etam Vibhutim Yogam Ca Mama Yo Vetti Tattvatah,
So Vikampena Yogena Yujyate Natra Samshayah.
verses.englishMeaning: One who truly understands this magnificent manifestation of my divine glories and my sovereign mystic power becomes united with me in unwavering yoga; of this there is no doubt.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo purush meri is divya vibhooti aur yog-shakti ko tatva se (sachchaai ke saath) jaan leta hai, woh nishchal aur sthir yog se mujh se jud jaata hai — isme koi sandeh nahi hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Jab insaan ko yeh pata chalta hai ki srishti ka har kan, har rishi, har taara aur har praani Ishwar ki hi vibhooti hai, tab kya hota hai?

Uska dhyan bhatakna band ho jaata hai! Use har jagah wahi ek Ishwar dikhta hai. Use kehte hain "Avikampen Yogena" — ek aisa yoga jo kabhi hilta nahi, kabhi dolta nahi.
Jaise ek ped jiski jadein zameen mein gehri chali jaati hain, toofan bhi use gira nahi sakta.

Ishwar ki mahima ko samajhna hi dridh bhakti ka aadhar banta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab dil mein yeh vishwas sthir ho jaaye ki har jagah aur har ghatna ke peeche Ishwar hi hain, tab mann kabhi chintit ya daanvaadol nahi hota. Atut shradha hi sthir shanti deti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते ।
इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Aham Sarvasya Prabhavo Mattah Sarvam Pravartate,
Iti Matva Bhajante Mam Budha Bhava Samanvitah.
verses.englishMeaning: I am the source of all spiritual and material worlds; everything emanates from me. Realizing this profound truth, the wise worship me with heartfelt love and deep spiritual devotion.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main hi samast srishti ki utpatti ka mool kaaran hoon; mujh se hi sab kuch chal raha hai aur pravritt hota hai. Aisa jaankar gyani log prem-bhav se bhar kar meri bhakti karte hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh "Chatur-shloki Gita" (Gita ke char sabse mahatvapurna shlok, 10.8 - 10.11) ka pehla shlok hai.

Krishna yahan aadhyaatma ka sabse bada niyam kehte hain:
- "Aham Sarvasya Prabhavo" — har cheez ka aadi main hoon.
- "Mattah Sarvam Pravartate" — saari gati, saari shakti, saara jeevan mujh se hi chal raha hai.

Jo buddhimaan log is gehre sach ko samajhte hain, unki pooja kewal formal rasm nahi rehti, balki "Bhava Samanvitah" ban jaati hai — yaani unka rom-rom prem aur shukrane se bhar jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jeevan ka har saans aur har shakti us param source se aati hai. Jab yeh sach samajh aata hai, tab jeevan mein shukrana aur prem aana swabhavik ho jaata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
मच्चित्ता मद्गतप्राणा बोधयन्तः परस्परम् ।
कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च ॥
verses.transliteration:
Mac Citta Mad Gata Prana Bodhayantah Parasparam,
Kathayantash Ca Mam Nityam Tushyanti Ca Ramanti Ca.
verses.englishMeaning: With their minds firmly fixed on me and their lives wholly dedicated unto me, continuously enlightening one another and speaking of me, they remain always contented and rejoice in supreme bliss.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Mujh mein hi apna chitt lagaye hue aur mujh mein hi apne praano ko arpit kiye hue, aapas mein ek-doosre ko meri baatein samjhaate hue aur meri charcha karte hue, woh sada santusht rehte hain aur divya anand mein ramte hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Chatur-shloki Gita ka doosra shlok sachche bhakton ke sang (Satsang) ki sundarta dikhata hai.

Aise bhakta aapas mein milte hain toh sansaari ninda, rajneeti ya bhedbhav ki baatein nahi karte.
1. "Bodhayantah Parasparam" — woh aapas mein aadhyaatmik anubhav baant-te hain aur ek doosre ki himmat badhate hain.
2. "Kathayantash Ca Mam Nityam" — unki baatcheet ka kendra Ishwar ka prem hota hai.
3. "Tushyanti Ca Ramanti Ca" — unhe kisi bahari manoranjan ki zaroorat nahi hoti, woh andar se poori tarah tript aur anandit rehte hain.

Satsang se bada koi sukh aur shanti nahi hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Achhi sangati insaan ki aatma ko nikharti hai. Jo log aapas mein satya aur prem ki baatein karte hain, unka jeevan sada santosh aur anand se mehakta rehta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां सततयुक्तानां भजतां प्रीतिपूर्वकम् ।
ददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tesham Satata Yuktanam Bhajatam Priti Purvakam,
Dadami Buddhi Yogam Tam Yena Mam Upayanti Te.
verses.englishMeaning: To those who are ever devoted to me and worship me with loving affection, I bestow that divine intellect and wisdom by which they surely come unto me.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Un nirantar mujhse jude hue aur prem-poorvak mera bhajan karne wale bhakton ko, main woh "buddhi-yog" pradan karta hoon jisse woh seedhe mujh tak pahunch jaate hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Chatur-shloki Gita ka teesra shlok ek adbhut wada karta hai.

Bahut se log sochte hain: "Main toh anpadh hoon, main Ved-shastra nahi jaanta, mujhe dhyan lagana nahi aata, main Ishwar tak kaise pahunchunga?"
Krishna jawab dete hain: "Tum bas prem se mujhse jude raho (Priti Purvakam). Baaki rasta dikhana mera kaam hai! Main tumhe woh buddhi-yog (divine intelligence) dunga jisse tum mujh tak pahunch jaoge."

Insaan apni mehdood buddhi se Ishwar tak nahi pahunch sakta, par jab prem sachcha ho, toh Ishwar khud aakar use divya drishti aur vivek de dete hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Aatmik raaste par sabse zaroori cheez kitaabi gyaan nahi, balki dil ka sachcha prem hai. Jab niyat saaf aur prem atut ho, toh Ishwar khud sahi rasta aur samajh pradan karte hain.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषामेवानुकम्पार्थमहमज्ञानजं तमः ।
नाशयाम्यात्मभावस्थो ज्ञानदीपेन भास्वता ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tesham Ev Anukampartham Aham Ajnanajam Tamah,
Nashayamy Atma Bhava Stho Jnana Dipena Bhasvata.
verses.englishMeaning: Out of pure compassion for them, dwelling within their innermost heart, I completely dispel the darkness born of ignorance with the luminous lamp of wisdom.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Un par anugrah aur kripa karne ke liye, main unke hriday mein sthit hokar, agyaan se paida hone wale andhere ko gyaan ke chamakdar deepak dwara poori tarah nasht kar deta hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Chatur-shloki Gita ka chautha aur aakhiri shlok kripa ki param paraakashtha hai.

Hriday ke bheetar agyaan ka andhera hota hai — darr, moh, sandeh aur ahankar ka andhera.
Krishna kehte hain: "Mujhe unke bheetar dekhkar daya aati hai (Anukampartham). Main unke hriday mein sthit hokar gyaan ka ek roshan deepak jala deta hoon."

Jaise ek kamre mein sadiyon se andhera ho, par ek diya jalate hi andhera ek pal mein gayab ho jaata hai — waise hi Ishwar ki kripa se saara agyaan ek pal mein mit jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Andhere se ladne ki zaroorat nahi hai, bas roshni jala do. Jab dil mein Ishwar ke prati samparpan hota hai, toh unki kripa saare darr aur bhatkan ko mita deti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान् ।
पुरुषं शाश्वतं दिव्यमादिदेवमजं विभुम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Arjuna Uvacha:
Param Brahma Param Dhama Pavitram Paramam Bhavan,
Purusham Shashvatam Divyam Adi Devam Ajam Vibhum.
verses.englishMeaning: Arjuna said: You are the Supreme Brahman, the supreme abode, the ultimate purifier. You are the eternal, divine person, the primal God, the unborn, and the all-pervading sovereign Lord.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Arjun ne kaha:

Aap param brahma hain, param dham hain, aur param pavitra hain. Aap shashwat divya purush, devon ke bhi aadi-deva, ajanma aur sarvavyapi swami hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna ke Chatur-shloki sandesh ko sunkar Arjun ka hriday gaurav, vishwas aur anand se bhar uthta hai!

Arjun ab Krishna ko sirf apna sarthi ya dost nahi dekh raha, balki unke param roop ko sakshat swikar kar raha hai.
Arjun unhe "Param Brahma" (supreme reality) aur "Param Dhama" (aakhiri aashray) ke roop mein pranaam karta hai.

Yeh shlok dikhata hai ki sachcha shishya wahi hai jo gyaan ko sunkar antar-aatmik roop se jaag uthta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab sachcha gyaan dil mein utar jaata hai, tab insaan ke saare sandeh mit jaate hain aur hriday mein param satya ke prati gehra aadar aur samarpan paida hota hai.

verses.sanskrit:
आहुस्त्वामृषयः सर्वे देवर्षिर्नारदस्तथा ।
असितो देवलो व्यासः स्वयं चैव ब्रवीषि मे ॥
verses.transliteration:
Ahus Tvam Rishayah Sarve Devarshir Naradas Tatha,
Asito Devalo Vyasah Svayam Caiva Bravishi Me.
verses.englishMeaning: All the great sages have proclaimed this about you — as have the celestial sage Narada, Asita, Devala, and the revered Vyasa — and now you yourself are revealing it directly to me.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Samast rishijan aapko yahi kehte hain — jaise devarshi Narada, Asita, Devala rishi aur Vedavyasa; aur ab aap khud bhi mujhse yahi keh rahe hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun keh rahe hain: "Krishna, main yeh baat sirf aapke kehne par nahi maan raha, balki sansaar ke sabse mahan rishiyon ne bhi yahi sach dekha aur bataya hai."

Narada ji jinhone bhakti ka marg dikhaya, Asita aur Devala jinhone gyaan ki charcha ki, aur mahan Maharshi Vyasa jinhone Vedon ka vistar kiya — sabne aapko hi param aadi-purush maana hai.
Aur ab aap khud apne shrimukh se mujhe yeh sach bata rahe hain. Isliye ab mere andar sandeh ka ek kan bhi nahi bacha.
verses.lifeLesson: Param satya woh hai jise itihaas ke sabhi mahan aatmaon ne anubhav kiya ho. Jab shastra, guru aur aantarik anubhav mil jaate hain, toh vishwas atut ban jaata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वमेतदृतं मन्ये यन्मां वदसि केशव ।
न हि ते भगवन्व्यक्तिं विदुर्देवा न दानवाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sarvam Etad Ritam Manye Yan Mam Vadasi Keshava,
Na Hi Te Bhagavan Vyaktim Vidur Deva Na Danavah.
verses.englishMeaning: I accept all this as pure truth which you tell me, O Keshava. Neither the celestial gods nor the demons, O Lord, truly comprehend the full mystery of your divine appearance and manifestation.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Keshava! Aap mujhse jo kuch bhi keh rahe hain, main is sabko poori tarah satya maanta hoon. Hey Bhagavan! Aapke vaastavik prakatya aur roop ko na devta jaan paate hain aur na danav.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun yahan poore samarpan aur shradha ki choti par hain: "Sarvam Etad Ritam Manye" — main aapke har shabd ko satya maanta hoon.

Aur fir Arjun kehte hain: "Aapko devta aur danav bhi nahi jaan sakte."
Kyun? Kyunki devtaon ke paas punya ka ahankar hota hai, aur danavon ke paas shakti ka ahankar hota hai! Ahankar chahe punya ka ho ya shakti ka, dono aankhon par parda daal dete hain.

Ishwar ko sirf wahi jaan sakta hai jo ahankar ko chhodkar nirmal hriday se sharan mein aata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Satya ko swikar karne ke liye shradha chahiye. Ahankar chahe kitna bhi bada kyun na ho, woh aatmik sachchaai ko nahi dekh sakta; vinamra hriday hi sachcha drishta banta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वयमेवात्मनात्मानं वेत्थ त्वं पुरुषोत्तम ।
भूतभावन भूतेश देवदेव जगत्पते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Svayam Evatmanatmanam Vettha Tvam Purushottama,
Bhuta Bhavana Bhutesha Deva Deva Jagatpate.
verses.englishMeaning: Indeed, you alone know yourself by your own supreme divine consciousness, O Supreme Person, origin of all beings, Lord of all creatures, God of gods, and Master of the universe!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Purushottama! Hey sabko utpanna karne wale! Hey bhoot-praaniyon ke swami! Hey devon ke deva! Hey jagat ke swami! Vastutah aap khud hi apne aap ko apni shakti se jaante hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun Krishna ko paanch adbhut sambodhan dete hain:
1. "Purushottama" — sabhi aatmaon mein sarvashreshtha.
2. "Bhuta Bhavana" — sabko rachne aur unka palan karne wale.
3. "Bhutesha" — samast srishti ke maalik.
4. "Deva Deva" — devtaon ke bhi Ishwar.
5. "Jagatpate" — poore brahmand ke swami.

Arjun swikar karte hain ki suraj ko dekhne ke liye kisi mombatti ki zaroorat nahi hoti; suraj apni roshni se khud dikhta hai. Thik waise hi, Ishwar ko poori tarah sirf Ishwar hi jaan sakte hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Ishwar ki vishalta ki koi seema nahi hai. Apne laghu gyaan se unhe baandhne ki koshish mat karo; bas unki mahanata ke aage shradha se sir jhukao.

verses.sanskrit:
वक्तुमर्हस्यशेषेण दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः ।
याभिर्विभूतिभिर्लोकानिमांस्त्वं व्याप्य तिष्ठसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
Vaktum Arhasy Asheshena Divya Hy Atma Vibhutayah,
Yabhir Vibhutibhir Lokan Imams Tvam Vyapya Tishthasi.
verses.englishMeaning: Please describe to me fully your divine manifestations, by which glorious powers you remain pervading all these worlds.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aap kripa karke apni un divya vibhootiyon ko poori tarah batane ki kripa karein, jin vibhootiyon ke dwara aap in samast lokon ko vyapt karke virajmaan hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ke mann mein ab ek sachchi aur pavitra jigyasa jagi hai.
Woh kehte hain: "Krishna, aap mujhe batayiye ki is sansaar mein aap kahan-kahan vishesh roop se prakat hain? Main aapki shaktiyon ko sansaar ke vibhinn roopon mein kaise pehchanu?"

Arjun yeh sawaal kisi tarka ya time-pass ke liye nahi poochh rahe, balki isliye poochh rahe hain taaki jab woh sansaar ko dekhein, toh unhe har cheez mein Ishwar ka hi darshan ho.

Yeh ek shishya ki sachchi dhyan-yatra ki maang hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab aatma mein sachchi jigyasa jagti hai, tab woh sansaar ki har sundarta aur shakti mein Ishwar ke nishan talashne lagti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
कथं विद्यामहं योगिंस्त्वां सदा परिचिन्तयन् ।
केषु केषु च भावेषु चिन्त्योऽसि भगवन्मया ॥
verses.transliteration:
Katham Vidyam Aham Yogims Tvam Sada Paricintayan,
Keshu Keshu Ca Bhaveshu Cintyo Si Bhagavan Maya.
verses.englishMeaning: How may I know you, O Supreme Mystic Yogi, by constantly meditating upon you? And in what various forms and aspects are you to be contemplated by me, O Blessed Lord?
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Yogeshwar! Main nirantar chintan karta hua aapko kaise jaanoon? Aur hey Bhagavan! Kin-kin bhavon aur roopon mein mere dwara aapka dhyan kiya jaana chahiye?
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh har saadhak ka sabse practical sawaal hai!
"Krishna, main 24 ghante dhyan kaise karun? Main jab aankhein khol kar duniya ko dekhta hoon, toh kin-kin cheezon mein aapka smaran karun?"

Insaan ka mann roop chaahta hai, aakar chaahta hai, focus chaahta hai. Nirakar ko dhyana mushkil hota hai, isliye Arjun poochhte hain ki main prakriti ke kin roopon mein aapki mahima ko dekh kar dhyan mein sthir rahoon.

Yeh shlok practical meditation ka raasta poochhta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Dhyan sirf aankhein band karke baithna nahi hai; balki aankhein khol kar bhi sansaar ki har sundarta mein Ishwar ko mehsoos karna sachcha dhyan hai.

verses.sanskrit:
विस्तरेणात्मनो योगं विभूतिं च जनार्दन ।
भूयः कथय तृप्तिर्हि शृण्वतो नास्ति मेऽमृतम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Vistarenatmano Yogam Vibhutim Ca Janardana,
Bhuyah Kathaya Triptir Hi Shrinvato Nasti Me Amritam.
verses.englishMeaning: Describe to me again in detail, O Janardana, your divine yogic power and manifestations, for hearing your nectar-like words, I am never satisfied — my longing only deepens!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Janardana! Apni yog-shakti aur vibhootiyon ko ek baar fir vistar se kahiye, kyunki aapki amrit-mayi baatein sunte hue mera mann tript nahi hota — meri pyaas aur badhti jaati hai!
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok sachche prem ka lakshan batata hai — "Triptir Hi Shrinvato Nasti Me Amritam".
Sansaar ki baatein sunte-sunte insaan thak jaata hai, bore ho jaata hai. Par Ishwar ki katha aisi amrit hai jise jitna suno, pyaas utni hi meethi hoti jaati hai!

Arjun kehte hain: "Krishna, bolte rahiye, rukhiye mat! Aapki baatein mere kaano mein amrit ghol rahi hain."
Jab kisi cheez se sacha prem ho jaata hai, toh insaan uske baare mein sunte hue kabhi thakta nahi hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sachche prem aur shradha mein kabhi thakan ya aalas nahi hota. Param satya ki khoj mein hriday hamesha naye utsah aur anand se bhara rehta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः ।
प्राधान्यतः कुरुश्रेष्ठ नास्त्यन्तो विस्तरस्य मे ॥
verses.transliteration:
Shri Bhagavan Uvacha:
Hanta Te Kathayishyami Divya Hy Atma Vibhutayah,
Pradhanyatah Kuru Shreshtha Nasty Anto Vistarasya Me.
verses.englishMeaning: Shri Krishna said: Yes, I shall certainly reveal to you my splendid divine manifestations, but only the most prominent ones, O best of the Kurus, for there is no end to the vast expanse of my glories!
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Shri Krishna ne kaha:

Haan! Hey Kuru-shreshtha Arjun! Main tumhe apni pramukh divya vibhootiyon ke baare mein bataunga, kyunki meri mahima aur vistar ka koi ant nahi hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna Arjun ke prem ko dekhkar khush ho jaate hain aur kehte hain: "Hanta" — yaani bahut achha! Main zaroor bataunga.

Lekin Krishna ek cheez spasht karte hain: "Pradhanyatah" — main sirf pramukh roopon ko bataunga, kyunki "Nasty Anto Vistarasya Me" — mere roopon aur vibhootiyon ka koi ant hi nahi hai! Agar main sab batane lagoonga toh poori zindagi bhi kam pad jayegi.

Jaise ek vishaal samundar se kuch boondein nikaal kar dikha di jaayein taaki samundar ki meethas aur gehraai ka andaaza lag sake.
verses.lifeLesson: Srishti anant hai aur Ishwar ki shaktiyan aseem hain. Jo thoda sa bhi hum dekh aur samajh paate hain, use aadar aur vinamrata se swikar karna chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
अहमात्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभूताशयस्थितः ।
अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च ॥
verses.transliteration:
Aham Atma Gudakesha Sarva Bhutashaya Sthitah,
Aham Adish Ca Madhyam Ca Bhutanam Anta Eva Ca.
verses.englishMeaning: I am the supreme Self, O Gudakesha (conqueror of sleep), seated in the heart of all living entities. I am the beginning, the middle, and the end of all beings.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Gudakesha (neend ko jeetne wale Arjun)! Main samast praaniyon ke hriday mein sthit unki aatma hoon; aur main hi sabhi jeevon ka aadi (shuruaat), madhya (jeevan), aur ant (pralaya) hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Vibhootiyon ki soochi shuru karne se pehle, Krishna sabse pehli aur sabse badi vibhooti batate hain: "Aham Atma" — Main tumhari aur sabhi praaniyon ki aatma hoon!

Kahin door aakaash mein dhundhne ki zaroorat nahi hai. Jo har jeev ke andar saans le raha hai, jo chetna hai, jo 'main hoon' ka ehsaas hai — wahi Krishna hain.
Aur har jeev ki utpatti, uska chalna aur uska ant — sab Krishna ke bheetar hi hota hai.

Yahan Arjun ko "Gudakesha" kaha gaya hai — jisne aalas aur neend ko jeet liya ho. Aisa hi jagrat insaan aatma ke sach ko pehchaan sakta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Ishwar tumhare bheetar tumhari aatma ke roop mein baithe hain. Doosron mein kamiyaan dhundhne ki jagah, sabke andar basi usi ek aatma ka aadar karo.

verses.sanskrit:
आदित्यानामहं विष्णुर्ज्योतिषां रविरंशुमान् ।
मरीचिर्मरुतामस्मि नक्षत्राणामहं शशी ॥
verses.transliteration:
Adityanam Aham Vishnur Jyotisham Ravir Amshuman,
Maricir Marutam Asmi Nakshatranam Aham Shashi.
verses.englishMeaning: Among the twelve Adityas, I am Vishnu; among radiant lights, I am the radiant sun; among the Maruts (wind deities), I am Marici; and among the stars of the night sky, I am the moon.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Baarah Adityon mein main Vishnu hoon; roshni dene walon mein main kiranon wala tejasvi suraj hoon; maruton (vayu devtaon) mein main Marichi hoon; aur aakaash ke nakshatron aur sitaron mein main chandrama hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Ab Krishna apni vibhootiyon ki sundar ladi shuru karte hain:
1. Adityon mein — Vishnu, jo sabka sanrakshan karte hain.
2. Prakaash mein — Suraj, jiske bina jeevan sambhav nahi.
3. Hawa ke devtaon mein — Marichi, jo prana-shakti ke mool hain.
4. Raat ke aakaash mein — Chandrama, jo shaanti aur sheetalta deta hai.

Matlab jahan bhi sabse tejasvi, shreshtha aur jeevandayi tatva dikhe, wahan samajh lo ki Ishwar ki kripa ka vishesh prakaash hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Suraj ki tarah bina bhedbhav ke roshni baanto aur chandrama ki tarah doosron ke dukhon mein sheetalta pradan karo. Jahan achhai aur tejasvita hai, wahan Ishwar hain.

verses.sanskrit:
वेदानां सामवेदोऽस्मि देवानामस्मि वासवः ।
इन्द्रियाणां मनश्चास्मि भूतानामस्मि चेतना ॥
verses.transliteration:
Vedanam Samavedo Smi Devanam Asmi Vasavah,
Indriyanam Manash Casmi Bhutanam Asmi Cetana.
verses.englishMeaning: Among the Vedas, I am the Sama Veda; among the celestial gods, I am Indra; among the senses, I am the mind; and in living beings, I am the living consciousness.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Vedon mein main Samaveda hoon; devtaon mein main Indra hoon; indriyon mein main mann hoon; aur samast praaniyon mein main unki jeevant chetna (consciousness) hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna char adbhut vibhootiyan batate hain:
1. Vedon mein Samaveda — jo sangeet aur bhaav se bhara hai, jise gaa kar Ishwar ko dhyaya jaata hai.
2. Devtaon mein Indra — jo shashan aur vyavastha ke prateek hain.
3. Indriyon mein Mann — kyunki aankh, kaan, naak sab bekaar hain agar mann unke saath na judhe. Mann hi sabka neta hai.
4. Praaniyon mein Chetna — woh shakti jiske bina sharir kewal mitti ka dher hai!

Sharir nahi, andar ki chetna hi asli jeevan hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apne mann ko saadhna sabse badi sadhana hai, kyunki jiska mann uske vash mein hai, uski saari indriyaan sahi disha mein chalti hain. Apni bheetari chetna ko sada jagrut rakho.

verses.sanskrit:
रुद्राणां शङ्करश्चास्मि वित्तेशो यक्षरक्षसाम् ।
वसूनां पावकश्चास्मि मेरुः शिखरिणामहम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Rudranam Shankarash Casmi Vittesho Yaksha Rakshasam,
Vasunam Pavakash Casmi Meruh Shikharinam Aham.
verses.englishMeaning: Among the Rudras, I am Lord Shiva (Shankara); among the Yakshas and Rakshasas, I am Kubera, the lord of wealth; among the Vasus, I am Agni (fire); and among the towering mountains, I am Mount Meru.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Gyaarah Rudron mein main Shankara (Shiv) hoon; yakshon aur rakshason mein dhanapati Kuber hoon; aath Vasuon mein agni hoon; aur shikhar wale parvaton mein main Sumeru parvat hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yahan shakti, dhan, urja aur unchaai ke mukhya kendra bataye gaye hain:
1. Rudron mein Bhagavan Shankar — jo kalyankari aur dhyan ke swami hain.
2. Yakshon mein Kuber — jo samridhi ke adhipati hain.
3. Vasuon mein Pavaka (Agni) — jo sabko pavitra karti hai aur urja deti hai.
4. Parvaton mein Meru — jo sthirta aur aakaash chhoone wali unchaai ka prateek hai.

Krishna dikhate hain ki chahe destruction ki shakti ho (Rudra), dhan ho (Kuber), ya pavitrata ho (Agni) — sabke peeche wahi ek shakti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Agni ki tarah pavitra bano, Shankar ki tarah shant aur kalyankari bano, aur Meru parvat ki tarah sankaton ke beech adig aur sthir raho.

verses.sanskrit:
पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम् ।
सेनानीनामहं स्कन्दः सरसामस्मि सागरः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Purodhasam Ca Mukhyam Mam Viddhi Partha Brihaspatim,
Senaninam Aham Skandah Sarasam Asmi Sagarah.
verses.englishMeaning: Among the royal priests, O Partha, know me to be the chief, Brihaspati. Among warrior generals, I am Kartikeya (Skanda); and among reservoirs of water, I am the boundless ocean.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Partha! Purohiton aur aacharyon mein mukhya Brihaspati mujhe jaano; senapatiyon mein main Skanda (Kartikeya) hoon; aur jalaashayon mein main athah samundar hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna teen shreshtha vibhootiyan batate hain:
1. Brihaspati — devtaon ke guru, jo buddhi aur gyaan ke bhandaar hain.
2. Skanda (Kartikeya) — devtaon ke senapati, jo adharma ke khilaaf yuddh mein adig veer hain.
3. Samudra — jo saari nadiyon ko apne andar samet leta hai par kabhi apni seema nahi laanghta.

Jab samundar ko dekho, toh uski gehraai aur vishaalta mein Ishwar ki anantata ko mehsoos karo.
verses.lifeLesson: Gyaan mein Brihaspati ki tarah samajhdar bano, annyay ke khilaaf Kartikeya ki tarah nidar bano, aur samundar ki tarah vishal hriday bano jo sabko apna leta hai par apni maryada nahi todta.

verses.sanskrit:
महर्षीणां भृगुरहं गिरामस्म्येकमक्षरम् ।
यज्ञानां जपयज्ञोऽस्मि स्थावराणां हिमालयः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Maharshinam Bhrigur Aham Giram Asmy Ekam Aksharam,
Yajnanam Japa Yajno Smi Sthavaranam Himalayah.
verses.englishMeaning: Among the great sages, I am Bhrigu; among sacred vibrations of speech, I am the single syllable Om; among all sacrifices, I am the silent chanting of the holy names (Japa Yajna); and among immovable giants, I am the holy Himalayas.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Maharshiyon mein main Bhrigu rishi hoon; shabdon aur vani mein main ek-akshar Omkar hoon; yajnon mein main japa-yajna (naam-jap) hoon; aur sthir achal cheezon mein main Himalaya hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok sadhana ke do sabse aasan aur shreshtha tarike batata hai:
1. "Giram Asmy Ekam Aksharam" — shabdon mein Omkar. Om bolne se poori chetna sthir ho jaati hai.
2. "Yajnanam Japa Yajno Smi" — yajnon mein Japa-Yajna!
Havan karne ke liye samagri, paise aur samay chahiye, par naam-jap ke liye kuch nahi chahiye! Kahi bhi, kabhi bhi, mann hi mann Ishwar ka naam lene se bada koi yajna nahi hai. Isme na hinsa hai, na kharcha, bas pavitra dhyan hai.
3. Achal cheezon mein Himalaya — jo pavitrata, dhyan aur shanti ka prateek hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Naam-jap (Japa) sabse saral aur sabse shaktishaali sadhana hai. Roz kuch pal khamoshi mein Ishwar ka naam lo; yeh mann ko Himalaya ki tarah shant aur pavitra bana deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अश्वत्थः सर्ववृक्षाणां देवर्षीणां च नारदः ।
गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथः सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Ashvatthah Sarva Vrikshanam Devarshinam Ca Naradah,
Gandharvanam Citrarathah Siddhanam Kapilo Munih.
verses.englishMeaning: Among all trees, I am the sacred Peepal (Ashvattha); among divine sages, I am Narada; among heavenly musicians (Gandharvas), I am Citraratha; and among perfected beings (Siddhas), I am Sage Kapila.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Samast pedon mein main Ashvattha (peepal ka ped) hoon; devarshiyon mein main Narada hoon; gandharvon mein main Chitraratha hoon; aur siddha purushon mein main Kapila Muni hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
1. Peepal ka ped — jise poojya maana jaata hai, jo din-raat oxygen deta hai aur jiske neeche baithkar Buddha ko gyaan mila tha.
2. Narada — jinki veena par hamesha Ishwar ka kirtan rehta hai aur jo sabke hit ki sochte hain.
3. Chitraratha — sangeet aur kala ke prateek.
4. Kapila Muni — jinhone Sankhya Darshan (spiritual science) ka gyaan srishti ko diya.

Prakriti, sangeet, bhakti aur gyaan — in sabke sarvashreshtha roop mein Ishwar hi vyapt hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Peepal ki tarah doosron ko jeevan aur chhaon do, Narada ki tarah jeevan ko sangeet aur bhakti se bharo, aur Kapila Muni ki tarah gyaan aur vivek ko aadhar banao.

verses.sanskrit:
उच्चैःश्रवसमश्वानां विद्धि माममृतोद्भवम् ।
ऐरावतं गजेन्द्राणां नराणां च नराधिपम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Uccaishravasam Ashvanam Viddhi Mam Amritodbhavam,
Airavatam Gajendranam Naranam Ca Naradhipam.
verses.englishMeaning: Among horses, know me to be Ucchaishravas, born of the nectar of the ocean churning; among royal elephants, Airavata; and among human beings, the righteous king.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Ghodon mein amrit-manthan se nikla Ucchaishravas ghoda mujhe jaano; haathiyon mein Airavata haathi; aur manushyon mein praja-palak raja main hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Samundar manthan se nikle divya ashwa Ucchaishravas (tezi aur sundarta ka prateek), Indra ke haathi Airavata (bal aur gaurav ka prateek), aur manushyon mein "Naradhipam" (raja).

Raja ka matlab yahan koi tanaashah nahi hai, balki praja ka palan karne wala nyayapriya sevak-neta hai. Jo neta sabki bhalai, suraksha aur nyay ke liye kaam karta hai, uske andar Ishwar ka tej hota hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Netritva (leadership) adhikar jatane ke liye nahi, balki doosron ki seva aur raksha karne ke liye hota hai. Jo doosron ke kalyan ke liye zimmedari uthata hai, wahi sachcha neta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
आयुधानामहं वज्रं धेनूनामस्मि कामधुक् ।
प्रजनश्चास्मि कन्दर्पः सर्पाणामस्मि वासुकिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Ayudhanam Aham Vajram Dhenunam Asmi Kamadhuk,
Prajanash Casmi Kandarpa Sarpanam Asmi Vasukih.
verses.englishMeaning: Among weapons, I am the celestial thunderbolt (Vajra); among cows, I am Kamadhenu, the wish-fulfilling cow; among causes of procreation, I am Kandarpa (divine love); and among serpents, I am Vasuki.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hathiyaaron mein main Maharshi Dadhichi ki asthiyon se bana Vajra hoon; gaayon mein main Kamadhenu hoon; vansh badhane wale prem mein main Kamadeva hoon; aur sarpon mein main Vasuki hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
1. Vajra — yeh aam hathiyar nahi hai, balki Maharshi Dadhichi ke aatm-balidaan se bana shastra hai. Tyag se aane wali taaqat hi Vajra hai.
2. Kamadhenu — jo sabki zaroorat poori karti hai, nishkaam poshan ka prateek.
3. Kandarpa — srishti ke srijan ke peeche ka pavitra prem.
4. Vasuki — woh naag jinhone amrit manthan mein rassi bankar samundar ko mathne mein sahayata ki thi.

In sabhi prateekon mein balidaan, sewa aur srijan ki shakti dikhayi deti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sachchi taaqat balidaan aur sewa se paida hoti hai, hinsa se nahi. Kamadhenu ki tarah niswarth bano aur apne har prayas ko srijanatmak banao.

verses.sanskrit:
अनन्तश्चास्मि नागानां वरुणो यादसामहम् ।
पितॄणामर्यमा चास्मि यमः संयमतामहम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Anantash Casmi Naganam Varuno Yadasam Aham,
Pitrinam Aryama Casmi Yamah Samyamatam Aham.
verses.englishMeaning: Among the celestial Nagas, I am Ananta (Sheshanaga); among water deities, I am Varuna; among the departed ancestors, I am Aryama; and among controllers and lawgivers, I am Yama (the lord of justice and death).
verses.hinglishMeaning: Naagon mein main Ananta (Sheshnaag) hoon; jal-devtaon mein Varuna hoon; pitron mein Aryama hoon; aur niyam aur anushashan rakhne walon mein main Yamaraj hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
1. Sheshnaag (Ananta) — jinke upar Bhagavan Vishnu vishram karte hain, jo sthirta aur shanti ke aadhar hain.
2. Varuna — jo jal aur shuddhata ke adhipati hain.
3. Aryama — purvajon mein shreshtha.
4. Yamaraj — log mrityu se darte hain, par Yamaraj dharma aur nishpaksh nyay ke devta hain. Wahan koi rishwat ya bhedbhav nahi chalta — sabke karmon ka barabar hisaab hota hai.

Yamaraj anushashan aur niyam ke prateek hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Niyam aur anushashan se mat daro; anushashan hi jeevan ko sthir aur pavitra banata hai. Nishpaksh bano aur har sthiti mein dharma aur nyay ka saath do.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रह्लादश्चास्मि दैत्यानां कालः कलयतामहम् ।
मृगाणां च मृगेन्द्रोऽहं वैनतेयश्च पक्षिणाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Prahladash Casmi Daityanam Kalah Kalayatam Aham,
Mriganam Ca Mrigendro Ham Vainateyash Ca Pakshinam.
verses.englishMeaning: Among the Daityas (demons), I am the devout devotee Prahlada; among measurers and reckoners, I am all-devouring Time; among beasts, I am the lion, king of animals; and among birds, I am Garuda, the swift eagle.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Daityon mein main param bhakta Prahlada hoon; hisaab rakhne walon mein main Kaal (Time) hoon; pashuon mein main jungle ka raja sher hoon; aur pakshiyon mein main Garuda hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
1. Daityon mein Prahlada — asuri vansh mein paida hokar bhi jinka vishwas koi toofan nahi hila saka! Prahlada dikhate hain ki parivar ya mahaul kaisa bhi ho, aatma chahe toh param pavitra reh sakti hai.
2. Kaal (Time) — samay sabse bada shaktishaali hai. Samay ke aage sab jhukte hain, samay har ghav bharta hai aur har ahankar ko mitaata hai.
3. Sher — nidarta aur garima ka prateek.
4. Garuda — unchi udaan aur divya sewa ka prateek.
verses.lifeLesson: Prahlada ki tarah har mushkil mahaul ke beech apne vishwas par adig raho. Samay ki keemat samjho, kyunki beeta hua samay kabhi laut kar nahi aata.

verses.sanskrit:
पवनः पवतामस्मि रामः शस्त्रभृतामहम् ।
झषाणां मकरश्चास्मि स्रोतसामस्मि जाह्नवी ॥
verses.transliteration:
Pavanah Pavatam Asmi Ramah Shastrabhritam Aham,
Jhashanam Makarash Casmi Srotasam Asmi Jahnavi.
verses.englishMeaning: Among purifiers, I am the cleansing wind; among wielders of weapons, I am Lord Rama; among aquatic creatures, I am the mighty crocodile (or shark); and among flowing rivers, I am the holy Ganga (Jahnavi).
verses.hinglishMeaning: Pavitra karne walon mein main vayu (pavan) hoon; shastradhari veeron mein main Maryada Purushottam Shri Ram hoon; jal-charon mein main makar hoon; aur behti hui nadiyon mein main pavitra Ganga hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Char param pavitra aur shaktishaali roop:
1. Pavan — hawa jo sabko saaf karti hai aur jeevan deti hai.
2. Shri Ram — shastradhariyon mein Bhagavan Ram! Jo maryada, dharma, sachchaai aur kalyan ke sarvochha adarsh hain. Jinhone hathiyar uthaye par kabhi Maryada nahi todi.
3. Makar — jal mein sabse tejasvi aur shaktishaali jeev.
4. Ganga — jo Himalaya se nikal kar har kan ko paavan karti hai aur mukti deti hai.

Shri Ram aur Ganga ka naam sunte hi dil shradha aur shanti se bhar jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Bhagavan Ram ki tarah har paristhiti mein maryada aur dharma par chalo. Ganga ki tarah pavitra bano jo bina kisi bhedbhav ke sabki pyaas bujhati hai aur sabka kalyan karti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्गाणामादिरन्तश्च मध्यं चैवाहमर्जुन ।
अध्यात्मविद्या विद्यानां वादः प्रवदतामहम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sarganam Adir Antash Ca Madhyam Caivaham Arjuna,
Adhyatma Vidya Vidyanam Vadah Pravadatam Aham.
verses.englishMeaning: Of all creations, I am the beginning, the end, and also the middle, O Arjuna. Among all fields of knowledge, I am the supreme science of the Self (Adhyatma Vidya); and among debate and discourse, I am the constructive pursuit of truth (Vada).
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Samast srishtiyon ka aadi, madhya aur ant main hi hoon. Vidyaon mein main aatam-vidya (aadhyaatma-vidya) hoon; aur charcha-vivaad karne walon mein main satya ki khoj karne wala "Vada" hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
1. Vidyaon mein Adhyatma Vidya:
Duniya mein physics, chemistry, medicine, technology hazaron vidyayein hain — sab achhi hain. Par woh bahar ka gyaan deti hain. Aatam-vidya batati hai ki "Main kaun hoon? Mera lakshya kya hai?" Yeh vidya sabki mool hai.
2. Vivaad mein "Vada":
Shastra-arth teen tarah ke hote hain:
- Jalpa — doosre ko neecha dikhane ke liye behes.
- Vitanda — bina wajah khamiyan nikaalna.
- Vada — dono paksh baithkar sirf "satya" tak pahunchna chahein.
Krishna kehte hain: "Main satya ki khoj wala Vada hoon."
verses.lifeLesson: Behes doosron ko harane ke liye mat karo, balki sachchaai tak pahunchne ke liye karo. Saari padhai ke beech apne aap ko jaanna hi sabse zaroori gyaan hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अक्षराणामकारोऽस्मि द्वन्द्वः सामासिकस्य च ।
अहमेवाक्षयः कालो धाताहं विश्वतोमुखः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Aksharanam Akaro Smi Dvandvah Samasikasya Ca,
Aham Evakshayah Kalo Dhataham Vishvatomukhah.
verses.englishMeaning: Among letters of the alphabet, I am the letter "A"; among compound words in grammar, I am the dual compound (Dvandva); I am truly inexhaustible, eternal Time; and I am the universal sustainer facing all directions.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aksharon mein main pehla akshar "A" (akaar) hoon; samason mein main Dvandva samaas hoon; main hi avinashi, anant Kaal hoon; aur sabka palan-poshan karne wala vishwaroop vidhata hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
1. Aksharon mein "A" (Akaar):
Sanskrit aur Hindi varnamala mein har akshar "A" ke bina bola hi nahi ja sakta (k + a = ka). "A" sabka aadi aur aadhar hai.
2. Dvandva Samaas:
Vyakaran mein aisa samaas jisme dono shabdon ka barabar mahatva ho (jaise Mata-Pita, Radhe-Shyam). Yahan barabari aur samta hai.
3. Akshay Kaal:
Sansaar ki ghadi ruk sakti hai, par Ishwar ka anant samay kabhi khatam nahi hota.
4. Vishvatomukhah:
Ishwar ke mukh har taraf hain, woh har jagah dekh rahe hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Har kisi ko barabar aadar do, jaise Dvandva samaas mein dono pad barabar hote hain. Samay ki shashwatta ko samjho aur har pal ko achhe karmon mein lagao.

verses.sanskrit:
मृत्युः सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च भविष्यताम् ।
कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा ॥
verses.transliteration:
Mrityuh Sarva Harash Caham Udbhavash Ca Bhavishyatam,
Kirtih Shrir Vak Ca Narinam Smritir Medha Dhritih Kshama.
verses.englishMeaning: I am all-devouring death, and I am the generator of all that is yet to be born. Among feminine qualities, I am fame, fortune, fine speech, memory, wisdom, steadfast fortitude, and patient forgiveness.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main sab kuch chheen lene wali mrityu hoon, aur bhavishya mein paida hone walon ka srijan-srot hoon. Striyon ke divya gunon mein main kirti, shree (shobha/samridhi), vani, smriti, medha (buddhi), dhriti (dhairya) aur kshama hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna jeevan ke dono chhoron ko ek shlok mein jodte hain:
- "Mrityuh Sarva Harah" — maut jo ek pal mein saara ahankar, daulat aur rishte chheen leti hai.
- "Udbhavash Ca" — naye jeevan ki nayi muskaan aur srijan.

Aur fir stri-shakti ke 7 param divya gun:
1. Kirti — achhi shohrat.
2. Shree — sundarta aur shobha.
3. Vak — madhur aur satya vani.
4. Smriti — achhi yaadasht.
5. Medha — gehra vivek aur gyaan.
6. Dhriti — kathin waqt mein dhairya.
7. Kshama — maaf karne ka bada dil.
Yeh saaton gun Ishwar ki hi divya shakti hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Dhairya, kshama, madhur vani aur samajhdari — yeh gun kisi bhi vyakti aur samaj ko pavitra banate hain. Maut ke sach ko yaad rakhkar vinamra bano aur in gunon ko apne bheetar dharan karo.

verses.sanskrit:
बृहत्साम तथा साम्नां गायत्री छन्दसामहम् ।
मासानां मार्गशीर्षोऽहमृतूनां कुसुमाकरः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Brihat Sama Tatha Samnam Gayatri Chandasam Aham,
Masanam Margashirsho Ham Ritunam Kusumakarah.
verses.englishMeaning: Among the hymns of the Sama Veda, I am the Brihat-sama; among poetic meters, I am the sacred Gayatri meter; among months of the year, I am Margashirsha (Agrahayana); and among seasons, I am flowering Spring (Vasant).
verses.hinglishMeaning: Samaveda ke geeton mein main Brihat-sama hoon; chhandon mein main pavitra Gayatri chhand hoon; maheeno mein main Margashirsha (Mangsir) hoon; aur rituon mein main phoolon se mehki hui Vasant ritu hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
1. Brihat-sama — Samaveda ka sabse ooncha aur divya mantra-gaan.
2. Gayatri Chhand — jisme prashiddh Gayatri Mantra racha gaya hai, jo aatam-prakaash aur gyaan ka mool mantra hai.
3. Margashirsha maas — yeh maheena na zyaada garm hota hai na thanda, fasal pakti hai aur sadhana ke liye sabse anukool hota hai.
4. Vasant Ritu — rituon ka raja! Jahan har ped-paudha naye phoolon aur patti se mehakta hai, poori prakriti anand mein jhoomti hai.

Prakriti ki taazgi, phoolon ki khushboo aur Gayatri mantra ki pavitrata mein Ishwar sakshat virajmaan hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Vasant ritu ki tarah apne jeevan ko utsah, taazgi aur anand se bharo. Gayatri mantra ki tarah apne mann ko gyaan aur satya ke prakaash se roshan karo.

verses.sanskrit:
द्यूतं छलयतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम् ।
जयोऽस्मि व्यवसायोऽस्मि सत्त्वं सत्त्ववतामहम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Dyutam Chalayatam Asmi Tejas Tejasvinam Aham,
Jayo Smi Vyavasayo Smi Sattvam Sattvavatam Aham.
verses.englishMeaning: Among cheats and deceivers, I am the gamble of dice; of the splendid, I am the radiant splendor. I am victory, I am resolute determination, and of the virtuous, I am the purity and goodness.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Chhal karne walon mein main juya (dyut) hoon; tejasviyon mein tejasvita hoon; vijay main hoon; dridh udyam aur sankalp main hoon; aur satvik purushon ka satva-bhav main hi hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yahan ek bada rochak shabd hai — "Dyutam Chalayatam Asmi" (Chhal karne walon mein juya).
Kyun? Juya ek aisi cheez hai jo acche-acche ghamandi aur chalak logon ka sab kuch chheen kar unhe mitti mein mila deti hai — jaise Mahabharat mein hua tha. Woh dand aur niyati ka prateek hai.

Aur doosri taraf:
- "Tejas" — chamak aur aatmik tej.
- "Jayah" — dharma ki jeet.
- "Vyavasayah" — dridh nishchay aur parishram.
- "Sattvam" — dil ki sachchaai aur pavitrata.

Har sankalp, har mehnat aur har jeet ke peeche Ishwar ki hi shakti kaam karti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Dridh nishchay aur parishram hi jeet ka rasta banate hain. Galat raste (jaise juya ya chhal) insaan ka sab kuch mita dete hain, isliye satvik aur imaandar bano.

verses.sanskrit:
वृष्णीनां वासुदेवोऽस्मि पाण्डवानां धनञ्जयः ।
मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासः कवीनामुशना कविः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Vrishninam Vasudevo Smi Pandavanam Dhananjayah,
Muninam Apy Aham Vyasah Kavinam Ushana Kavih.
verses.englishMeaning: Among the descendants of Vrishni, I am Krishna (Vasudeva); among the Pandavas, I am Arjuna (Dhananjaya); among silent ascetics, I am Sage Vyasa; and among visionary poets, I am Sage Ushana (Shukracharya).
verses.hinglishMeaning: Vrishni-vanshiyon mein main Vasudeva-putra Shri Krishna hoon; Pandavon mein Dhananjaya (Arjun) main hoon; muniyon mein Maharshi Vyasa hoon; aur door-drishta kaviyon mein main Shukracharya hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok kitna adbhut aur prem-bhara hai!
Krishna Arjun se kehte hain: "Pandavon mein main Arjun hoon!"
Sochiye, Krishna Arjun ko apna hi swaroop keh rahe hain! Arjun Krishna ka itna priya bhakta aur sathi hai ki Krishna use khud se alag nahi maante.

Aur Vrishni vansh mein Krishna khud ko kehte hain — Vasudeva Krishna.
Muniyon mein Maharshi Vyasa — jinhone Mahabharat, Puran aur Gita likhi.
Kaviyon mein Shukracharya — jinke paas param door-drishti aur vidya thi.

Bhakta aur Bhagavan ka milan itna gehra hota hai ki dono ek ho jaate hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Bhakti ki shakti itni mahan hoti hai ki Ishwar apne bhakta ko apna hi swaroop bana lete hain. Prem mein koi faasla nahi rehta, do aatmaayein ek ho jaati hain.

verses.sanskrit:
दण्डो दमयतामस्मि नीतिरस्मि जिगीषताम् ।
मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतामहम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Dando Damayatam Asmi Nitir Asmi Jigishatam,
Maunam Caivasmi Guhyanam Jnanam Jnanavatam Aham.
verses.englishMeaning: Among all instruments of law and order, I am the rod of punishment; among those seeking victory, I am noble statesmanship and righteous policy (Niti); of hidden secrets, I am silence; and of the wise, I am wisdom.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Anushashan aur nyay rakhne walon mein main danda (nyay-dand) hoon; jeetne ki ichha rakhne walon mein main shreshtha niti hoon; gupt rahasyon mein main maun (khamoshi) hoon; aur gyan-vaano ka gyaan main hi hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
1. Danda — kanoon aur nyay ki taaqat jo samaj ko apradh se bachati hai.
2. Niti — sahi rasta aur vyavastha. Bina niti aur imaandari ke koi jeet tik nahi sakti.
3. Maunam (Silence) — sabse gehra rahasya!
Bole hue shabd kharch ho jaate hain, par maun mein anant shakti hoti hai. Rahasya ko surakshit rakhne ki sabse badi taaqat khamoshi hai. Dhyan ka sabse ooncha anubhav shabdon mein nahi, maun mein hota hai.
4. Gyaan — gyaniyon ki samajh aur vivek.
verses.lifeLesson: Bolne se zyaada maun ki taaqat ko pehchano. Sahi niti aur imaandari se chalo, kyunki bina niti ke mili jeet kshanik hoti hai, jabki sachcha vivek sada saath deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यच्चापि सर्वभूतानां बीजं तदहमर्जुन ।
न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yac Capi Sarva Bhutanam Bijam Tad Aham Arjuna,
Na Tad Asti Vina Yat Syan Maya Bhutam Caracaram.
verses.englishMeaning: Furthermore, O Arjuna, I am the generating seed of all existences. There is no entity — moving or unmoving — that can possibly exist devoid of me.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aur hey Arjun! Samast jeevon ki utpatti ka jo beej hai, woh bhi main hi hoon. Aisa koi bhi char (chalne wala) ya achar (sthir) praani ya vastu nahi hai, jo mere bina astitva mein reh sake.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna saari baaton ka mool bindu samjhaate hain:
"Maine itni saari vibhootiyan batayi, par aakhiri sach yeh hai ki poori srishti ka beej main hoon."

Jaise gehun ke daane ke bina roti nahi ban sakti, mitti ke bina bartan nahi ban sakta, paani ke bina barf nahi ban sakti — waise hi Ishwar ke bina koi bhi cheez, koi bhi jeev, koi bhi tara astitva mein aa hi nahi sakta.

Chhoti si cheenti se lekar vishaal aakaashganga tak, sab kuch usi ek beej se ubharta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Srishti ki har cheez aur har praani mein ek hi chetna ka astitva hai. Kisi ko tuchh ya bekaar mat samjho; sabke bheetar usi mool beej ka ansh hai.

verses.sanskrit:
नान्तोऽस्ति मम दिव्यानां विभूतीनां परन्तप ।
एष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तो विभूतेर्विस्तरो मया ॥
verses.transliteration:
Nanto Asti Mama Divyanam Vibhutinam Parantapa,
Esha Tuddheshatah Prokto Vibhuter Vistaro Maya.
verses.englishMeaning: There is no end to my divine manifestations, O scorcher of enemies! What has been spoken by me is merely a brief glimpse, an illustrative hint of the infinite expanse of my glory.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Parantapa Arjun! Meri divya vibhootiyon ka koi ant nahi hai. Yeh jo maine bataya hai, yeh toh meri anant mahima ka bas ek chhota sa sanket aur udaharan maatra hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna kehte hain: "Arjun, maine jo kuch bataya, woh toh anant aakaash ke samne ek jharokhe jaisa hai!"

Jaise koi poore Himalaya ki taarif mein bas do-chaar barfili chotiyan dikha de. Ishwar ki sundarta aur shaktiyon ka varnan na shabdon mein ho sakta hai, na kitaabon mein samaya ja sakta hai.

Yeh jaan lene ke baad insaan ke dil mein se ahankar poori tarah mit jaata hai aur anant shradha jagti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Ishwar ki kripa aur shakti anant hai, use kisi seema mein nahi baandha ja sakta. Vinamra bano aur is vishaal srishti ke har roop mein us param shakti ko pranaam karo.

verses.sanskrit:
यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा ।
तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसम्भवम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yad Yad Vibhutimat Sattvam Shrimad Urjitam Eva Va,
Tat Tad Evavagaccha Tvam Mama Tejo Amsha Sambhavam.
verses.englishMeaning: Whatever reality there is that is glorious, prosperous, beautiful, or exceptionally powerful — know that every such thing springs from a mere spark of my divine splendor.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo kuch bhi srishti mein vibhooti-yukt (prabhavshaali), shree-yukt (sundar aur samriddh), ya shakti aur bal se bhara hua hai — us sabko tum mere hi tej ke ek chhote se ansh se utpanna hua samjho.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Gita ka ek universal formula hai!
Krishna kehte hain: "Arjun, agar tumhe har cheez ki alag-alag soochi yaad na rahe, toh bas yeh ek niyam yaad rakh lo:
Kahin bhi agar tumhe koi adbhut shakti dikhe, koi bemisaal sundarta dikhe, koi prabhavshaali gyaan dikhe, koi mahan kalakaar ya veerta dikhe — toh samajh lena ki yeh sab us vyakti ki apni kamayi nahi hai, balki mere anant tej ka ek chhota sa ansh wahan chamak raha hai!"

Jaise hire ki chamak hire ki nahi, suraj ki roshni ka reflection hoti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apne kisi bhi gun, sundarta ya taaqat par ghamand mat karo; sab kuch Ishwar ki kripa ka ek ansh hai. Dusron ki achhai aur kshamta dekhkar jalan mat karo, balki usme Ishwar ke tej ka aadar karo.

verses.sanskrit:
अथवा बहुनैतेन किं ज्ञातेन तवार्जुन ।
विष्टभ्याहमिदं कृत्स्नमेकांशेन स्थितो जगत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Athava Bahunaitena Kim Jnatena Tavarjuna,
Vishtabhyaham Idam Kritsnam Ekamshena Sthito Jagat.
verses.englishMeaning: Or, what need is there, O Arjuna, for all this detailed knowledge? Suffice it to say that with a mere fraction of my being, I pervade and continually support this entire cosmic universe!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Athava hey Arjun! Is saare vistar ko bahut zyaada janne ki kya aavashyakta hai? Main apne keval ek ansh maatra se is poore vishva aur brahmand ko dharan karke sthit hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Chapter 10 ka aakhiri aur poore brahmand ko hila dene wala shlok hai!
Krishna kehte hain: "Arjun, itni lambi baatein chhod do. Bas ek aakhiri sach samajh lo:
Yeh jitna bada brahmand tum dekh rahe ho — arbon taare, dharti, aakaash, soorya, devta aur samast jeev — yeh sab mere keval EK CHHOTE SE ANSH mein sthit hai!"

99% se bhi zyaada param satya toh srishti se pare, shashwat roop mein virajmaan hai. Srishti Ishwar ko nahi baandh sakti, Ishwar srishti ko apne ek kan mein sambhale hue hain.

Is vishal roop ki jhalki hi agle chapter (Adhyay 11: Vishwaroop Darshan) ka dwaar kholti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Humara jeevan, humari chintayein aur humara sansaar us anant srishti ke samne ek tinke jaisa hai. Apni choti si chintaon se upar utho aur us param shakti par poora bharosa rakho jo poore brahmand ko sambhale hue hai.

summary: The eleventh chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga. In this chapter, Arjuna requests Krishna to reveal His Universal Cosmic Form that encompasses all the universes, the entire existence. Arjuna is granted divine vision to be able to see the entirety of creation in the body of the Supreme Lord Krishna.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
मदनुग्रहाय परमं गुह्यमध्यात्मसंज्ञितम् ।
यत्त्वयोक्तं वचस्तेन मोहोऽयं विगतो मम ॥ १॥
verses.transliteration:
Arjuna Uvacha:
Mad Anugrahaya Paramam Guhyam Adhyatma Samjnitam,
Yat Tvayoktam Vachas Tena Moho Yam Vigato Mama.
verses.englishMeaning: Arjuna said: Out of supreme compassion for me, You have revealed this most confidential spiritual wisdom regarding the Self. By hearing Your words, my delusion and confusion have now been dispelled.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Arjun ne kaha: Mujh par kripa karke aapne aatma aur parmatma ke baare mein jo param gupt aadhyaatmik gyaan diya hai, use sunkar mera saara moh aur bhram ab door ho gaya hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun Shri Krishna se kehte hain ki pichhle adhyayon mein aapne jo aatma, karm aur Ishwar ka gyaan diya, usne meri aankhon par pada moh ka parda hata diya hai.

Pehle Arjun apno ke moh mein phas kar kartavya se bhag raha tha. Lekin sachcha aadhyaatmik gyaan andhere mein diye ki tarah kaam karta hai aur insaan ko uske mool kartavya ki sachchaai dikhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab jeevan mein moh aur dvidha gher le, tab sahi margdarshan aur aatm-gyaan hi humein darr aur bhram se aazad kar sakta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया ।
त्वत्तः कमलपत्राक्ष माहात्म्यमपि चाव्ययम् ॥ २॥
verses.transliteration:
Bhavapyayau Hi Bhutanam Shrutau Vistarasho Maya,
Tvattah Kamala Patraksha Mahatmyam Api Cavyayam.
verses.englishMeaning: O lotus-eyed Lord, I have heard from You in detail about the origin and dissolution of all living beings, as well as Your inexhaustible, eternal majesty.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey kamal ke saman netron wale Shri Krishna! Maine aapse sabhi jeevon ki utpatti aur unke pralaya (ant) ke baare mein vistar se suna hai, aur aapki anant, avinashi mahima ko bhi achhi tarah samjha hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun Bhagavan Krishna ko Kamal-patraksha (kamal ki pankhudi jaise sundar aur komal aankhon wale) kehkar sambodhit karte hain.

Woh kehte hain ki maine sun liya ki kaise saara brahmand aapse nikalta hai aur wapas aap hi mein sama jaata hai. Yeh jaankar Arjun ke mann mein Krishna ke prati aadar aur shradha aur bhi gehri ho gayi hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Srishti ke banne aur mitne ke niyam ko samajh lene se insaan ke andar se mrityu ka darr khatam ho jaata hai aur jeevan mein vinamrata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमेतद्यथात्थ त्वमात्मानं परमेश्वर ।
द्रष्टुमिच्छामि ते रूपमैश्वरं पुरुषोत्तम ॥ ३॥
verses.transliteration:
Evam Etad Yathattha Tvam Atmanam Parameshvara,
Drashtum Icchami Te Rupam Aishvaram Purushottama.
verses.englishMeaning: O Supreme Lord, You are precisely as You describe Yourself to be. Yet, O Supreme Person, I yearn to behold Your divine, sovereign cosmic form with my own eyes!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Parameshwar! Aap apne baare mein jaisa keh rahe hain, woh bilkul sach hai. Parantu hey Purushottam! Main aapke us divya aishvarya-may vishwaroop ko apni aankhon se dekhna chahta hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ko Krishna ki baaton par poora vishwas hai, koi shaq nahi hai. Lekin prem aur bhakti mein ek aisi pyas hoti hai jahan sunne ke baad saakshaatkar karne ki chahat jagti hai.

Arjun Krishna ke us roop ko dekhna chahte hain jisme poora brahmand, grah-nakshatra aur anant srishti samayi hui hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sachche gyaan ke baad anubhav ki pyas jagti hai. Sirf padhna ya sunna kaafi nahi hota, satya ka saakshaatkar karna hi jeevan ki poornata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
मन्यसे यदि तच्छक्यं मया द्रष्टुमिति प्रभो ।
योगेश्वर ततो मे त्वं दर्शयात्मानमव्ययम् ॥ ४॥
verses.transliteration:
Manyase Yadi Tac Chakyam Maya Drashtum Iti Prabho,
Yogeshvara Tato Me Tvam Darshayatmanam Avyayam.
verses.englishMeaning: If You consider that it is possible for me to behold it, O Lord of Yoga, then please graciously reveal Your imperishable, eternal cosmic Self to me!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Prabhu! Agar aapko lagta hai ki main aapke us roop ko dekhne ke kabil hoon, toh hey Yogeshwar! Kripa karke mujhe apne us avinashi swaroop ke darshan karaiye.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yahan Arjun ki apar vinamrata dikhti hai. Woh koi zid ya daawa nahi karte ki 'main aapka sacha mitra hoon toh mujhe dikhao hi dikhao'.

Woh kehte hain: 'Agar aapko lagta hai ki meri aisi yogyata aur shakti hai, tabhi dikhaiye.' Ishwar se kripa maangte samay hamesha vinamra patrata honi chahiye.
verses.lifeLesson: Prarthana mein ahankar ya adhikar nahi, balki vinamrata honi chahiye. Guru aur Ishwar ke aage patra bankar khade hone par hi anugrah praapt hota hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
पश्य मे पार्थ रूपाणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ।
नानाविधानि दिव्यानि नानावर्णाकृतीनि च ॥ ५॥
verses.transliteration:
Shri Bhagavan Uvacha:
Pashya Me Partha Rupani Shatasho Tha Sahasrashah,
Nanavidhani Divyani Nana Varnakritini Ca.
verses.englishMeaning: The Blessed Lord said: Behold, O Partha, My divine forms by the hundreds and thousands, in infinite varieties, celestial, and of countless colors and shapes!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shri Bhagavan ne kaha: Hey Partha! Mere saikadon aur hazaron divya roopon ko dekho, jo alag-alag tarah ke hain, anek rangon ke hain aur tarah-tarah ke aakaron wale hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhagavan Krishna ne Arjun ki vinamra prarthana sunte hi swikar kar li.

Unhone kaha: 'Dekho Arjun, mera koi ek chehra ya ek aakar nahi hai. Mere hazaron divya roop hain — har rang, har prakar aur har aakar mein.' Ishwar ko kisi ek seema ya deewar mein nahi baandha ja sakta.
verses.lifeLesson: Ishwar ki srishti anant vividhta se bhari hai. Jab insaan sankuchit soch chhodkar vishal drishti apnata hai, tab use har kan mein divyata dikhti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
पश्यादित्यान्वसून्रुद्रानश्विनौ मरुतस्तथा ।
बहून्यदृष्टपूर्वाणि पश्याश्चर्याणि भारत ॥ ६॥
verses.transliteration:
Pashyadityan Vasun Rudran Ashvinau Marutas Tatha,
Bahuny Adrishta Purvani Pashyashcaryani Bharata.
verses.englishMeaning: Behold the Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the two Ashvins, and the Maruts, O Bharata! Behold countless extraordinary wonders never before seen by anyone!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Bharatvanshi Arjun! Mujhme barah Adityon ko, aath Vasuon ko, gyarah Rudron ko, dono Ashwini-kumaron ko aur unachas Maruton ko dekho; aur anek aise adbhut chamatkar dekho jo pehle kabhi kisi ne nahi dekhe!
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna Arjun se kehte hain ki tum mere andar srishti ki saari mool shaktiyon ko dekho — prakash ke devta Aditya, vasundhara ko sambhalne wale Vasu, shakti ke prateek Rudra aur pavan devta Marut.

Saath hi aisi anant cheezein dekho jo aaj tak kisi manushya ne kabhi sapne mein bhi nahi dekhi thi.
verses.lifeLesson: Brahmand humari kalpana se kahin zyaada vishal aur rahasyamayi hai. Apne gyaan par ghamand mat karo; anant srishti ke aage hamesha jigyasu bane raho.

verses.sanskrit:
इहैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं पश्याद्य सचराचरम् ।
मम देहे गुडाकेश यच्चान्यद् द्रष्टुमिच्छसि ॥ ७॥
verses.transliteration:
Ihaikastham Jagat Kritsnam Pashyadya Sacaracaram,
Mama Dehe Gudakesha Yac Canyad Drashtum Icchasi.
verses.englishMeaning: Behold here today, O Gudakesha, the entire universe with all its moving and unmoving beings, centered all at once within My body, and whatever else you desire to see!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Gudakesha (Arjun)! Aaj is mere ek hi shareer mein char aur achar samet poore vishva ko ek saath sthit dekho, aur jo kuch bhi tum dekhna chahte ho, use bhi yahan dekh lo.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna kehte hain: 'Arjun, tumhe kahin bhatakne ki zaroorat nahi hai. Poora brahmand — sabhi grah, sitare, ped-paudhe, pashu-pakshi, manushya, bhoot, vartaman aur bhavishya — sab kuch mere is ek shareer ke andar sthit hai.'

Jo kuch bhi dekhne ki tumhari ichha ho, woh sab yahan dikhega.
verses.lifeLesson: Har cheez aur har praani aapas mein jude hue hain kyunki sabka aadhar ek hi param shakti hai. Sabhi mein us ek chetna ka aadar karo.

verses.sanskrit:
न तु मां शक्यसे द्रष्टुमनेनैव स्वचक्षुषा ।
दिव्यं ददामि ते चक्षुः पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम् ॥ ८॥
verses.transliteration:
Na Tu Mam Shakyase Drashtum Anenaiva Sva Cakshusha,
Divyam Dadami Te Cakshuh Pashya Me Yogam Aishvaram.
verses.englishMeaning: However, you cannot see Me with these physical eyes of yours. Therefore, I grant you divine vision! Behold now My sovereign, majestic yogic power!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Lekin tum apni in chamde ki aam aankhon se mujhe dekhne mein samarth nahi ho. Isliye main tumhe divya drishti (divya chakshu) deta hoon. Ab mere param aishvaryapoorna yog-shakti ko dekho!
verses.simpleExplanation:
Humari aam aankhein sirf physical roop aur rang dekh sakti hain. Suraj ki tezz dhoop ko bhi hum sidha nahi dekh sakte, toh anant brahmand ke srot ko kaise dekhenge?

Krishna samjhate hain ki anant ko dekhne ke liye divya drishti (aatmik bodh) ki zaroorat hoti hai. Isliye Krishna ne kripa karke Arjun ko divya drishti pradan ki.
verses.lifeLesson: Gehre aatmik satya ko bahari aankhon ya saste tarka se nahi dekha ja sakta; uske liye shuddh buddhi aur divya drishti ki aavashyakta hoti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच ।
एवमुक्त्वा ततो राजन्महायोगेश्वरो हरिः ।
दर्शयामास पार्थाय परमं रूपमैश्वरम् ॥ ९॥
verses.transliteration:
Sanjaya Uvacha:
Evam Uktva Tato Rajan Maha Yogeshvaro Harih,
Darshayam Asa Parthaya Paramam Rupam Aishvaram.
verses.englishMeaning: Sanjaya said: O King, having spoken thus, the Supreme Lord of Yoga, Hari, revealed unto Partha His supreme, majestic cosmic form!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Sanjay ne kaha: Hey Rajan Dhritarashtra! Aisa kehkar param yogeshwar Bhagavan Shri Krishna ne Arjun ko apna param divya aur aishvarya-may vishwaroop dikhaya.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yahan se Sanjay Raja Dhritarashtra ko Kurukshetra ke maidan ka woh drishya bata rahe hain jise dekh kar dhartein kaanp jayein.

Bhagavan Krishna ne jo kaha, use sach kar dikhaya aur Arjun ke samne apna anant vishwaroop prakat kar diya.
verses.lifeLesson: Ishwar jo sankalp karte hain, woh poora hota hai. Jab satya prakat hota hai, tab saari kalpanayein peeche chhut jaati hain.

verses.sanskrit:
अनेकवक्त्रनयनमनेकाद्भुतदर्शनम् ।
अनेकदिव्याभरणं दिव्यानेकोद्यतायुधम् ॥ १०॥
verses.transliteration:
Aneka Vaktra Nayanam Anekadbhuta Darshanam,
Aneka Divyabharanam Divyanekodyatayudham.
verses.englishMeaning: Having countless mouths and eyes, presenting manifold wondrous sights, adorned with numerous divine ornaments, and brandishing countless celestial weapons raised on high,
verses.hinglishMeaning: Us vishwaroop mein anekon mukh aur netra the, anek hairat-angez aur adbhut drishya the, bahut se divya aabhushan the aur haathon mein uthaye hue anekon divya hathiyar the.
verses.simpleExplanation:
