Arjun ne dekha ki us roop ke hazaron mukh the, hazaron aankhein theen jo har taraf dekh rahi theen.

Har taraf anokhe roop, divya gehne aur haathon mein dharme ki raksha karne wale divya shastra the. Yeh drishya ek hi samay mein atyant sundar aur be-hadd shaktishaali tha.
verses.lifeLesson: Parmatma sirf shanti ke roop nahi hain; woh srishti ke anushashan, suraksha aur adharma ke naash ki sarvochha shakti bhi hain.

verses.sanskrit:
दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम् ।
सर्वाश्चर्यमयं देवमनन्तं विश्वतोमुखम् ॥ ११॥
verses.transliteration:
Divya Malyambara Dharam Divya Gandhanulepanam,
Sarvashcaryamayam Devam Anantam Vishvatomukham.
verses.englishMeaning: Wearing celestial garlands and robes, anointed with heavenly fragrances, all-wonderful, resplendent, boundless, and facing all directions at once,
verses.hinglishMeaning: Unhone divya phoolon ki maalaayein aur divya vastra dharan kiye hue the, divya sugandhit dravyon ka lep laga hua tha; woh samast aashcharyon se yukt, anant aur sabhi dishaon mein mukh wale the.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Us roop mein aisi divya sugandh aur shobha thi jo sansaar mein kahin sambhav nahi hai.

Har disha mein unka chehra tha — aage, peeche, upar, neeche. Yeh darshata hai ki Ishwar se kuch bhi chhipa nahi hai, unki drishti aur upasthiti har sthan par vidyamaan hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Ishwar har jagah maujood hain aur sab kuch dekh rahe hain. Jab insaan is sach ko mehsoos karta hai, toh woh akele mein bhi galat kaam karne se darta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
दिवि सूर्यसहस्रस्य भवेद्युगपदुत्थिता ।
यदि भाः सदृशी सा स्याद्भासस्तस्य महात्मनः ॥ १२॥
verses.transliteration:
Divi Surya Sahasrasya Bhaved Yugapad Utthita,
Yadi Bhah Sadrishi Sa Syad Bhasas Tasya Mahatmanah.
verses.englishMeaning: If a thousand suns were to blaze forth simultaneously in the sky, their collective brilliance might resemble the radiance of that Supreme Soul!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aakash mein yadi hazaron suraj ek saath uday ho jayein, toh unka jo tej aur prakaash hoga, shayad woh bhi us param vishwaroop ke prakaash ke barabar ho sake!
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Gita ka sabse prasiddh aur tejasvi shlok hai!

Sanjay kehte hain: 'Kalpana karo ki aakash mein ek suraj nahi, balki ek hazaar suraj ek hi pal mein chamak uthein — unka tezz kitna prachand hoga? Us vishwaroop ka prakaash usse bhi kahin adhik divya aur aparampaar tha!'
(Yahi woh shlok hai jo atomic bomb ke parikshan ke samay Oppenheimer ne yaad kiya tha).
verses.lifeLesson: Satya aur aatmik shakti ka tej itna vishal hota hai ki uske aage andhere aur jhooth ka koi astitva nahi rehta.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्रैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं प्रविभक्तमनेकधा ।
अपश्यद्देवदेवस्य शरीरे पाण्डवस्तदा ॥ १३॥
verses.transliteration:
Tatraikastham Jagat Kritsnam Pravibhaktam Anekadha,
Apashyad Deva Devasya Sharire Pandavas Tada.
verses.englishMeaning: There, situated in one single place within the body of the God of gods, the Pandava (Arjuna) then beheld the entire cosmos in its manifold divisions!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Usi samay Pandu-putra Arjun ne devon ke dev Shri Krishna ke us divya shareer mein ek hi sthan par anekon hisson mein bante hue poore brahmand ko dekha.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ne dekha ki anant aakashgangayein, taramandal, samudra, pahaad aur vibhinn lok — jo door-door bikhre lagte hain — woh sab Krishna ke ek hi shareer ke andar poori tarah vyavasthit roop se sthit hain.

Sansaar ki alag-alag dikhne wali cheezein vastav mein ek hi dor mein bandhi hui hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Vividhta ke peeche chhipi ekta ko pehchano. Bahar se sab alag dikhte hain, par bheetar se sab us ek parmatma ke ansh hain.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः स विस्मयाविष्टो हृष्टरोमा धनञ्जयः ।
प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं कृताञ्जलिरभाषत ॥ १४॥
verses.transliteration:
Tatah Sa Vismayavishto Hrishtaroma Dhananjayah,
Pranamya Shirasa Devam Kritanjalir Abhashata.
verses.englishMeaning: Then, overwhelmed with profound wonder, his hair standing on end, Dhananjaya (Arjuna) bowed his head in reverence to the Divine Lord and spoke with folded hands.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Uske baad aashcharya aur vismay se bhare hue, romanchit shareer wale Arjun ne sar jhuka kar us vishwaroop Bhagavan ko pranam kiya aur haath jodkar prarthana karne laga.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Is anant drishya ko dekhkar Arjun ka rom-rom khada ho gaya (romanchit ho gaya). Unka dil vinamrata aur aashcharya se bhar gaya.

Unhone apna sar jhukaya aur haath jodkar Krishna ke aage prarthana karna shuru kiya. Jab manushya anant satya ke samne khada hota hai, toh ahankar pighal jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sachcha aashcharya aur gyaan insaan ko ahankar nahi, balki sarvottam vinamrata deta hai. Shradha se sar jhukana hi shreshtha samvedna hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
पश्यामि देवांस्तव देव देहे
सर्वांस्तथा भूतविशेषसङ्घान् ।
ब्रह्माणमीशं कमलासनस्थ-
मृषींश्च सर्वानुरगांश्च दिव्यान् ॥ १५॥
verses.transliteration:
Arjuna Uvacha:
Pashyami Devams Tava Deva Dehe
Sarvams Tatha Bhuta Vishesha Sanghan,
Brahmanam Isham Kamalasanastham
Rishimsh Ca Sarvan Uragamsh Ca Divyan.
verses.englishMeaning: Arjuna said: O Lord, within Your body I see all the gods and the multitudes of various living beings; I see Brahma, the creator, seated upon the lotus flower, Lord Shiva, all the great sages, and the celestial serpents!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Arjun ne kaha: Hey Prabhu! Main aapke shareer mein sabhi devtaon ko, samast praaniyon ke samoohon ko, kamal ke aasan par baithe Brahma ji ko, Mahadev Shiva ko, sabhi rishiyon ko aur divya sarpon ko dekh raha hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun kahte hain ki main dekh raha hoon ki srishti ke rachyita Brahma ji, pralayankari Shiva ji, samast devta aur mahan rishi sab aapke hi bheetar virajmaan hain.

Yeh darshata hai ki koi bhi devta ya shakti Krishna se alag nahi hai; sab us ek param shakti ke hi vividh aayam hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Bhedbhav chhodkar yeh samjho ki srishti ki saari shaktiyan aur sadhu-sant ek hi param aadhar se jude hue hain.

verses.sanskrit:
अनेकबाहूदरवक्त्रनेत्रं
पश्यामि त्वां सर्वतोऽनन्तरूपम् ।
नान्तं न मध्यं न पुनस्तवादिं
पश्यामि विश्वेश्वर विश्वरूप ॥ १६॥
verses.transliteration:
Aneka Bahudara Vaktra Netram
Pashyami Tvam Sarvato Nanta Rupam,
Nantam Na Madhyam Na Punas Tavadim
Pashyami Vishveshvara Vishva Rupa.
verses.englishMeaning: I see You with countless arms, bellies, mouths, and eyes, extending boundlessly on all sides! O Lord of the universe, O Universal Form, I see neither Your end, nor Your middle, nor Your beginning!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Vishweshwar! Hey Vishwaroop! Main aapko anekon bhujaon, peton, mukhon aur aankhon ke saath sabhi or anant roopon mein dekh raha hoon. Mujhe aapka na aadi dikhta hai, na madhya aur na hi ant!
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun jahan bhi dekhte hain, unhe Krishna ka hi vistar dikhta hai. Na koi shuruwaat hai, na koi beech ka hissa aur na koi seema.

Insaan ki buddhi har cheez ko shuru aur khatam hone ke hisaab se samajhti hai, par Ishwar anant hain — unka na koi aadi hai aur na ant.
verses.lifeLesson: Ishwar aur unke gyaan ki koi seema nahi hai. Apne sankuchit daayre se nikal kar anant ko swikar karna seekho.

verses.sanskrit:
किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रिणं च
तेजोराशिं सर्वतो दीप्तिमन्तम् ।
पश्यामि त्वां दुर्निरीक्ष्यं समन्ताद्
दीप्तानलार्कद्युतिमप्रमेयम् ॥ १७॥
verses.transliteration:
Kiritinam Gadinam Cakrinam Ca
Tejo Rashim Sarvato Diptimantam,
Pashyami Tvam Durnirikshyam Samantad
Diptanalarkadyutim Aprameyam.
verses.englishMeaning: I see You wearing a radiant crown, bearing a mace and a discus, a blazing mass of effulgence glowing everywhere, dazzling like blazing fire and the radiant sun, immeasurable and blinding to behold!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main aapko mukut pehne, gada aur chakra dharan kiye, sabhi or prakaashit teja ki rashi ke roop mein dekh raha hoon. Dhak-dhak karti aag aur suraj ke saman tejasvi, jise aankhon se dekhna behad kathin hai aur jo aparampar hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ko us vishwaroop mein Bhagavan Vishnu ke divya chinh dikh rahe hain — mukut, gada aur sudarshan chakra.

Lekin unka prakaash itna tezz hai, jaise dahakti hui jwala aur hazaron suraj ki roshni ek saath ho, jise dekh paana aam aankhon ke liye asambhav tha.
verses.lifeLesson: Satya ki roshni itni prachand hoti hai ki uske aage manushya ki aam drishti thithak jaati hai. Shuddh hriday se hi us tej ko samjha ja sakta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वमक्षरं परमं वेदितव्यं
त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम् ।
त्वमव्ययः शाश्वतधर्मगोप्ता
सनातनस्त्वं पुरुषो मतो मे ॥ १८॥
verses.transliteration:
Tvam Aksharam Paramam Veditavyam
Tvam Asya Vishvasya Param Nidhanam,
Tvam Avyayah Shashvata Dharma Gopta
Sanatanas Tvam Purusho Mato Me.
verses.englishMeaning: You are the supreme imperishable Truth to be known! You are the ultimate resting place of this entire universe! You are the inexhaustible guardian of eternal Dharma! In my understanding, You are the primal, eternal Person!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aap hi janne yogya param avinashi satya hain! Aap hi is sampoorna brahmand ke param aashray hain! Aap hi avyaya aur shashwat dharma ke rakshak hain, aur aap hi sanatan param purush hain — yeh mera nishchit mat hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun kehte hain ki vishwaroop dekhne ke baad ab mujhe poora vishwas ho gaya hai ki shastron mein jis param satya ki baat kahi gayi hai, woh aap hi hain.

Aap hi is srishti ko sambhalne wale hain, dharma ki raksha karne wale hain aur shashwat purush hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Sansaar badalta rehta hai, par Ishwar aur unka satya-dharma shashwat aur achal hai. Usi sanatan satya ko apna aadhar banao.

verses.sanskrit:
अनादिमध्यान्तमनन्तवीर्य-
मनन्तबाहुं शशिसूर्यनेत्रम् ।
पश्यामि त्वां दीप्तहुताशवक्त्रं
स्वतेजसा विश्वमिदं तपन्तम् ॥ १९॥
verses.transliteration:
Anadi Madhyantam Ananta Viryam
Ananta Bahum Shashi Surya Netram,
Pashyami Tvam Dipta Hutasha Vaktram
Sva Tejasa Vishvam Idam Tapantam.
verses.englishMeaning: I behold You without beginning, middle, or end, of infinite power, with boundless arms, with the sun and moon as Your eyes, with blazing fire issuing from Your mouths, scorching this entire universe with Your radiance!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main aapko aadi, madhya aur ant se rahit, anant shakti se yukt, asankhya bhujaon wale, suraj aur chandrama roopi netron wale aur dahakti aag jaise mukhon wale dekh raha hoon, jo apne tej se is poore vishva ko tapt kar rahe hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna ke netra suraj aur chandrama hain — suraj jo tezz aur urja deta hai, aur chandrama jo shanti aur amrit barsata hai.

Unke mukh se nikalne wali jwala srishti ke pralay aur parivartan ka sanket de rahi hai, jo sabhi asatya ko bhasma kar rahi hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Prakriti mein suraj ki garmi aur chandrama ki sheetalta dono zaroori hain. Ishwar shanti aur nyay-shakti dono ke swaroop hain.

verses.sanskrit:
द्यावापृथिव्योरिदमन्तरं हि
व्याप्तं त्वयैकेन दिशश्च सर्वाः ।
दृष्ट्वाद्भुतं रूपमुग्रं तवेदं
लोकत्रयं प्रव्यथितं महात्मन् ॥ २०॥
verses.transliteration:
Dyavaprithivyor Idam Antaram Hi
Vyaptam Tvayaikena Dishash Ca Sarvah,
Drishtvadbhutam Rupam Ugram Tavedam
Lokatrayam Pravyathitam Mahatman.
verses.englishMeaning: The entire space between heaven and earth and all directions are pervaded by You alone! Beholding this wondrous yet terrifying form of Yours, all three worlds are trembling in awe and fear, O Great Soul!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Mahatman! Dharti aur aakash ke beech ka saara antariksh aur sabhi dishaayein akele aapse hi vyapt hain. Aapke is adbhut aur ugra roop ko dekhkar teeno lok vyathit aur bhaybheet ho rahe hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun kehte hain ki aakash aur dharti ke beech jo khali jagah dikhti hai, wahan koi shunya nahi hai — wahan aap hi vyapt hain.

Lekin aapka yeh ugra aur vishal roop itna prachand hai ki teeno lok is adbhut drishya ko dekhkar thar-thar kaanp rahe hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Kudrat aur Ishwar ke niyam behad shaktishaali hain. Unki vishalta ke samne insaan ka ghamand ek tinke ke barabar bhi nahi tikta.

verses.sanskrit:
अमी हि त्वां सुरसङ्घा विशन्ति
केचिद्भीताः प्राञ्जलयो गृणन्ति ।
स्वस्तीत्युक्त्वा महर्षिसिद्धसङ्घाः
स्तुवन्ति त्वां स्तुतिभिः पुष्कलाभिः ॥ २१॥
verses.transliteration:
Ami Hi Tvam Sura Sangha Vishanti
Kecid Bhitah Pranjalayo Grinanti,
Svastity Uktva Maharshi Siddha Sanghah
Stuvanti Tvam Stutibhih Pushkalabhih.
verses.englishMeaning: These hosts of celestial gods are entering into You; some, awe-struck and fearful, praise You with folded hands. Multitudes of great sages and enlightened masters cry, "May there be peace and wellbeing unto the universe!" and glorify You with magnificent hymns.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Devtaon ke samooh aap hi mein pravesh kar rahe hain; kuch bhaybheet hokar haath jodkar aapki prarthana kar rahe hain. Maharshi aur siddha purush "Sanskrit: Svasti! (sabka mangal ho)" kehkar pavitra stutiyon dwara aapka gun-gaan kar rahe hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun dekhte hain ki bade-bade devta bhi is anant tej ke aage sar jhuka rahe hain.

Siddha aur rishi 'Sarve Bhavantu Sukhinah' (sabka kalyan ho) ki bhavna se prarthana kar rahe hain taaki srishti mein shanti bani rahe. Ishwar ki vishalta ke samne shreshtha se shreshtha gyaani bhi prarthana mein leen ho jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Badi shakti aur sankat ke samne khade hokar swarth nahi, balki samast srishti ke kalyan aur shanti ki prarthana karni chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
रुद्रादित्या वसवो ये च साध्या
विश्वेऽश्विनौ मरुतश्चोष्मपाश्च ।
गन्धर्वयक्षासुरसिद्धसङ्घा
वीक्षन्ते त्वां विस्मिताश्चैव सर्वे ॥ २२॥
verses.transliteration:
Rudraditya Vasavo Ye Ca Sadhya
Vishve Shvinau Marutash Coshmapash Ca,
Gandharva Yakshasura Siddha Sangha
Vikshante Tvam Vismitash Caiva Sarve.
verses.englishMeaning: The Rudras, the Adityas, the Vasus, the Sadhyas, the Vishvedevas, the two Ashvins, the Maruts, the ancestors, along with hosts of Gandharvas, Yakshas, Asuras, and Siddhas — all are beholding You in sheer wonder and astonishment!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Gyarah Rudra, barah Aditya, aath Vasu, Sadhya-gana, Vishvedeva, dono Ashwini-kumar, Marut-gana, pitar, tatha Gandharva, Yaksha, Asura aur Siddhon ke samooh — yeh sabhi hairat aur vismay se aapko dekh rahe hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Srishti ki jitni bhi shaktiyan hain — chahe woh devta hon, pitra hon, gandharva hon ya daitya — sabhi us vishwaroop ko dekhkar aashcharyachakita hain.

Sabko yeh ehsaas ho raha hai ki unki apni shakti us ek param shakti ke aage kitni chhoti aur seemit hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sansaar ke bade se bade shaktishaali log bhi Ishwar ke samne nacheez hain. Apni taaqat par kabhi ahankar mat karo.

verses.sanskrit:
रूपं महत्ते बहुवक्त्रनेत्रं
महाबाहो बहुबाहूरुपादम् ।
बहूदरं बहुदंष्ट्राकरालं
दृष्ट्वा लोकाः प्रव्यथितास्तथाहम् ॥ २३॥
verses.transliteration:
Rupam Mahat Te Bahu Vaktra Netram
Maha Baho Bahu Bahuru Padam,
Bahudaram Bahu Damshtra Karalam
Drishtva Lokah Pravyathitas Tathaham.
verses.englishMeaning: Beholding Your colossal form with its countless mouths, eyes, arms, thighs, feet, bellies, and fearful tusks, O mighty-armed Lord, all the worlds are terrified, and so am I!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Mahabaho! Aapke is vishal roop ko jisme anekon mukh, aankhein, bhujaayein, jaanghein, charan, pet aur bhayanak daant hain — use dekhkar sabhi lok vyathit aur bhaybheet hain, aur main bhi thar-thar kaanp raha hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Ab drishya aur bhi gambhir aur ugra ho jaata hai.

Arjun dekhte hain ki is roop mein sirf srishti ka nirmaan hi nahi, balki srishti ka pralay aur Kaal (Samay) ka bhayanak roop bhi hai. Yeh dekhkar Arjun ke bheetar darr aur kampan paida ho jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Kudrat mein sirf phool aur sheetal pavan nahi, tufaan aur pralay bhi hote hain. Jeevan ke kathor sach ko swikar karna hi aatmik paripakvata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
नभःस्पृशं दीप्तमनेकवर्णं
व्यात्ताननं दीप्तविशालनेत्रम् ।
दृष्ट्वा हि त्वां प्रव्यथितान्तरात्मा
धृतिं न विन्दामि शमं च विष्णो ॥ २४॥
verses.transliteration:
Nabhah Sprisham Diptam Aneka Varnam
Vyattananam Dipta Vishala Netram,
Drishtva Hi Tvam Pravyathitantaratma
Dhritim Na Vindami Shamam Ca Vishno.
verses.englishMeaning: Touching the heavens, blazing with radiant colors, mouths gaping wide, and huge glowing eyes — seeing You thus, my innermost soul trembles, O Vishnu, and I find neither composure nor peace!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Vishnu! Aakash ko chhoote hue, anekon rangon se chamakte hue, khule hue mukhon aur dahakti hui vishal aankhon wale aapko dekhkar mera antaratma darr se kaanp raha hai; mujhe na dhairya mil raha hai aur na shanti!
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun yahan Krishna ko pehli baar sidha 'Vishnu' kehkar pukarte hain.

Woh kehte hain: 'Aapka roop aakash se bhi ooncha hai, aankhein agni ki tarah dahak rahi hain. Is prachand drishya ke aage mera dil ghabra raha hai aur mere andar ka dhairya doobta ja raha hai.'
verses.lifeLesson: Jab manushya param shakti ki anant vishalta ke aage khada hota hai, toh uski saari chaturai aur dambh kho jaate hain. Shanti sirf poorn samarpana se aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
दंष्ट्राकरालानि च ते मुखानि
दृष्ट्वैव कालानलसन्निभानि ।
दिशो न जाने न लभे च शर्म
प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास ॥ २५॥
verses.transliteration:
Damshtra Karalani Ca Te Mukhani
Drishtvaiva Kalanala Sannibhani,
Dishon Na Jane Na Labhe Ca Sharma
Prasida Devesha Jagannivasa.
verses.englishMeaning: Beholding Your terrible jaws with fierce tusks resembling the blazing fires of cosmic dissolution, I lose all sense of direction and find no peace! Be gracious, O Lord of gods, O Refuge of the universe!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Pralay-kaal ki aag ke saman dahakne wale aur bhayanak daanton wale aapke mukhon ko dekhkar mujhe dishaon ka gyaan nahi reh gaya hai aur na hi koi shanti mil rahi hai. Hey Devesh! Hey Jagannivas! Mujh par prasanna hoiye aur kripa kijiye.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Pralay ke samay jo agni sab kuch bhasma kar deti hai, wahi agni Krishna ke mukhon se nikal rahi hai.

Arjun itne ghabra gaye hain ki unhe purva, pashchim, uttar, dakshin ka koi hosh nahi raha. Isliye woh hath jodkar daya ki bheekh maangte hain: 'Hey Prabhuji, daya kijiye!'
verses.lifeLesson: Badi bipatti aur darr ke samay Ishwar ki kripa aur sharan hi insaan ka antim aashray hoti hai. Daya ki prarthana dil ko sahas deti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अमी च त्वां धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राः
सर्वे सहैवावनिपालसङ्घैः ।
भीष्मो द्रोणः सूतपुत्रस्तथासौ
सहास्मदीयैरपि योधमुख्यैः ॥ २६॥
verses.transliteration:
Ami Ca Tvam Dhritarashtrasya Putrah
Sarve Sahaivavanipala Sanghaih,
Bhishmo Dronah Suta Putras Tathasau
Sahasmadiyair Api Yodha Mukhyaih.
verses.englishMeaning: All the sons of Dhritarashtra, along with the multitudes of allied kings, Bhishma, Drona, and that charioteer's son (Karna), together with the prominent warriors from our own army as well —
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yeh sabhi Dhritarashtra ke putra (Duryodhan aadi), unke saath samast rajaon ke samooh, Bhishma Pitamah, Dronacharya, aur woh Sutputra Karna — aur humari sena ke bhi pramukh yoddha —
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ab Kurukshetra ke yuddh ka bhavishya dekh rahe hain!

Duryodhan aur uske 100 bhai, unke saathi raja, aur yahan tak ki sabse mahan yoddha jaise Bhishma, Drona, Karna aur Pandav sena ke veer — sab us vishwaroop ki taraf kheenchte chale ja rahe hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Kaal (Samay) ke samne na koi raja bachta hai na koi shaktishaali senapati. Samay sabko barabar hisaab se apne andar samet leta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
वक्त्राणि ते त्वरमाणा विशन्ति
दंष्ट्राकरालानि भयानकानि ।
केचिद्विलग्ना दशनान्तरेषु
सन्दृश्यन्ते चूर्णितैरुत्तमाङ्गैः ॥ २७॥
verses.transliteration:
Vaktrani Te Tvaramana Vishanti
Damshtra Karalani Bhayanakani,
Kecid Vilagna Dashanantareshu
Sandrishyante Curnitair Uttamangaih.
verses.englishMeaning: Are rushing headlong into Your fearful, gaping mouths with terrible tusks! Some are seen caught between Your teeth with their heads crushed to dust!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Badi tezi se daudte hue aapke bhayanak aur daravne mukhon mein pravesh kar rahe hain! Kuch ke sar aapke daanton ke beech phanse hue chur-chur hote dikh rahe hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh daravna drishya dikhata hai ki yuddh mein jo mahasangram hona hai, uska parinaam pehle se tay ho chuka hai.

Veer yoddha jinpar sabko garv tha, woh sab Kaal ke daanton ke beech tinke ki tarah pis rahe hain. Yeh srishti ke Kaal-chakra ka kathor satya hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shareer, sundarta aur balidaan ka ahankar mat karo; yeh sabhi Kaal ke samne pal bhar mein mit jaate hain. Shuddh karm hi shashwat rehte hain.

verses.sanskrit:
यथा नदीनां बहवोऽम्बुवेगाः
समुद्रमेवाभिमुखा द्रवन्ति ।
तथा तवामी नरलोकवीरा
विशन्ति वक्त्राण्यभिविज्वलन्ति ॥ २८॥
verses.transliteration:
Yatha Nadinam Bahavo Mbu Vegah
Samudram Evabhimukha Dravanti,
Tatha Tavam Naraloka Vira
Vishanti Vaktrany Abhivijvalanti.
verses.englishMeaning: Just as the numerous torrential currents of rivers rush swiftly toward the ocean, so too do these great heroes of the mortal world rush into Your blazing mouths!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jaise nadiyon ki anant jal-dharayein tezi se behti hui samudra ki taraf daudti hain, waise hi is manushya-lok ke saare veer yoddha aapke dahakte hue mukhon mein pravesh kar rahe hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Gita ka yeh sundar udaharan hai: Jaise pahadon se nikli hui nadi chahe jitni bhi tez daude, aakhiri mein samudra mein hi sama jaati hai.

Usi tarah sansaar ke saare yoddha aur manushya, chahe jitna bhi ghamand kar lein, aakhiri mein usi param Kaal-srot mein vileen ho jaate hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Jaise nadi ki antim manzil samudra hai, waise hi har jeev ki antim yatra Ishwar ki taraf hai. Is satya ko pehchankar jeevan ko shuddh aur pavitra banao.

verses.sanskrit:
यथा प्रदीप्तं ज्वलनं पतङ्गा
विशन्ति नाशाय समृद्धवेगाः ।
तथैव नाशाय विशन्ति लोकास्-
तवापि वक्त्राणि समृद्धवेगाः ॥ २९॥
verses.transliteration:
Yatha Pradiptam Jvalanam Patanga
Vishanti Nashaya Samriddha Vegah,
Tathaiva Nashaya Vishanti Lokas
Tavapi Vaktrani Samriddha Vegah.
verses.englishMeaning: Just as moths rush with headlong velocity into a blazing fire only to perish, even so do these worlds rush with swift speed into Your fiery mouths toward their own destruction!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jaise patange (keede-patange) apne naash ke liye tezi se daudkar jalti hui aag mein kood padte hain, waise hi yeh sabhi log apne vinaash ke liye poori tezi se aapke mukhon mein ghuste chale ja rahe hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Diye ki lau dekhkar patanga mohit ho jaata hai aur sochte hue ki yeh koi sundar cheez hai, aag mein koodkar jal jaata hai.

Usi tarah ahankari log apne lobh, ghamand aur lalach mein andhe hokar vinaash ke raste par bina soche daud rahe hain. Duryodhan aur uski sena ka yahi haal tha.
verses.lifeLesson: Lobh aur ahankar patange ki tarah manushya ko vinaash ki taraf kheench le jaate hain. Hosh mein aao aur vinaashkari aakarshan se bacho.

verses.sanskrit:
लेलिह्यसे ग्रसमानः समन्ताल्-
लोकान्समग्रान्वदनैर्ज्वलद्भिः ।
तेजोभिरापूर्य जगत्समग्रं
भासस्तवोग्राः प्रतपन्ति विष्णो ॥ ३०॥
verses.transliteration:
Lelihyase Grasamanah Samantal
Lokan Samagran Vadanair Jvaladbhih,
Tejobhir Apurya Jagat Samagram
Bhasas Tavograh Pratapanti Vishno.
verses.englishMeaning: Devouring all the worlds from every side with Your flaming mouths, You lick them up greedily! Filling the entire cosmos with blinding radiance, Your terrifying rays are scorching the universe, O Vishnu!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aap apne dahakte hue mukhon se chaaron taraf se samast lokon ko nigalte hue unhe chaat rahe hain! Hey Vishnu! Aapka ugra aur prachand prakaash poore vishva ko tej se bhar kar jala raha hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Kaal (Maha-Kaal) ka woh swaroop hai jahan srishti ka har dosh aur adharma bhasma kiya ja raha hai.

Krishna ka ugra prakaash sabhi dishaon mein phailkar unhe tapt kar raha hai. Arjun is prachand shakti ko dekhkar stambh reh jaate hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Parmatma ka ek roop param prem hai, toh doosra roop param shuddhi aur adharma ka naash hai. Dharmik bane raho taaki Kaal ka bhay na sataye.

verses.sanskrit:
आख्याहि मे को भवानुग्ररूपो
नमोऽस्तु ते देववर प्रसीद ।
विज्ञातुमिच्छामि भवन्तमाद्यं
न हि प्रजानामि तव प्रवृत्तिम् ॥ ३१॥
verses.transliteration:
Akhyahi Me Ko Bhavan Ugra Rupo
Namo Stu Te Deva Vara Prasida,
Vijnatum Icchami Bhavantam Adyam
Na Hi Prajanami Tava Pravrittim.
verses.englishMeaning: Tell me, who are You in this terrifying form? Salutations unto You, O supreme God! Be gracious! I yearn to know You, the Primal Being, for I do not comprehend Your action and purpose!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Kripa karke mujhe batayein ki is ugra aur bhayanak roop mein aap kaun hain? Hey Deveshvar! Aapko mera pranam hai, kripa karke prasanna hoiye. Main aap aadi-swaroop ko jaanna chahta hoon, kyunki main aapke is karya aur uddeshya ko samajh nahi paa raha hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun Krishna ko bachpan se ek prem karne wale saathi aur sakha ke roop mein jaante the.

Ab achanak itna prachand aur ugra roop dekhkar Arjun poonchte hain: 'Prabhu, aap vastav mein kaun hain? Aur is bhayankar roop ke peeche aapka maksad kya hai?'
verses.lifeLesson: Mushkil paristhitiyon mein jab jeevan ka roop bhayanak lage, tab ghabrane ke bajaye vinamrata se uske peeche chhipe uddeshya aur sandesh ko samajhne ki koshish karo.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
कालोऽस्मि लोकक्षयकृत्प्रवृद्धो
लोकान्समाहर्तुमिह प्रवृत्तः ।
ऋतेऽपि त्वां न भविष्यन्ति सर्वे
येऽवस्थिताः प्रत्यनीकेषु योधाः ॥ ३२॥
verses.transliteration:
Shri Bhagavan Uvacha:
Kalo Smi Loka Kshaya Krit Pravriddho
Lokan Samahartum Iha Pravrittah,
Rite Pi Tvam Na Bhavishyanti Sarve
Ye Vasthitah Pratyanikeshu Yodhah.
verses.englishMeaning: The Blessed Lord said: I am mighty Time (Kala), the great destroyer of worlds, arisen here to annihilate these peoples. Even without your participation, none of the warriors assembled in the opposing armies shall survive!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shri Bhagavan ne kaha: Main lokon ka naash karne wala mahaan Kaal (Samay) hoon, jo is samay in sabhi logon ka sanghar karne ke liye prakat hua hoon. Tumhare yuddh kiye bina bhi, vipakshi sena mein khade yeh sabhi yoddha zinda nahi bachenge!
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Gita ka sabse aitihasik aur powerful shlok hai: 'Kalo Asmi' — Main Kaal hoon!

Krishna Arjun ko batate hain: 'Arjun, tum sochte ho ki tum inko maaroge ya bachaoge? Yeh tumhari galatfehmi hai. In sabhi adharmiyon ka samay poora ho chuka hai. Agar tum talwar na bhi uthao, tab bhi inka ant tay hai kyunki Kaal ne apna faisla suna diya hai.'
verses.lifeLesson: Samay (Kaal) sabse badi shakti hai. Insaan ko yeh ghamand nahi karna chahiye ki 'sab kuch main chala raha hoon'. Samay ke niyam ko pehchano aur apna kartavya nibhao.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मात्त्वमुत्तिष्ठ यशो लभस्व
जित्वा शत्रून् भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यं समृद्धम् ।
मयैवैते निहताः पूर्वमेव
निमित्तमात्रं भव सव्यसाचिन् ॥ ३३॥
verses.transliteration:
Tasmat Tvam Uttishtha Yasho Labhasva
Jitva Shatrun Bhunkshva Rajyam Samriddham,
Mayaivaite Nihatah Purvam Eva
Nimitta Matram Bhava Savyasacin.
verses.englishMeaning: Therefore, arise and attain glory! Conquer your enemies and enjoy an opulent kingdom! By Me alone have they already been slain; be merely an instrument (nimitta-matram), O ambidextrous archer!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Isliye tum utho aur yash praapt karo! Shatruon ko jeet kar samriddha rajya ka upbhog karo! Yeh sabhi pehle se hi mere dwara maare ja chuke hain. Hey Savyasachin (dono haathon se teer chalane wale Arjun)! Tum bas ek nimit (madhyam) ban jao!
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Gita ka mool sandesh hai: 'Nimitta-matram bhava' — Sirf ek madhyam bano!

Krishna kehte hain: 'Adharma ka ant main pehle hi nishchit kar chuka hoon. Lekin tum dharma ke yoddha ho, isliye utho, ladho aur sansaar mein yash kamao. Karya Parmatma ka hai, tum bas unke haath ka ek aala (instrument) ban kar apna dharm nibhao.'
verses.lifeLesson: Ahankar mat karo ki 'yeh maine kiya'. Hum sab Ishwar ki shakti ke aage sirf ek madhyam hain. Apne kaam ko nishkam bhav aur poori mehnat se karo, baaki parinaam Parmatma par chhod do.

verses.sanskrit:
द्रोणं च भीष्मं च जयद्रथं च
कर्णं तथान्यानपि योधवीरान् ।
मया हतांस्त्वं जहि मा व्यथिष्ठा
युध्यस्व जेतासि रणे सपत्नान् ॥ ३४॥
verses.transliteration:
Dronam Ca Bhishmam Ca Jayadratham Ca
Karnam Tathanyan Api Yodha Viran,
Maya Hatams Tvam Jahi Ma Vyathishtha
Yudhyasva Jetasi Rane Sapatnan.
verses.englishMeaning: Drona, Bhishma, Jayadratha, Karna, and the other mighty warriors have already been slain by Me. Do not grieve, slay them! Fight, and you shall surely conquer your enemies in battle!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Dronacharya, Bhishma Pitamah, Jayadratha, Karna tatha anya sabhi veer yoddha mere dwara pehle hi maare ja chuke hain. Tum chinta mat karo, unhe maaro! Yuddh karo, rannbhoomi mein shatruon par tumhari hi jeet hogi!
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun jin mahan logon ko maarne se darr rahe the — guru Drona, pitaamah Bhishma aur shaktishaali Karna — Krishna unhe spasht kehte hain:

'Inka aadhyaatmik ant inke dushkarmo aur adharma ke saath khade hone ki wajah se pehle hi ho chuka hai. Tum bas unke physical shareer ko girane ka kartavya poora karo. Darr chhod kar khade ho jao, jeet tumhari hi hai.'
verses.lifeLesson: Jab nyay aur satya ke liye ladna ho, toh vyakti-vishesh ke moh mein mat phaso. Satya ke paksh mein khade rehne wale ki hamesha jeet hoti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच ।
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं केशवस्य
कृताञ्जलिर्वेपमानः किरीटी ।
नमस्कृत्वा भूय एवाह कृष्णं
सगद्गदं भीतभीतः प्रणम्य ॥ ३५॥
verses.transliteration:
Sanjaya Uvacha:
Etac Chrutva Vachanam Keshavasya
Kritanjalir Vepamanah Kiriti,
Namaskritva Bhuya Evaha Krishnam
Sagadgadam Bhita Bhitah Pranamya.
verses.englishMeaning: Sanjaya said: Having heard these words of Keshava, the crowned one (Arjuna), trembling and with folded hands, prostrated himself repeatedly and spoke to Krishna in a voice choked with awe and fear.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Sanjay ne kaha: Bhagavan Keshava ke in vachanon ko sunkar, mukut-dhari Arjun haath jodkar thar-thar kaanpte hue baar-baar pranam karne laga, aur darr se bhare hue swar mein gadgad hokar Shri Krishna se bola.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna ke shabdon ko sunkar Arjun ki aatma hil gayi. Unka shareer kaanp raha tha, aankhon mein aansu the aur gale se aawaz gadgad hokar nikal rahi thi.

Woh samajh gaye ki jise woh apna dost maante the, woh saakshaat poore brahmand ke Vidhata aur Kaal-swaroop hain. Arjun ka hriday apar shradha aur vinamrata se bhar gaya.
verses.lifeLesson: Satya ki vishalta ka anubhav insaan ke bheetar ek gahan shradha aur vinamrata jaga deta hai. Sachche bhakt ka hriday ghamand se nahi, shradha ke aansuon se bharta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
स्थाने हृषीकेश तव प्रकीर्त्या
जगत्प्रहृष्यत्यनुरज्यते च ।
रक्षांसि भीतानि दिशो द्रवन्ति
सर्वे नमस्यन्ति च सिद्धसङ्घाः ॥ ३६॥
verses.transliteration:
Arjuna Uvacha:
Sthane Hrishikesha Tava Prakirtya
Jagat Prahirishyaty Anurajyate Ca,
Rakshamsi Bhitani Disho Dravanti
Sarve Namasyanti Ca Siddha Sanghah.
verses.englishMeaning: Arjuna said: It is altogether right and proper, O Hrishikesha, that the entire universe rejoices and is filled with love by Your glory! The demons flee in terror in all directions, while all the hosts of perfected saints bow down in adoration!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Arjun ne kaha: Hey Hrishikesha! Yeh bilkul uchit hi hai ki aapke naam aur mahima ke kirtan se poora jagat harshit ho raha hai aur prem mein leen ho raha hai; darr ke maare rakshas sabhi dishaon mein bhaag rahe hain aur samast siddha purush aapko pranam kar rahe hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun kehte hain ki Prabhu, aapki mahima sunkar dharmatma log khush hote hain aur unka mann bhakti se bhar jaata hai.

Lekin jin logo ke mann mein paap aur burai (asuri vritti) hai, woh aapke naam se darte hain aur bhaagte hain. Yeh srishti ka sahaj niyam hai — satya bhakton ko sukoon deta hai aur dushkarm karne walon ko bhay.
verses.lifeLesson: Pavitra aatmaayein satya aur Ishwar ke naam se anand paati hain, jabki burai karne wale hamesha bhaybheet rehte hain. Shuddh man se jiyo taaki bheetar anand bana rahe.

verses.sanskrit:
कस्माच्च ते न नमेरन्महात्मन्
गरीयसे ब्रह्मणोऽप्यादिकर्त्रे ।
अनन्त देवेश जगन्निवास
त्वमक्षरं सदसत्तत्परं यत् ॥ ३७॥
verses.transliteration:
Kasmad Ca Te Na Nameran Mahatman
Gariyase Brahmano Py Adi Kartre,
Ananta Devesha Jagannivasa
Tvam Aksharam Sad Asat Tat Param Yat.
verses.englishMeaning: And why should they not bow down to You, O Great Soul, who are greater even than Brahma, being the original Creator? O Infinite One, God of gods, Refuge of the cosmos! You are the imperishable Reality, being (Sat), non-being (Asat), and that which transcends both!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Mahatman! Brahma ji ke bhi aadi-rachayita aur sabse mahan hone ke naate, woh aapko pranam kyun na karein? Hey Ananta! Hey Devesh! Hey Jagannivas! Aap hi avinashi satya hain, aap hi Sat (sakar) aur Asat (nirakar) hain, aur jo in dono se pare param satya hai, woh bhi aap hi hain!
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun kehte hain ki srishti ke rachayita Brahma ji hain, par Brahma ji ko banane wale bhi aap hi hain.

Sansaar mein jo kuch dikhta hai (Sat) aur jo nahi dikhta (Asat), aur jo in dono ke pare shashwat param satya hai — woh sab kuch keval aur keval aap hi hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Jeevan ki saari shaktiyon ke mool srot ko pehchano. Us ek param aadhar ko pranam karo jo srishti ke har roop aur aakaar se pare hai.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वमादिदेवः पुरुषः पुराणस्-
त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम् ।
वेत्तासि वेद्यं च परं च धाम
त्वया ततं विश्वमनन्तरूप ॥ ३८॥
verses.transliteration:
Tvam Adi Devah Purushah Puranas
Tvam Asya Vishvasya Param Nidhanam,
Vettasi Vedyam Ca Param Ca Dhama
Tvaya Tatam Vishvam Ananta Rupa.
verses.englishMeaning: You are the Primal Godhead, the ancient Person! You are the supreme sanctuary of this universe! You are the knower, the object to be known, and the supreme abode! By You alone is this entire universe pervaded, O One of infinite forms!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aap hi aadi devata aur sanatan param purush hain! Aap hi is sampoorna srishti ke param aashray hain! Aap hi sab kuch janne wale (gyata), janne yogya param tatva (gyeya) aur param dhaam hain! Hey Anant-roop! Aapse hi yeh poora brahmand vyapt hai!
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun Krishna ki stuti mein kehte hain:
1. Aap janne wale hain (knower).
2. Aap hi woh gyaan hain jise jaanna chahiye (known).
3. Aur aakhiri manzil jahan aatma vishram paati hai, woh param dhaam bhi aap hi hain.
Poora vishva aapke hi aanchal mein khila hua hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Gyaan, dhyan aur lakshya — sabka antim kendra Parmatma hi hain. Jab jeevan ka uddeshya unhe jaan lena ban jaata hai, tab saari bhatkan khatam ho jaati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
वायुर्यमोऽग्निर्वरुणः शशाङ्कः
प्रजापतिस्त्वं प्रपितामहश्च ।
नमो नमस्तेऽस्तु सहस्रकृत्वः
पुनश्च भूयोऽपि नमो नमस्ते ॥ ३९॥
verses.transliteration:
Vayur Yamo Gnir Varunah Shashankah
Prajapatis Tvam Prapitamahash Ca,
Namo Namas Te Stu Sahasra Kritvah
Punash Ca Bhuyo Pi Namo Namas Te.
verses.englishMeaning: You are Vayu (the wind), Yama (death and justice), Agni (fire), Varuna (the waters), the moon, Prajapati (Brahma the creator), and the Great-Grandfather! Salutations, salutations unto You a thousand times, and again and yet again, salutations, salutations to You!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aap hi Vayu, Yamaraj, Agni, Varuna, Chandrama, Prajapati Brahma aur Brahma ji ke bhi pita (Prapitamah) hain! Aapko hazaron baar mera pranam, pranam ho! Puna: aur baarambaar aapko mera koti-koti pranam!
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh stuti bhakti ras se labrez hai!

Arjun ko shabdon ki kami pad rahi hai. Woh kehte hain hawa aap hain, aag aap hain, nyay aap hain, suraj-chaand aap hain. 'Namo Namaste Astu Sahasra-kritvah' — main aapko ek baar nahi, hazaar baar pranam karta hoon, aur baar-baar sar jhukata hoon!
verses.lifeLesson: Jab dil mein sachchi shradha umadti hai, toh shabdon ki seemayein toot jaati hain aur keval vinamra samarpana aur pranam hi bachta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
नमः पुरस्तादथ पृष्ठतस्ते
नमोऽस्तु ते सर्वत एव सर्व ।
अनन्तवीर्यामितविक्रमस्त्वं
सर्वं समाप्नोषि ततोऽसि सर्वः ॥ ४०॥
verses.transliteration:
Namah Purastad Atha Prishthatas Te
Namo Stu Te Sarvata Eva Sarva,
Ananta Viryamita Vikramas Tvam
Sarvam Samapnoshi Tato Si Sarvah.
verses.englishMeaning: Salutations unto You from the front, from behind, and from every side, O All! Possessing infinite prowess and limitless might, You pervade everything, and therefore You are everything!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Sarva-swaroop! Aapko aage se pranam, peeche se pranam aur chaaron taraf se pranam ho! Hey anant shaktishaali aur aseem parakrami Prabhu! Aapne sab kuch apne bheetar samaya hua hai, isliye aap hi sab kuch hain!
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun kehte hain ki Prabhu, main kis taraf sar jhukaoon? Aap aage bhi hain, peeche bhi hain, daayein bhi hain, baayein bhi hain.

Isliye main aapko har taraf se pranam karta hoon. Chunki aap har kan mein samaye hue hain, isliye srishti mein jo kuch bhi hai, woh sab aap hi ka roop hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Parmatma ko kisi ek kone ya disha mein mat dhoondo. Woh har taraf, har insaan aur har jeev mein virajmaan hain. Sabka samman karo.

verses.sanskrit:
सखेति मत्वा प्रसभं यदुक्तं
हे कृष्ण हे यादव हे सखेति ।
अजानता महिमानं तवेदं
मया प्रमादात्प्रणयेन वापि ॥ ४१॥
verses.transliteration:
Sakheti Matva Prasabham Yad Uktam
He Krishna He Yadava He Sakheti,
Ajanata Mahimanam Tavedam
Maya Pramadat Pranayena Vapi.
verses.englishMeaning: Regarding You merely as a friend, unaware of this divine greatness of Yours, whatever I rashly said out of negligence or deep affection, calling You "O Krishna! O Yadava! O friend!",
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aapko keval apna mitra samajhkar, aapki is asim mahima ko na jaante hue, maine galti se ya prem-vash bina soche-samjhe jo kuch bhi keh diya — jaise "Hey Krishna! Hey Yadava! Hey sakha!" —
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ko yaad aata hai ki unhone Krishna ko sadharan insaan samajhkar kitni baar dostana hak jataya tha.

Kabhi 'Hey Krishna', kabhi 'Hey Yadav', kabhi hansi-mazaak mein dost ki tarah baat ki thi. Arjun ko ab ehsaas hua ki woh jise dost samajh rahe the, woh toh saakshaat poore brahmand ke Parameshwar hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab kisi mahan vyakti ya Ishwar ki kripa humare kareeb hoti hai, toh hum use aam samajhne ki bhool kar baithte hain. Rishto mein aadar aur vinamrata ka bhav hamesha bana rehna chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
यच्चावहासार्थमसत्कृतोऽसि
विहारशय्यासनभोजनेषु ।
एकोऽथवाप्यच्युत तत्समक्षं
तत्क्षामये त्वामहमप्रमेयम् ॥ ४२॥
verses.transliteration:
Yac Cavahasartham Asatkritosi
Vihara Shayyasana Bhojaneshu,
Eko Thavapy Acyuta Tat Samaksham
Tat Kshamaye Tvam Aham Aprameyam.
verses.englishMeaning: And whatever disrespect I may have shown You in jest, while resting, sitting, walking, or dining, whether alone or in the presence of companions — for all that, O infallible Lord, I earnestly beg forgiveness of You, the immeasurable!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aur hansi-mazaak mein khelte, sote, baithte ya bhojan karte samay, akele mein ya doosron ke samne maine anjaane mein jo bhi aapka anaadar kiya ho — us sabhi ke liye hey Achyuta (avinashi Prabhu)! Main aapse kshama maangta hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun dil se maafi maangte hain ki hansi-khel mein, saath khana khate samay ya baithte waqt maine dosti mein aapse jo bhi bina aadar wali baatein ki hon, kripa karke use maaf kar dein.

Sachchi bhakti mein dil saaf hota hai aur insaan apni galti ko khule dil se maanta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni bhool ko swikar karke kshama maangna kamzori nahi, balki hriday ki pavitrata aur shreshtha sanskaar hai.

verses.sanskrit:
पितासि लोकस्य चराचरस्य
त्वमस्य पूज्यश्च गुरुर्गरीयान् ।
न त्वत्समोऽस्त्यभ्यधिकः कुतोऽन्यो
लोकत्रयेऽप्यप्रतिमप्रभाव ॥ ४३॥
verses.transliteration:
Pitasi Lokasya Caracarasya
Tvam Asya Pujyash Ca Gurur Gariyan,
Na Tvat Samo Sty Abhyadhikah Kuto Nyo
Lokatraye Py Apratima Prabhava.
verses.englishMeaning: You are the Father of this world, of all moving and unmoving beings! You are its most venerable and supreme Guru! There is none equal to You; how then could anyone be greater in all the three worlds, O Being of peerless glory?
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aap is char aur achar jagat ke pita hain, aap hi iske param poojneeya aur sabse mahan guru hain! Teeno lokon mein aapke barabar bhi koi nahi hai, toh bhala aapse bada koi doosra kaise ho sakta hai, hey bemisaal prabhav wale Prabhu!
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun kehte hain ki aap poori srishti ke janm-data pita hain aur aatmik gyaan dene wale sabse mahan guru hain.

Jab teeno lokon mein aapke barabar hi koi shakti nahi hai, toh aapse bada toh koi ho hi nahi sakta.
verses.lifeLesson: Guru aur Parmatma hi jeevan ke mool aadhar hain. Unke prati shraddhavan rehne se insaan ko jeevan ki sahi disha aur shanti milti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मात्प्रणम्य प्रणिधाय कायं
प्रसादये त्वामहमीशमीड्यम् ।
पितेव पुत्रस्य सखेव सख्युः
प्रियः प्रियायार्हसि देव सोढुम् ॥ ४४॥
verses.transliteration:
Tasmat Pranamya Pranidhaya Kayam
Prasadaye Tvam Aham Isham Idyam,
Piteva Putrasya Sakheva Sakhyuh
Priyah Priyayarhasi Deva Sodhum.
verses.englishMeaning: Therefore, bowing down and prostrating my whole body, I beseech Your grace, O adorable, sovereign Lord! As a father bears with his son, a friend with his friend, and a lover with his beloved, so may You, O God, bear with and forgive me!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Isliye main poore shareer se saashtaang pranam karke, stuti ke yogya aap Parameshwar ko prasanna karne ki prarthana karta hoon. Hey Prabhu! Jaise pita apne putra ki, sakha apne sakha ki aur premi apni premika ki galtiyon ko maaf karta hai, waise hi aap bhi meri bhool ko kshama kijiye.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok Geeta ke sabse madhur aur prem-bhare shloko mein se ek hai.

Arjun zameen par gir kar saashtaang pranam karte hain aur kehte hain: 'Prabhu, jaise ek pita apne bache ki galti maaf karta hai, jaise ek dost apne dost ki bhool bhula deta hai, aur jaise do premi ek doosre ko maaf karte hain — usi tarah aap bhi mere apraadh ko kshama kar dijiye.'
verses.lifeLesson: Ishwar se humara rishta keval darr ya niyam ka nahi, balki pita, dost aur premi jaisa gehra prem ka rishta hai. Sache dil se maafi maangne par kripa zaroor milti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अदृष्टपूर्वं हृषितोऽस्मि दृष्ट्वा
भयेन च प्रव्यथितं मनो मे ।
तदेव मे दर्शय देव रूपं
प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास ॥ ४५॥
verses.transliteration:
Adrishta Purvam Hrishito Smi Drishtva
Bhayena Ca Pravyathitam Mano Me,
Tad Eva Me Darshaya Deva Rupam
Prasida Devesha Jagannivasa.
verses.englishMeaning: I am overjoyed having beheld this marvel never seen before, yet my mind is afflicted with fear! Please reveal unto me that familiar divine form once again; be gracious, O Lord of gods, O Refuge of the cosmos!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Pehle kabhi na dekhe gaye is divya roop ko dekhkar main harshit (khush) toh hoon, lekin mera man bhay se vyathit bhi ho raha hai. Isliye hey Prabhu! Mujhe apna wahi poorva roop dikhaiye. Hey Devesh! Hey Jagannivas! Kripa karke prasanna hoiye.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun kehte hain ki ek taraf toh mujhe anand ho raha hai ki maine aapka itna vishal aur adbhut roop dekha jo kisi ne nahi dekha.

Lekin doosri taraf aapka ugra roop dekhkar mera mann darr se ghabra raha hai. Isliye Prabhu, ab kripa karke apna shant, sundar aur prem-may roop punah dikha dijiye.
verses.lifeLesson: Adhura gyaan ya bheetar ki ghabrahat insaan ko vichlit kar sakti hai. Hamesha Ishwar se shanti aur saumyata ki prarthana karni chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रहस्तं
इच्छामि त्वां द्रष्टुमहं तथैव ।
तेनैव रूपेण चतुर्भुजेन
सहस्रबाहो भव विश्वमूर्ते ॥ ४६॥
verses.transliteration:
Kiritinam Gadinam Cakra Hastam
Icchami Tvam Drashtum Aham Tathaiva,
Tenaiva Rupena Catur Bhujena
Sahasra Baho Bhava Vishva Murte.
verses.englishMeaning: I yearn to behold You as before, wearing a radiant crown, bearing a mace, and holding the discus in hand! In that very gentle, four-armed form, do You appear, O thousand-armed One of universal form!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main aapko pehle ki tarah hi mukut pehne hue, gada aur chakra haath mein liye dekhna chahta hoon. Hey hazaron bhujaon wale vishwaroop Prabhu! Aap apne usi char bhujaon wale (chaturbhuja) sundar roop mein prakat ho jaiye.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun Krishna se unke prem-may Chaturbhuj Narayan roop aur unke saumya sakha roop mein lautne ki prarthana karte hain.

Woh hazaron bhujaon wale bhayanak roop ke bajaye shant, shobhamay aur aashirwad dene wale sundar roop ka darshan karna chahte hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Bhakti mein aatmiyata aur shanti tab milti hai jab hum Ishwar ke prem aur kripa wale roop se judte hain.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
मया प्रसन्नेन तवार्जुनेदं
रूपं परं दर्शितमात्मयोगात् ।
तेजोमयं विश्वमनन्तमाद्यं
यन्मे त्वदन्येन न दृष्टपूर्वम् ॥ ४७॥
verses.transliteration:
Shri Bhagavan Uvacha:
Maya Prasannena Tavarjunedam
Rupam Param Darshitam Atma Yogat,
Tejomayam Vishvam Anantam Adyam
Yan Me Tvad Anyena Na Drishta Purvam.
verses.englishMeaning: The Blessed Lord said: Being pleased with you, O Arjuna, I have revealed unto you through My supreme yogic power this transcendental, radiant, universal, boundless, and primal form of Mine, which has never before been seen by anyone other than you!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shri Bhagavan ne kaha: Hey Arjun! Maine tum par prasanna hokar apni yog-shakti ke bal par apna yeh param tejomay, anant, sabka aadi aur vishwaroop tumhe dikhaya hai, jise tumhare alawa pehle kisi ne kabhi nahi dekha.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna Arjun ko saantvana dete hain: 'Arjun, ghabrao mat! Yeh roop kisi krodh se nahi, balki tumhare nishchhal prem aur bhakti par prasanna hokar maine tumhe dikhaya hai.'

Yeh darshan durlabh tha aur sirf Arjun ke sachche prem ki wajah se sambhav hua.
verses.lifeLesson: Parmatma ka gahan satya keval prem aur samarpana se milta hai. Jab Ishwar kisi par prasanna hote hain, tabhi anant rahasya khulte hain.

verses.sanskrit:
न वेदयज्ञाध्ययनैर्न दानैर्-
न च क्रियाभिर्न तपोभिरुग्रैः ।
एवंरूपः शक्य अहं नृलोके
द्रष्टुं त्वदन्येन कुरुप्रवीर ॥ ४८॥
verses.transliteration:
Na Veda Yajnadhyayanair Na Danair
Na Ca Kriyabhir Na Tapobhir Ugraih,
Evam Rupah Shakya Aham Nriloke
Drashtum Tvad Anyena Kuru Pravira.
verses.englishMeaning: Neither by the study of the Vedas, nor by sacrifices, nor by charity, nor by ritualistic ceremonies, nor by severe penances can I be seen in such a cosmic form in the world of mortals by anyone other than you, O hero of the Kurus!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Kurushreshtha! Manushya-lok mein tumhare atirikt koi bhi doosra vyakti na toh Vedon ke adhyayan se, na yajyo se, na daan se, na karmakando se aur na hi kathor tapasyaon dwara mere is roop ko dekh sakta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna spasht karte hain ki sirf kitaabi gyaan, dikhawe ka daan ya kathor sharirik tapasya se Ishwar ka saakshaatkar nahi hota.

Yeh sabhi sadhan ache hain, par jab tak bheetar ananya bhakti aur nishchhal prem na ho, tab tak vishwaroop ka darshan asambhav hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Bahari dikhava, ghamand bhari tapasya ya karmakand se Parmatma nahi milte. Shuddh aur nishkapat hriday hi Ishwar ko pane ka ekmatra rasta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
मा ते व्यथा मा च विमूढभावो
दृष्ट्वा रूपं घोरमीदृङ्ममेदम् ।
व्यपेतभीः प्रीतमनाः पुनस्त्वं
तदेव मे रूपमिदं प्रपश्य ॥ ४९॥
verses.transliteration:
Ma Te Vyatha Ma Ca Vimudha Bhavo
Drishtva Rupam Ghoram Idring Mamedam,
Vyapetabhih Prita Manah Punas Tvam
Tad Eva Me Rupam Idam Prapashya.
verses.englishMeaning: Let there be no bewilderment nor fear in you upon seeing this awe-inspiring, terrible form of Mine. Free from fear and with a gladdened heart, behold once again that very gentle form of Mine as before!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Mere is ghor aur bhayanak roop ko dekhkar tum vyatha (darr) aur moh mein mat pado. Bhay-mukt hokar aur prasanna chit hokar tum punah mere usi priya aur saumya roop ko dekho.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna jaise ek snehi mitra aur pita ki tarah Arjun ko dharas bandhate hain: 'Darr mat Arjun, chinta chhod do. Apne dil ko shant karo aur khush hokar dekho — main wapas apne usi snehamayi roop mein aa raha hoon.'

Yeh Bhagavan ki apar karuna ko dikhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Parmatma kabhi apne bhakt ko bhaybheet nahi dekhna chahte. Prem aur karuna hi Ishwar ka aakhiri aur mool swaroop hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच ।
इत्यर्जुनं वासुदेवस्तथोक्त्वा
स्वकं रूपं दर्शयामास भूयः ।
आश्वासयामास च भीतमेनं
भूत्वा पुनः सौम्यवपुर्महात्मा ॥ ५०॥
verses.transliteration:
Sanjaya Uvacha:
Ity Arjunam Vasudevas Tathoktva
Svakam Rupam Darshayam Asa Bhuyah,
Ashvasayam Asa Ca Bhitam Enam
Bhutva Punah Saumya Vapur Mahatma.
verses.englishMeaning: Sanjaya said: Having spoken thus to Arjuna, Vasudeva revealed once again His own familiar, gentle form, and assuming His pleasant, graceful appearance, the Great Soul comforted the terrified Arjuna.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Sanjay ne kaha: Bhagavan Vasudeva ne Arjun se aisa kehkar, punah apna saumya manushya roop dikhaya; aur us mahan aatma Shri Krishna ne punah sundar aur sheetal swaroop dharan karke bhaybheet Arjun ko poori tarah aashvast aur shant kiya.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Sanjay Dhritarashtra ko batate hain ki Krishna ne turant apna bhayanak vishwaroop samet liya aur wapas wahi muskurate hue, sundar, peetambar-dhari Shri Krishna ban gaye.

Unhone Arjun ke paas aakar use prem se sambhala aur uski ghabrahat door ki.
verses.lifeLesson: Mahan wahi hota hai jo doosre ke darr ko samjhe aur use sahas tatha prem pradan kare. Krishna ka saumya roop har darr ka ant kar deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
दृष्ट्वेदं मानुषं रूपं तव सौम्यं जनार्दन ।
इदानीमस्मि संवृत्तः सचेताः प्रकृतिं गतः ॥ ५१॥
verses.transliteration:
Arjuna Uvacha:
Drishtvedam Manusham Rupam
Tava Saumyam Janardana,
Idanim Asmi Samvrittah
Sacatah Prakritim Gatah.
verses.englishMeaning: Arjuna said: Beholding this gentle human form of Yours, O Janardana, I have now become composed in mind and restored to my normal, peaceful self!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Arjun ne kaha: Hey Janardana! Aapke is atyant saumya aur manohar manushya-roop ko dekhkar ab mera chitta shant ho gaya hai aur main wapas apni swabhavik dasha mein laut aaya hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna ke sundar aur muskurate hue mukh ko dekhkar Arjun ki saari ghabrahat pal bhar mein gayab ho gayi.

Arjun ne gehri saans li aur kaha: 'Prabhu, aapke is shant manav-roop ko dekhkar mere mann ko sukoon mil gaya hai aur meri aatma tript ho gayi hai.'
verses.lifeLesson: Jab insaan Ishwar ke prem aur kripa se judta hai, tab saari bechaini door ho jaati hai aur mann mein sachchi shanti laut aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
सुदुर्दर्शमिदं रूपं दृष्टवानसि यन्मम ।
देवा अप्यस्य रूपस्य नित्यं दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः ॥ ५२॥
verses.transliteration:
Shri Bhagavan Uvacha:
Su Durdarsham Idam Rupam
Drishtavan Asi Yan Mama,
Deva Apy Asya Rupasya
Nityam Darshana Kankshinah.
verses.englishMeaning: The Blessed Lord said: Extremely difficult to behold is this cosmic form of Mine which you have just seen! Even the celestial gods ever long to gaze upon this sublime form!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shri Bhagavan ne kaha: Mera yeh vishwaroop jise tumne abhi dekha hai, behad durlabh hai! Yahan tak ki swarg ke devta bhi is roop ke darshan ke liye sadaiv taraste rehte hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna Arjun ko samjhate hain ki jo tumne dekha, woh koi sadharan anubhav nahi tha.

Bade-bade tapasvi aur swarg ke devta bhi is darshan ke liye yugon-yugon tak prarthana karte hain, par unhe bhi yeh dekhne ko nahi milta. Yeh keval Arjun ki ananya bhakti ka prasad tha.
verses.lifeLesson: Bhakti ki shakti itni mahan hai ki jo cheez bade-bade devtaon ko nahi milti, woh ek sachche aur nishkapat bhakt ko sahaj hi praapt ho jaati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
नाहं वेदैर्न तपसा न दानेन न चेज्यया ।
शक्य एवंविधो द्रष्टुं दृष्टवानसि मां यथा ॥ ५३॥
verses.transliteration:
Naham Vedair Na Tapasa
Na Danena Na Cejyaya,
Shakya Evam Vidho Drashtum
Drishtavan Asi Mam Yatha.
verses.englishMeaning: Neither by the Vedas, nor by penances, nor by charity, nor by sacrifices can I be seen in this divine form as you have seen Me!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Na Vedon ke paath se, na kathor tapasya se, na daan dene se aur na yajyo dwara main is tarah dekha ja sakta hoon, jaise tumne mujhe sakshat dekha hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna dobara is baat par zor dete hain ki bahari sadhan — chahe kitni bhi padhai ho, daan ho ya yajya — akele kaafi nahi hain.

In sabhi sadhano se insaan ko punyo ka fal toh mil sakta hai, par Parmatma ka saakshaatkar sirf aur sirf prem se hota hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Parmatma ko kisi saundaryabodh, dhan ya ghamand se nahi kharida ja sakta. Sirf dil ki shuddhata aur nishkapat prem hi unhe paane ki kunji hai.

verses.sanskrit:
भक्त्या त्वनन्यया शक्य अहमेवंविधोऽर्जुन ।
ज्ञातुं द्रष्टुं च तत्त्वेन प्रवेष्टुं च परन्तप ॥ ५४॥
verses.transliteration:
Bhaktya Tv Ananyaya Shakya
Aham Evam Vidho Rjuna,
Jnatum Drashtum Ca Tattvena
Praveshtum Ca Parantapa.
verses.englishMeaning: But by unalloyed, single-minded devotion (ananya bhakti) alone can I be truly known, directly beheld, and entered into, O Arjuna, scorcher of foes!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Parantu hey Parantapa Arjun! Keval ananya bhakti (poorn samarpit prem) dwara hi mujhe tatva se jaana ja sakta hai, saakshaat dekha ja sakta hai aur mujhme pravesh (ekatva) kiya ja sakta hai!
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yahan Krishna aadhyaatma ka sabse bada rahasya batate hain: 'Bhaktya Tu Ananyaya' — Keval Ananya Bhakti se!

Ananya bhakti ka matlab hai aisa prem jisme koi shart na ho, koi swarth na ho aur Ishwar ke alawa doosra koi sahara na ho. Aise prem se insaan Parmatma ko jaanta bhi hai, dekhta bhi hai aur ant mein unhi mein leen ho jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab jeevan mein bhatkan chhodkar ekagrachit prem aur samarpana aata hai, tab Ishwar ka anubhav atyant sahaj aur nikat ho jaata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
मत्कर्मकृन्मत्परमो मद्भक्तः सङ्गवर्जितः ।
निर्वैरः सर्वभूतेषु यः स मामेति पाण्डव ॥ ५५॥
verses.transliteration:
Mat Karma Krin Mat Paramo
Mad Bhaktah Sanga Varjitah,
Nirvairah Sarva Bhuteshu
Yah Sa Mam Eti Pandava.
verses.englishMeaning: One who performs all actions for My sake, who regards Me as the supreme goal, who is devoted to Me, free from attachment, and free from malice toward any living being — such a person attains Me, O son of Pandu!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Pandav Arjun! Jo vyakti apne samast karm mere liye karta hai, jo mujhe hi apna param lakshya maanta hai, jo mera nishtha-vaan bhakt hai, jo aasakti se rahit hai aur sabhi praaniyon ke prati vair-bhav (dushmani) se mukt hai — woh nishchit roop se mujhe hi praapt hota hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Chapter 11 ka aakhiri aur poori Bhagavad Gita ke saar-shloko mein se ek mahan shlok hai!
Krishna yahan moksha aur Ishwar-praapti ka 5 sutra formula dete hain:
1. Mat-karmakrit — Apne har kaam ko Ishwar ki sewa samajhkar karo.
2. Mat-paramah — Zindagi ka aakhiri lakshya Ishwar ko banao.
3. Mad-bhaktah — Dil mein sachcha prem rakho.
4. Sanga-varjitah — Sansarik buraiyon aur moh se bacho.
5. Nirvairah sarva-bhuteshu — Kisi bhi jeev ya insaan ke prati dil mein nafrat ya dushmani mat rakho.
Jo in 5 baaton ko apnata hai, use Ishwar zaroor milte hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Kisi se nafrat mat karo, apne kaam ko imaandari se Ishwar ki pooja samajhkar karo, aur sabke prati prem rakho — yahi jeevan ki sabse badi sadhana aur mukti ka marg hai.

summary: The twelfth chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Bhakti Yoga. In this chapter, Krishna emphasizes the superiority of Bhakti Yoga (the path of devotion) over all other types of spiritual disciplines and reveals various aspects of devotion. He further explains that the devotees who perform pure devotional service to Him, with their consciousness, merged in Him and all their actions dedicated to Him, are quickly liberated from the cycle of life and death. He also describes the various qualities of the devotees who are very dear to Him.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
एवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते ।
ये चाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः ॥ १॥
verses.transliteration:
Arjuna Uvacha:
Evam Satata Yukta Ye Bhaktas Tvam Paryupasate,
Ye Capy Aksharam Avyaktam Tesham Ke Yoga Vittamah.
verses.englishMeaning: Arjuna said: Those devotees who are constantly devoted and worship You thus in Your personal form, and those who worship the imperishable, unmanifest Supreme — of these, who are the foremost knowers of yoga?
verses.hinglishMeaning: Arjun ne poochha: Jo bhakt nirantar aapke sakar roop ki ananya bhav se upaasna karte hain, aur jo avinashi, nirakar avyakta tatva ki dhyan-sadhan karte hain — in dono mein se yoga ke sarvashreshtha gyani kaun hain?
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun yahan aadhyaatma ka ek bohot bada prashna poochte hain: 'Hey Krishna, Ishwar ki bhakti sakar roop (Prem, Murti, Swaroop) mein karna behtar hai, ya nirakar roop (Adrishya, Nirgun, Avyakta) mein?'

Yeh sawaal har aam seeker ke mann mein aata hai ki Bhagavan ko roop mein poojein ya bina roop ke.
verses.lifeLesson: Bhakti ke marg par chalte samay dvidha mein mat raho. Apne hriday aur swabhav ke anusaar Ishwar se gehra rishta jodna hi sabse zaroori hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
मय्यावेश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते ।
श्रद्धया परयोपेताः ते मे युक्ततमा मताः ॥ २॥
verses.transliteration:
Shri Bhagavan Uvacha:
Mayy Aveshya Mano Ye Mam Nitya Yukta Upasate,
Shraddhaya Parayopetas Te Me Yuktatama Matah.
verses.englishMeaning: The Blessed Lord said: Those who, fixing their minds on Me, worship Me with constant devotion, endowed with supreme faith — them do I consider the foremost among yogis!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shri Bhagavan ne kaha: Jo log apne man ko mujhme poori tarah ekaagra karke, nitya mujhse jude rehkar param shraddha ke saath meri upaasna karte hain, unhe main sarvashreshtha yogi maanta hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna spasht uttar dete hain: 'Jo bhakt apne mann ko poori tarah mujhme samarpit kar dete hain, jinke dil mein apar prem aur atoot vishwas hota hai, woh yogiyon mein sabse shreshtha hain.'

Sakar bhakti isliye saral aur shreshtha hai kyunki isme hriday ka prem sahaj roop se behta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jeevan mein kisi bhi lakshya ya Ishwar ko paane ke liye atoot shraddha aur man ki ekaagrata hi sabse badi taaqat hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ये त्वक्षरमनिर्देश्यमव्यक्तं पर्युपासते ।
सर्वत्रगमचिन्त्यञ्च कूटस्थमचलन्ध्रुवम् ॥ ३॥
verses.transliteration:
Ye Tv Aksharam Anirdeshyam Avyaktam Paryupasate,
Sarvatragam Acintyam Ca Kutastham Acalam Dhruvam.
verses.englishMeaning: Yet those who worship the imperishable, the indefinable, the unmanifest, the all-pervading, the unthinkable, the unchanging, the immovable, and the eternal,
verses.hinglishMeaning: Lekin jo log us avinashi, anirvachaneeya (jise shabdon mein bayaan na kiya ja sake), avyakta, sarvavyapi, achintya (jo kalpana se pare ho), kootastha (aparivartan-sheel), achal aur shashwat tatva ki upaasna karte hain,
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna Nirgun-Nirakar marg ka varnan karte hain:
Woh tatva jise aankhon se nahi dekha ja sakta, jise shabdon mein nahi baandha ja sakta, jo har jagah hai par roop-rahit hai.

Yeh gyaan ka marg hai jahan aatma bina kisi chitra ya aakar ke keval shuddh chetna mein dhyan lagati hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Parmatma shabdon aur aakaron se pare hain. Jo log gehri dhyan-avastha mein shanti ko khojte hain, unke liye bhi satya utna hi mahan hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सन्नियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं सर्वत्र समबुद्धयः ।
ते प्राप्नुवन्ति मामेव सर्वभूतहिते रताः ॥ ४॥
verses.transliteration:
Sanniyamyendriya Gramam Sarvatra Sama Buddhayah,
Te Prapnuvanti Mam Eva Sarva Bhuta Hite Ratah.
verses.englishMeaning: Having fully mastered all their senses, maintaining an equal vision everywhere, and actively devoted to the welfare of all living beings — they too attain Me alone!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Apni samast indriyon ko poori tarah vash mein karke, har sthiti aur har praani mein sam-bhav (samata) rakhne wale aur sabhi jeevon ke kalyan mein lage rehne wale log bhi mujhe hi praapt hote hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Nirakar marg par chalne walon ke liye Krishna do badi shartein batate hain:
1. Indriyon par poora niyantran aur har sthiti mein samta.
2. 'Sarva-bhuta-hite ratah' — Sabhi praaniyon ki bhalai aur kalyan mein lage rehna!

Jo log sabhi ki sewa karte hain aur sabme ek hi chetna dekhte hain, woh bhi ant mein Krishna ko hi paate hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Sanyam aur doosron ke kalyan ki bhavna ke bina gyaan adhura hai. Sabhi jeevon ke prati dayavan hona hi sachchi aatmik unnti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
क्लेशोऽधिकतरस्तेषामव्यक्तासक्तचेतसाम् ।
अव्यक्ता हि गतिर्दुःखं देहवद्भिरवाप्यते ॥ ५॥
verses.transliteration:
Klesho Dhikataras Tesham Avyaktasakta Cetasam,
Avyakta Hi Gatir Duhkham Dehavadbhir Avapyate.
verses.englishMeaning: Greater is the struggle for those whose minds are attached to the unmanifest; for the unmanifest path is exceedingly difficult for embodied beings to attain.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Avyakta (nirakar) tatva mein mann lagane walon ke liye klesh (kathinai aur sangharsh) bahut adhik hota hai; kyunki shareer-dhari jeevon ke liye nirakar ki gati ko paana behad dukhdayak aur kathin hota hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Hum sab shareer wale manushya hain. Jab tak humara astitva aakar mein hai, tab tak aakar-rahit (nirakar) mein dhyan lagana man ke liye behad mushkil hota hai.

Man bhatak jaata hai kyunki use koi aalamban (sahara) nahi milta. Isliye Krishna kehte hain ki nirakar ka rasta kathin hai, jabki prem aur bhakti ka rasta saral aur anand-dayak hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni swabhavik kshamta ko pehchano. Aatmik yatra mein zabardasti ke kathor raste ke bajaye sahaj, prem-bharia aur saral rasta chunna zyaada labhdayak hota hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः ।
अनन्येनैव योगेन मां ध्यायन्त उपासते ॥ ६॥
verses.transliteration:
Ye Tu Sarvani Karmani Mayi Sannyasya Mat Parah,
Ananyenaiva Yogena Mam Dhyayanta Upasate.
verses.englishMeaning: But those who dedicate all their actions unto Me, regarding Me as the supreme goal, meditating on Me with unswerving devotion,
verses.hinglishMeaning: Lekin jo log apne samast karmon ko mujhe samarpit karke, mujhe hi param lakshya maante hue, ananya bhav se mera dhyan karte hue meri upaasna karte hain,
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhakti marg ki sundarta yeh hai ki isme kuch chhodna nahi padta, balki sab kuch Ishwar ko arpan karna hota hai.

Jo log apna har karya, har saans aur har chintan Bhagavan ko samarpit kar dete hain, unhe alag se kathor tapasya nahi karni padti.
verses.lifeLesson: Apne har karm ko imaandari aur nishkam bhav se Ishwar ki bhent bana do; aisa karne se zindagi ka har pal pooja ban jaata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषामहं समुद्धर्ता मृत्युसंसारसागरात् ।
भवामि नचिरात्पार्थ मय्यावेशितचेतसाम् ॥ ७॥
verses.transliteration:
Tesham Aham Samuddharta Mrityu Samsara Sagarat,
Bhavami Na Cirat Partha Mayy Aveshita Cetasam.
verses.englishMeaning: For them, whose minds are absorbed in Me, I swiftly become their deliverer from the ocean of death and mortal existence, O Partha!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Partha! Mujhme man lagane wale aise bhakton ka main bina kisi vilamb ke (sheeghra hi) mrityu-roopi sansaar ke saagar se uddhar karne wala ban jaata hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Bhagavan ka pavan aashirwad hai!
Krishna wada karte hain: 'Arjun, jo mujh par bharosa karta hai, use akele sangharsh nahi karna padta. Sansaar ke dukh-dard aur janm-mrityu ke samudra se main khud use haath pakad kar paar kara deta hoon.'
verses.lifeLesson: Jab hum apna bhaar Ishwar par chhod dete hain, tab woh humara hath tham lete hain. Bharosa rakho, sankat ke samay Parmatma khud sahayak bante hain.

verses.sanskrit:
मय्येव मन आधत्स्व मयि बुद्धिं निवेशय ।
निवसिष्यसि मय्येव अत ऊर्ध्वं न संशयः ॥ ८॥
verses.transliteration:
Mayy Eva Mana Adhatsva Mayi Buddhim Niveshaya,
Nivasishyasi Mayy Eva Ata Urdhvam Na Samshayah.
verses.englishMeaning: Fix your mind on Me alone, and rest your intellect in Me; thereafter, you shall undoubtedly live in Me forever!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Tum apna man mujh mein hi sthir karo aur apni buddhi ko mujhme hi lagao; iske baad tum nishchit roop se mujh mein hi nivas karoge, isme koi sanshay nahi hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Man bhavnaon ka kendra hai aur buddhi faisle lene ka kendra hai.

Krishna kehte hain: 'Apna prem (man) aur apni samajh (buddhi) dono ko mere saath jod do.' Jab dil aur dimag dono ek disha mein chalte hain, tab insaan ka jeevan Ishwar-roop ho jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Keval dil se sochna ya keval dimag se sochna kaafi nahi hota. Dil ki shradha aur dimag ke vivek ko jab ek achhe lakshya mein lagaya jaaye, tab safalta nishchit hoti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नोषि मयि स्थिरम् ।
अभ्यासयोगेन ततो मामिच्छाप्तुं धनञ्जय ॥ ९॥
verses.transliteration:
Atha Cittam Samadhatum Na Shaknoshi Mayi Sthiram,
Abhyasa Yogena Tato Mam Icchaptum Dhananjaya.
verses.englishMeaning: If you are unable to fix your mind steadily on Me, then seek to attain Me through the regular practice of yoga (Abhyasa Yoga), O Dhananjaya!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yadi tum apne man ko mujhme achal roop se sthir karne mein asamarth ho, toh hey Dhananjaya (Arjun)! Abhyas-yoga (nirantar prayas) ke dwara mujhe paane ki ichha karo.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna bohot dayalu guru hain. Woh jaante hain ki ek hi din mein man ko sthir karna aasan nahi hai.

Isliye woh seedhi ka agla kadam batate hain: 'Agar man baar-baar bhatakta hai, toh chinta mat karo. Abhyas karo — man jab-jab bhatke, use dheere se wapas sahi disha mein lao.'
verses.lifeLesson: Kisi bhi achhi aadat ya dhyan ko paane ke liye baar-baar abhyas (practice) ki zaroorat hoti hai. Asafalta se haar mat maano, lagatar koshish hi jeet dilati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अभ्यासेऽप्यसमर्थोऽसि मत्कर्मपरमो भव ।
मदर्थमपि कर्माणि कुर्वन्सिद्धिमवाप्स्यसि ॥ १०॥
verses.transliteration:
Abhyase Py Asamartho Si Mat Karma Paramo Bhava,
Mad Artham Api Karmani Kurvan Siddhim Avapsyasi.
verses.englishMeaning: If you are unable even to practice meditation regularly, then be devoted to working for My sake. Even by performing actions for My sake, you shall attain perfection!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yadi tum niyamit abhyas karne mein bhi asamarth ho, toh mere liye karm karne mein lag jao. Mere nimit (sewa-bhav se) karm karte hue bhi tum param siddhi ko praapt karoge.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Agar dhyan lagane ka samay ya abhyas nahi ho paata, toh Krishna ek aur aasan rasta batate hain:
'Jo bhi kaam tum karte ho — chahe naukri, vyapar, ghar ke kaam ya samaj ki sewa — use doosron ke kalyan aur Ishwar ki sewa samajh kar karo.' Aisa karm-yoga dhyan jitna hi pavitra ban jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Agar aap roz ghanto dhyan nahi laga sakte, toh apne har kaam ko imandari aur sewa-bhav se karo. Sewa hi sabse bada dhyan hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अथैतदप्यशक्तोऽसि कर्तुं मद्योगमाश्रितः ।
सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं ततः कुरु यतात्मवान् ॥ ११॥
verses.transliteration:
Athaitad Apy Ashakto Si Kartum Mad Yogam Ashritah,
Sarva Karma Phala Tyagam Tatah Kuru Yatatma Van.
verses.englishMeaning: If you are unable to do even this, then taking refuge in My divine yoga, surrender the fruits of all your actions with self-restraint!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aur yadi tum isko bhi karne mein asamarth ho, toh aatm-sanyam se yukt hokar mere aashray mein aao aur apne sabhi karmon ke phal ki aasakti ka tyag kar do.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Krishna ki karuna ki hadh hai! Woh aam insaan ke liye rasta aur aasan bana dete hain:
'Agar tum sab kuch Ishwar ko arpan karna bhi nahi samajh paate, toh bas itna karo ki jo bhi kaam karo, uske parinaam (result) ki chinta chhod do. Kaam poora karo, par fal ke lalach mein mat phaso.'
verses.lifeLesson: Parinaam ki chinta chhod kar vartaman mein imaandari se mehnat karo. Fal ki apeksha na rakhna hi man ko tanav aur darr se mukt karta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रेयो हि ज्ञानमभ्यासाज्ज्ञानाद्ध्यानं विशिष्यते ।
ध्यानात्कर्मफलत्यागस्त्यागाच्छान्तिरनन्तरम् ॥ १२॥
verses.transliteration:
Shreyo Hi Jnanam Abhyasaj Jnanad Dhyanam Vishishyate,
Dhyanat Karma Phala Tyagas Tyagac Chantir Anantaram.
verses.englishMeaning: Better indeed is knowledge than blind mechanical practice; better than knowledge is meditation; better than meditation is the surrender of the fruits of action; for immediate peace follows such surrender!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Bina samjhe kiye gaye abhyas se gyaan shreshtha hai; gyaan se dhyan shreshtha hai; aur dhyan se bhi shreshtha karm-phal ka tyag hai; kyunki tyag karte hi tatkaal param shanti praapt hoti hai!
verses.simpleExplanation:
Gita ka ek adbhut shlok jisme man ki shanti ka sidha formula diya gaya hai:
1. Ratne wale abhyas se behtar hai samajh (gyaan).
2. Gyaan se behtar hai us par manan (dhyan).
3. Aur dhyan se bhi bada hai 'fal ki chinta chhodna' (tyag).
Jaise hi insaan parinaam ki chinta aur lalach chhod deta hai, usi pal uske bheetar shanti ka jharokha khul jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Zindagi mein tanav aur bechaini ka mool kaaran 'har cheez apne hisaab se chaahna' hai. Parinaam ki pakad chhodte hi mann mein tatkaal shanti laut aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च ।
निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी ॥ १३॥
verses.transliteration:
Adveshta Sarva Bhutanam Maitrah Karuna Eva Ca,
Nirmamo Nirahankarah Sama Duhkha Sukhah Kshami.
verses.englishMeaning: One who bears no malice toward any living creature, who is friendly and compassionate, free from possessiveness and ego, equal in joy and sorrow, and ever forgiving,
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo kisi bhi praani se dvesh (nafrat) nahi karta, jo sabka sachcha mitra hai aur karunawan (dayalu) hai, jo mamta (mera-mera) aur ahankar se mukt hai, sukh aur dukh mein ek saman rehta hai aur kshama-sheel hai,
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yahan se Krishna batate hain ki unhe kaisa insaan sabse priya hai:
1. Adveshta — kisi se jalan ya dushmani na ho.
2. Maitrah aur Karuna — sabke prati dosti aur daya ka bhav ho.
3. Nirmamah, Nirahankarah — ghamand aur lalach se door ho.
4. Kshami — doosron ki galtiyon ko maaf karne ki vishalta ho.
verses.lifeLesson: Nafrat ko dil se nikaalo, sabke dost bano aur maaf karna seekho. Jo vyakti dukh aur sukh mein shant rehta hai, wahi sachcha aatmik insaan hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सन्तुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः ।
मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः ॥ १४॥
verses.transliteration:
Santushtah Satatam Yogi Yatatma Dridha Nishcayah,
Mayy Arpita Mano Buddhir Yo Mad Bhaktah Sa Me Priyah.
verses.englishMeaning: Ever content, constantly united in yoga, self-restrained, firm in conviction, with mind and intellect dedicated unto Me — such a devotee of Mine is exceedingly dear to Me!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo sadaiv santusht rehta hai, nityayukt yogi hai, sanyami aatma wala hai, dridh nishchay wala hai, aur jisne apna man aur buddhi mujhe samarpit kar rakhi hai — aisa mera bhakt mujhe atyant priya hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna kehte hain ki mujhe woh insaan bohot pyara lagta hai jo:
- Har halaat mein santusht rehta hai, bina shikayat kiye.
- Apne niyam aur dridh sankalp par atal rehta hai.
- Jiska man aur samajh Parmatma ke prem mein bandhi hui hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Santosh (contentment) sabse bada dhan hai. Jo insaan bheetar se santusht aur dridh nishchayi hota hai, woh sansaar ki kisi bhi mushkil se nahi darta.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः ।
हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः ॥ १५॥
verses.transliteration:
Yasman Nodvijate Loko Lokan Nodvijate Ca Yah,
Harshamarsha Bhayodvegair Mukto Yah Sa Ca Me Priyah.
verses.englishMeaning: One by whom the world is not agitated, and who is not agitated by the world, free from the grips of excessive excitement, resentment, fear, and anxiety — such a one is dearly beloved to Me!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jiske kaaran kisi bhi doosre vyakti ko koi dukh ya kshobh (tension) nahi hota, aur jo khud bhi kisi vyakti ke vyavahar se pareshan nahi hota; jo atyadhik harsha, jalan (amarsha), bhay aur chinta se mukt hai — aisa vyakti mujhe priya hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh jeevan jeene ka ek mahan niyam hai:
1. Na toh kisi ko dukh ya tanav do.
2. Aur na hi doosron ke burre vyavahar se khud ko pareshan hone do.
Jo vyakti gusse, jalan aur darr se upar uthkar shant jeeta hai, Krishna use apna sabse pyara kehte hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Na kisi ki chinta ka kaaran bano, na doosron ki baaton se apna sukoon kho do. Apne mann ka remote control apne haath mein rakho.

verses.sanskrit:
अनपेक्षः शुचिर्दक्ष उदासीनो गतव्यथः ।
सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः ॥ १६॥
verses.transliteration:
Anapekshah Shucir Daksha Udasino Gata Vyathah,
Sarvarambha Parityagi Yo Mad Bhaktah Sa Me Priyah.
verses.englishMeaning: One who is free from selfish expectation, pure inside and out, skillful and capable, detached, free from anxiety, and who has renounced the ego of doership in all undertakings — such a devotee is dear to Me!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo kisi apeksha (swarth) se rahit hai, bheetar aur bahar se pavitra hai, apne karya mein daksh (efficient) hai, nishpaksh hai, chintaon se mukt hai aur sabhi karmon mein karta-pan ke ahankar se rahit hai — aisa mera bhakt mujhe priya hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna yahan 6 adbhut gun batate hain:
- Anapekshah: Kisi se koi faltu umeed na rakhna.
- Shucih: Tan aur man ki pavitrata.
- Dakshah: Apne kaam mein nipun aur mehanti hona.
- Udasinah: Bina pakshpaat ke nishpaksh rehna.
- Gata-vyathah: Chinta aur darr se aazad hona.
- Sarvarambha-parityagi: 'Yeh sab maine kiya' wale ghamand se mukt hona.
verses.lifeLesson: Apne kaam mein expert bano, par swarth aur ghamand se door raho. Jab apekshayein kam hoti hain, tab jeevan saral aur shant ban jaata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यो न हृष्यति न द्वेष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति ।
शुभाशुभपरित्यागी भक्तिमान्यः स मे प्रियः ॥ १७॥
verses.transliteration:
Yo Na Hrishyati Na Dveshti Na Shocati Na Kankshati,
Shubhashubha Parityagi Bhaktiman Yah Sa Me Priyah.
verses.englishMeaning: One who neither rejoices excessively nor hates, who neither grieves nor craves, and who renounces both good and bad attachments, full of pure devotion — such a one is dear to Me!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo na toh atyadhik khush hokar aapa khota hai, na kisi se dvesh karta hai, na nuksaan hone par shok karta hai, na kisi cheez ki laalsa karta hai; aur jo shubh tatha ashubh dono falon se upar uth chuka hai — aisa bhaktiman vyakti mujhe priya hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Insaan aamtaur par acchi cheez milne par uchhal padta hai aur buri cheez milne par rone lagta hai.

Krishna kehte hain ki santulit manushya woh hai jo har sthiti mein sthir rehta hai — na kisi se nafrat, na be-wajah shok aur na lalach. Uska dhyan keval Parmatma mein laga hota hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Zindagi mein utaar-chadhaav aate rahenge. Khushi mein zameen mat chhod aur dukh mein himmat mat haaro; santulan hi asli yog hai.

verses.sanskrit:
समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः ।
शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु समः सङ्गविवर्जितः ॥ १८॥
verses.transliteration:
Samah Shatrau Ca Mitre Ca Tatha Manapamanayoh,
Shitoshna Sukha Duhkheshu Samah Sanga Vivarjitah.
verses.englishMeaning: One who treats friend and foe alike, who remains equal in honor and dishonor, the same in cold and heat, pleasure and pain, and free from all selfish attachment,
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo shatru aur mitra mein ek saman bhav rakhta hai, maan aur apmaan mein shant rehta hai, sardi aur garmi tatha sukh aur dukh mein samta banaye rakhta hai, aur sabhi asaktiyon se mukt hai,
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ko Krishna samjhate hain ki aatmik unnti ki sachchi pehchan tab hoti hai jab koi aapki tareef kare ya be-izzati kare, par aapka bheetari sukoon na toote.

Jaise pahaad par mausam ka asar nahi hota, waise hi sachche bhakt ke mann par paristithiyon ki thand aur garmi ka bura asar nahi padta.
verses.lifeLesson: Duniya ki tareef aur burai dono aani-jaani dhoop-chhaon hain. Apne bheetar ki shanti ko doosron ki rai par nirbhar mat hone do.

verses.sanskrit:
तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिर्मौनी सन्तुष्टो येन केनचित् ।
अनिकेतः स्थिरमतिर्भक्तिमान्मे प्रियो नरः ॥ १९॥
verses.transliteration:
Tulya Ninda Stutir Mauni Santushto Yena Kenacit,
Aniketah Sthira Matir Bhaktiman Me Priyo Narah.
verses.englishMeaning: To whom praise and blame are equal, who is contemplative and silent, content with whatever comes unsought, free from possessiveness of home, and of steady intellect — such a devoted person is dear to Me!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jiske liye ninda aur prashansa dono barabar hain, jo mauni (chup rehne aur aatm-chintan karne wala) hai, jo kuch bhi mil jaaye usme santusht rehta hai, ghar ya sthan ke moh se mukt hai aur dridh buddhi wala hai — aisa bhakt mujhe atyant priya hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna kehte hain:
- Mauni ka matlab hai bina wajah faltu baatein na bolna aur andar shanti rakhna.
- Ninda aur stuti mein barabari — koi bura kahe toh gussa nahi, accha kahe toh ahankar nahi.
- Jo mil gaya, usi mein khush rehna.
Aisa vyakti jahan bhi rehta hai, wahan mandir ban jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Kam bolo, gehra socho aur jo prasad-swaroop mil jaaye usme santusht raho. Sthir buddhi hi insaan ko shanti deti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ये तु धर्म्यामृतमिदं यथोक्तं पर्युपासते ।
श्रद्दधाना मत्परमा भक्तास्तेऽतीव मे प्रियाः ॥ २०॥
verses.transliteration:
Ye Tu Dharmyamritam Idam Yathoktam Paryupasate,
Shraddadhana Mat Parama Bhaktas Te Tiva Me Priyah.
verses.englishMeaning: Those who with deep faith cultivate this immortal nectar of righteous wisdom (dharmyamritam) as declared, regarding Me as the supreme goal — such devotees are exceedingly dear to Me!
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo bhakt shraddha-yukt hokar, mujhe hi apna param aashray aur lakshya maante hue, is upar kahe gaye dharm-may amrit ka (in sabhi mahan gunon ka) aacharan karte hain — woh bhakt mujhe sabse adhik priya hain!
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Chapter 12 ka aakhiri shlok hai aur Bhakti Yoga ka amrit hai!
Krishna kehte hain: 'Jo log sirf sunte hi nahi, balki is amrit-tulya dharma ko apne aacharan aur vyavahar mein utarte hain — jinme daya hai, kshama hai, santosh hai aur prem hai — woh bhakt mere dil ke sabse kareeb hain.'
verses.lifeLesson: Gyaan sirf baatein karne ke liye nahi, jeevan mein jeene ke liye hota hai. Daya, prem, shanti aur vinamrata ko apne rozana ke vyavahar mein utaro — yahi Bhagavan ki sabse badi pooja hai.

summary: The thirteenth chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga. The word kshetra means the field, and the kshetrajna means the knower of the field. We can think of our material body as the field and our immortal soul as the knower of the field. In this chapter, Krishna discriminates between the physical body and the immortal soul. He explains that the physical body is temporary and perishable whereas the soul is permanent and eternal. The physical body can be destroyed but the soul can never be destroyed. The chapter then describes God, who is the Supreme Soul. All the individual souls have originated from the Supreme Soul. One who clearly understands the difference between the body, the Soul and the Supreme Soul attains the realization of Brahman.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
इदं शरीरं कौन्तेय क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते ।
एतद्यो वेत्ति तं प्राहुः क्षेत्रज्ञ इति तद्विदः ॥ १॥
verses.transliteration:
Shri-Bhagavan Uvacha:
Idam Shariram Kaunteya Kshetram Ity Abhidhiyate,
Etad Yo Vetti Tam Prahuh Kshetrajna Iti Tad-vidah.
verses.englishMeaning: The Supreme Lord said: O son of Kunti (Arjuna), this body is called the Kshetra (the field of activities). And one who knows this body is called Kshetrajna (the knower of the field) by those who discern the ultimate truth.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shri Bhagavan ne kaha: Hey Kunti-putra Arjun! Yeh shareer "kshetra" (khet ya karm-kshetra) kehlata hai. Aur jo is shareer ko bheetar se jaan-ne wala hai (is chetna ka gyaata hai), use tatva ko jaan-ne wale gyaani "kshetrajna" kehte hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Is shlok mein Bhagavan Shri Krishna adhyatmik gyaan ki sabse moolbhoot baat samjhate hain. Vah kehte hain ki hamara sthool aur sookshma shareer ek khet (kshetra) ki tarah hai, jismein ham karm ke beej bote hain aur unke phal prapt karte hain.
