Lekin jo is shareer ke har anubhav, vichar aur parivartan ko jaan raha hai—arthat hamari aatma—vah is khet se poori tarah alag hai. Use "kshetrajna" kaha gaya hai.

Ise samajhna hi gyaan ki shuruat hai, kyunki jab hum shareer aur aatma ke is antar ko jaan lete hain, tab dehabhiman aur mrityu ka bhay swatah door ho jata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Aapka shareer aur man ek saadhan hain, parantu aap swayam unke gyaata aur nitya chetna hain. Apne shareer aur man ke badalte halaat se ghabrane ke bajay, unke shant sakshi banein.

verses.sanskrit:
क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत ।
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ज्ञानं यत्तज्ज्ञानं मतं मम ॥ २॥
verses.transliteration:
Kshetrajnam Chapi Mam Viddhi Sarva-kshetreshu Bharata,
Kshetra-kshetrajnayor Jnanam Yat Taj Jnanam Matam Mama.
verses.englishMeaning: O scion of Bharata, know that I am also the Kshetrajna (the knower) residing within all fields (all bodies). The true perception and knowledge of both the field and the knower of the field is what I consider to be genuine wisdom.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Bharatvanshi Arjun! Samast shareeron mein jo kshetrajna (antaryami jaan-ne wala) hai, use tum Mujhe hi jaano. Kshetra (shareer) aur kshetrajna (aatma v Parmatma) ke bhed ko yatharth roop se jaan lena hi vastavik gyaan hai—aisa Mera mat hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhagavan Krishna yahan ek atyant gambhir tatva prakat karte hain. Har shareer mein aatma ke roop mein sthit hone ke saath-saath, Bhagavan swayam Paramatma roop mein sabhi jeevon ke antaryami sakshi hain.

Keval sansarik vidya ya bhedbhav jan-na vastavik gyaan nahi hai. Asli gyaan yeh samajhna hai ki nashvar shareer (kshetra) kya hai aur uske bheetar sthit anashvar chetna (kshetrajna) kaun hai.

Jab manushya ko shareer aur aatma ka yeh spashta vivek ho jata hai, tab vah sansar ke bandhanon se mukt hokar Parmeshwar ko sabhi mein sthit dekh pata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Vastavik gyaan kitaabon ki jankari nahi, balki swayam ke nitya aatmaroop ko pehchanna aur sabhi jeevon mein ek hi Divya Chetna ko anubhav karna hai.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्क्षेत्रं यच्च यादृक्च यद्विकारि यतश्च यत् ।
स च यो यत्प्रभावश्च तत्समासेन मे शृणु ॥ ३॥
verses.transliteration:
Tat Kshetram Yac Cha Yadrik Cha Yad-vikari Yatash Cha Yat,
Sa Cha Yo Yat-prabhavash Cha Tat Samasena Me Shrinu.
verses.englishMeaning: Now hear briefly from Me what that field is, what its nature is, what transformations it undergoes, from what source it arises, and also who that knower is and what His divine glory and power are.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Vah kshetra kya hai, uska swaroop kaisa hai, usmein kya-kya vikar (badlav) hote hain, vah kisse utpann hua hai, aur vah kshetrajna kaun hai tatha uska kya prabhav hai—yeh sab tum sankshep mein Mujhse suno.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhagavan Krishna Arjun se kehte hain ki aage aane wale shlokon mein vah kshetra aur kshetrajna ke poorna tatva ko saral aur sankshep mein batayenge.

Ismein shareer ki sanrachna, man aur indriyon ke badlav jaise kamana, krodh, sukh-dukh, aur aatma v Parmeshwar ka alaukik prabhav shamil hain.

Bhagavan ka uddeshya yeh hai ki Arjun bina kisi bhram ke is goorh adhyatmik rahasya ko asani se hridyangam kar sake.
verses.lifeLesson: Kissi bhi vishay ko samajhne ke liye uske mool karano, parivartano aur prabhav ko shanti se vishleshan karna zaroori hai. Sahi vivek hi jeevan ki buniyad hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋषिभिर्बहुधा गीतं छन्दोभिर्विविधैः पृथक् ।
ब्रह्मसूत्रपदैश्चैव हेतुमद्भिर्विनिश्चितैः ॥ ४॥
verses.transliteration:
Rishibhir Bahudha Gitam Chhandobhir Vividhaih Prithak,
Brahma-sutra-padaish Chaiva Hetumadbhir Vinishchitaih.
verses.englishMeaning: This truth of the field and its knower has been sung in manifold ways by the great rishis, described separately in various Vedic hymns, and logically analyzed with definitive conclusions in the aphorisms of the Brahma Sutras.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Is kshetra aur kshetrajna ke tatva ko rishiyon ne alag-alag tarah se gaya hai, vedon ke vibhinn chhandon mein spashta kiya hai, aur yukti-yukta tatha nishchayatmak Brahma-sutra ke pado dwara bhi samjhaya gaya hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhagavan Krishna batate hain ki aatma aur shareer ka yeh vivek koi nayi baat nahi hai. Prachin kal se mahan tapashvi rishiyon ne iska dhyan kiya hai aur Vedon ke pavitra mantron mein ise gaya hai.

Sath hi Brahma Sutra jaise nishchayatmaka aur tark-sangat granthon mein bhi yuktiyon ke saath is satya ko pramanit kiya gaya hai.

Isse yeh siddha hota hai ki yeh gyaan sarvakalik, pramanik aur sanatan hai, jismein kisi sanshay ki koi gunjayish nahi hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Satya wahi hai jo anubhav, praman aur tarka teeno ki kasauti par khara utre. Prachin rishiyon ke anubhav aur shastron ki seekh hamare jeevan ko sahi disha deti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
महाभूतान्यहंकारो बुद्धिरव्यक्तमेव च ।
इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च पञ्च चेन्द्रियगोचराः ॥ ५॥
verses.transliteration:
Maha-bhutany Ahankaro Buddhir Avyaktam Eva Cha,
Indriyani Dashaika Cha Pancha Chendriya-gocharah.
verses.englishMeaning: The five great elements, the ego, the intellect, the unmanifest primal nature, the ten senses, the one mind, and the five objects of the senses—all these constitute the field.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Paanch mahabhoot (prithvi, jal, agni, vayu, aakash), ahankar, buddhi, avyakta mool prakriti, das indriyan (paanch gyaan-indriyan aur paanch karm-indriyan), ek man, aur indriyon ke paanch vishay (roop, ras, gandh, sparsh, shabd)—yeh sab milkar kshetra bante hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yahan Bhagavan Krishna kshetra (prakriti ya shareer) ke chaubees (24) tatva ginate hain. Ismein sthool bhoot (panch-tatva), sookshma shaktiyan jaise ahankar, buddhi aur mool prakriti shamil hain.

Sath hi dekhne, sunne, soonghne, chakhne aur chhoone ki paanch gyaan-indriyan, paanch karm-indriyan, unka kendra hamara man, aur sansar ke paanch vishay aate hain.

Yeh sabhi padarth nashvar aur parivartansheel prakriti ka hissa hain, aatma inse poornatah alag aur nirmal hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Hamara sharir, man aur vichar prakriti ke tatvon se bane hain. In badalte hue tatvon ko apna swaroop na maankar, inke sakshi bankar jeena hi sachhi swatantrata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
इच्छा द्वेषः सुखं दुःखं संघातश्चेतना धृतिः ।
एतत्क्षेत्रं समासेन सविकारमुदाहृतम् ॥ ६॥
verses.transliteration:
Ichha Dveshah Sukham Duhkham Sanghatash Chetana Dhritih,
Etat Kshetram Samasena Sa-vikaram Udahritam.
verses.englishMeaning: Desire, aversion, pleasure, pain, the aggregate (the physical body), consciousness, and conviction—this, in brief, is declared to be the field along with its modifications.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Ichha (kamana), dvesha (shatrutva), sukh, dukh, shareer (indriyon ka sanghata), chetna (praan shakti) aur dhriti (dhairya)—yeh sabhi vikar sahit "kshetra" sankshep mein kaha gaya hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Pichhle shlok mein prakriti ke chaubees tatvon ka varnan karne ke baad, yahan Bhagavan man ke bheetar uthne wale vikar batate hain.

Ichha, dvesha, sukh, dukh, shareer ka sangathan, chetna ki vritti aur dhairya—yeh sabhi aatma ke swaroop nahi hain, balki man aur shareer roopi "kshetra" ke hi roopantar hain.

Aksar hum sukh-dukh ya kamanaon ko apni aatma samajh baithte hain, parantu yeh sabhi khet mein paida hone wali fasal ki tarah badalti rehti hain. Aatma in sabhi ka nirlep sakshi hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Aapke man mein uthne wali kamana, krodh, dukh ya sukh aapka asli swaroop nahi hain. Vah man ke parivartan hain. Unke saath judkar vyakul hone ke bajay, unhe ek sakshi ki tarah dekhna seekhein.

verses.sanskrit:
अमानित्वमदम्भित्वमहिंसा क्षान्तिरार्जवम् ।
आचार्योपासनं शौचं स्थैर्यमात्मविनिग्रहः ॥ ७॥
verses.transliteration:
Amanitvam Adambhitvam Ahimsa Kshantir Arjavam,
Acharyopasanam Shaucham Sthairyam Atma-vinigrahah.
verses.englishMeaning: Humility, modesty, non-violence, forgiveness, uprightness, devoted service to the spiritual teacher, inner and outer purity, steadfastness, and self-control.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Maan-samman ki ichha na hona (vinamrata), pakhand ka abhav (saralta), ahimsa, kshama, seedhapan (arjav), guru ki nishkapata seva, bheetari aur bahari shuddhata, mann ki sthirata, aur aatma-sanyam (indriyo par niyantran).
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yahan se Bhagavan Krishna "gyaan" ke lakshano ka varnan shuru karte hain. Vah spashta karte hain ki gyaan keval dimag ki jankari nahi hai, balki yeh aacharan aur charitra ki pavitrata hai.

Apne ahankar ko mitana, dikhava na karna, kisi ko dukh na pahunchana, kshama bhav rakhna, man-vachan-karm se seedha hona, sadguru ki nishkam seva karna, shuddhata, sthirata aur atm-sanyam—yeh sabhi sadgun aatma-saakshatkar ke dwar hain.

In guno ke bina manushya kitna bhi padh-likh le, vah sachhe adhyatmik gyaan se vanchit hi rehta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sachha gyaan vinamrata aur charitra ki pavitrata se jhalakta hai, dikhave se nahi. Jab man mein shuddhata aur dhairya hota hai, tabhi jeevan mein shanti aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रियार्थेषु वैराग्यमनहंकार एव च ।
जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिदुःखदोषानुदर्शनम् ॥ ८॥
verses.transliteration:
Indriyartheshu Vairagyam Anahankara Eva Cha,
Janma-mrityu-jara-vyadhi-duhkha-doshanudarshanam.
verses.englishMeaning: Dispassion toward the objects of the senses, absence of false ego, and persistent reflection on the inherent suffering and defects of birth, death, old age, and disease.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Indriyon ke bhogon ke prati vairagya (anasakti), ahankar ka abhav, tatha janma, mrityu, budhapa aur bimariyon mein dukh aur dosh ka nirantar chintan karna.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhagavan Krishna gyaan ke agle lakshan batate hain. Sansar ke nashvar bhogon ke peeche bhaagne ke bajay man mein virakti ka hona aur ahankar ka na hona atyant mahatvapoorna hai.

Sath hi manushya ko jeevan ki vastavikta ko pehchanna chahiye—janma, mrityu, vriddhavastha aur rog ke dukhon ko gehrai se samajhna chahiye.

Jab vyakti is sansar ki nashvarta aur dukh-roop ko dekh leta hai, tab uska moh toot jata hai aur vah aatma ke nitya anand ki taraf aage badhta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jeevan ki kadvii sachhaiyon—rog, budhape aur mrityu—ko yaad rakhne se sansarik lalach aur ahankar shant hote hain, aur man satya ki khoj mein lagta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
असक्तिरनभिष्वङ्गः पुत्रदारगृहादिषु ।
नित्यं च समचित्तत्वमिष्टानिष्टोपपत्तिषु ॥ ९॥
verses.transliteration:
Asaktir Anabhishvangah Putra-dara-grihadishu,
Nityam Cha Sama-chittatvam Ishtanishtopapattishu.
verses.englishMeaning: Non-attachment, absence of clinging identification with children, spouse, home, and the like; and constant equanimity of mind amid desirable and undesirable events.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aasakti ka abhav, parivar, patni, ghar aadi mein andha moh ya chipkav na hona, aur shubh tatha ashubh ghatnaon ki prapti mein sada chitta ka sam-bhav (santulan) bane rehna.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Is shlok ka arth parivar ya kartavyon ka tyag karna nahi hai, balki unse jude andhe moh aur aasakti se mukt hona hai. Prem karna alag baat hai aur moh mein bandh jana alag.

Sath hi priya (manpasand) aur apriya (anukool ya pratikool) sthitiyon mein man ka santulan banaye rakhna gyaan ka prateek hai.

Jo vyakti labh-hani ya sukh-dukh mein samata mein rehta hai, uska man sada shaant aur sthir bana rehta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Parivar aur jimmedariyon ko poore prem se nibhayein, parantu unhe apna bandhan na banne dein. Paristhitiyan chahe anukool hon ya pratikool, apne man ki shanti ko mat khone dein.

verses.sanskrit:
मयि चानन्ययोगेन भक्तिरव्यभिचारिणी ।
विविक्तदेशसेवित्वमरतिर्जनसंसदि ॥ १०॥
verses.transliteration:
Mayi Chananya-yogena Bhaktir Avyabhicharini,
Vivikta-desha-sevitvam Aratir Jana-samsadi.
verses.englishMeaning: Unswerving, exclusive devotion unto Me with singular focus, fondness for solitary and peaceful places, and a natural detachment from frivolous worldly crowds.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Mujhmein ananya prem ke saath avyabhicharini (eknishtha) bhakti, shant aur ekant sthanon mein rehne ki ruchi, aur sansarik vyarth ki bheed-bhad se virakti.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhagavan batate hain ki bina bhakti ke gyaan poora nahi ho sakta. Parmeshwar mein aisi nishtha jismein koi doosra swarth ya bhatkav na ho, wahi sachha gyaan hai.

Iski prapti ke liye sadhak ko ekant, shant aur pavitra sthan priya lagte hain jahan vah aatmadhyan kar sake.

Vah sansarik vishayon mein lipt shor-sharabe aur vyarth ki charchaon se door rehna pasand karta hai, taaki uski urja Parmatma ke chintan mein lagi rahe.
verses.lifeLesson: Apne dhyan aur urja ko vyarth ke samajik dikhave mein nasht na karein. Thoda samay ekant aur Ishwar chintan mein bitayein, jisse antarmukhi shanti prapt ho.

verses.sanskrit:
अध्यात्मज्ञाननित्यत्वं तत्त्वज्ञानार्थदर्शनम् ।
एतज्ज्ञानमिति प्रोक्तमज्ञानं यदतोऽन्यथा ॥ ११॥
verses.transliteration:
Adhyatma-jnana-nityatvam Tattva-jnanartha-darshanam,
Etaj Jnanam Iti Proktam Ajnanam Yad Ato 'nyatha.
verses.englishMeaning: Constancy in self-knowledge, perception of the goal of true knowledge (the Supreme Truth)—all this is declared to be wisdom; and whatever is opposed to this is ignorance.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Adhyatmik gyaan mein nirantar sthirata aur tatva-gyaan ke uddeshya (Parmatma) ka nitya darshan karna—ise hi gyaan kaha gaya hai, aur jo iske viprit hai, vah sab agyaan hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shlok 7 se 11 tak gyaan ke bees (20) sadguno ka varnan karne ke baad, Bhagavan Krishna yahan nishkarsh nikaalte hain.

Atma-gyaan mein nitya lage rehna aur Param Tatva (Ishwar) ko jeevan ka antim lakshya maankar uska anubhav karna hi sachha gyaan hai.

In sabhi sadguno ke alawa jo kuch bhi hai—jaise ahankar, dambh, krodh, vishay-bhog aur sansarik bhatkav—vah sabhi "agyaan" (avidya) hai, jo manushya ko bandhan mein daalta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jeevan ka vastavik uddeshya aatma aur Parmatma ko pehchanna hai. Jo gyaan humein ahankar se mukt karke nirmal aur shaant banaye, wahi sachha gyaan hai; shesh sab agyaan hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञेयं यत्तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वामृतमश्नुते ।
अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म न सत्तन्नासदुच्यते ॥ १२॥
verses.transliteration:
Jneyam Yat Tat Pravakshyami Yaj Jnatvamritam Ashnute,
Anadi Mat-param Brahma Na Sat Tan Nasad Uchyate.
verses.englishMeaning: I shall now clearly describe that which is to be known, knowing which one attains immortality. It is the beginningless Supreme Brahman, which is said to be neither being (sat) nor non-being (asat).
verses.hinglishMeaning: Ab Main use spashta roop se kahoonga jo jaan-ne yogya (jneyam) hai, jise jaankar manushya amritatva (amar pad) ko paata hai. Vah anaadi (jiska koi aadi nahi), Parambrahma hai, jise na "sat" kaha ja sakta hai aur na "asat".
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhagavan Krishna ab "Jneya" arthat us Param Satya ka varnan karte hain jise jaan-na hi manushya jeevan ka antim lakshya hai. Ise jaan lene par manushya janma-mrityu ke chakravyooh se mukt hokar amritatva ko prapt karta hai.

Parambrahma anaadi hai aur kisi seema mein nahi bandhta. Use kisi sthool roop (sat) ya shunya (asat) ke roop mein seemit nahi kiya ja sakta, kyunki vah sabhi bhed-bhaavon aur kalpanaon se pare hai.

Vah shuddh chetna roop hai, jo har vastu mein sthit hokar bhi sabse pare hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sansar ki nashvar cheezon ko jaan-ne se mrityu ka bhay khatam nahi hota; kintu bheetar sthit Param Tatva ko anubhav karne par amar shanti aur nirdarata prapt hoti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत्सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम् ।
सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति ॥ १३॥
verses.transliteration:
Sarvatah Pani-padam Tat Sarvato 'kshi-shiro-mukham,
Sarvatah Shrutimal Loke Sarvam Avritya Tishthati.
verses.englishMeaning: With hands and feet everywhere, with eyes, heads, and faces everywhere, with ears in all directions, that Supreme Reality exists, pervading everything in the cosmos.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Us Paramatma ke haath aur pair sabhi or hain; Uske netra, sir aur mukh sabhi dishaon mein hain; Uske kaan sabhi jagah hain. Vah is sansar mein sab kuch vyapt karke (samakar) sthit hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Is divya shlok mein Bhagavan Parambrahma ki sarvavyapakta ka roopak khinchte hain. Iska arth yeh nahi ki Ishwar ke anant shareer hain, balki yeh hai ki sansar ke sabhi haath, pair, aakhein aur kaan usi ek Chetna se sanchalit hain.

Jahan bhi koi karm hota hai, wahan Ishwar ki shakti kaam kar rahi hai; jo kuch bhi dekha ya suna ja raha hai, uske sakshi wahi hain.

Jab hum yeh samajhte hain ki Ishwar sarvatra sthit hai, tab humein lagta hai ki hum kabhi akele nahi hain aur hamara koi bhi karm Usse chhipa nahi hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Ishwar har sthan par aur har jeev ke roop mein upasthit hain. Isliye sabhi ke prati aadar aur dayaluta ka bhav rakhein, aur yeh yaad rakhein ki Parmatma sada hamare saath hain.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वेन्द्रियगुणाभासं सर्वेन्द्रियविवर्जितम् ।
असक्तं सर्वभृच्चैव निर्गुणं गुणभोक्तृ च ॥ १४॥
verses.transliteration:
Sarvendriya-gunabhasam Sarvendriya-vivarjitam,
Asaktam Sarva-bhric Chaiva Nirgunam Guna-bhoktri Cha.
verses.englishMeaning: Illuminating the functions of all the senses, yet devoid of all material senses; completely unattached, yet the sustainer of all; beyond the gunas (modes of nature), yet the experiencer of the gunas.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Vah sabhi indriyon ke vishayon aur guno ko prakaashit karne wala hai, parantu vastav mein sabhi indriyon se rahit hai. Vah poornatah anasakta hokar bhi sabka poshan karne wala hai, aur trigunatit (nirguna) hote hue bhi guno ka anubhav karne wala hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok Ishwar ke adbhut rahasya ko samjhata hai. Hamari aankh, kaan ya man bina chetna ke kuch nahi jaan sakte, kintu aatma ya Parmatma ko jan-ne ke liye kisi aankh ya kaan ki zaroorat nahi hoti.

Bhagavan kisi se bandhte nahi (anasakta hain), fir bhi poore brahmand ko dharan aur poshan karte hain. Vah prakriti ke teeno guno (sattva, rajas, tamas) se pare nirguna hain, fir bhi vishva ke har anubhav ke param sakshi hain.

Yeh darshata hai ki Paramatma kisi bhi sthool seema mein nahi aate.
verses.lifeLesson: Karyon ko poori kshamata se karein kintu unse asakta na hon. Swaarth aur bandhano se upar uthkar hi vyakti sabka hit kar sakta hai aur nirmal reh sakta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
बहिरन्तश्च भूतानामचरं चरमेव च ।
सूक्ष्मत्वात्तदविज्ञेयं दूरस्थं चान्तिके च तत् ॥ १५॥
verses.transliteration:
Bahir Antash Cha Bhutanam Acharam Charam Eva Cha,
Sukshmatvat Tad Avijneyam Durastham Chantike Cha Tat.
verses.englishMeaning: Existing outside and inside all living beings, moving and unmoving; incomprehensible due to Its extreme subtlety; It is very far away, and yet very near.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Vah sabhi praaniyon ke bheetar bhi sthit hai aur bahar bhi; vah chalne wala (char) bhi hai aur na chalne wala (achar) bhi. Ati-sookshma hone ke karan vah indriyon dwara jaan-ne mein kathin hai; aur vah atyant door bhi hai tatha behad paas bhi.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Paramatma har vastu ke andar aatma roop mein aur bahar sansar roop mein vyapt hain, jaise jal ke bheetar aur bahar aakash hota hai.

Vah itne sookshma hain ki in chamde ki aankhon se ya sthool indriyon se unhe nahi dekha ja sakta. Agyaani ke liye vah laakhon kos door hain kyunki vah unhe sansar ke bhogon mein dhoondhta hai.

Lekin prem aur gyaan se yukta bhakta ke liye vah uske apne hridaya ke sabse kareeb hain, uske astitva ka mool adhar hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Shanti aur Ishwar ko bahar dhoondhne ke bajay apne antar-man mein khojein. Jo satya humein door lagta hai, vah dar-asal hamare bheetar hi maujood hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अविभक्तं च भूतेषु विभक्तमिव च स्थितम् ।
भूतभर्तृ च तज्ज्ञेयं ग्रसिष्णु प्रभविष्णु च ॥ १६॥
verses.transliteration:
Avibhaktam Cha Bhuteshu Vibhaktam Iva Cha Sthitam,
Bhuta-bhartri Cha Taj Jneyam Grasishnu Prabha-vishnu Cha.
verses.englishMeaning: Undivided among all beings, yet appearing as if divided; that Supreme Reality is to be known as the sustainer of all beings, their devourer (in dissolution), and their creator (in manifestation).
verses.hinglishMeaning: Vah sabhi praaniyon mein vibhajan-rahit (akhand) hokar bhi alag-alag bata hua sa dikhta hai. Us jaan-ne yogya Param Tatva ko sabhi praaniyon ka paalan-poshan karne wala, pralayakal mein sametne wala (grasishnu) aur srishti ke samay utpann karne wala jaano.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhagavan Krishna Parambrahma ki ekta aur anant roopon ka vivek batate hain. Jaise ek hi aakash ghade, kamre aur bahar alag-alag pratit hota hai, parantu vastav mein aakash akhand hai; waise hi ek hi Chetna sabhi jeevon mein sthit hai.

Vah Paramatma hi srishti ka utpatti-karta (janmadata), sthiti-karta (palanhara) aur laya-karta (samaharata) hai.

Ise jan-ne par manushya sabhi praaniyon ke prati ekta aur bandhutva ka anubhav karta hai, kyunki bhed keval bahari aakaron mein hai, antaratma ek hi hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Bahar se sabhi log alag dikhte hain, parantu bheetari chetna sabhi mein ek hi hai. Bhedbhav aur nafrat ko chhodkar sabhi mein usi ek Ishwariya tatva ka aadar karein.

verses.sanskrit:
ज्योतिषामपि तज्ज्योतिस्तमसः परमुच्यते ।
ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं हृदि सर्वस्य विष्ठितम् ॥ १७॥
verses.transliteration:
Jyotisham Api Taj Jyotis Tamasah Param Uchyate,
Jnanam Jneyam Jnana-gamyam Hridi Sarvasya Vishthitam.
verses.englishMeaning: That is the Light of all lights, said to be far beyond darkness. It is wisdom itself, the object of wisdom, and reached only through wisdom; and It is seated in the hearts of all living beings.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Vah sabhi prakashon (surya, agni, sitare) ka bhi mool prakash hai, aur agyaan roopi andhakar se atyant pare kaha jata hai. Vah swayam gyaan-swaroop hai, jaan-ne yogya hai, gyaan dwara hi paaya ja sakta hai, aur sabhi ke hridaya mein vishesh roop se sthit hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Surya, chandrama ya agni ke paas jo prakash hai, vah sabhi us Param Chetna ke astitva se hi chamak rahe hain. Vah agyaan ke andhakar se poori tarah pare ek swayam-prakashit Divya Jyoti hai.

Vah keval jaanne yogya tatva nahi hai, balki swayam gyaan ka srot hai, aur nishkam sadhana v vivek se use prapt kiya ja sakta hai.

Sabse sunder baat yeh hai ki vah Param Prakash kisi aakash-ganga ke paar nahi, balki har jeev ke apne hridaya-kamal mein nitya virajman hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Aapke hridaya ke bheetar hi satya aur shanti ka anant prakash sthit hai. Sansar ke andhakar aur nirasha mein bhatakne ke bajay apne bheetar ki us divya aatma-jyoti par vishwas karein.

verses.sanskrit:
इति क्षेत्रं तथा ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं चोक्तं समासतः ।
मद्भक्त एतद्विज्ञाय मद्भावायोपपद्यते ॥ १८॥
verses.transliteration:
Iti Kshetram Tatha Jnanam Jneyam Choktam Samasatah,
Mad-bhakta Etad Vijnaya Mad-bhavayopapadyate.
verses.englishMeaning: Thus the field, wisdom, and the object of wisdom have been briefly explained by Me. My devotee, understanding this in truth, attains to My divine nature.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Is prakar kshetra (shareer), gyaan (vinamrata aadi sadgun), aur jneya (Parambrahma) ko Maine sankshep mein keh diya hai. Mera nishkam bhakta ise tatva se samajhkar Mere param swaroop ko prapt hota hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhagavan Krishna is vishay ka upashanhar karte hue kehte hain ki inhone kshetra (24 tatva v vikar), gyaan (bees divya gun) aur jneya (Paramatma ka swaroop) ko sankshep mein samjha diya hai.

Jo bhakta is tatva ko gehrai se samajhta hai, vah sansar ke mithya bandhanon se chhoot jata hai aur Bhagavan ke sachhe swaroop mein leen ho jata hai.

Bhakti aur gyaan ek doosre ke virodhi nahi, balki poora hain—sachhi bhakti se hi is tatva ka anubhav hota hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shareer aur aatma ka vivek karke jab manushya Ishwar ke prati samarpit hota hai, tab vah sansarik dukho se mukt hokar param shanti ko prapt kar leta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव विद्ध्यनादी उभावपि ।
विकारांश्च गुणांश्चैव विद्धि प्रकृतिसम्भवान् ॥ १९॥
verses.transliteration:
Prakritim Purusham Chaiva Viddhy Anadi Ubhav Api,
Vikaransh Cha Gunansh Chaiva Viddhi Prakriti-sambhavan.
verses.englishMeaning: Know that both Prakriti (material nature) and Purusha (the spirit) are beginningless. And know also that all transformations and the modes (gunas) are born of Prakriti.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Prakriti (jadd swabhav) aur Purusha (chetna/aatma)—in dono ko hi tum anaadi (bina kisi aadi ke) jaano. Aur sabhi vikar (man v shareer ke parivartan) tatha teeno guno ko prakriti se hi utpann hua samjho.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yahan Bhagavan Krishna srishti ke do mool siddhanto—Prakriti aur Purusha—ko samjhate hain. Dono anaadi hain arthat inka koi aadi-ant nahi hai.

Lekin sabhi badlav, jaise indriyan, sharirik vikar, rag-dvesh aur prakriti ke teen guna (sattva, rajas, tamas), yeh sab prakriti se utpann hote hain.

Purusha (aatma) nirvikar hai, vah kisi bhi vikar ya parivartan ka hissa nahi banta. Vah shuddh chetna hai jo sabko jeevant karti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jeevan ke sare badlav, utar-chadhav aur bhavnayein prakriti ka niyam hain. Apni aatma ko nitya aur sthir jaankar har parivartan ko sahaj roop se swikar karein.

verses.sanskrit:
कार्यकारणकर्तृत्वे हेतुः प्रकृतिरुच्यते ।
पुरुषः सुखदुःखानां भोक्तृत्वे हेतुरुच्यते ॥ २०॥
verses.transliteration:
Karya-karana-kartritve Hetuh Prakritir Uchyate,
Purushah Sukha-duhkhanam Bhoktritve Hetur Uchyate.
verses.englishMeaning: Prakriti is said to be the cause in the creation of physical effects and instruments (the body and senses); while Purusha is said to be the cause in the experiencing of pleasure and pain.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Karya (shareer) aur karan (indriyan aadi) ko utpann karne mein prakriti hetu (karan) kahi jaati hai; aur Purusha (jeev) sukh-dukh ke bhogne mein hetu kaha jaata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Is shlok mein karm aur anubhav ke bhed ko bahut sundar dhang se bataya gaya hai. Hamara shareer, indriyan aur sansar ke sabhi karya prakriti ki shakti dwara hi kiye jaate hain.

Parantu jab chetna (Purusha) shareer ke saath apna sambandh jod leti hai, tab vah swayam ko "bhokta" (anubhav karne wala) maan baithti hai aur sukh-dukh ka anubhav karti hai.

Jab vyakti ko pata chalta hai ki karm prakriti karti hai aur aatma keval sakshi hai, tab vah bhog ke bandhan se mukt ho jata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Karm prakriti aur indriyon ke niyam ke anusaar chalte hain. Apne aap ko kshudr sukh-dukh se bandha hua na maanein; hamesha sthir sakshi bhav mein rahein.

verses.sanskrit:
पुरुषः प्रकृतिस्थो हि भुङ्क्ते प्रकृतिजान्गुणान् ।
कारणं गुणसङ्गोऽस्य सदसद्योनिजन्मसु ॥ २१॥
verses.transliteration:
Purushah Prakriti-stho Hi Bhungkte Prakriti-jan Gunan,
Karanam Guna-sango 'sya Sad-asad-yoni-janmasu.
verses.englishMeaning: The Purusha (the embodied living entity), situated in Prakriti (material nature), experiences the modes (gunas) born of Prakriti. Attachment to these gunas is the cause of its rebirths in good and evil wombs.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Prakriti mein sthit hokar hi Purusha (jeev) prakriti se utpann guno (sukh, dukh, moh aadi) ko bhogta hai. In guno ke saath aasakti (sang) hi is jeev ke achhi ya buri yoniyon mein janma lene ka mool karan hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Is shlok mein punarjanma aur sansar ke bandhan ka mool rahasya bataya gaya hai. Aatma swabhav se mukt aur nirmal hai, kintu jab vah shareer aur prakriti ke guno (sattva, rajas, tamas) ke saath taadatmya (identification) bana leti hai, tab vah unka anubhav karne lagti hai.

In guno ke prati ruchi aur kamana hi jeev ke man mein vasnayein aur sanskar paida karti hain.

Inhi sanskaron ke karan jeev ko alag-alag yoniyon (uchcha ya neech janmo) mein baar-baar janma lena padta hai. Jab tak guno ki aasakti nahi chhoot-ti, tab tak mukti nahi milti.
verses.lifeLesson: Hamare vichar aur aasaktiyan hi hamare bhavishya ka nirmaan karti hain. Agar hum guno ke bhatkav se bachkar shuddh chetna mein sthit rahein, toh sabhi bandhanon se mukti mil sakti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
उपद्रष्टानुमन्ता च भर्ता भोक्ता महेश्वरः ।
परमात्मेति चाप्युक्तो देहेऽस्मिन्पुरुषः परः ॥ २२॥
verses.transliteration:
Upadrashtanumanta Cha Bharta Bhokta Maheshvarah,
Paramatmeti Chapy Ukto Dehe 'smin Purushah Parah.
verses.englishMeaning: The Supreme Spirit within this body is also called the Witness (Upadrashta), the Permitter (Anumanta), the Sustainer (Bharta), the Experiencer (Bhokta), the Great Lord (Maheshvara), and the Supreme Self (Paramatma).
verses.hinglishMeaning: Is shareer mein sthit Divya Purusha vastav mein Upadrashta (sameep rehkar dekhne wala sakshi), Anumanta (anumati dene wala), Bharta (dharan/poshan karne wala), Bhokta (chetna roop mein anubhav karne wala), Maheshvara (param niyamak) aur Paramatma kaha gaya hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhagavan is shlok mein batate hain ki hamare shareer ke bheetar keval ek saadharan jeevatma hi nahi hai, balki swayam Paramatma bhi virajman hain.

Vah hamare har karm ke nishpaksh "Upadrashta" (sakshi) hain, karmon ko hone ki anumati dene wale "Anumanta" hain, shareer aur jeevan ko sahara dene wale "Bharta" hain, aur param swami "Maheshvara" hain.

Jab manushya ko yeh anubhav ho jata hai ki uske bheetar aisi sarvochha Divya Satta upasthit hai, tab uski kshudrata aur akelapan door ho jata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Aapke andar hi Parmeshwar sakshi roop mein baithe hain. Kisi bhi galat kaam se bachein aur yeh yaad rakhein ki Paramatma hamesha aapki aatma mein margdarshak bankar upasthit hain.

verses.sanskrit:
य एवं वेत्ति पुरुषं प्रकृतिं च गुणैः सह ।
सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि न स भूयोऽभिजायते ॥ २३॥
verses.transliteration:
Ya Evam Vetti Purusham Prakritim Cha Gunaih Saha,
Sarvatha Vartamano 'pi Na Sa Bhuyo 'bhijayate.
verses.englishMeaning: One who thus understands the Purusha (Spirit) and Prakriti (material nature) together with the gunas, no matter how one lives in this world, is never born again.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo manushya is prakar Purusha (aatma) aur guno sahit prakriti ko tatva se jaan leta hai, vah sabhi prakar se karm karta hua bhi dobara janma nahi leta (mukti ko paata hai).
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhagavan Krishna gyaan ke phal ka aashwasan dete hain. Jo vyakti yeh spashta roop se samajh leta hai ki prakriti kya hai, guno ki kriya kya hai, aur uske bheetar aatma ka nitya swaroop kya hai, vah mukt ho jata hai.

Bahar se dekhne par aisa gyaani sadharan sansarik jeevan jeeta hua lag sakta hai, parantu bheetar se uska ahankar aur aasakti poori tarah bhashma ho chuki hoti hai.

Isliye uske karm uspar bandhan nahi daalte aur vah janma-mrityu ke chakra se sada ke liye mukt ho jata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Bheetari jagrukta aur vivek hi mukti ka marg hai. Jab aap bheetar se nishkam aur aatmaroop mein sthit hote hain, toh bahari zimmedariyan aapko bandhan mein nahi daal paati hain.

verses.sanskrit:
ध्यानेनात्मनि पश्यन्ति केचिदात्मानमात्मना ।
अन्ये साङ्ख्येन योगेन कर्मयोगेन चापरे ॥ २४॥
verses.transliteration:
Dhyanenatmani Pashyanti Kechid Atmanam Atmana,
Anye Sankhyena Yogena Karma-yogena Chapare.
verses.englishMeaning: Some perceive the Supreme Self within their own heart by meditation (Dhyana Yoga) through the purified mind; others by the path of philosophical discernment (Sankhya Yoga), and still others by the path of selfless action (Karma Yoga).
verses.hinglishMeaning: Kuch sadhak dhyan-abhyas dwara shuddh buddhi se apne hridaya mein aatma ka saakshatkar karte hain; anya log Sankhya-yoga (tattva-vivek) dwara aur kuch sadhak Nishkam Karma-yoga dwara Paramatma ko anubhav karte hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhagavan Krishna yahan adhyatmik margon ki vividhta ko swikar karte hain. Sabhi manushyon ka swabhav ek jaisa nahi hota, isliye Ishwar-prapti ke marg bhi vibhinn hain.

Kuch log dhyan aur antarmukhta (Dhyana Yoga) dwara aatma ka darshan karte hain. Kuch log gyaan aur vivek (Sankhya Yoga) ke zariye aatma aur anatma ka bhed samajhkar satya ko paate hain.

Aur kuch log nishkam bhav se kartavya-karm (Karma Yoga) karte hue apne chitta ko nirmal karke Ishwar ko prapt karte hain. Sabhi marg ek hi Param Satya tak pahunchate hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Har vyakti ki prakriti alag hoti hai. Apne swabhav ke anukul marg—dhyan, gyaan, ya nishkam seva—ko chunein aur uspar poori nishtha ke saath aage badhein.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्ये त्वेवमजानन्तः श्रुत्वान्येभ्य उपासते ।
तेऽपि चातितरन्त्येव मृत्युं श्रुतिपरायणाः ॥ २५॥
verses.transliteration:
Anye Tv Evam Ajanantah Shrutvanyebhya Upasate,
Te 'pi Chatitaranty Eva Mrityum Shruti-parayanah.
verses.englishMeaning: Yet others, not knowing these spiritual paths by themselves, worship having heard from realized masters. They too, devoted to hearing the truth, surely transcend death.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Parantu anya log, jo swayam in margon ko nahi jaante, ve gyaani mahapurushon aur aacharyon se sunkar unke vachano ke anusaar upaashana karte hain. Ve shravan-parayan (guru-vachan par vishwas karne wale) sadhak bhi nishchay hi mrityu-sagar ko paar kar jaate hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhagavan Krishna ki kripa kitni apar hai, yeh is shlok se pata chalta hai. Agar koi vyakti kathin dhyan nahi kar sakta ya shastron ka goorh gyaan nahi rakhta, tab bhi uske liye mukti ka dwar khula hai.

Jab vah shraddha ke saath sadguruon aur gyaani mahatmaon ke upadesh sunta hai aur unpar vishwas karke jeevan mein utarta hai, toh vah bhi kalyan ko prapt hota hai.

Sat-sang aur shravan ki shakti itni mahan hai ki yeh kisi bhi sadharan manushya ko sansar ke janma-maran se mukt kar sakti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Gyaaniyon aur sadguruon ke vachano ko shraddha se sunna aur unhe jeevan mein apnana sabse saral aur prabhavshali sadhana hai. Namrata se seekhna hi vikas ki kunji hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यावत्सञ्जायते किञ्चित्सत्त्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम् ।
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञसंयोगात्तद्विद्धि भरतर्षभ ॥ २६॥
verses.transliteration:
Yavat Sanjayate Kinchit Sattvam Sthavara-jangamam,
Kshetra-kshetrajna-samyogat Tad Viddhi Bharatashabha.
verses.englishMeaning: Whatever being is born, whether moving or non-moving, know that to arise from the union of the field and the knower of the field, O best of the Bharatas.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Bharatshreshtha Arjun! Is sansar mein jo kuch bhi sthavar (achal, jaise ped-paudhe) ya jangam (chalne-phirne wale, jeev-jantu) praani utpann hote hain, un sabhi ko tum kshetra (prakriti/shareer) aur kshetrajna (aatma) ke sanyog se hi utpann hua jaano.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhagavan Krishna batate hain ki sansar ki har utpatti jadd aur chetan ke milan se hoti hai. Khet (kshetra) ke bina beej nahi ug sakta, aur beej ke bina khet mein fasal nahi ho sakti.

Isi tarah, sharir ya prakriti (jadd tatva) aur aatma (chetan tatva) ka jab sanyog hota hai, tabhi jeevan prakat hota hai, chahe vah vriksh ho, pashu-pakshi ho ya manushya.

Ise samajhne se spashta ho jata hai ki chetna ke bina prakriti nishpran hai aur prakriti ke bina sansar ka kram nahi chal sakta.
verses.lifeLesson: Sansar ke har jeev mein aatma aur shareer dono hain. Kisi ko keval uske bahari sthool roop se na aankein; har jeev ke bheetar sthit divya chetna ka aadar karein.

verses.sanskrit:
समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम् ।
विनश्यत्स्वविनश्यन्तं यः पश्यति स पश्यति ॥ २७॥
verses.transliteration:
Samam Sarveshu Bhuteshu Tishthantam Parameshvaram,
Vinashyatsv Avinashyantam Yah Pashyati Sa Pashyati.
verses.englishMeaning: One who sees the Supreme Lord dwelling equally in all living beings, the Imperishable within the perishable, truly sees.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo manushya sabhi nashvar praaniyon mein ek samaan roop se sthit avinashi Parmeshwar ko dekhta hai, vastav mein wahi yatharth roop se dekhta hai (wahi sachha gyaani hai).
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok adhyatma ka ek param shikhar hai. Hamari aankhein sansar mein keval bhed aur nashvarta dekhti hain—janma aur mrityu, chhota aur bada, ameer aur gareeb.

Lekin jo vyakti in marne-mit-ne wale shareeron ke bheetar us kabhi na nasht hone wale Paramatma ko sam-bhav se dekhta hai, Bhagavan kehte hain ki aakhein toh keval usi ke paas hain.

Uski drishti bahari aavaranon ko bhedkar antaratma ke satya tak pahunch chuki hoti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Logon ke bahari roop, pad ya sthiti ko dekhkar bhedbhav na karein. Sabhi ke bheetar ek hi nitya aur pavitra aatma ko dekhne ki drishti viksit karein.

verses.sanskrit:
समं पश्यन्हि सर्वत्र समवस्थितमीश्वरम् ।
न हिनस्त्यात्मनात्मानं ततो याति परां गतिम् ॥ २८॥
verses.transliteration:
Samam Pashyan Hi Sarvatra Samavasthitam Ishvaram,
Na Hinasty Atmanatmanam Tato Yati Param Gatim.
verses.englishMeaning: Perceiving the same Lord established equally everywhere, one does not degrade oneself by one's own mind, and thereby attains the supreme destination.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Kyunki sabhi sthanon par samaan roop se sthit Parmeshwar ko dekhne wala vyakti apne dwara apne aap ka ghaat (patan) nahi karta, isliye vah Param Gati (moksha) ko prapt hota hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Jab koi vyakti sabhi mein ek hi Ishwar ko dekhne lagta hai, tab uske andar kisi ke prati irshya, dwesh, ahankar ya hinsa nahi reh jaati.

Jo doosron ko dukh deta hai, vah agyaan-vash vastav mein apni hi aatma ka patan karta hai. Parantu jo sabhi mein samata dekhta hai, vah apne man aur buddhi ko nirmal rakhta hai.

Aisa nishpap aur samadarshi vyakti aatma-saakshatkar karke param mukti aur shanti ko prapt karta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab aap kisi doosre ko chot pahunchate hain, toh aatmaroop se aap swayam ko hi nuksan pahunchate hain. Sabhi ke prati prem aur samata rakhna hi aatmic vikas ka sarvashreshtha marg hai.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रकृत्यैव च कर्माणि क्रियमाणानि सर्वशः ।
यः पश्यति तथात्मानमकर्तारं स पश्यति ॥ २९॥
verses.transliteration:
Prakrityaiva Cha Karmani Kriyamanani Sarvashah,
Yah Pashyati Tathatmanam Akartaram Sa Pashyati.
verses.englishMeaning: One who sees that all actions are performed entirely by material nature (Prakriti) alone, and that the Self is truly the non-doer, truly sees.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo manushya yeh dekhta hai ki samast karm sabhi prakar se prakriti ke dwara hi kiye ja rahe hain aur aatma nishkriya (akarta) hai, vastav mein wahi sachha dekhne wala hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Hum aksar yeh ahankar paal lete hain ki 'maine yeh kiya, main karta hoon'. Lekin sharirik aur mansik sabhi kriyaayein prakriti ke guno aur shaktiyon dwara ho rahi hain.

Aatma na toh koi karm karti hai aur na kisi karm se bandhti hai; vah to keval ek nirmal, nishpaksh sakshi hai.

Jo vyakti is satya ko anubhav kar leta hai, uska kartritva ka ahankar samapt ho jata hai, aur vah karmfal ke bandhan se mukt ho jata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apne achhe ya safal karyon ka ahankar na paalein. Kartavya ko poori nishtha se nibhayein, parantu yeh yaad rakhein ki kriyaayein Ishwar ki prakriti ke adheen hain; aap keval ek nimit hain.

verses.sanskrit:
यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति ।
तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा ॥ ३०॥
verses.transliteration:
Yada Bhuta-prithag-bhavam Eka-stham Anupashyati,
Tata Eva Cha Vistaram Brahma Sampadyate Tada.
verses.englishMeaning: When one sees the diverse existence of all beings rooted in the One, and their manifold expansion arising from That alone, then one attains Brahman.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jab manushya praaniyon ke alag-alag bhavo aur astitva ko ek hi Parmatma mein sthit dekhta hai, aur usi ek Param Tatva se sabhi ka vistar hua jaanta hai, tab vah Parambrahma ko prapt ho jata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Jaise ek hi vriksh se aneko shakhaayein, patte aur phool phoot-te hain, ya ek hi samudra se laakhon leharein uthti hain; waise hi poore brahmand ke anant jeev us ek Paramatma mein hi sthit hain aur Usi se vistar paate hain.

Jab manushya bahari vividhta mein chhupi is mool ekta ko dekh leta hai, tab uska sara bhedbhav mit jata hai.

Is avastha mein pahunchkar sadhak poornatah Parambrahma ke anand mein sthit ho jata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Bahar ki bhed-bhav bhari duniya ke peeche ek hi shakti aur ekta ko dekhna seekhein. Jab man ekta ko dekhne lagta hai, tab sabhi bhatkav aur sangharsh shant ho jaate hain.

verses.sanskrit:
अनादित्वान्निर्गुणत्वात्परमात्मायमव्ययः ।
शरीरस्थोऽपि कौन्तेय न करोति न लिप्यते ॥ ३१॥
verses.transliteration:
Anaditvan Nirgunatvat Paramatmayam Avyayah,
Sharira-stho 'pi Kaunteya Na Karoti Na Lipyate.
verses.englishMeaning: Being beginningless and free from material modes (nirguna), this imperishable Supreme Self, O son of Kunti, though residing in the body, neither acts nor is tainted.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Kunti-putra Arjun! Anaadi hone se aur trigunatit (nirguna) hone ke karan yeh avinashi Paramatma shareer mein sthit hokar bhi na toh kuch karta hai aur na kisi phal se lipt hota hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhagavan Krishna aatma ki asangata aur pavitrata ka rahasya batate hain. Hamara shareer janm leta hai, badalta hai aur nasht hota hai, kintu usmein sthit aatma anaadi aur avyaya hai.

Vah prakriti ke teeno guno se pare hai. Shareer ke dwara kiye gaye bhale ya bure karm aatma ko chhoo bhi nahi sakte.

Vah shareer mein rehte hue bhi jaise surya ki kiran kichad par padkar bhi maili nahi hoti, waise hi aatma nirmal aur asanga rehti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Aapka mool aatmic swaroop har prakar ke dosho, kamzoriyon aur dukhon se nirmal aur pare hai. Apni bheetari pavitrata ko pehchanein aur atit ke pashchatap se mukt hon.

verses.sanskrit:
यथा सर्वगतं सौक्ष्म्यादाकाशं नोपलिप्यते ।
सर्वत्रावस्थितो देहे तथात्मा नोपलिप्यते ॥ ३२॥
verses.transliteration:
Yatha Sarva-gatam Saukshmyad Akasham Nopalipyate,
Sarvatravasthito Dehe Tathatma Nopalipyate.
verses.englishMeaning: Just as the all-pervading space (ether), due to its subtlety, is not tainted by anything, similarly the Self, though situated everywhere in the body, is never tainted.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jaise sabhi jagah vyapt aakash apne sookshma hone ke karan kisi bhi vastu (dhool ya dhuyen) se lipt nahi hota, waise hi shareer mein sabhi jagah sthit hote hue bhi aatma kisi vikar se lipt nahi hoti.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yahan aakash ka ek atyant sundar aur prabhavi drishtant diya gaya hai. Aakash har jagah hai—sugandhit pushp mein bhi aur durgandhit sthan par bhi—parantu aakash kabhi kisi sugandh ya durgandh se maila nahi hota.

Usi prakar, hamari aatma poore shareer mein chetna ke roop mein vyapt hai, parantu shareer ke rog, vriddhavastha, dukh ya paap-punya use sparsh nahi kar sakte.

Vah sadaiv shuddh, nirmal aur nirdosh rehti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jaise aakash har vatavaran mein nirmal rehta hai, waise hi aapko bhi sansar ki buraiyon aur pratikooltaon ke beech apne man aur charitra ko nirmal banaye rakhna chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
यथा प्रकाशयत्येकः कृत्स्नं लोकमिमं रविः ।
क्षेत्रं क्षेत्री तथा कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति भारत ॥ ३३॥
verses.transliteration:
Yatha Prakashayaty Ekah Kritsnam Lokam Imam Ravih,
Kshetram Kshetri Tatha Kritsnam Prakashayati Bharata.
verses.englishMeaning: Just as the single sun illuminates this entire universe, so does the Knower of the field (the Self) illuminate the whole field (the body and mind), O scion of Bharata.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Bharatvanshi Arjun! Jis prakar aakash mein akela surya is sampoorna brahmand ko prakashit karta hai, usi prakar ek akela kshetrajna (aatma) sampoorna kshetra (shareer aur chitta) ko chetna dwara prakashit karta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhagavan Krishna surya ka udaharan dekar aatma ki shakti ko samjhate hain. Jaise aakash mein ek hi surya poore sansar ko roshan karta hai, parantu sansar ki kisi achhai ya burai se surya par koi asar nahi padta.

Usi tarah, shareer ke andar baithi ek akeli chetna (aatma) hamari aankhon, kano, man aur buddhi ko jeevant aur prakashit karti hai.

Shareer badalta rehta hai, par usko roshan karne wali aatma wahi rehti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Aapke jeevan ki chetna aur urja ka srot aapki aatma hai. Apne antar-prakash ko pehchanein aur jeevan ke har andhakar ko aatma-vishwas se door karein.

verses.sanskrit:
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोरेवमन्तरं ज्ञानचक्षुषा ।
भूतप्रकृतिमोक्षं च ये विदुर्यान्ति ते परम् ॥ ३४॥
verses.transliteration:
Kshetra-kshetrajnayor Evam Antaram Jnana-chakshusha,
Bhuta-prakriti-moksham Cha Ye Vidur Yanti Te Param.
verses.englishMeaning: Those who perceive with the eye of wisdom this distinction between the field and the knower of the field, and understand the liberation of beings from material nature (Prakriti), attain the Supreme.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Is prakar jo log gyaan-roopi netron (vivek) dwara kshetra (shareer) aur kshetrajna (aatma) ke bhed ko, tatha praaniyon ki prakriti se mukti ke marg ko tatva se jaan lete hain, ve Param Pad (Brahma) ko prapt ho jaate hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Vivek aur gyaan ki drishti hi manushya ko bandhanon se aazad karti hai. Jab aap shareer aur aatma ka sachha bhed samajh lete hain, tab jeevan mein kisi bhi baat ka bhay ya shok nahi rehta.

summary: The fourteenth chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Gunatraya Vibhaga Yoga. In this chapter, Krishna reveals the three gunas (modes) of the material nature - goodness, passion and ignorance which everything in the material existence is influenced by. He further explains the essential characteristics of each of these modes, their cause and how they influence a living entity affected by them. He then reveals the various characteristics of the persons who have gone beyond these gunas. The chapter ends with Krishna reminding us of the power of pure devotion to God and how attachment to God can help us transcend these gunas.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
परं भूयः प्रवक्ष्यामि ज्ञानानां ज्ञानमुत्तमम् ।
यज्ज्ञात्वा मुनयः सर्वे परां सिद्धिमितो गताः ॥ १॥
verses.transliteration:
Shri-Bhagavan Uvacha:
Param Bhuyah Pravakshyami Jnananam Jnanam Uttamam,
Yaj Jnatva Munayah Sarve Param Siddhim Ito Gatah.
verses.englishMeaning: The Supreme Lord said: I shall once again reveal to you that supreme wisdom, the best of all knowledge, knowing which all the sages have attained the highest perfection after departing from this world.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shri Bhagavan ne kaha: Sabhi gyaano mein sarvashreshtha us param gyaan ko Main fir se kahoonga, jise jaankar sabhi munijan is sansar ke bandhano se mukt hokar param siddhi (moksha) ko prapt hue hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhagavan Krishna is adhyay ki shuruat mein is gyaan ki mahanata batate hain. Vah kehte hain ki yeh koi sadharan sansarik vidya nahi hai, balki "gyaanon ka gyaan" hai.

Ise janne se manushya ko pata chalta hai ki prakriti ke teen guna (sattva, rajas, tamas) use kaise bandhte hain aur unse upar kaise utha jaata hai.

Prachin kal ke mahan rishiyon aur muniyon ne is param gyaan ko anubhav karke hi jeevan ke sarvochha anand aur mukti ko paya tha.
verses.lifeLesson: Sansar ki sabhi jankariyon ke beech aatma aur prakriti ke satya ko jan-na hi sarvashreshtha gyaan hai. Yahi gyaan manushya ko sabhi bhramon se mukt karke param shanti deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
इदं ज्ञानमुपाश्रित्य मम साधर्म्यमागताः ।
सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च ॥ २॥
verses.transliteration:
Idam Jnanam Upashritya Mama Sadharmyam Agatah,
Sarge 'pi Nopajayante Pralaye Na Vyathanti Cha.
verses.englishMeaning: Having taken refuge in this wisdom, they attain unity with My divine nature; they are neither born at the time of creation nor distressed at the time of cosmic dissolution.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Is param gyaan ka aashray lekar jo log Mere swaroop (divya prakriti) ko prapt ho jaate hain, ve srishti ke rachna-kaal mein na toh dobara janma lete hain aur na hi pralay ke samay vyakul (nasht) hote hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Jab koi sadhak is tatva-gyaan ko apne jeevan mein dharan kar leta hai, tab vah sansarik parivartano se pare ho jata hai. Vah Bhagavan ke divya swabhav ko prapt karta hai.

Srishti ki nayi utpatti hone par bhi use janma lene ki vivashata nahi rehti, aur jab poora brahmand pralay mein samapt ho jata hai, tab bhi uski aatma shant aur avinashi rehti hai.

Yeh darshata hai ki sachha gyaan manushya ko kal (samay) ke chakra se bhi aazad kar deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab aapka chitta Param Satya se jud jata hai, tab jeevan ke bade se bade sankat ya parivartan bhi aapki aatmic sthirata aur shanti ko hila nahi sakte.

verses.sanskrit:
मम योनिर्महद् ब्रह्म तस्मिन्गर्भं दधाम्यहम् ।
सम्भवाः सर्वभूतानां ततो भवति भारत ॥ ३॥
verses.transliteration:
Mama Yonir Mahad Brahma Tasmin Garbham Dadhamy Aham,
Sambhavah Sarva-bhutanam Tato Bhavati Bharata.
verses.englishMeaning: My womb is the great material nature (Mahad Brahma); into that I cast the seed of consciousness. From that union, O scion of Bharata, arises the birth of all living beings.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Bharatvanshi Arjun! Mahad Brahma (mool prakriti) Meri yoni (garbha) hai, jismein Main chetna roopi beej ko sthapit karta hoon. Uske sanyog se hi samast praaniyon ki utpatti hoti hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhagavan srishti ki utpatti ka mool rahasya samjhate hain. Prakriti (jadd tatva) mata ke saman hai jise "Mahad Brahma" kaha gaya hai, aur Bhagavan swayam usmein chetna ka beej dalne wale pita hain.

Bina chetna ke beej ke prakriti mein koi jeevan prakat nahi ho sakta, aur bina prakriti ke aakaar nahi ban sakta.

Is tarah poore brahmand ke sabhi jeev Ishwar ki chetna aur prakriti ke sanyog se hi astitva mein aate hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Srishti ka har jeev usi ek Param Pita aur Prakriti Mata ki santaan hai. Isliye sabhi jeev-jantuo ke prati aatmiyata aur prem ka bhav rakhein.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वयोनिषु कौन्तेय मूर्तयः सम्भवन्ति याः ।
तासां ब्रह्म महद्योनिरहं बीजप्रदः पिता ॥ ४॥
verses.transliteration:
Sarva-yonishu Kaunteya Murtayah Sambhavanti Yah,
Tasam Brahma Mahad Yonir Aham Bija-pradah Pita.
verses.englishMeaning: Whatever physical forms are produced in all the various species of life, O son of Kunti, the great material nature is their maternal womb, and I am the seed-giving father.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Kunti-putra Arjun! Sabhi yoniyon (manushya, pashu, pakshi, ped aadi) mein jitne bhi shareer paida hote hain, un sabhi ki garbhadhatri mata mahat-prakriti hai aur Main beej sthapit karne wala pita hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Pichhle shlok ki baat ko aur spashta karte hue Bhagavan kehte hain ki sansar mein 84 laakh ya anant prajatiyan hain, un sabhi ke shareer prakriti se bante hain.

Lekin unke bheetar jo jeevan, chetna aur aatma hai, vah Bhagavan ke dwara di gayi hai. Bhagavan hi sabhi ke param pita hain.

Yeh jaan lene par manushya ke man se jaati, prajati ya bhedbhav ka ahankar poori tarah mit jata hai, kyunki sabka mool srot ek hi hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Hum sabhi ek hi Divya Srot se jude hain. Bhedbhav, jaati ya varg ke ahankar ko chhodkar sabhi mein ek hi parivar ki aatmiyata ko mehsoos karein.

verses.sanskrit:
सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसम्भवाः ।
निबध्नन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनमव्ययम् ॥ ५॥
verses.transliteration:
Sattvam Rajas Tama Iti Gunah Prakriti-sambhavah,
Nibadhnanti Maha-baho Dehe Dehinam Avyayam.
verses.englishMeaning: Sattva (goodness), Rajas (passion), and Tamas (ignorance)—these three gunas born of material nature bind the imperishable soul to the mortal body, O mighty-armed Arjuna.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey mahabaho Arjun! Sattva, Rajas aur Tamas—prakriti se utpann yeh teeno guna avinashi aur nitya aatma ko is nashvar shareer mein baandh dete hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yahan se adhyay ka mool vishay shuru hota hai. Bhagavan batate hain ki hamari aatma vastav mein shuddh aur avinashi hai, parantu vah shareer ke bheetar kaise bandh jaati hai?

Prakriti ke teen rassi-roopi guna—Sattva (pavitrata aur gyaan), Rajas (kamana aur karm), aur Tamas (alasya aur agyaan)—aatma ko shareer ke saath baandh dete hain.

Yeh teeno guna manushya ke swabhav aur aacharan ko nirdharit karte hain, aur jab tak inka bandhan rehta hai, tab tak aatma sansar ke chakravyuh mein rehti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Aapke man ke vichar aur vyavahar in teeno guno ke prabhav se chalte hain. Apne swabhav ko pehchanein aur unke gulam banne ke bajay unke niyantrak banein.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्र सत्त्वं निर्मलत्वात्प्रकाशकमनामयम् ।
सुखसङ्गेन बध्नाति ज्ञानसङ्गेन चानघ ॥ ६॥
verses.transliteration:
Tatra Sattvam Nirmalatvat Prakashakam Anamayam,
Sukha-sangena Badhnati Jnana-sangena Chanagha.
verses.englishMeaning: Of these, Sattva guna, being pure, is luminous and free from sorrow. It binds the soul, O sinless one, through attachment to happiness and attachment to knowledge.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey nishpap Arjun! In teeno mein Sattva guna apne nirmal (shuddh) hone ke karan prakashak (gyaan dene wala) aur anamayam (dukh-rahit) hota hai. Vah jeev ko sukh ki aasakti aur gyaan ke ahankar se baandh deta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhagavan pehle Sattva guna ka swaroop batate hain. Sattva shuddh kanch ki tarah nirmal hota hai, jisse gyaan ka prakash phailta hai aur man mein shanti v sukh rehta hai.

Lekin iska bandhan kya hai? Sattva guna manushya ko yeh ehsaas karata hai ki "main sukhi hoon, main vidwan hoon, main gyaani hoon".

Yeh sukh ki aadat aur gyaan ka ahankar bhi aatma ke liye ek soni zanjeer (golden chain) ki tarah bandhan ban jata hai, kyunki aatma in sabse pare shuddh mukti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Achhai, shanti aur gyaan shreshtha hain, parantu unka ahankar na karein. "Main gyaani ya pavitra hoon" ka ghamand bhi ek bandhan hai; hamesha namra rahein.

verses.sanskrit:
रजो रागात्मकं विद्धि तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम् ।
तन्निबध्नाति कौन्तेय कर्मसङ्गेन देहिनम् ॥ ७॥
verses.transliteration:
Rajo Ragatmakam Viddhi Trishna-sanga-samudbhavam,
Tan Nibadhnati Kaunteya Karma-sangena Dehinam.
verses.englishMeaning: Know Rajas to be of the nature of passion, arising from thirst (desire) and attachment. It binds the embodied soul fast, O son of Kunti, by attachment to action and its fruits.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Kunti-putra Arjun! Rajo-guna ko kamana aur rag (aakarshan) ke swaroop wala jaano, jo trishna (lalach) aur aasakti se utpann hota hai. Vah dehadhari jeev ko karmon ki daud aur unke phalon ke moh se baandh deta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Rajo-guna manushya ke andar laalsa aur aag ki tarah sulagta hai. Yeh naye-naye sapne, dhan-daulat, pad-pratishtha aur bhogon ki pyas (trishna) ko janm deta hai.

Jab vyakti Rajo-guna ke vash mein hota hai, toh vah chain se baith nahi pata. Vah nirantar naye karmon mein ulajhta hai aur unke phalon ki aasha mein chintit rehta hai.

Is tarah Rajo-guna manushya ko aashant karke din-raat ki daud-bhaag mein baandhe rakhta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Aakankshaon ki koi seema nahi hoti. Kamanaon ke peechhe andhadhundh bhaagne ke bajay apne karyon ko nishkam bhav se karein, taaki man mein shanti aur thehraav bana rahe.

verses.sanskrit:
तमस्त्वज्ञानजं विद्धि मोहनं सर्वदेहिनाम् ।
प्रमादालस्यनिद्राभिस्तन्निबध्नाति भारत ॥ ८॥
verses.transliteration:
Tamas Tv Ajnana-jam Viddhi Mohanam Sarva-dehinam,
Pramadalasa-nidrabhis Tan Nibadhnati Bharata.
verses.englishMeaning: Know Tamas, however, to be born of ignorance, deluding all embodied beings. It binds the soul, O scion of Bharata, by negligence, indolence, and excessive sleep.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Bharatvanshi Arjun! Tamo-guna ko agyaan se utpann hua jaano, jo sabhi dehadhari praaniyon ko mohit (bhramit) karne wala hai. Vah jeev ko pramaad (laaparwahi), aalasya aur nidra (behoshi/susthi) ke dwara baandh deta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Tamo-guna andhakar ka prateek hai. Yeh manushya ki vivek-shakti ko dhaanp deta hai, jisse sahi aur galat ka fark samajh nahi aata.

Iske lakshan hain: pramaad (jo karna chahiye use na karna aur vyarth ke kaamo mein samay ganvana), aalasya (karm se jee churana), aur atyadhik neend ya susthi.

Tamo-guna jeev ko adhogati ki taraf kheenchta hai aur use sachhaai dekhne se rokta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Aalasya, laaparwahi aur taalm-tol jeevan ke sabse bade shatru hain. Inse bachein aur apne andar jagrukta aur sachetata laayein.

verses.sanskrit:
सत्त्वं सुखे सञ्जयति रजः कर्मणि भारत ।
ज्ञानमावृत्य तु तमः प्रमादे सञ्जयत्युत ॥ ९॥
verses.transliteration:
Sattvam Sukhe Sanjayati Rajah Karmani Bharata,
Jnanam Avritya Tu Tamah Pramade Sanjayaty Uta.
verses.englishMeaning: Sattva attaches one to happiness, Rajas attaches one to action, O scion of Bharata; but Tamas, cloaking wisdom, attaches one to heedlessness and negligence.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Bharatvanshi Arjun! Sattva guna manushya ko sukh mein jodta hai, Rajo-guna karm mein pravritta karta hai; kintu Tamo-guna gyaan ko dhak-kar use pramaad (laaparwahi aur bhool) mein baandh deta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhagavan Krishna teeno guno ke prabhav ko ek hi shlok mein sankshep mein spashta karte hain.

Sattva guna manushya ke chitta ko shanti aur aatmic prasannata mein jodta hai. Rajo-guna use nirantar naye-naye karyon aur bhogon ki daud mein uljhata hai.

Aur Tamo-guna uski buddhi aur gyaan par parda daalkar use vyarth ke kaamo, laaparwahi aur bhram mein phansa deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apne man ki dasha ko pehchanein: kya aap santosh (Sattva), chanchalta (Rajas) ya aalasya (Tamas) mein jee rahe hain? Jagruk hokar apne jeevan ko Sattva aur shanti ki or le jaayein.

verses.sanskrit:
रजस्तमश्चाभिभूय सत्त्वं भवति भारत ।
रजः सत्त्वं तमश्चैव तमः सत्त्वं रजस्तथा ॥ १०॥
verses.transliteration:
Rajas Tamash Chabhibhuya Sattvam Bhavati Bharata,
Rajah Sattvam Tamash Chaiva Tamah Sattvam Rajas Tatha.
verses.englishMeaning: Sometimes Sattva prevails, overpowering Rajas and Tamas, O Bharata; sometimes Rajas prevails, overpowering Sattva and Tamas; and at other times Tamas prevails, overpowering Sattva and Rajas.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Bharatvanshi Arjun! Kabhi Rajas aur Tamas ko dabakar Sattva guna badhta hai; kabhi Sattva aur Tamas ko dabakar Rajo-guna prabal hota hai; aur usi tarah kabhi Sattva aur Rajas ko dabakar Tamo-guna prabal ho jata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Hamare man ke bheetar in teeno guno ki ladaai nirantar chalti rehti hai. Koi bhi ek guna hamesha sthir nahi rehta.

Jab Sattva prabal hota hai, tab humein shanti aur prarthana mein anand milta hai. Jab Rajo-guna prabal hota hai, tab kamanaayein aur dhar-pakad badh jaati hai.

Aur jab Tamo-guna haavi hota hai, tab susthi, udaasi aur laaparwahi gher leti hai. Is aantarik sangharsh ko samajhna hi man ko jeetne ka pehla kadam hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ki manodasha badalti rehti hai. Jab alasya ya krodh aaye, toh ghabraayein nahi; dhyan aur sat-sang dwara apne andar ke Sattva guna ko badhayein.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वद्वारेषु देहेऽस्मिन्प्रकाश उपजायते ।
ज्ञानं यदा तदा विद्याद्विवृद्धं सत्त्वमित्युत ॥ ११॥
verses.transliteration:
Sarva-dvareshu Dehe 'smin Prakasha Upajayate,
Jnanam Yada Tada Vidyad Vivriddham Sattvam Ity Uta.
verses.englishMeaning: When the light of wisdom shines forth through all the gates (the senses) in this body, then one should know that Sattva is predominantly increased.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jab is shareer ke sabhi dwaaron (indriyon) mein gyaan-roopi prakash aur chetna ka uday hota hai, tab yeh jaan lena chahiye ki Sattva guna badh gaya hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shareer ke dwaar hamari indriyan hain—aankh, kaan, naak, jeebh aur twacha. Jab vyakti ke andar Sattva guna prabal hota hai, tab in indriyon mein ek vishesh nirmalta aur vivek aa jata hai.

Aankhein satya aur sundarta dekhna chahti hain, kaan shubh aur gyaan ki baatein sunna chahte hain, aur man nishpap v shant rehta hai.

Har kriya mein spashtata, gyaan aur pavitrata jhalakne lagti hai. Yeh Sattva guna ke vikas ki spashta pehchan hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab aapka man shant, buddhi spashta aur indriyan shuddh vicharon ki or aakarshit hon, tab samjhein ki aapke andar Sattva guna ka vikas ho raha hai. Is shubh dasha ko banaye rakhein.

verses.sanskrit:
लोभः प्रवृत्तिरारम्भः कर्मणामशमः स्पृहा ।
रजस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे भरतर्षभ ॥ १२॥
verses.transliteration:
Lobhah Pravrittir Arambhah Karmanam Ashamah Spriha,
Rajasy Etani Jayante Vivriddhe Bharatashabha.
verses.englishMeaning: Greed, restless activity, undertaking of self-interested enterprises, unrest, and longing—these arise when Rajas is predominantly increased, O best of the Bharatas.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Bharatshreshtha Arjun! Rajo-guna ke badh jaane par lobh (laalach), pravritti (sansarik bhagon mein lage rehna), naye-naye swarth-poorna karmon ka aarambh, ashanti (chitta ki bechaini), aur spriha (bhogon ki tivr ichha)—yeh sabhi lakshan utpann hote hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Rajo-guna ke badhne par manushya ke andar laalach aur bechaini badh jaati hai. Vah sadaiv aur adhik paane ki hwas mein rehta hai.

Vah shanti se baith nahi pata; uske dimag mein naye-naye project, vyapar aur swarth ke kaamo ki yojanaayein banti rehti hain.

Uska chitta kabhi shaant nahi hota, balki vah nirantar chintao aur asantosh ki aag mein jalta rehta hai. Yeh Rajo-guna ke prabal hone ke spashta sanket hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Bina thehraav ki andhi daud aur atyadhik lalach man ki shanti chheen lete hain. Apni aavashyaktaon ko santulit karein aur vyarth ki daud-bhaag se man ko vishram dein.

verses.sanskrit:
अप्रकाशोऽप्रवृत्तिश्च प्रमादो मोह एव च ।
तमस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे कुरुनन्दन ॥ १३॥
verses.transliteration:
Aprakasho 'pravrittish Cha Pramado Moha Eva Cha,
Tamasy Etani Jayante Vivriddhe Kuru-nandana.
verses.englishMeaning: Darkness (lack of discernment), inactivity, heedlessness, and delusion—these arise when Tamas is predominantly increased, O descendant of Kuru.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Kurunandan Arjun! Tamo-guna ke badh jaane par aprakash (vivekheen andhakar), apravritti (karm karne ki ichha na hona/susthi), pramaad (laaparwahi) aur moh (bhram/moorkhata)—yeh sabhi vikar paida hote hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Jab manushya par Tamo-guna haavi hota hai, tab uski buddhi mein andhakar chha jata hai. Use achhe aur bure ka koi gyaan nahi rehta.

Vah koi bhi kartavya ya mehanat ka kaam nahi karna chahta (apravritti). Vah aalasya mein pada rehta hai, zaroori kaamo ko taal-ta hai, aur vyarth ke bhram v galat-fehmiyon (moh) mein gira rehta hai.

Yeh sthiti aatmic vikas ke raste par sabse badi rukawat hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ki susthi, aalasya aur moorkhta ko pehchan kar turant usse baahar niklein. Chhoti-chhoti shubh kriyaon dwara apne man mein jagrukta aur urja ka sanchaar karein.

verses.sanskrit:
यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत् ।
तदोत्तमविदां लोकानमलान्प्रतिपद्यते ॥ १४॥
verses.transliteration:
Yada Sattve Pravriddhe Tu Pralayam Yati Deha-bhrit,
Tadottama-vidam Lokan Amalan Pratipadyate.
verses.englishMeaning: When the embodied living being meets with death at a time when Sattva is predominant, then one attains the spotless, pure realms of the knowers of the highest truth.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jab yeh dehadhari jeev Sattva guna ki vriddhi ke samay shareer chhodta hai (mrityu ko prapt hota hai), tab vah Param Satya ko janne wale rishiyon ke nirmal aur divya lokon ko prapt karta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhagavan Krishna yahan batate hain ki mrityu ke samay manushya ki manodasha ka agle janma par kya asar padta hai.

Agar mrityu ke samay jeev ka man shant, pavitra, bhagavad-bhakti aur Sattva guna se paripoorn ho, toh uski aatma uchchatam divya lokon mein jaati hai jahan nirmal gyaan aur shanti hoti hai.

Isliye jeevan-bhar Sattva guna ka abhyas zaroori hai, kyunki aakhiri samay wahi smaran hota hai jiska humne jeevan-bhar abhyas kiya ho.
verses.lifeLesson: Jeevan ko nirmal aur pavitra vicharon se bharein. Hamari niyamit aadatein hi hamari antim sthiti aur aane wale bhavishya ka nirdharan karti hain.

verses.sanskrit:
रजसि प्रलयं गत्वा कर्मसङ्गिषु जायते ।
तथा प्रलीनस्तमसि मूढयोनिषु जायते ॥ १५॥
verses.transliteration:
Rajasi Pralayam Gatva Karma-sangishu Jayate,
Tatha Pralinas Tamasi Mudha-yonishu Jayate.
verses.englishMeaning: Meeting death when Rajas predominates, one is born among those attached to fruitive action; and dying when Tamas predominates, one is born in the wombs of the ignorant and senseless (subhuman species).
verses.hinglishMeaning: Rajo-guna ke badhe hone par mrityu ko prapt hokar vyakti karmon ki aasakti wale manushyon mein janma leta hai; tatha Tamo-guna ke badhe hone par mrityu hone par vah agyaani, pashu aadi moodh yoniyon mein janma paata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok Rajo-guna aur Tamo-guna mein sharir chhodne ke parinam ko batata hai.

Jo vyakti sansarik laalsaon, lalach aur daud-bhaag (Rajas) ke dauran marta hai, vah fir se aisi jagah janm leta hai jahan use din-raat karmon ke bandhano mein jhulna padta hai.

Aur jo vyakti behoshi, aalasya, nasha ya moorkhta (Tamas) ki dasha mein marta hai, vah pashu, pakshi ya neech agyaani yoniyon mein gir jata hai jahan vivek ka koi vikas nahi hota.
verses.lifeLesson: Aasakti aur aalasya humein neechay giraate hain, jabki pavitrata aur gyaan humein upar uthate hain. Apne man ko hamesha sachet aur shuddh banaye rakhein.

verses.sanskrit:
कर्मणः सुकृतस्याहुः सात्त्विकं निर्मलं फलम् ।
रजसस्तु फलं दुःखमज्ञानं तमसः फलम् ॥ १६॥
verses.transliteration:
Karmanah Sukritasyahuh Sattvikam Nirmalam Phalam,
Rajasas Tu Phalam Duhkham Ajnanam Tamasah Phalam.
verses.englishMeaning: The fruit of a virtuous action is said to be Sattvik and pure; but the fruit of Rajas is pain and sorrow, and the fruit of Tamas is sheer ignorance.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shubh aur pavitra karm ka phal Sattvik arthat nirmal (sukh aur shanti-dayak) kaha gaya hai; Rajo-guna ke karmon ka phal dukh hai; aur Tamo-guna ke karmon ka phal agyaan (moorkhata) hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Har karm ka ek nishchit parinam hota hai jo uske peeche ke guna par nirbhar karta hai. Pavitra, nishkam aur hitkari (Sattvik) karm man ko nirmal anand aur shanti dete hain.

Kamana aur swarth (Rajas) se kiye gaye karm hamesha asantosh, irshya aur dukh mein khatam hote hain, kyunki trishna kabhi tript nahi hoti.

Aur aalasya, hinsa ya laaparwahi (Tamas) se kiye gaye bure karm buddhi ko aur adhik andhere aur agyaan mein duba dete hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Achhe karmon ka parinam sadaiv shanti aur nirmalta hota hai. Swarth aur krodh dukh laate hain, aur aalasya agyaan badhata hai. Apne har karm ko Sattvik aur shuddh banayein.

verses.sanskrit:
सत्त्वात्सञ्जयते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च ।
प्रमादमोहौ तमसो भवतोऽज्ञानमेव च ॥ १७॥
verses.transliteration:
Sattvat Sanjayate Jnanam Rajaso Lobha Eva Cha,
Pramada-mohau Tamaso Bhavato 'jnanam Eva Cha.
verses.englishMeaning: From Sattva arises wisdom, and from Rajas arises greed; from Tamas arise heedlessness, delusion, and also ignorance.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Sattva guna se gyaan (vivek) utpann hota hai, Rajo-guna se nishchay hi lobh (laalach) paida hota hai, aur Tamo-guna se pramaad (laaparwahi), moh (bhram) tatha agyaan utpann hote hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh shlok hamare man ki aantarik fasal ko samjhata hai. Jab man mein Sattva badhta hai, tab satya aur asatya ko pehchanne wala vivek-gyaan phalta hai.

Jab Rajo-guna prabal hota hai, tab lobh paida hota hai—aur paane ki bhookh jo kabhi shaant nahi hoti.

Aur jab Tamo-guna chha jata hai, tab kartavya ko bhool jana (pramaad), galat ko sahi samajh baithna (moh) aur buddhi ka andhera (agyaan) paida hota hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apne man ke bheetar kya panap raha hai, ispar dhyan dein. Gyaan aur shanti chahiye toh Sattva ko badhayein; lalach aur bhram ko pehchan kar unka tyag karein.

verses.sanskrit:
ऊर्ध्वं गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः ।
जघन्यगुणवृत्तिस्था अधो गच्छन्ति तामसाः ॥ १८॥
verses.transliteration:
Urdhvam Gacchanti Sattva-stha Madhye Tishthanti Rajasah,
Jaghanya-guna-vritti-stha Adho Gacchanti Tamasah.
verses.englishMeaning: Those situated in Sattva ascend upward (to higher realms); those in Rajas remain in the middle (the human world); and those abiding in the lowest mode of Tamas sink downward (to lower realms).
verses.hinglishMeaning: Sattva guna mein sthit purush oordhva (oonche divya lokon ko) jaate hain; Rajo-guna wale madhya (manushya loka) mein hi rehte hain; aur atyant heena Tamo-guna ki vrittiyon mein sthit log adhogati (neech yoniyon/narak) ko prapt hote hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Hamare guno ki disha hi hamari aatma ki gati tay karti hai. Jo log nirmalta, gyaan aur paropkar (Sattva) mein jeevan bitate hain, unki chetna oordhva-gami hokar unche aatmic stharon par jaati hai.

Jo log sansarik kamanaon aur dhar-pakad (Rajas) mein rehte hain, ve manushya loka ke sukh-dukh ke daayre mein hi bhatakte rehte hain.

Aur jo log aalasya, nasha, hinsa aur andhakar (Tamas) mein jeevan barbaad karte hain, unka patan hota hai aur ve adhogati ko paate hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Aapki aantarik vrittiyan hi aapka bhagya banati hain. Apne aacharan aur vicharon ko uncha uthaayein, taaki aapka jeevan oordhva-gami aur kalyankari bane.

verses.sanskrit:
नान्यं गुणेभ्यः कर्तारं यदा द्रष्टानुपश्यति ।
गुणेभ्यश्च परं वेत्ति मद्भावं सोऽधिगच्छति ॥ १९॥
verses.transliteration:
Nanyam Gunebhyah Kartaram Yada Drashtanupashyati,
Gunebhyash Cha Param Vetti Mad-bhavam So 'dhigacchati.
verses.englishMeaning: When the discerning seer perceives no agent of action other than these gunas, and knows That which is supreme beyond the gunas, he attains to My divine nature.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jab viveki drashta (saadhak) in teeno guno ke atirikt kisi anya ko karta nahi dekhta, aur guno se pare Param Tatva (Mujhe) jaan leta hai, tab vah Mere divya swaroop ko prapt hota hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sansar ke vyavahar prakriti ke niyam se ho rahe hain. Kartritva ke ahankar se mukt hokar apne swabhav ke sakshi banein; yahi param shanti ka dwar hai.

verses.sanskrit:
गुणानेतानतीत्य त्रीन्देही देहसमुद्भवान् ।
जन्ममृत्युजरादुःखैर्विमुक्तोऽमृतमश्नुते ॥ २०॥
verses.transliteration:
Gunan Etan Atitya Trin Dehi Deha-samudbhavan,
Janma-mrityu-jara-duhkhair Vimukto 'mritam Ashnute.
verses.englishMeaning: Transcending these three gunas which originate in the material body, the embodied soul, completely freed from birth, death, old age, and sorrow, attains immortality.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yeh dehadhari jeev shareer ki utpatti ke karan-roop in teeno guno se pare (gunatit) hokar janma, mrityu, budhapa aur sabhi prakar ke dukhon se mukt hua amritatva (param anand) ko prapt karta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shareer prakriti ke teeno guno se paida hota hai, isliye ismein janm, bimari, budhapa aur mrityu jaise vikar aate hain.

Parantu aatma in teeno guno se upar uthkar jab apne shuddh swaroop ko pehchan leti hai (ise "gunatit" avastha kehte hain), tab shareer ke dukh use sparsh nahi kar sakte.

Vah sansar ke janma-maran ke chakravyuha se hamesha ke liye aazad hokar us amar anand ko pa leti hai jo kabhi nasht nahi hota.
verses.lifeLesson: Shareer aur man ke dukh-dard temporary hain. Inse upar uthkar jab aap apni amar aatma ko jaan lete hain, tab kisi bhi bhay ya kasht ka asar aap par nahi padta.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
कैर्लिङ्गैस्त्रीन्गुणानेतानतीतो भवति प्रभो ।
किमाचारः कथं चैतांस्त्रीन्गुणानतिवर्तते ॥ २१॥
verses.transliteration:
Arjuna Uvacha:
Kair Lingais Trin Gunan Etan Atito Bhavati Prabho,
Kim-acharah Katham Chaitan Trin Gunan Ativartate.
verses.englishMeaning: Arjuna said: By what characteristics is one known who has transcended these three gunas, O Lord? What is his conduct, and how does he rise above these three modes of nature?
verses.hinglishMeaning: Arjun ne kaha: Hey Prabhu! In teeno guno se pare hua manushya kin lakshano se yukta hota hai? Uska aacharan kaisa hota hai? Aur vah kis upaay se in teeno guno se mukt hota hai?
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhagavan ke mukti-vachano ko sunkar Arjun ke man mein jigyasa jaagti hai. Vah teen atyant spashta aur vyavaharik prashna poochhta hai:

1. Jo vyakti in teeno guno se upar uth chuka hai (gunatit hai), uski kya pehchan ya lakshan hain?
2. Vah sansar mein kaisa aacharan karta hai, uska vyavahar kaisa hota hai?
3. Aur sadhak kin saadhano ya upaayo se in teeno kathin guno ko paar kar sakta hai?

Yeh prashna har us vyakti ke liye zaroori hain jo sachhi aatmic shanti chahta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Adhyatmik pragati keval siddhanto mein nahi, balki vyavahar aur aacharan mein jhalakni chahiye. Shreshtha lakshanon ko samajhna unhe apnane ka pehla kadam hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
प्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहमेव च पाण्डव ।
न द्वेष्टि सम्प्रवृत्तानि न निवृत्तानि काङ्क्षति ॥ २२॥
verses.transliteration:
Shri-Bhagavan Uvacha:
Prakasham Cha Pravrittim Cha Moham Eva Cha Pandava,
Na Dveshti Sampravrittani Na Nivrittani Kangkshati.
verses.englishMeaning: The Supreme Lord said: He who does not hate illumination (Sattva), activity (Rajas), or delusion (Tamas) when they arise, O Pandava, nor longs for them when they cease.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shri Bhagavan ne kaha: Hey Pandu-putra Arjun! Jo manushya gyaan/prakash (Sattva), karm-pravritti (Rajas) aur moh (Tamas) ke prakat hone par na toh unse dvesha karta hai aur na hi unke shant hone par unki aakanksha karta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhagavan Arjun ke pehle prashna ka uttar dete hain. Gunaatit vyakti ka sabse bada lakshan uski aantarik tat-sthata (detachment) hai.

Jab man mein Sattva ka prakash aaye, toh vah usmein asakta nahi hota; jab Rajas ki pravritti ya Tamas ka moh aaye, toh vah unse dvesha ya nafrat nahi karta.

Aur jab yeh chale jaate hain, tab vah unke peeche ro-ta ya unki kamana nahi karta. Vah jaanta hai ki yeh prakriti ke badalte mausam hain aur vah inka asanga sakshi hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ke utar-chadhav aur bhavnaon se ladne ke bajay unhe ek sakshi bankar dekhein. Na achhi sthitiyon mein ahankar karein aur na kathin sthitiyon se nafrat karein.

verses.sanskrit:
उदासीनवदासीनो गुणैर्यो न विचाल्यते ।
गुणा वर्तन्त इत्येवं योऽवतिष्ठति नेङ्गते ॥ २३॥
verses.transliteration:
Udasina-vad Asino Gunair Yo Na Vichalyate,
Guna Vartanta Ity Evam Yo 'vatishthati Nengate.
verses.englishMeaning: He who sits like one unconcerned (a neutral witness) and is not moved by the gunas; who, knowing that 'the gunas alone are interacting with the gunas', remains firmly established in the Self and wavers not.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo udaseen (tat-stha/sakshi) ki tarah sthit hokar guno ke dwara vichalit nahi kiya ja sakta, aur 'guna hi guno mein vyavahar kar rahe hain' aisa samajhkar apni aatma mein sthir rehta hai aur kabhi dolta nahi.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Gunaatit purush jeevan ke khel ko ek nishpaksh darshak ki tarah dekhta hai. Jaise nadi ke kinare baitha vyakti paani ke bahav ko dekhta hai par behta nahi, waise hi vah man aur indriyon ke khel ko dekhta hai.

Vah samajhta hai ki indriyan apne vishayon mein ghoom rahi hain—yeh sab prakriti ke guno ka aapas ka khel hai, aatma ka isse koi lena-dena nahi.

Is dridh gyaan ke karan koi bhi sthiti use uske aatmic thehraav se hila nahi sakti.
verses.lifeLesson: Har paristhiti mein turant react karne ke bajay ek shant darshak banna seekhein. Jab aap yeh samajhte hain ki duniya apna kaam kar rahi hai, toh aapki bheetari sthirata kabhi bhang nahi hoti.

verses.sanskrit:
समदुःखसुखः स्वस्थः समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः ।
तुल्यप्रियाप्रियो धीरस्तुल्यनिन्दात्मसंस्तुतिः ॥ २४॥
verses.transliteration:
Sama-duhkha-sukhah Sva-sthah Sama-loshtashma-kanchanah,
Tulya-priyapriyo Dhiras Tulya-nindatma-samstutih.
verses.englishMeaning: He who is equal in pain and pleasure, established in the Self (sva-stha), regarding a clod of earth, a stone, and gold as alike; equanimous toward desirable and undesirable things, steady, and the same in blame and praise.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo sukh aur dukh mein samaan rehta hai, apne aatmaroop mein sthit (swasth) hai, mitti ke dhele, patthar aur sone ko ek samaan drishti se dekhta hai; jiske liye priya aur apriya barabar hain, jo dhairyavaan hai aur ninda tatha prashansa mein ek samaan rehta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Is shlok mein gunaatit vyakti ke chitta ki divya samata ka adbhut varnan hai. Vah 'swasth' hai arthat apne aatmic swaroop mein poori tarah thehra hua hai.

Uske liye sukh-dukh samaan hain; vah sone aur mitti mein keval bahari aakar dekhta hai, dono se asakta nahi hota. Priya ghatna par phoolta nahi aur apriya par toot-ta nahi.

Chahe koi uski ninda kare ya tareef, uska man santulit rehta hai kyunki vah jaanta hai ki laukik prashansa aur aalochana dono kshanbhangur hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Duniya ki taareef par hawa mein na udein aur aalochana par nirash na hon. Apne bheetari santulan aur aatmic mulyon par sthir rehna hi sachhi shanti aur shakti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
मानापमानयोस्तुल्यस्तुल्यो मित्रारिपक्षयोः ।
सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी गुणातीतः स उच्यते ॥ २५॥
verses.transliteration:
Manapamanayos Tulyas Tulyo Mitrari-pakshayoh,
Sarvarambha-parityagi Gunatitah Sa Uchyate.
verses.englishMeaning: He who is the same in honor and dishonor, equal to friends and foes, and has renounced the sense of doership in all undertakings—he is said to have transcended the gunas.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo maan aur apmaan mein samaan bhav rakhta hai, shatru aur mitra ke paksha mein bhi samadarshi hai, aur jisne swarth-bhav se sabhi karmon ke kartritva ka tyag kar diya hai—aisa mahapurush 'gunaatit' kaha jata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhagavan Arjun ke doosre prashna (aacharan kaisa hota hai) ka upashanhar karte hain. Gunaatit sadhak maan aur apmaan dono ko hawa ke jhoke ki tarah leta hai.

Uska koi shatru nahi hota aur mitra ke prati bhi uska koi andha moh nahi hota; vah sabhi ke prati shuddh nishpaksh prem rakhta hai.

Vah ahankar-vash naye-naye swarthi karmon ka bojh nahi uthata (sarvarambha-parityagi), balki Ishwar ki ichha se jo kartavya saamne aaye use poori shuddhata se karta hai. Aisa vyakti hi sachha gunaatit hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Maan-samman ki chinta chhodkar aur bhedbhav mitakar jeena hi sachhi aazadi hai. Kartavya ko nishkam bhav se karein aur sabhi ke prati prem-bhav banaye rakhein.

verses.sanskrit:
मां च योऽव्यभिचारेण भक्तियोगेन सेवते ।
स गुणान्समतीत्यैतान्ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते ॥ २६॥
verses.transliteration:
Mam Cha Yo 'vyabhicharena Bhakti-yogena Sevate,
Sa Gunan Samatityaitan Brahma-bhuyaya Kalpate.
verses.englishMeaning: And he who serves Me with unswerving, steadfast devotion (Bhakti Yoga) transcends these three gunas and becomes eligible for attaining the status of Brahman (oneness with the Absolute).
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aur jo manushya ananya, avyabhichari (eknishtha) bhakti-yoga dwara nirantar Meri seva aur dhyan karta hai, vah in teeno guno ko poori tarah paar karke Parambrahma ko prapt hone ka yogya ban jata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yahan Bhagavan Arjun ke teesre prashna (kin upaayon se guno ko paar kiya jata hai) ka sarvashreshtha uttar dete hain.

Keval apne prayas se prakriti ke teeno balwan guno ko jeetna atyant kathin hai. Lekin jab koi bhakta Bhagavan Shri Krishna ke charnon mein ananya prem aur sharanagati ke saath samarpit hota hai, tab Ishwar ki kripa se vah asani se in guno se paar ho jata hai.

Bhakti hi vah sethu (pul) hai jo sadhak ko guno ke bhatkav se mukt karke Brahmi-sthiti (param mukti) tak pahunchata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apne bal par sabhi manovikaron ko jeetna kathin ho sakta hai, parantu Ishwar ke prati poorn sharanagati aur niswarth prem se har bandhan sahaj hi toot jata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मणो हि प्रतिष्ठाहममृतस्याव्ययस्य च ।
शाश्वतस्य च धर्मस्य सुखस्यैकान्तिकस्य च ॥ २७॥
verses.transliteration:
Brahmano Hi Pratishthaham Amritasyavyayasya Cha,
Shashvatasya Cha Dharmasya Sukhasyaikantikasya Cha.
verses.englishMeaning: For I am the foundational basis of the formless Brahman, of immortal life, of the imperishable, of the eternal Dharma, and of ultimate, unending bliss.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Kyunki us niraakaar Parambrahma ka, amritatva (amar pad) ka, avinashi tatva ka, nitya sanatan dharma ka aur anant paaramaarthik anand ka param aashray aur mool aadhar Main hi hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Adhyay 14 ka antim aur atyant mahatvapoorna shlok hai. Bhagavan Krishna apne purna divya swaroop ka ailan karte hain.

Jis niraakaar Parambrahma ki khoj gyaani karte hain, jis amritatva aur moksha ki kamana sadhak karte hain, jis sanatan dharma par poora vishva tikka hai, aur jo param anant sukh hai—un sabhi ka mool aadhar aur pratishtha swayam Bhagavan hain.

Isliye Bhagavan ki bhakti karna hi sabhi sadhanaon ka saar aur sarvochha gyaan ki parakaashtha hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Ishwar hi sabhi dharmon, nitya shanti aur anant anand ka mool srot hain. Sabhi sansarik aashrayon ko chhodkar us ek Param Adhar par vishwas karein.

summary: The fifteenth chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Purushottama Yoga. In Sanskrit, Purusha means the All-pervading God, and Purushottam means the timeless & transcendental aspect of God.
