Krishna reveals that the purpose of this Transcendental knowledge of the God is to detach ourselves from the bondage of the material world and to understand Krishna as the Supreme Divine Personality, who is the eternal controller and sustainer of the world. One who understands this Ultimate Truth surrenders to Him and engages in His devotional service.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
ऊर्ध्वमूलमधःशाखमश्वत्थं प्राहुरव्ययम् ।
छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca.
ūrdhvamūlamadhaḥśākhamaśvatthaṃ prāhuravyayam.
chandāṃsi yasya parṇāni yastaṃ veda sa vedavit
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shree bhagavaan ne kahaa -- (jnyaanee purusha isa sansaara vriksha ko) oordhvamoola aura adha:shaakhaa vaalaa ashvattha aura avyaya kahate hain; jisake parna chhanda arthaat veda hain, aise (sansaara vriksha) ko jo jaanataa hai, vaha vedavit hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Shree bhagavaan ne kahaa -- (jnyaanee purusha isa sansaara vriksha ko) oordhvamoola aura adha:shaakhaa vaalaa ashvattha aura avyaya kahate hain; jisake parna chhanda arthaat veda hain, aise (sansaara vriksha) ko jo jaanataa hai, vaha vedavit hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 15 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sansar-vriksha, jeev aur Purushottam ke sambandh ko spasht karta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अधश्चोर्ध्वं प्रसृतास्तस्य शाखा
गुणप्रवृद्धा विषयप्रवालाः ।
अधश्च मूलान्यनुसन्ततानि
कर्मानुबन्धीनि मनुष्यलोके ॥
verses.transliteration:
adhaścordhvaṃ prasṛtāstasya śākhā guṇapravṛddhā viṣayapravālāḥ.
adhaśca mūlānyanusantatāni karmānubandhīni manuṣyaloke
verses.hinglishMeaning: Usa vriksha kee shaakhaaen gunon se pravriddha hueen neechey aura oopara phailee hueen hain; (pancha) vishaya isake ankura hain; manushya loka men karmon kaa anusarana karane vaalee isakee anya jaden neechey phailee hueen hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Usa vriksha kee shaakhaaen gunon se pravriddha hueen neechey aura oopara phailee hueen hain; (pancha) vishaya isake ankura hain; manushya loka men karmon kaa anusarana karane vaalee isakee anya jaden neechey phailee hueen hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 15 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sansar-vriksha, jeev aur Purushottam ke sambandh ko spasht karta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
न रूपमस्येह तथोपलभ्यते
नान्तो न चादिर्न च सम्प्रतिष्ठा ।
अश्वत्थमेनं सुविरूढमूलं
असङ्गशस्त्रेण दृढेन छित्त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
na rūpamasyeha tathopalabhyate nānto na cādirna ca sampratiṣṭhā.
aśvatthamenaṃ suvirūḍhamūlaṃ asaṅgaśastreṇa dṛḍhena chittvā
verses.hinglishMeaning: Isa (sansaara vriksha) kaa svaroopa jaisaa kahaa gayaa hai vaisaa yahaan upalabdha naheen hotaa hai, kyonki isakaa na aadi hai aura na anta aura na pratishthaa hee hai. isa ati dridha moola vaale ashvattha vriksha ko dridha asangga shastra se kaatakara ...৷৷৷৷
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Isa (sansaara vriksha) kaa svaroopa jaisaa kahaa gayaa hai vaisaa yahaan upalabdha naheen hotaa hai, kyonki isakaa na aadi hai aura na anta aura na pratishthaa hee hai. isa ati dridha moola vaale ashvattha vriksha ko dridha asangga shastra se kaatakara ...৷৷৷৷. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 15 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sansar-vriksha, jeev aur Purushottam ke sambandh ko spasht karta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः पदं तत्परिमार्गितव्यं
यस्मिन्गता न निवर्तन्ति भूयः ।
तमेव चाद्यं पुरुषं प्रपद्ये ।
यतः प्रवृत्तिः प्रसृता पुराणी ॥
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ padaṃ tatparimārgitavyaṃ yasmingatā na nivartanti bhūyaḥ.
tameva cādyaṃ puruṣaṃ prapadye.
yataḥ pravṛttiḥ prasṛtā purāṇī
verses.hinglishMeaning: (taduparaanta) usa pada kaa anveshana karanaa chaahie jisako praapta hue purusha puna: sansaara men naheen lautate hain. "main usa aadi purusha kee sharana hoon, jisase yaha puraatana pravritti prasrita huee hai"
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: (taduparaanta) usa pada kaa anveshana karanaa chaahie jisako praapta hue purusha puna: sansaara men naheen lautate hain. "main usa aadi purusha kee sharana hoon, jisase yaha puraatana pravritti prasrita huee hai". Iska sandarbh Adhyay 15 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sansar-vriksha, jeev aur Purushottam ke sambandh ko spasht karta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
निर्मानमोहा जितसङ्गदोषा
अध्यात्मनित्या विनिवृत्तकामाः ।
द्वन्द्वैर्विमुक्ताः सुखदुःखसंज्ञैर्-
गच्छन्त्यमूढाः पदमव्ययं तत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
nirmānamohā jitasaṅgadoṣā adhyātmanityā vinivṛttakāmāḥ.
dvandvairvimuktāḥ sukhaduḥkhasaṃjñaira- gacchantyamūḍhāḥ padamavyayaṃ tat
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jinakaa maana aura moha nivritta ho gayaa hai, jinhonne sangadosha ko jeeta liyaa hai, jo adhyaatma men sthita hain jinakee kaamanaaen nivritta ho chukee hain aura jo sukha-du:kha naamaka dvandvon se vimukta ho gaye hain, aise sammoha rahita jnyaaneejana usa avyaya pada ko praapta hote hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jinakaa maana aura moha nivritta ho gayaa hai, jinhonne sangadosha ko jeeta liyaa hai, jo adhyaatma men sthita hain jinakee kaamanaaen nivritta ho chukee hain aura jo sukha-du:kha naamaka dvandvon se vimukta ho gaye hain, aise sammoha rahita jnyaaneejana usa avyaya pada ko praapta hote hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 15 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sansar-vriksha, jeev aur Purushottam ke sambandh ko spasht karta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
न तद्भासयते सूर्यो न शशाङ्को न पावकः ।
यद्गत्वा न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम ॥
verses.transliteration:
na tadbhāsayate sūryo na śaśāṅko na pāvakaḥ.
yadgatvā na nivartante taddhāma paramaṃ mama
verses.hinglishMeaning: Use na soorya prakaashita kara sakataa hai aura na chandramaa aura na agni. jise praapta kara manushya puna: (sansaara ko) naheen lautate hain, vaha meraa parama dhaama hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Use na soorya prakaashita kara sakataa hai aura na chandramaa aura na agni. jise praapta kara manushya puna: (sansaara ko) naheen lautate hain, vaha meraa parama dhaama hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 15 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sansar-vriksha, jeev aur Purushottam ke sambandh ko spasht karta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
ममैवांशो जीवलोके जीवभूतः सनातनः ।
मनःषष्ठानीन्द्रियाणि प्रकृतिस्थानि कर्षति ॥
verses.transliteration:
mamaivāṃśo jīvaloke jīvabhūtaḥ sanātanaḥ.
manaḥṣaṣṭhānīndriyāṇi prakṛtisthāni karṣati
verses.hinglishMeaning: Isa jeeva loka men meraa hee eka sanaatana ansha jeeva banaa hai. vaha prakriti men sthita huaa (dehatyaaga ke samaya) paancho indriyon tathaa mana ko apanee ora kheencha letaa hai arthaat unhen ekatrita kara letaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Isa jeeva loka men meraa hee eka sanaatana ansha jeeva banaa hai. vaha prakriti men sthita huaa (dehatyaaga ke samaya) paancho indriyon tathaa mana ko apanee ora kheencha letaa hai arthaat unhen ekatrita kara letaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 15 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sansar-vriksha, jeev aur Purushottam ke sambandh ko spasht karta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
शरीरं यदवाप्नोति यच्चाप्युत्क्रामतीश्वरः ।
गृहीत्वैतानि संयाति वायुर्गन्धानिवाशयात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śarīraṃ yadavāpnoti yaccāpyutkrāmatīśvaraḥ.
gṛhitvaitāni saṃyāti vāyurgandhānivāśayāt
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jaba (dehaadi kaa) eeshvara (jeeva) (eka shareera se) utkramana karataa hai, taba ina (indriyon aura mana) ko grahana kara anya shareera men isa prakaara le jaataa hai, jaise gandha ke aashraya (phoolaadi) se gandha ko vaayu le jaataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jaba (dehaadi kaa) eeshvara (jeeva) (eka shareera se) utkramana karataa hai, taba ina (indriyon aura mana) ko grahana kara anya shareera men isa prakaara le jaataa hai, jaise gandha ke aashraya (phoolaadi) se gandha ko vaayu le jaataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 15 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sansar-vriksha, jeev aur Purushottam ke sambandh ko spasht karta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रोत्रं चक्षुः स्पर्शनं च रसनं घ्राणमेव च ।
अधिष्ठाय मनश्चायं विषयानुपसेवते ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrotraṃ cakṣuḥ sparśanaṃ ca rasanaṃ ghrāṇameva ca.
adhiṣṭhāya manaścāyaṃ viṣayānupasevate
verses.hinglishMeaning: (yaha jeeva) shrotra, chakshu, sparshendriya, rasanaa aura ghraana (naaka) ina indriyon tathaa mana ko aashraya karake arthaat inake dvaaraa vishayon kaa sevana karataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: (yaha jeeva) shrotra, chakshu, sparshendriya, rasanaa aura ghraana (naaka) ina indriyon tathaa mana ko aashraya karake arthaat inake dvaaraa vishayon kaa sevana karataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 15 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sansar-vriksha, jeev aur Purushottam ke sambandh ko spasht karta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
उत्क्रामन्तं स्थितं वापि भुञ्जानं वा गुणान्वितम् ।
विमूढा नानुपश्यन्ति पश्यन्ति ज्ञानचक्षुषः ॥
verses.transliteration:
utkrāmantaṃ sthitaṃ vāpi bhuñjānaṃ vā guṇānvitam.
vimūḍhā nānupaśyanti paśyanti jñānacakṣuṣaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shareera ko tyaagate huye, usamen sthita huye athavaa (vishayon ko) bhogate huye, gunon se samanvita atma ko vimoodha loga naheen dekhate hain; (parantu) jnyaanachakshu vaale purusha use dekhate hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Shareera ko tyaagate huye, usamen sthita huye athavaa (vishayon ko) bhogate huye, gunon se samanvita atma ko vimoodha loga naheen dekhate hain; (parantu) jnyaanachakshu vaale purusha use dekhate hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 15 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sansar-vriksha, jeev aur Purushottam ke sambandh ko spasht karta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यतन्तो योगिनश्चैनं पश्यन्त्यात्मन्यवस्थितम् ।
यतन्तोऽप्यकृतात्मानो नैनं पश्यन्त्यचेतसः ॥
verses.transliteration:

yatanto.apyakṛtātmāno nainaṃ paśyantyacetasaḥ

यच्चन्द्रमसि यच्चाग्नौ तत्तेजो विद्धि मामकम् ॥
verses.transliteration:

पुष्णामि चौषधीः सर्वाः सोमो भूत्वा रसात्मकः ॥
verses.transliteration:

verses.sanskrit:
अहं वैश्वानरो भूत्वा प्राणिनां देहमाश्रितः ।
प्राणापानसमायुक्तः पचाम्यन्नं चतुर्विधम् ॥
verses.transliteration:

verses.hinglishMeaning: Main hee samasta praaniyon ke deha men sthita vaishvaanara agniroopa hokara praana aura apaana se yukta chaara prakaara ke anna ko pachaataa hoon

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वस्य चाहं हृदि सन्निविष्टो
मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनञ्च ।
वेदैश्च सर्वैरहमेव वेद्यो
वेदान्तकृद्वेदविदेव चाहम् ॥
verses.transliteration:

verses.sanskrit:

verses.transliteration:

verses.hinglishMeaning: Isa loka men kshara (nashvara) aura akshara (anashvara) ye do purusha hain, samasta bhoota kshara hain aura 'kootastha' akshara kahalaataa hai

verses.sanskrit:
उत्तमः पुरुषस्त्वन्यः परमात्मेत्युधाहृतः ।
यो लोकत्रयमाविश्य बिभर्त्यव्यय ईश्वरः ॥
verses.transliteration:

yo lokatrayamāviśya bibhartyavyaya īśvaraḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Parantu uttama purusha anya hee hai, jo paramatma kahalaataa hai aura jo teenon lokon men pravesha karake sabakaa dhaarana karane vaalaa avyaya eeshvara hai

यस्मात्क्षरमतीतोऽहमक्षरादपि चोत्तमः ।
अतोऽस्मि लोके वेदे च प्रथितः पुरुषोत्तमः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yasmātkṣaramatīto.ahamakṣarādapi cottamaḥ.
ato.asmi loke vedeca prathitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Kyonki main kshara se ateeta hoon aura akshara se bhee uttama hoon, isaliye loka men aura veda men bhee purushottama ke naama se prasiddha hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Kyonki main kshara se ateeta hoon aura akshara se bhee uttama hoon, isaliye loka men aura veda men bhee purushottama ke naama se prasiddha hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 15 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sansar-vriksha, jeev aur Purushottam ke sambandh ko spasht karta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यो मामेवमसम्मूढो जानाति पुरुषोत्तमम् ।
स सर्वविद्भजति मां सर्वभावेन भारत ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo māmevamasammūḍho jānāti puruṣottamam.
sa sarvavidbhajati māṃ sarvabhāvena bhārata
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey bhaarata ! isa prakaara, jo, sanmoharahita, purusha mujha purushottama ko jaanataa hai, vaha sarvajnya hokara sampoorna bhaava se arthaat poorna hridaya se meree bhakti karataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey bhaarata ! isa prakaara, jo, sanmoharahita, purusha mujha purushottama ko jaanataa hai, vaha sarvajnya hokara sampoorna bhaava se arthaat poorna hridaya se meree bhakti karataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 15 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sansar-vriksha, jeev aur Purushottam ke sambandh ko spasht karta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
इति गुह्यतमं शास्त्रमिदमुक्तं मयानघ ।
एतद्बुद्ध्वा बुद्धिमान्स्यात्कृतकृत्यश्च भारत ॥
verses.transliteration:
iti guhyatamaṃ śāstramidamuktaṃ mayānagha.
etadbuddhvā buddhimānsyātkṛtakṛtyaśca bhārata
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey nishpaapa bhaarata ! isa prakaara yaha guhyatama shaastra mere dvaaraa kahaa gayaa, isako jaanakara manushya buddhimaana aura kritakritya ho jaataa hai

summary: The sixteenth chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Daivasura Sampad Vibhaga Yoga. In this chapter, Krishna describes explicitly the two kinds of natures among human beings - divine and demoniac. Those who possess demonaic qualities associate themselves with the modes of passion and ignorance do not follow the regulations of the scriptures and embrace materialistic views. These people attain lower births and further material bondage. But people who possess divine qualities, follow the instructions of the scriptures, associate themselves with the mode of goodness and purify the mind through spiritual practices. This leads to the enhancement of divine qualities and they eventually attain spiritual realization.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
अभयं सत्त्वसंशुद्धिर्ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः ।
दानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca.
abhayaṃ sattvasaṃśuddhirjñānayogavyavasthitiḥ.
dānaṃ damaśca yajñaśca svādhyāyastapa ārjavam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shree bhagavaan ne kahaa -- abhaya, anta:karana kee shuddhi, jnyaanayoga men dridha sthiti, daana, dama, yajnya, svaadhyaaya, tapa aura aarjava

verses.sanskrit:

verses.transliteration:

Iska sandarbh Adhyay 16 ke mool vishay se juda hai: daivi aur asuri gunon ke bhed se charitra ki disha sudharta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
तेजः क्षमा धृतिः शौचमद्रोहो नातिमानिता ।
भवन्ति सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातस्य भारत ॥
verses.transliteration:

Iska sandarbh Adhyay 16 ke mool vishay se juda hai: daivi aur asuri gunon ke bhed se charitra ki disha sudharta hai.

अज्ञानं चाभिजातस्य पार्थ सम्पदमासुरीम् ॥
verses.transliteration:

ajñānaṃ cābhijātasya pārtha sampadamāsurīm

verses.sanskrit:
दैवी सम्पद्विमोक्षाय निबन्धायासुरी मता ।
मा शुचः सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातोऽसि पाण्डव ॥
verses.transliteration:
daivī sampadvimokṣāya nibandhāyāsurī matā.
mā śucaḥ sampadaṃ daivīmabhijāto.asi pāṇḍava
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey paandava ! daivee sampadaa moksha ke lie aura aasuree sampadaa bandhana ke lie maanee gayee hai, tuma shoka mata karo, kyonki tuma daivee sampadaa ko praapta hue ho

दैवो विस्तरशः प्रोक्त आसुरं पार्थ मे शृणु ॥
verses.transliteration:

verses.sanskrit:
प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुरासुराः ।
न शौचं नापि चाचारो न सत्यं तेषु विद्यते ॥

verses.sanskrit:

verses.sanskrit:

verses.transliteration:

prabhavantyugrakarmāṇaḥ kṣayāya jagato.ahitāḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Isa drishti kaa avalambana karake nashtasvabhaava ke alpa buddhi vaale, ghora karma karane vaale loga jagat ke shatru (ahita chaahane vaale) ke roopa men usakaa naasha karane ke lie utpanna hote hain

verses.sanskrit:

ईहन्ते कामभोगार्थमन्यायेनार्थसञ्चयान् ॥

verses.sanskrit:

verses.sanskrit:

summary: The seventeenth chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Sraddhatraya Vibhaga Yoga. In this chapter, Krishna describes the three types of faith corresponding to the three modes of the material nature. Lord Krishna further reveals that it is the nature of faith that determines the quality of life and the character of living entities. Those who have faith in passion and ignorance perform actions that yield temporary, material results while those who have faith in goodness perform actions in accordance with scriptural instructions and hence their hearts get further purified.

दम्भाहंकारसंयुक्ताः कामरागबलान्विताः ॥

verses.transliteration:

आहारस्त्वपि सर्वस्य त्रिविधो भवति प्रियः ।
यज्ञस्तपस्तथा दानं तेषां भेदमिमं शृणु ॥

rasyāḥ snigdhāḥ sthirā hṛdyā āhārāḥ sāttvikapriyāḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aayu, sattva (shuddhi), bala, aarogya, sukha aura preeti ko pravriddha karane vaale evan rasayukta, snigdha ( ghee aadi kee chikanaaee se yukta) sthira tathaa mana ko prasanna karane vaale aahaara arthaat bhojya padaartha saattvika purushon ko priya hote hain

verses.sanskrit:

आहारा राजसस्येष्टा दुःखशोकामयप्रदाः ॥
verses.transliteration:

āhārā rājasasyeṣṭā duḥkhaśokāmayapradāḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Kadave, khatte, lavanayukta, ati ushna, teekshna (teekhe, mircha yukta), rookhe. daahakaaraka, du:kha, shoka aura roga utpanna kaaraka bhojya padaartha raajasa purusha ko priya hote hain

verses.sanskrit:
यातयामं गतरसं पूति पर्युषितं च यत् ।
उच्छिष्टमपि चामेध्यं भोजनं तामसप्रियम् ॥
verses.transliteration:

ucchiṣṭamapi cāmedhyaṃ bhojanaṃ tāmasapriyam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Ardhapakva, rasarahita, durgandhayukta, baasee, uchchhishta tathaa apavitra (amedhya) anna taamasa janon ko priya hotaa hai

यष्टव्यमेवेति मनः समाधाय स सात्त्विकः ॥
verses.transliteration:

yaṣṭavyameveti manaḥ samādhāya sa sāttvikaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo yajnya shaastravidhi se niyantrita kiyaa huaa tathaa jise "yaha meraa kartavya hai" aisaa mana kaa samaadhaana (nishchaya) kara phala kee aakaankshaa naheen rakhane vaale logon ke dvaaraa kiyaa jaataa hai, vaha yajnya saattvika hai

verses.transliteration:

ijyate bharataśreṣṭha taṃ yajñaṃ viddhi rājasam

verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo vaakya (bhaashana) udvega utpanna karane vaalaa naheen hai, jo priya, hitakaaraka aura satya hai tathaa vedon kaa svaadhyaaya abhyaasa vaangmaya (vaanee kaa) tapa kahalaataa hai

bhāvasaṃśuddhirityetattapo mānasamucyate

क्रियते तदिह प्रोक्तं राजसं चलमध्रुवम् ॥
verses.transliteration:

kriyate tadiha proktaṃ rājasaṃ calamadhruvam

परस्योत्सादनार्थं वा तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ॥
verses.transliteration:

parasyotsādanārthaṃ vā tattāmasamudāhṛtam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo tapa moodhataapoorvaka svayan ko peedita karate hue athavaa anya logon ke naasha ke lie kiyaa jaataa hai, vaha tapa taamasa kahaa gayaa hai

verses.sanskrit:

देशे काले च पात्रे च तद्दानं सात्त्विकं स्मृतम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
dātavyamiti yaddānaṃ dīyate.anupakāriṇe.
deśe kāle ca pātre ca taddānaṃ sāttvikaṃ smṛtam
verses.hinglishMeaning: "daana denaa hee kartavya hai" - isa bhaava se jo daana yogya desha, kaala ko dekhakara aise (yogya) paatra (vyakti) ko diyaa jaataa hai, jisase pratyupakaara kee apekshaa naheen hotee hai, vaha daana saattvika maanaa gayaa hai

दीयते च परिक्लिष्टं तद्दानं राजसं स्मृतम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yattu pratyupakārārthaṃ phalamuddiśya vā punaḥ.
dīyate ca parikliṣṭaṃ taddānaṃ rājasaṃ smṛtam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aura jo daana kleshapoorvaka tathaa pratyupakaara ke uddeshya se athavaa phala kee kaamanaa rakhakara diyaa jaataa hain, vaha daana raajasa maanaa gayaa hai

verses.sanskrit:

असत्कृतमवज्ञातं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ॥
verses.transliteration:

asatkṛtamavajñātaṃ tattāmasamudāhṛtam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo daana binaa satkaara kiye, athavaa tiraskaarapoorvaka, ayogya deshakaala men, kupaatron ke lie diyaa jaataa hai, vaha daana taamasa maanaa gayaa hai

verses.sanskrit:
ॐतत्सदिति निर्देशो ब्रह्मणस्त्रिविधः स्मृतः ।
ब्राह्मणास्तेन वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च विहिताः पुरा ॥
verses.transliteration:
OMtatsaditi nirdeśo brahmaṇastrividhaḥ smṛtaḥ.

summary: The eighteenth chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Moksha Sanyas Yoga. Arjuna requests the Lord to explain the difference between the two types of renunciations - sanyaas(renunciation of actions) and tyaag(renunciation of desires). Krishna explains that a sanyaasi is one who abandons family and society in order to practise spiritual discipline whereas a tyaagi is one who performs their duties without attachment to the rewards of their actions and dedicating them to the God. Krishna recommends the second kind of renunciation - tyaag. Krishna then gives a detailed analysis of the effects of the three modes of material nature. He declares that the highest path of spirituality is pure, unconditional loving service unto the Supreme Divine Personality, Krishna. If we always remember Him, keep chanting His name and dedicate all our actions unto Him, take refuge in Him and make Him our Supreme goal, then by His grace, we will surely overcome all obstacles and difficulties and be freed from this cycle of birth and death.

अधिष्ठानं तथा कर्ता करणं च पृथग्विधम् ।
विविधाश्च पृथक्चेष्टा दैवं चैवात्र पञ्चमम् ॥
verses.transliteration:

verses.hinglishMeaning: Adhishthaana (shareera), kartaa ,vividha karana (indriyaadi) ,vividha aura prithak-prithak cheshtaaen tathaa paanchavaa hetu daiva hai

verses.sanskrit:
शरीरवाङ्मनोभिर्यत्कर्म प्रारभते नरः ।
न्याय्यं वा विपरीतं वा पञ्चैते तस्य हेतवः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śarīravāṅmanobhiryatkarma prārabhate naraḥ.
nyāyyaṃ vā viparītaṃ vā pañcaite tasya hetavaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Manushya apane shareera, vaanee aura mana se jo koee nyaayya (uchita) yaa vipareeta (anuchita) karma karataa hai, usake ye paancha kaarana hee hain

verses.sanskrit:
तत्रैवं सति कर्तारमात्मानं केवलं तु यः ।
पश्यत्यकृतबुद्धित्वान्न स पश्यति दुर्मतिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tatraivaṃ sati kartāramātmānaṃ kevalaṃ tu yaḥ.
paśyatyakṛtabuddhitvānna sa paśyati durmatiḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aba isa sthiti men jo purusha asanskrita buddhi hone ke kaarana, kevala shuddha atma ko kartaa samajhataa hain, vaha durmati purusha (yathaartha) naheen dekhataa hai

verses.sanskrit:
यस्य नाहंकृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न लिप्यते ।
हत्वाऽपि स इमाँल्लोकान्न हन्ति न निबध्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
yasya nāhaṃkṛto bhāvo buddhiryasya na lipyate.
hatvā.api sa imā.Nllokānna hanti na nibadhyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jisa purusha men ahankaara kaa bhaava naheen hai aura buddhi kisee (guna dosha) se lipta naheen hotee, vaha purusha ina saba lokon ko maarakara bhee vaastava men na marataa hai aura na (paapa se) bandhataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jisa purusha men ahankaara kaa bhaava naheen hai aura buddhi kisee (guna dosha) se lipta naheen hotee, vaha purusha ina saba lokon ko maarakara bhee vaastava men na marataa hai aura na (paapa se) bandhataa hai. verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं परिज्ञाता त्रिविधा कर्मचोदना ।
करणं कर्म कर्तेति त्रिविधः कर्मसंग्रहः ॥
verses.transliteration:
jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ parijñātā trividhā karmacodanā.
karaṇaṃ karma karteti trividhaḥ karmasaṃgrahaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jnyaana, jnyeya aura parijnyaataa ye trividha karma preraka hain, aura, karana, karma. kartaa ye trividha karma sangraha hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jnyaana, jnyeya aura parijnyaataa ye trividha karma preraka hain, aura, karana, karma. kartaa ye trividha karma sangraha hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञानं कर्म च कर्ताच त्रिधैव गुणभेदतः ।
प्रोच्यते गुणसङ्ख्याने यथावच्छृणु तान्यपि ॥
verses.transliteration:
jñānaṃ karma ca kartāca tridhaiva guṇabhedataḥ.
procyate guṇasaṅkhyāne yathāvacchṛṇu tānyapi
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jnyaana, karma aura kartaa bhee gunon ke bheda se saankhyashaastra (gunasankhyaane) men trividha hee kahey gaye hain; unako bhee tuma mujha se yathaavat shravana karo
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jnyaana, karma aura kartaa bhee gunon ke bheda se saankhyashaastra (gunasankhyaane) men trividha hee kahey gaye hain; unako bhee tuma mujha se yathaavat shravana karo. verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वभूतेषु येनैकं भावमव्ययमीक्षते ।
अविभक्तं विभक्तेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि सात्त्विकम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sarvabhūteṣu yenaikaṃ bhāvamavyayamīkṣate.
avibhaktaṃ vibhakteṣu tajjñānaṃ viddhi sāttvikam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jisa jnyaana se manushya, vibhakta roopa men sthita samasta bhooton men eka avibhakta aura avinaashee (avyaya) svaroopa ko dekhataa hai, usa jnyaana ko tuma saattvika jaano

Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
पृथक्त्वेन तु यज्ज्ञानं नानाभावान्पृथग्विधान् ।
वेत्ति सर्वेषु भूतेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि राजसम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pṛthaktvena tu yajjñānaṃ nānābhāvānpṛthagvidhān.
vetti sarveṣu bhūteṣu tajjñānaṃ viddhi rājasam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jisa jnyaana ke dvaaraa manushya samasta bhooton men naanaa bhaavon ko prithak-prithak jaanataa hai, usa jnyaana ko tuma raajasa jaano
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jisa jnyaana ke dvaaraa manushya samasta bhooton men naanaa bhaavon ko prithak-prithak jaanataa hai, usa jnyaana ko tuma raajasa jaano. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यत्तु कृत्स्नवदेकस्मिन्कार्ये सक्तमहैतुकम् ।
अतत्त्वार्थवदल्पं च तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yattu kṛtsnavadekasminkārye saktamahaitukam.
atattvārthavadalpaṃ ca tattāmasamudāhṛtam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aura jisa jnyaana ke dvaaraa manushya eka kaarya (shareera) men hee aasakta ho jaataa hai, maano vaha (kaarya hee) poorna vastu ho tathaa jo (jnyaana) heturahita (ayuktika), tattvaartha se rahita tathaa sankuchita (alpa) hai, vaha (jnyaana) taamasa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Aura jisa jnyaana ke dvaaraa manushya eka kaarya (shareera) men hee aasakta ho jaataa hai, maano vaha (kaarya hee) poorna vastu ho tathaa jo (jnyaana) heturahita (ayuktika), tattvaartha se rahita tathaa sankuchita (alpa) hai, vaha (jnyaana) taamasa hai. verses.sanskrit:
नियतं सङ्गरहितमरागद्वेषतः कृतम् ।
अफलप्रेप्सुना कर्म यत्तत्सात्त्विकमुच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
niyataṃ saṅgarahitamarāgadveṣataḥ kṛtam.
aphalaprepsunā karma yattatsāttvikamucyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo karma (shaastravidhi se) niyata aura sangarahita hai, tathaa phala ko na chaahane vaale purusha ke dvaaraa binaa kisee raaga dvesha ke kiyaa gayaa hai, vaha (karma) saattvika kahaa jaataa hai

यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहंकारेण वा पुनः ।
क्रियते बहुलायासं तद्राजसमुदाहृतम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yattu kāmepsunā karma sāhaṃkāreṇa vā punaḥ.
kriyate bahulāyāsaṃ tadrājasamudāhṛtam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aura jo karma bahuta parishrama se yukta hai tathaa phala kee kaamanaa vaale, ahankaarayukta purusha ke dvaaraa kiyaa jaataa hai, vaha karma raajasa kahaa gayaa hai

अनुबन्धं क्षयं हिंसामनपेक्ष्य च पौरुषम् ।
मोहादारभ्यते कर्म यत्तत्तामसमुच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
anubandhaṃ kṣayaṃ hiṃsāmanapekṣya ca pauruṣam.
mohādārabhyate karma yattattāmasamucyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo karma parinaama, haani, hinsaa aura saarmathya (paurusham) kaa vichaara na karake kevala mohavasha aarambha kiyaa jaataa hai, vaha karma taamasa kahalaataa hai

मुक्तसङ्गोऽनहंवादी धृत्युत्साहसमन्वितः ।
सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योर्निर्विकारः कर्ता सात्त्विक उच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
muktasaṅgo.anahaṃvādī dhṛtyutsāhasamanvitaḥ.
siddhyasiddhyornirvikāraḥ kartā sāttvika ucyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo kartaa sangarahita, ahanmanyataa se rahita, dhairya aura utsaaha se yukta evan kaarya kee siddhi (saphalataa) aura asiddhi (viphalataa) men nirvikaara rahataa hai, vaha kartaa saattvika kahaa jaataa hai

रागी कर्मफलप्रेप्सुर्लुब्धो हिंसात्मकोऽशुचिः ।
हर्षशोकान्वितः कर्ता राजसः परिकीर्तितः ॥
verses.transliteration:
rāgī karmaphalaprepsurlubdho hiṃsātmako.aśuciḥ.
harṣaśokānvitaḥ kartā rājasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Raagee, karmaphala kaa ichchhuka, lobhee, hinsaka svabhaava vaalaa, ashuddha aura harshashoka se yukta kartaa raajasa kahalaataa hai

विषादी दीर्घसूत्री च कर्ता तामस उच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
ayuktaḥ prākṛtaḥ stabdhaḥ śaṭho naiṣkṛtiko.alasaḥ.
viṣādī dīrghasūtrī ca kartā tāmasa ucyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Ayukta, praakrita, stabdha, shatha, naishkritika, aalasee, vishaadee aura deerghasootree kartaa taamasa kahaa jaataa hai

verses.sanskrit:
बुद्धेर्भेदं धृतेश्चैव गुणतस्त्रिविधं शृणु ।
प्रोच्यमानमशेषेण पृथक्त्वेन धनञ्जय ॥
verses.transliteration:
buddherbhedaṃ dhṛteścaiva guṇatastrividhaṃ śṛṇu.
procyamānamaśeṣeṇa pṛthaktvena dhanañjaya
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey dhananjaya ! mere dvaaraa asheshata: aura prithakata: kahey jaane vaale, gunon ke kaarana utpanna hue buddhi aura dhriti ke trividha bheda ko suno

प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कार्याकार्ये भयाभये ।
बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी ॥
verses.transliteration:
pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca kāryākārye bhayābhaye.
bandhaṃ mokṣaṃ ca yā vetti buddhiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey paartha ! jo buddhi pravritti aura nivritti, kaarya aura akaarya, bhaya aura abhaya tathaa bandha aura moksha ko tattvata jaanatee hai, vaha buddhi saatvikee hai

verses.sanskrit:
यया धर्ममधर्मं च कार्यं चाकार्यमेव च ।
अयथावत्प्रजानाति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ राजसी ॥
verses.transliteration:
yayā dharmamadharmaṃ ca kāryaṃ cākāryameva ca.
ayathāvatprajānāti buddhiḥ sā pārtha rājasī
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey paartha ! jisa buddhi ke dvaaraa manushya dharma aura adharma ko tathaa kartavya aura akartavya ko yathaavat naheen jaanataa hai, vaha buddhi raajasee hai

verses.sanskrit:
अधर्मं धर्ममिति या मन्यते तमसावृता ।
सर्वार्थान्विपरीतांश्च बुद्धिः सा पार्थ तामसी ॥
verses.transliteration:
adharmaṃ dharmamiti yā manyate tamasāvṛtā.
sarvārthānviparītāṃśca buddhiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey paartha ! tamas (ajnyaana andha:kaara) se aavrita jo buddhi adharma ko hee dharma maanatee hai aura sabhee padaarthon ko vipareeta roopa se jaanatee hai, vaha buddhi taamasee hai

verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
धृत्या यया धारयते मनःप्राणेन्द्रियक्रियाः ।
योगेनाव्यभिचारिण्या धृतिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी ॥
verses.transliteration:
dhṛtyā yayā dhārayate manaḥprāṇendriyakriyāḥ.
yogenāvyabhicāriṇyā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī
verses.hinglishMeaning: Saattvikee hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Saattvikee hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यया तु धर्मकामार्थान्धृत्या धारयतेऽर्जुन ।
प्रसङ्गेन फलाकाङ्क्षी धृतिः सा पार्थ राजसी ॥
verses.transliteration:
yayā tu dharmakāmārthāndhṛtyā dhārayate.arjuna.
prasaṅgena phalākāṅkṣī dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha rājasī
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey prithaaputra Arjun ! karmaphala kaa ichchhuka purusha ati aasakti (prasanga) se jisa dhriti ke dvaaraa dharma, artha aura kaama (ina teena purushaarthon) ko dhaarana karataa hai, vaha dhriti raajasee hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey prithaaputra Arjun ! karmaphala kaa ichchhuka purusha ati aasakti (prasanga) se jisa dhriti ke dvaaraa dharma, artha aura kaama (ina teena purushaarthon) ko dhaarana karataa hai, vaha dhriti raajasee hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
यया स्वप्नं भयं शोकं विषादं मदमेव च ।
न विमुञ्चति दुर्मेधा धृतिः सा पार्थ तामसी ॥
verses.transliteration:
yayā svapnaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ viṣādaṃ madameva ca.
na vimuñcati durmedhā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī
verses.hinglishMeaning: Ho paartha ! durbuddhi purusha jisa dhaaranaa ke dvaaraa, svapna, bhaya, shoka, vishaada aura mada ko naheen tyaagataa hai, vaha dhriti taamasee hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Ho paartha ! durbuddhi purusha jisa dhaaranaa ke dvaaraa, svapna, bhaya, shoka, vishaada aura mada ko naheen tyaagataa hai, vaha dhriti taamasee hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सुखं त्विदानीं त्रिविधं शृणु मे भरतर्षभ ।
अभ्यासाद्रमते यत्र दुःखान्तं च निगच्छति ॥
verses.transliteration:
sukhaṃ tvidānīṃ trividhaṃ śṛṇu me bharatarṣabha.
abhyāsādramate yatra duḥkhāntaṃ ca nigacchati
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey bharatashreshtha ! aba tuma trividha sukha ko mujhase suno, jisamen (saadhaka purusha) abhyaasa se ramataa hai aura du:khon ke anta ko praapta hotaa hai (jahaan usake du:khon kaa anta ho jaataa hai.)
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey bharatashreshtha ! aba tuma trividha sukha ko mujhase suno, jisamen (saadhaka purusha) abhyaasa se ramataa hai aura du:khon ke anta ko praapta hotaa hai (jahaan usake du:khon kaa anta ho jaataa hai.). Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
यत्तदग्रे विषमिव परिणामेऽमृतोपमम् ।
तत्सुखं सात्त्विकं प्रोक्तमात्मबुद्धिप्रसादजम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yattadagre viṣamiva pariṇāme.amṛtopamam.
tatsukhaṃ sāttvikaṃ proktamātmabuddhiprasādajam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo sukha prathama (praarambha men) visha ke samaana (bhaasataa) hai, parantu parinaama men amrita ke samaana hai, vaha aatmabuddhi ke prasaada se utpanna sukha saattvika kahaa gayaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo sukha prathama (praarambha men) visha ke samaana (bhaasataa) hai, parantu parinaama men amrita ke samaana hai, vaha aatmabuddhi ke prasaada se utpanna sukha saattvika kahaa gayaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
विषयेन्द्रियसंयोगाद्यत्तदग्रेऽमृतोपमम् ।
परिणामे विषमिव तत्सुखं राजसं स्मृतम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
viṣayendriyasaṃyogādyattadagre.amṛtopamam.
pariṇāme viṣamiva tatsukhaṃ rājasaṃ smṛtam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo sukha vishayon aura indriyon ke sanyoga se utpanna hotaa hai, vaha prathama to amrita ke samaana, parantu parinaama men visha tulya hotaa hai, vaha sukha raajasa kahaa gayaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo sukha vishayon aura indriyon ke sanyoga se utpanna hotaa hai, vaha prathama to amrita ke samaana, parantu parinaama men visha tulya hotaa hai, vaha sukha raajasa kahaa gayaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apne gunon aur pravrittiyon ko pehchaan kar unse upar uthna hi vikas hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यदग्रे चानुबन्धे च सुखं मोहनमात्मनः ।
निद्रालस्यप्रमादोत्थं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadagre cānubandhe ca sukhaṃ mohanamātmanaḥ.
nidrālasyapramādotthaṃ tattāmasamudāhṛtam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo sukha praarambha men aura parinaama (anubandha) men bhee atma (manushya) ko mohita karane vaalaa hotaa hai, vaha nidraa, aalasya aura pramaada se utpanna sukha taamasa kahaa jaataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo sukha praarambha men aura parinaama (anubandha) men bhee atma (manushya) ko mohita karane vaalaa hotaa hai, vaha nidraa, aalasya aura pramaada se utpanna sukha taamasa kahaa jaataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
न तदस्ति पृथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः ।
सत्त्वं प्रकृतिजैर्मुक्तं यदेभिः स्यात्त्रिभिर्गुणैः ॥
verses.transliteration:
na tadasti pṛthivyāṃ vā divi deveṣu vā punaḥ.
sattvaṃ prakṛtijairmuktaṃ yadebhiḥ syāttribhirguṇaiḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Prithvee para athavaa svarga ke devataaon men aisaa koee praanee (sattvan arthaat vidyamaana vastu) naheen hai jo prakriti se utpanna ina teena gunon se mukta (rahita) ho
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Prithvee para athavaa svarga ke devataaon men aisaa koee praanee (sattvan arthaat vidyamaana vastu) naheen hai jo prakriti se utpanna ina teena gunon se mukta (rahita) ho. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apne gunon aur pravrittiyon ko pehchaan kar unse upar uthna hi vikas hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां च परन्तप ।
कर्माणि प्रविभक्तानि स्वभावप्रभवैर्गुणैः ॥
verses.transliteration:
brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca parantapa.
karmāṇi pravibhaktāni svabhāvaprabhavairguṇaiḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey parantapa! braahmanon, kshatriyon, vaishyon aura shoodron ke karma, svabhaava se utpanna gunon ke anusaara vibhakta kiye gaye hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey parantapa! braahmanon, kshatriyon, vaishyon aura shoodron ke karma, svabhaava se utpanna gunon ke anusaara vibhakta kiye gaye hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
शमो दमस्तपः शौचं क्षान्तिरार्जवमेव च ।
ज्ञानं विज्ञानमास्तिक्यं ब्रह्मकर्म स्वभावजम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śamo damastapaḥ śaucaṃ kṣāntirārjavameva ca.
jñānaṃ vijñānamāstikyaṃ brahmakarma svabhāvajam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shama, dama, tapa, shaucha, kshaanti, aarjava, jnyaana, vijnyaana aura aastikya - ye braahmana ke svaabhaavika karma hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Shama, dama, tapa, shaucha, kshaanti, aarjava, jnyaana, vijnyaana aura aastikya - ye braahmana ke svaabhaavika karma hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
शौर्यं तेजो धृतिर्दाक्ष्यं युद्धे चाप्यपलायनम् ।
दानमीश्वरभावश्च क्षात्रं कर्म स्वभावजम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śauryaṃ tejo dhṛtirdākṣyaṃ yuddhe cāpyapalāyanam.
dānamīśvarabhāvaśca kṣātraṃ karma svabhāvajam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shaurya, teja, dhriti, daakshya (dakshataa), yuddha se palaayana na karanaa, daana aura eeshvara bhaava (svaamee bhaava) - ye saba kshatriya ke svaabhaavika karma hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Shaurya, teja, dhriti, daakshya (dakshataa), yuddha se palaayana na karanaa, daana aura eeshvara bhaava (svaamee bhaava) - ye saba kshatriya ke svaabhaavika karma hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
कृषिगौरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं वैश्यकर्म स्वभावजम् ।
परिचर्यात्मकं कर्म शूद्रस्यापि स्वभावजम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
kṛṣigaurakṣyavāṇijyaṃ vaiśyakarma svabhāvajam.
paricaryātmakaṃ karma śūdrasyāpi svabhāvajam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Krishi, gaupaalana tathaa vaanijya - ye vaishya ke svaabhaavika karma hain, aura shoodra kaa svaabhaavika karma hai paricharyaa arthaat sevaa karanaa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Krishi, gaupaalana tathaa vaanijya - ye vaishya ke svaabhaavika karma hain, aura shoodra kaa svaabhaavika karma hai paricharyaa arthaat sevaa karanaa. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभते नरः ।
स्वकर्मनिरतः सिद्धिं यथा विन्दति तच्छृणु ॥
verses.transliteration:
sve sve karmaṇyabhirataḥ saṃsiddhiṃ labhate naraḥ.
svakarmanirataḥ siddhiṃ yathā vindati tacchṛṇu
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo purusha saba karma brahma men arpana karake aura aasakti ko tyaagakara karataa hai, vaha purusha kamala ke patte ke sadrisha paapa se lipta naheen hotaa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo purusha saba karma brahma men arpana karake aura aasakti ko tyaagakara karataa hai, vaha purusha kamala ke patte ke sadrisha paapa se lipta naheen hotaa. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां येन सर्वमिदं ततम् ।
स्वकर्मणा तमभ्यर्च्य सिद्धिं विन्दति मानवः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yataḥ pravṛttirbhūtānāṃ yena sarvamidaṃ tatam.
svakarmaṇā tamabhyarcya siddhiṃ vindati mānavaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jisa (paramatma) se bhootamaatra kee pravritti arthaat utpatti huee hai aura jisase yaha sampoorna jagat vyaapta hai, usa (paramatma) kee svakarma dvaaraa poojaa karake manushya siddhi ko praapta hotaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jisa (paramatma) se bhootamaatra kee pravritti arthaat utpatti huee hai aura jisase yaha sampoorna jagat vyaapta hai, usa (paramatma) kee svakarma dvaaraa poojaa karake manushya siddhi ko praapta hotaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात् ।
स्वभावनियतं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śreyānsvadharmo viguṇaḥ paradharmātsvanuṣṭhitāt.
svabhāvaniyataṃ karma kurvannāpnoti kilbiṣam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Samyak anushthita paradharma kee apekshaa gunarahita svadharma shreshtha hai. (kyonki) svabhaava se niyata kiye gaye karma ko karate hue manushya paapa ko naheen praapta karataa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Samyak anushthita paradharma kee apekshaa gunarahita svadharma shreshtha hai. (kyonki) svabhaava se niyata kiye gaye karma ko karate hue manushya paapa ko naheen praapta karataa. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न त्यजेत् ।
सर्वारम्भा हि दोषेण धूमेनाग्निरिवावृताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sahajaṃ karma kaunteya sadoṣamapi na tyajet.
sarvārambhā hi doṣeṇa dhūmenāgnirivāvṛtāḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey kaunteya ! doshayukta hone para bhee sahaja karma ko naheen tyaaganaa chaahie; kyonki sabhee karma dosha se aavrita hote hai, jaise dhuyen se agni
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey kaunteya ! doshayukta hone para bhee sahaja karma ko naheen tyaaganaa chaahie; kyonki sabhee karma dosha se aavrita hote hai, jaise dhuyen se agni. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
असक्तबुद्धिः सर्वत्र जितात्मा विगतस्पृहः ।
नैष्कर्म्यसिद्धिं परमां संन्यासेनाधिगच्छति ॥
verses.transliteration:
asaktabuddhiḥ sarvatra jitātmā vigataspṛhaḥ.
naiṣkarmyasiddhiṃ paramāṃ saṃnyāsenādhigacchati
verses.hinglishMeaning: Sarvatra aasakti rahita buddhi vaalaa vaha purusha jo sprihaarahita tathaa jitatma hai, sannyaasa ke dvaaraa parama nairshkamya siddhi ko praapta hotaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Sarvatra aasakti rahita buddhi vaalaa vaha purusha jo sprihaarahita tathaa jitatma hai, sannyaasa ke dvaaraa parama nairshkamya siddhi ko praapta hotaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
सिद्धिं प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाप्नोति निबोध मे ।
समासेनैव कौन्तेय निष्ठा ज्ञानस्य या परा ॥
verses.transliteration:
siddhiṃ prāpto yathā brahma tathāpnoti nibodha me.
samāsenaiva kaunteya niṣṭhā jñānasya yā parā
verses.hinglishMeaning: Siddhi ko praapta purusha kisa prakaara brahma ko praapta hotaa hai, tathaa jnyaana kee paraa nishthaa ko bhee tuma mujhase sankshepa men jaano
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Siddhi ko praapta purusha kisa prakaara brahma ko praapta hotaa hai, tathaa jnyaana kee paraa nishthaa ko bhee tuma mujhase sankshepa men jaano. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
बुद्ध्या विशुद्धया युक्तो धृत्यात्मानं नियम्य च ।
शब्दादीन्विषयांस्त्यक्त्वा रागद्वेषौ व्युदस्य च ॥
verses.transliteration:
buddhyā viśuddhayā yukto dhṛtyātmānaṃ niyamya ca.
śabdādīnviṣayāṃstyaktvā rāgadveṣau vyudasya ca
verses.hinglishMeaning: Vishuddha buddhi se yukta, dhriti se aatmasanyama kara, shabdaadi vishayon ko tyaaga kara aura raaga-dvesha kaa parityaaga kara....৷৷৷৷
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Vishuddha buddhi se yukta, dhriti se aatmasanyama kara, shabdaadi vishayon ko tyaaga kara aura raaga-dvesha kaa parityaaga kara....৷৷৷৷. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
विविक्तसेवी लघ्वाशी यतवाक्कायमानसः ।
ध्यानयोगपरो नित्यं वैराग्यं समुपाश्रितः ॥
verses.transliteration:
viviktasevī laghvāśī yatavākkāyamānasaḥ.
dhyānayogaparo nityaṃ vairāgyaṃ samupāśritaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Vivikta sevee, laghvaashee (mitaahaaree) jisane apane shareera, vaanee aura mana ko sanyata kiyaa hai, dhyaanayoga ke abhyaasa men sadaiva tatpara tathaa vairaagya para samaashrita
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Vivikta sevee, laghvaashee (mitaahaaree) jisane apane shareera, vaanee aura mana ko sanyata kiyaa hai, dhyaanayoga ke abhyaasa men sadaiva tatpara tathaa vairaagya para samaashrita. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अहंकारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम् ।
विमुच्य निर्ममः शान्तो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahaṃkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ parigraham.
vimucya nirmamaḥ śānto brahmabhūyāya kalpate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Ahankaara, bala, darpa, kaama, krodha aura parigraha ko tyaaga kara mamatvabhaava se rahita aura shaanta purusha brahma praapti ke yogya bana jaataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Ahankaara, bala, darpa, kaama, krodha aura parigraha ko tyaaga kara mamatvabhaava se rahita aura shaanta purusha brahma praapti ke yogya bana jaataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Asakti kam karne se karm halka, spasht aur shant ho jata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति ।
समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्तिं लभते पराम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahmabhūtaḥ prasannātmā na śocati na kāṅkṣati.
samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu madbhaktiṃ labhate parām
verses.hinglishMeaning: Brahmabhoota (jo saadhaka brahma bana gayaa hai), prasanna mana vaalaa purusha na ichchhaa karataa hai aura na shoka, samasta bhooton ke prati sama hokara vaha meree paraa bhakti ko praapta karataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Brahmabhoota (jo saadhaka brahma bana gayaa hai), prasanna mana vaalaa purusha na ichchhaa karataa hai aura na shoka, samasta bhooton ke prati sama hokara vaha meree paraa bhakti ko praapta karataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
भक्त्या मामभिजानाति यावान्यश्चास्मि तत्त्वतः ।
ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhaktyā māmabhijānāti yāvānyaścāsmi tattvataḥ.
tato māṃ tattvato jñātvā viśate tadanantaram
verses.hinglishMeaning: (usa paraa) bhakti ke dvaaraa mujhey vaha tattvata: jaanataa hai ki main kitanaa (vyaapaka) hoon tathaa main kyaa hoon. (isa prakaara) tattvata: jaanane ke pashchaat tatkaala hee vaha mujhamen pravesha kara jaataa hai, arthaat matsvaroopa bana jaataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: (usa paraa) bhakti ke dvaaraa mujhey vaha tattvata: jaanataa hai ki main kitanaa (vyaapaka) hoon tathaa main kyaa hoon. (isa prakaara) tattvata: jaanane ke pashchaat tatkaala hee vaha mujhamen pravesha kara jaataa hai, arthaat matsvaroopa bana jaataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वकर्माण्यपि सदा कुर्वाणो मद्व्यपाश्रयः ।
मत्प्रसादादवाप्नोति शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sarvakarmāṇyapi sadā kurvāṇo madvyapāśrayaḥ.
matprasādādavāpnoti śāśvataṃ padamavyayam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo purusha madaashrita hokara sadaiva samasta karmon ko karataa hai, vaha mere prasaada (anugraha) se shaashvata, avyaya pada ko praapta kara letaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo purusha madaashrita hokara sadaiva samasta karmon ko karataa hai, vaha mere prasaada (anugraha) se shaashvata, avyaya pada ko praapta kara letaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः ।
बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः सततं भव ॥
verses.transliteration:
cetasā sarvakarmāṇi mayi saṃnyasya matparaḥ.
buddhiyogamupāśritya maccittaḥ satataṃ bhava
verses.hinglishMeaning: Mana se samasta karmon kaa sannyaasa mujhamen karake matparaayana hokara buddhiyoga kaa aashraya lekara tuma satata machchitta bano
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Mana se samasta karmon kaa sannyaasa mujhamen karake matparaayana hokara buddhiyoga kaa aashraya lekara tuma satata machchitta bano. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
मच्चित्तः सर्वदुर्गाणि मत्प्रसादात्तरिष्यसि ।
अथ चेत्त्वमहंकारान्न श्रोष्यसि विनङ्क्ष्यसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
maccittaḥ sarvadurgāṇi matprasādāttariṣyasi.
atha cettvamahaṃkārānna śroṣyasi vinaṅkṣyasi
verses.hinglishMeaning: Machchitta hokara tuma meree kripaa se samasta kathinaaiyon (sarvadurgaani) ko paara kara jaaoge; aura yadi ahankaaravasha (isa upadesha ko) naheen sunoge, to tuma nashta ho jaaoge
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Machchitta hokara tuma meree kripaa se samasta kathinaaiyon (sarvadurgaani) ko paara kara jaaoge; aura yadi ahankaaravasha (isa upadesha ko) naheen sunoge, to tuma nashta ho jaaoge. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
यदहंकारमाश्रित्य न योत्स्य इति मन्यसे ।
मिथ्यैष व्यवसायस्ते प्रकृतिस्त्वां नियोक्ष्यति ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadahaṃkāramāśritya na yotsya iti manyase.
mithyaiṣa vyavasāyaste prakṛtistvāṃ niyokṣyati
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aura ahankaaravasha tuma jo yaha socha rahey ho, "main yuddha naheen karoongaa", yaha tumhaaraa nishchaya mithyaa hai, (kyonki) prakriti (tumhaaraa svabhaava) hee tumhen (balaat karma men) pravritta karegee
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Aura ahankaaravasha tuma jo yaha socha rahey ho, "main yuddha naheen karoongaa", yaha tumhaaraa nishchaya mithyaa hai, (kyonki) prakriti (tumhaaraa svabhaava) hee tumhen (balaat karma men) pravritta karegee. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वभावजेन कौन्तेय निबद्धः स्वेन कर्मणा ।
कर्तुं नेच्छसि यन्मोहात्करिष्यस्यवशोपि तत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
svabhāvajena kaunteya nibaddhaḥ svena karmaṇā.
kartuṃ necchasi yanmohātkariṣyasyavaśopi tat
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey kaunteya ! tuma apane svaabhaavika karmon se bandhey ho, (ata:) mohavashaat jisa karma ko tuma karanaa naheen chaahate ho, vahee tuma vivasha hokara karoge
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey kaunteya ! tuma apane svaabhaavika karmon se bandhey ho, (ata:) mohavashaat jisa karma ko tuma karanaa naheen chaahate ho, vahee tuma vivasha hokara karoge. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां हृद्देशेऽर्जुन तिष्ठति ।
भ्रामयन्सर्वभूतानि यन्त्रारूढानि मायया ॥
verses.transliteration:
īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ hṛddeśe.arjuna tiṣṭhati.
bhrāmayansarvabhūtāni yantrārūḍhāni māyayā
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun (maanon kisee) yantra para aaroodha samasta bhooton ko eeshvara apanee maayaa se ghumaataa huaa (bhraamayan) bhootamaatra ke hridaya men sthita rahataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey Arjun (maanon kisee) yantra para aaroodha samasta bhooton ko eeshvara apanee maayaa se ghumaataa huaa (bhraamayan) bhootamaatra ke hridaya men sthita rahataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
तमेव शरणं गच्छ सर्वभावेन भारत ।
तत्प्रसादात्परां शान्तिं स्थानं प्राप्स्यसि शाश्वतम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
tameva śaraṇaṃ gaccha sarvabhāvena bhārata.
tatprasādātparāṃ śāntiṃ sthānaṃ prāpsyasi śāśvatam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey bhaarata ! tuma sampoorna bhaava se usee (eeshvara) kee sharana men jaao. usake prasaada se tuma parama shaanti aura shaashvata sthaana ko praapta karoge
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey bhaarata ! tuma sampoorna bhaava se usee (eeshvara) kee sharana men jaao. usake prasaada se tuma parama shaanti aura shaashvata sthaana ko praapta karoge. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया ।
विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु ॥
verses.transliteration:
iti te jñānamākhyātaṃ guhyādguhyataraṃ mayā.
vimṛśyaitadaśeṣeṇa yathecchasi tathā kuru
verses.hinglishMeaning: Isa prakaara samasta gopaneeyon se adhika guhya jnyaana mainne tumase kahaa; isa para poorna vichaara (vimrishya) karane ke pashchaat tumhaaree jaisee ichchhaa ho, vaisaa tuma karo
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Isa prakaara samasta gopaneeyon se adhika guhya jnyaana mainne tumase kahaa; isa para poorna vichaara (vimrishya) karane ke pashchaat tumhaaree jaisee ichchhaa ho, vaisaa tuma karo. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः शृणु मे परमं वचः ।
इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sarvaguhyatamaṃ bhūyaḥ śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ.
iṣṭo.asi me dṛḍhamiti tato vakṣyāmi te hitam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Puna: eka baara tuma mujhase samasta guhyon men guhyatama parama vachana (upadesha) ko suno. tuma mujhey atishaya priya ho, isalie main tumhen tumhaare hita kee baata kahoongaa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Puna: eka baara tuma mujhase samasta guhyon men guhyatama parama vachana (upadesha) ko suno. tuma mujhey atishaya priya ho, isalie main tumhen tumhaare hita kee baata kahoongaa. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु ।
मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे ॥
verses.transliteration:
manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru.
māmevaiṣyasi satyaṃ te pratijāne priyo.asi me
verses.hinglishMeaning: Tuma machchita, madbhakta aura mere poojaka (madyaajee) bano aura mujhey namaskaara karo; (isa prakaara) tuma mujhey hee praapta hoge; yaha main tumhey satya vachana detaa hoon,(kyonki) tuma mere priya ho
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Tuma machchita, madbhakta aura mere poojaka (madyaajee) bano aura mujhey namaskaara karo; (isa prakaara) tuma mujhey hee praapta hoge; yaha main tumhey satya vachana detaa hoon,(kyonki) tuma mere priya ho. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज ।
अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sarvadharmānparityajya māmekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja.
ahaṃ tvāṃ sarvapāpebhyo mokṣyayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Saba dharmon kaa parityaaga karake tuma eka meree hee sharana men aao, main tumhen samasta paapon se mukta kara doongaa, tuma shoka mata karo
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Saba dharmon kaa parityaaga karake tuma eka meree hee sharana men aao, main tumhen samasta paapon se mukta kara doongaa, tuma shoka mata karo. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Dharma ka sahara lekar kathin faisle bhi shuddh bhav se liye ja sakte hain.

verses.sanskrit:
इदं ते नातपस्काय नाभक्ताय कदाचन ।
न चाशुश्रूषवे वाच्यं न च मां योऽभ्यसूयति ॥
verses.transliteration:
idaṃ te nātapaskāya nābhaktāya kadācana.
na cāśuśrūṣave vācyaṃ na ca māṃ yo.abhyasūyati
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yaha jnyaana aise purusha se naheen kahanaa chaahie, jo atapaska (taparahita) hai, aura na use jo abhakta hai; use bhee naheen jo ashushrushu (sevaa men atatpara) hai aura usa purusha se bhee naheen kahanaa chaahie, jo mujha (eeshvara) se asooyaa karataa hai, arthaat mujha men dosha dekhataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Yaha jnyaana aise purusha se naheen kahanaa chaahie, jo atapaska (taparahita) hai, aura na use jo abhakta hai; use bhee naheen jo ashushrushu (sevaa men atatpara) hai aura usa purusha se bhee naheen kahanaa chaahie, jo mujha (eeshvara) se asooyaa karataa hai, arthaat mujha men dosha dekhataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
य इदं परमं गुह्यं मद्भक्तेष्वभिधास्यति ।
भक्तिं मयि परां कृत्वा मामेवैष्यत्यसंशयः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ya idaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ madbhakteṣvabhidhāsyati.
bhaktiṃ mayi parāṃ kṛtvā māmevaiṣyatyasaṃśayaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo purusha mujhase parama prema (paraa bhakti) karake isa parama guhya jnyaana kaa upadesha mere bhakton ko detaa hai, vaha ni:sandeha mujhey hee praapta hotaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo purusha mujhase parama prema (paraa bhakti) karake isa parama guhya jnyaana kaa upadesha mere bhakton ko detaa hai, vaha ni:sandeha mujhey hee praapta hotaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
न च तस्मान्मनुष्येषु कश्चिन्मे प्रियकृत्तमः ।
भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि ॥
verses.transliteration:
na ca tasmānmanuṣyeṣu kaścinme priyakṛttamaḥ.
bhavitā na ca me tasmādanyaḥ priyataro bhuvi
verses.hinglishMeaning: Na to usase badhakara meraa atishaya priya kaarya karane vaalaa manushyon men koee hai aura na usase badhakara meraa priya isa prithvee para doosaraa koee hogaa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Na to usase badhakara meraa atishaya priya kaarya karane vaalaa manushyon men koee hai aura na usase badhakara meraa priya isa prithvee para doosaraa koee hogaa. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः ।
ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहमिष्टः स्यामिति मे मतिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
adhyeṣyate ca ya imaṃ dharmyaṃ saṃvādamāvayoḥ.
jñānayajñena tenāhamiṣṭaḥ syāmiti me matiḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo purusha, hama donon ke isa dharmamaya sanvaada kaa pathana karegaa, usake dvaaraa main jnyaanayajnya se poojita hooongaa - aisaa meraa mata hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo purusha, hama donon ke isa dharmamaya sanvaada kaa pathana karegaa, usake dvaaraa main jnyaanayajnya se poojita hooongaa - aisaa meraa mata hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च शृणुयादपि यो नरः ।
सोऽपि मुक्तः शुभाँल्लोकान्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यकर्मणाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śraddhāvānanasūyaśca śṛṇuyādapi yo naraḥ.
so.api muktaḥ śubhā.Nllokānprāpnuyātpuṇyakarmaṇām
verses.hinglishMeaning: Tathaa jo shraddhaavaan aura anasuyu (doshadrishti rahita) purusha isakaa shravanamaatra bhee karegaa, vaha bhee (paapon se) mukta hokara punyakarmiyon ke shubha (shreshtha) lokon ko praapta kara legaa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Tathaa jo shraddhaavaan aura anasuyu (doshadrishti rahita) purusha isakaa shravanamaatra bhee karegaa, vaha bhee (paapon se) mukta hokara punyakarmiyon ke shubha (shreshtha) lokon ko praapta kara legaa. verses.sanskrit:
कच्चिदेतच्छ्रुतं पार्थ त्वयैकाग्रेण चेतसा ।
कच्चिदज्ञानसम्मोहः प्रनष्टस्ते धनञ्जय ॥
verses.transliteration:
kaccidetacchrutaṃ pārtha tvayaikāgreṇa cetasā.
kaccidajñānasammohaḥ pranaṣṭaste dhanañjaya
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey paartha ! kyaa ise (mere upadesha ko) tumane ekaagrachitta hokara shravana kiyaa ? aura hey dhananyjaya ! kyaa tumhaaraa ajnyaana janita sanmoha poornatayaa nashta huaa ?

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
नष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्लब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाच्युत ।
स्थितोऽस्मि गतसन्देहः करिष्ये वचनं तव ॥
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvāca.
naṣṭo mohaḥ smṛtirlabdhā tvatprasādānmayācyuta.
sthito.asmi gatasandehaḥ kariṣye vacanaṃ tava
verses.hinglishMeaning: Arjun ne kahaa -- hey achyuta ! aapake kripaaprasaada se meraa moha nashta ho gayaa hai, aura mujhey smriti (jnyaana) praapta ho gayee hai? aba main sanshayarahita ho gayaa hoon aura main aapake vachana (aajnyaa) kaa paalana karoongaa

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच ।
इत्यहं वासुदेवस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः ।
संवादमिममश्रौषमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvāca.
ityahaṃ vāsudevasya pārthasya ca mahātmanaḥ.
saṃvādamimamaśrauṣamadbhutaṃ romaharṣaṇam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Sanjaya ne kahaa -- isa prakaara mainne bhagavaan vaasudeva aura mahatma Arjun ke isa adbhuta aura romaanchaka sanvaada kaa varnana kiyaa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Sanjaya ne kahaa -- isa prakaara mainne bhagavaan vaasudeva aura mahatma Arjun ke isa adbhuta aura romaanchaka sanvaada kaa varnana kiyaa. verses.sanskrit:
व्यासप्रसादाच्छ्रुतवानेतद्गुह्यमहं परम् ।
योगं योगेश्वरात्कृष्णात्साक्षात्कथयतः स्वयम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
vyāsaprasādācchrutavānetadguhyamahaṃ param.
yogaṃ yogeśvarātkṛṣṇātsākṣātkathayataḥ svayam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Vyaasa jee kee kripaa se mainne isa param guhya yoga ko saakshaat kahate hue svayan yogoshvara shreeKrishna bhagavaan se sunaa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Vyaasa jee kee kripaa se mainne isa param guhya yoga ko saakshaat kahate hue svayan yogoshvara shreeKrishna bhagavaan se sunaa. verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
राजन्संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य संवादमिममद्भुतम् ।
केशवार्जुनयोः पुण्यं हृष्यामि च मुहुर्मुहुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
rājansaṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya saṃvādamimamadbhutam.
keśavārjunayoḥ puṇyaṃ hṛṣyāmi ca muhurmuhuḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey raajan ! bhagavaan keshava aura Arjun ke isa adbhuta aura punya (pavitra) sanvaada ko smarana karake main baarambaara harshita hotaa hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey raajan ! bhagavaan keshava aura Arjun ke isa adbhuta aura punya (pavitra) sanvaada ko smarana karake main baarambaara harshita hotaa hoon. verses.sanskrit:
तच्च संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य रूपमत्यद्भुतं हरेः ।
विस्मयो मे महान् राजन्हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tacca saṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya rūpamatyadbhutaṃ hareḥ.
vismayo me mahān rājanhṛṣyāmi ca punaḥ punaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey raajana ! shree hari ke ati adbhuta roopa ko bhee puna: puna: smarana karake mujhey mahaan vismaya hotaa hai aura main baarambaara harshita ho rahaa hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey raajana ! shree hari ke ati adbhuta roopa ko bhee puna: puna: smarana karake mujhey mahaan vismaya hotaa hai aura main baarambaara harshita ho rahaa hoon. verses.sanskrit:
यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः ।
तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम ॥
verses.transliteration:
yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanurdharaḥ.
tatra śrīrvijayo bhūtirdhruvā nītirmatirmama
